//! StatusNotifierWatcher host.
//!
//! Tray applications (Steam, CoreCtrl, music players, Discord, …) speak the
//! `org.kde.StatusNotifierItem` protocol. For their registration call to go
//! anywhere, something has to own `org.kde.StatusNotifierWatcher` on the
//! session bus. Waybar / Plasma do this; bare Sway+this-shell does not, which
//! is why SNI apps silently disappear without a host. This module is that host.
//!
//! It's a pure D-Bus background thread — no window, no layer surface. The
//! tray_popup overlay queries `RegisteredStatusNotifierItems` on startup.

use std::collections::HashSet;
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};

#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct TrayWatcher {
    items: Arc<Mutex<HashSet<String>>>,
}

#[zbus::interface(name = "org.kde.StatusNotifierWatcher")]
impl TrayWatcher {
    fn register_status_notifier_item(
        &self,
        service: String,
        #[zbus(header)] hdr: zbus::message::Header<'_>,
    ) -> zbus::fdo::Result<()> {
        // Finding 54: bound input length + item count. A same-user process
        // can call this in a loop with unique strings; unbounded HashSet
        // growth OOMs the bar → lockscreen children die.
        const MAX_SERVICE_LEN: usize = 250;
        const MAX_ITEMS: usize = 500;
        if service.len() > MAX_SERVICE_LEN {
            crate::dbg_log!(
                "[tray-watcher] reject oversize service ({} bytes)",
                service.len()
            );
            return Ok(());
        }
        {
            let g = self.items.lock().unwrap();
            if g.len() >= MAX_ITEMS && !g.contains(&normalize_service(&service)) {
                crate::dbg_log!("[tray-watcher] reject registration: at cap ({})", MAX_ITEMS);
                return Ok(());
            }
        }
        // Some clients (ayatana-style, e.g. Steam) send just the object path.
        // Fall back to the sender's unique bus name so the item is reachable.
        let entry = if service.starts_with('/') {
            let sender = hdr
                .sender()
                .map(|s| s.as_str().to_string())
                .unwrap_or_default();
            format!("{}{}", sender, service)
        } else {
            normalize_service(&service)
        };
        let is_new = self.items.lock().unwrap().insert(entry.clone());
        if is_new {
            eprintln!("[tray-watcher] registered: {}", entry);
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    fn register_status_notifier_host(&self, service: String) -> zbus::fdo::Result<()> {
        eprintln!("[tray-watcher] host registered: {}", service);
        Ok(())
    }

    #[zbus(property)]
    fn registered_status_notifier_items(&self) -> Vec<String> {
        self.items.lock().unwrap().iter().cloned().collect()
    }

    #[zbus(property)]
    fn is_status_notifier_host_registered(&self) -> bool {
        true
    }

    #[zbus(property)]
    fn protocol_version(&self) -> i32 {
        0
    }
}

fn normalize_service(s: &str) -> String {
    // Registration strings are one of:
    //   ":1.42"                            (well-known bus name, default path)
    //   "org.kde.StatusNotifierItem-1234"  (well-known service name)
    //   ":1.42/org/ayatana/.../steam"      (explicit object path)
    if let Some(idx) = s.find('/') {
        format!("{}{}", &s[..idx], &s[idx..])
    } else {
        format!("{}/StatusNotifierItem", s)
    }
}

pub fn spawn() {
    std::thread::spawn(|| {
        let rt = match tokio::runtime::Builder::new_current_thread()
            .enable_all()
            .build()
        {
            Ok(r) => r,
            Err(e) => {
                eprintln!("[tray-watcher] rt build: {e}");
                return;
            }
        };
        rt.block_on(async move {
            let watcher = TrayWatcher {
                items: Arc::new(Mutex::new(HashSet::new())),
            };
            let conn = zbus::connection::Builder::session()
                .and_then(|b| b.name("org.kde.StatusNotifierWatcher"))
                .and_then(|b| b.serve_at("/StatusNotifierWatcher", watcher))
                .expect("zbus builder")
                .build()
                .await;
            match conn {
                Ok(_c) => {
                    eprintln!("[tray-watcher] org.kde.StatusNotifierWatcher owned");
                    std::future::pending::<()>().await;
                    let _ = _c;
                }
                Err(e) => eprintln!("[tray-watcher] serve failed: {e}"),
            }
        });
    });
}

// ── SNI client side: enumeration, icons, activation ────────────────

use sha2::Digest;

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct TrayItem {
    pub bus: String,
    pub path: String,
    pub id: String,
    pub title: String,
    pub icon_path: Option<String>,
    pub tooltip: String,
}

pub async fn fetch_tray_items(cache: Vec<TrayItem>) -> Vec<TrayItem> {
    let conn = match zbus::Connection::session().await {
        Ok(c) => c,
        Err(e) => {
            eprintln!("[tray-fetch] session bus: {e}");
            return Vec::new();
        }
    };
    let watcher = match zbus::Proxy::new(
        &conn,
        "org.kde.StatusNotifierWatcher",
        "/StatusNotifierWatcher",
        "org.kde.StatusNotifierWatcher",
    )
    .await
    {
        Ok(p) => p,
        Err(e) => {
            eprintln!("[tray-fetch] watcher proxy: {e}");
            return Vec::new();
        }
    };
    let raw_items: Vec<String> = match watcher.get_property("RegisteredStatusNotifierItems").await {
        Ok(v) => v,
        Err(e) => {
            eprintln!("[tray-fetch] RegisteredStatusNotifierItems: {e}");
            return Vec::new();
        }
    };

    // Finding 56: cap enumeration. Chained from finding 54 — a hostile
    // process that registered N names now drives N Proxy::new calls,
    // each blocking up to 25s on timeout. 200 is 10× real systems; caps
    // worst-case to 200 * 25s = 83 min. Combined with the refetch
    // cadence, only one stalled fetch at a time.
    const MAX_ITEMS: usize = 200;
    if raw_items.len() > MAX_ITEMS {
        crate::dbg_log!(
            "[tray-fetch] capping item enumeration {} → {}",
            raw_items.len(),
            MAX_ITEMS
        );
    }
    // Deduplicate raw items by their object path. Steam and other apps
    // leak old bus names, which causes timeouts and blocked fetches.
    let mut seen_paths = std::collections::HashSet::new();
    let mut filtered_raw_items = Vec::new();
    for raw in raw_items {
        let path = if let Some(idx) = raw.find('/') { &raw[idx..] } else { &raw };
        if seen_paths.insert(path.to_string()) {
            filtered_raw_items.push(raw);
        }
    }

    let mut out: Vec<TrayItem> = Vec::new();
    let mut seen_names: std::collections::HashMap<String, usize> = std::collections::HashMap::new();
    for raw in filtered_raw_items.into_iter().take(MAX_ITEMS) {
        let Some((bus, path)) = parse_registered(&raw) else {
            continue;
        };
        // Finding 56: per-item timeout (3s). Bounds the total fetch time
        // when combined with MAX_ITEMS. A hung peer no longer stalls the
        // whole enumeration at the D-Bus default 25s.
        let proxy_result = tokio::time::timeout(
            std::time::Duration::from_secs(2),
            zbus::Proxy::new(
                &conn,
                bus.as_str(),
                path.as_str(),
                "org.kde.StatusNotifierItem",
            ),
        )
        .await;
        
        let proxy = match proxy_result {
            Ok(Ok(p)) => p,
            Ok(Err(e)) => {
                eprintln!("[tray-fetch] {} proxy error: {e}", raw);
                if let Some(c) = cache.iter().find(|i| i.bus == bus && i.path == path) {
                    out.push(c.clone());
                }
                continue;
            }
            Err(_) => {
                eprintln!("[tray-fetch] {} proxy timeout", raw);
                if let Some(c) = cache.iter().find(|i| i.bus == bus && i.path == path) {
                    out.push(c.clone());
                }
                continue;
            }
        };
        // Finding 38: cap SNI strings before display.
        const MAX_ID: usize = 128;
        const MAX_TITLE: usize = 512;
        const MAX_ICON_NAME: usize = 128;
        let id_res = proxy.get_property::<String>("Id").await;
        let id: String = id_res.ok().map(|s| s.chars().take(MAX_ID).collect()).unwrap_or_default();
        
        if id.is_empty() {
            eprintln!("[tray-fetch] empty id for {}, using cache", raw);
            if let Some(c) = cache.iter().find(|i| i.bus == bus && i.path == path) {
                out.push(c.clone());
            }
            continue;
        }

        let mut title: String = proxy
            .get_property::<String>("Title")
            .await
            .ok()
            .map(|s| s.chars().take(MAX_TITLE).collect())
            .unwrap_or_default();



        let icon_name: String = proxy
            .get_property::<String>("IconName")
            .await
            .ok()
            .map(|s| s.chars().take(MAX_ICON_NAME).collect())
            .unwrap_or_default();
        let mut icon_path = if !icon_name.is_empty() {
            resolve_icon(&icon_name)
        } else {
            None
        };
        if icon_path.is_none() {
            if let Ok(pixmaps) = proxy
                .get_property::<Vec<(i32, i32, Vec<u8>)>>("IconPixmap")
                .await
            {
                if let Some((w, h, data)) = pixmaps.into_iter().max_by_key(|(w, h, _)| (*w, *h)) {
                    icon_path = save_pixmap(&id, w.max(0) as u32, h.max(0) as u32, &data);
                }
            }
        }
        let tooltip = match proxy
            .get_property::<(String, Vec<(i32, i32, Vec<u8>)>, String, String)>("ToolTip")
            .await
        {
            Ok((_icon, _pixmaps, ttl, sub)) => {
                let ttl = ttl.trim().to_string();
                let sub = sub.trim().to_string();
                let combined = match (ttl.is_empty(), sub.is_empty()) {
                    (true, true) => String::new(),
                    (false, true) => ttl,
                    (true, false) => sub,
                    (false, false) => format!("{} — {}", ttl, sub),
                };
                const MAX_TOOLTIP: usize = 4096;
                if combined.chars().count() > MAX_TOOLTIP {
                    combined.chars().take(MAX_TOOLTIP - 3).collect::<String>() + "..."
                } else {
                    combined
                }
            }
            Err(_) => String::new(),
        };
        eprintln!("[tray-fetch] item: {} path: {:?}", title, icon_path);
        if title.trim().is_empty() {
            title = id.clone();
        }
        
        // Skip ghost items that have no title and no icon
        if title.trim().is_empty() && icon_path.is_none() {
            eprintln!("[tray-fetch] skipping ghost item: {}", raw);
            continue;
        }

        // Deduplicate: Steam and other apps sometimes register twice
        let title_clean = title.trim().to_string();
        if let Some(&idx) = seen_names.get(&title_clean) {
            if icon_path.is_some() && out[idx].icon_path.is_none() {
                eprintln!("[tray-fetch] replacing duplicate {} with better icon", title_clean);
                out[idx] = TrayItem {
                    bus,
                    path,
                    id,
                    title: title_clean.clone(),
                    icon_path,
                    tooltip,
                };
            }
            continue;
        }
        
        seen_names.insert(title_clean, out.len());
        out.push(TrayItem {
            bus,
            path,
            id,
            title,
            icon_path,
            tooltip,
        });
    }
    
    out
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize)]
pub struct TrayMenuItem {
    pub id: i32,
    pub label: String,
    pub enabled: bool,
    pub visible: bool,
}

pub async fn get_menu_tree(bus: &str, path: &str) -> Option<(String, Vec<TrayMenuItem>)> {
    let conn = zbus::Connection::session().await.ok()?;
    let proxy = zbus::Proxy::new(&conn, bus, path, "org.kde.StatusNotifierItem")
        .await
        .ok()?;

    // Menu property is ObjectPath, not String.
    let menu_obj: zbus::zvariant::OwnedObjectPath = proxy.get_property("Menu").await.ok()?;
    let menu_path: String = menu_obj.as_str().to_string();
    if menu_path.is_empty() {
        return None;
    }

    let menu_proxy = zbus::Proxy::new(&conn, bus, menu_path.as_str(), "com.canonical.dbusmenu")
        .await
        .ok()?;
    let reply = menu_proxy
        .call_method(
            "GetLayout",
            &(0i32, -1i32, vec!["label", "enabled", "visible"]),
        )
        .await
        .ok()?;

    type RawItem = (
        i32,
        std::collections::HashMap<String, zbus::zvariant::OwnedValue>,
        Vec<zbus::zvariant::OwnedValue>,
    );
    let (_rev, layout): (u32, RawItem) = reply.body().deserialize().ok()?;

    fn parse_item(
        id: i32,
        props: std::collections::HashMap<String, zbus::zvariant::OwnedValue>,
        children: Vec<zbus::zvariant::OwnedValue>,
        depth: usize,
    ) -> Vec<TrayMenuItem> {
        // Finding 34: cap recursion depth. Real dbusmenu trees are 2-4
        // levels; a hostile provider returns 10000-deep nesting → stack
        // overflow → shell crash → lockscreen child dies → unlock window.
        const MAX_DEPTH: usize = 16;
        if depth > MAX_DEPTH {
            eprintln!(
                "[tray-menu] depth {} exceeds cap {}, truncating",
                depth, MAX_DEPTH
            );
            return Vec::new();
        }
        let mut items = Vec::new();

        let label = match props.get("label").map(|v| &**v) {
            Some(zbus::zvariant::Value::Str(s)) => s.as_str().to_string(),
            _ => String::new(),
        };
        let enabled = match props.get("enabled").map(|v| &**v) {
            Some(zbus::zvariant::Value::Bool(b)) => *b,
            _ => true,
        };
        let visible = match props.get("visible").map(|v| &**v) {
            Some(zbus::zvariant::Value::Bool(b)) => *b,
            _ => true,
        };
        let label_clean = label.replace('_', "");

        if label_clean == "-" {
            items.push(TrayMenuItem {
                id: -1,
                label: "-".into(),
                enabled: false,
                visible: true,
            });
        } else if !label_clean.is_empty() {
            items.push(TrayMenuItem {
                id,
                label: label_clean,
                enabled,
                visible,
            });
        }

        // Finding 57: cap flat width per level. Real dbusmenu trees are
        // <20 items wide; a hostile single-level 1M-children response
        // allocates 1M TrayMenuItem before depth guard (34) can fire.
        // Cap at 1000 per level — recursion depth 16 with cap 1000 means
        // worst case is 16 × 1000 = 16K items in memory regardless of
        // tree shape.
        const MAX_ITEMS_PER_LEVEL: usize = 1000;
        for c in children {
            if items.len() >= MAX_ITEMS_PER_LEVEL {
                crate::dbg_log!(
                    "[tray-menu] level width cap {} at depth {}",
                    MAX_ITEMS_PER_LEVEL,
                    depth
                );
                break;
            }
            let val: zbus::zvariant::Value = c.into();
            if let Ok((cid, cprops, ckids)) = val.downcast::<RawItem>() {
                items.extend(parse_item(cid, cprops, ckids, depth + 1));
            }
        }
        items
    }

    let items = parse_item(layout.0, layout.1, layout.2, 0);
    eprintln!("[tray-menu] found {} items", items.len());
    Some((menu_path, items))
}

pub async fn trigger_menu_item(
    bus: &str,
    menu_path: &str,
    id: i32,
) -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error + Send + Sync>> {
    let conn = zbus::Connection::session().await?;
    let proxy = zbus::Proxy::new(&conn, bus, menu_path, "com.canonical.dbusmenu").await?;
    proxy
        .call_method(
            "Event",
            &(id, "clicked", zbus::zvariant::Value::from(0i32), 0u32),
        )
        .await?;
    Ok(())
}

pub async fn activate_tray_item(
    bus: &str,
    path: &str,
) -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error + Send + Sync>> {
    let conn = zbus::Connection::session().await?;
    let proxy = zbus::Proxy::new(&conn, bus, path, "org.kde.StatusNotifierItem").await?;
    proxy.call_method("Activate", &(0i32, 0i32)).await?;
    Ok(())
}

fn parse_registered(s: &str) -> Option<(String, String)> {
    if let Some(idx) = s.find('/') {
        let (bus, path) = (&s[..idx], &s[idx..]);
        if bus.is_empty() {
            None
        } else {
            Some((bus.to_string(), path.to_string()))
        }
    } else if !s.is_empty() {
        Some((s.to_string(), "/StatusNotifierItem".to_string()))
    } else {
        None
    }
}

/// Resolve an SNI icon name to a normalized, content-hashed PNG/SVG in
/// `$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/mbs-tray/`.
///
/// **When to use this:** for tray icons (SNI items registered with
/// `org.kde.StatusNotifierWatcher`) and any other caller that needs a
/// **render-stable** icon path for the whole session.
///
/// **Difference from `overlays::notifications::resolve_icon_name`:**
///   - Raster icons are ALWAYS re-encoded through ImageMagick
///     (`-strip`, `png:color-type=6`). This strips malformed chunks
///     (e.g. Steam's broken iCCP) that iced's strict decoder rejects
///     but libpng-adjacent decoders tolerate. Tray slots are rendered
///     continuously for the whole session — a broken decode means a
///     permanently blank slot.
///   - The output filename gets a content hash (`icon-<safe>-<sha8>.png`).
///     Iced's image cache is keyed on path; without a hash, changing
///     file contents in place leaves iced serving stale 1x1 decodes.
///   - SVG files bypass ImageMagick (iced has native SVG support),
///     but still get hashed for the same cache-bust reason.
///   - The fast path (`$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/mbs-tray/icon-<safe>.<ext>` exists
///     and has non-zero size) skips all of the above; subsequent refetches
///     of the same icon are O(1) stat calls.
///
/// **Cost vs notifications:** one ImageMagick subprocess per *new* icon,
/// amortized to zero across the session. Notifications skip this entirely
/// because they're transient — a broken avatar just falls back to the
/// default icon on the next toast.
///
/// **Fallback chain** if the source can't be decoded after re-encode:
///   → return `None`, renderer shows the initial letter (from `title`,
///     falling back to `id` and then `tooltip`).
/// Finding 06: cap the tray icon cache directory at 20 MB. SNI items are
/// untrusted — without a cap, a hostile app pins arbitrarily many icons
/// into $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/mbs-tray (tmpfs), growing until session OOM.
/// Cached hits bypass this (they're already counted); only new resolves
/// are declined when over budget.
fn tray_cache_budget_ok(dir: &std::path::Path) -> bool {
    const MAX: u64 = 20 * 1024 * 1024;
    let total: u64 = std::fs::read_dir(dir)
        .ok()
        .into_iter()
        .flatten()
        .flatten()
        .filter_map(|e| e.metadata().ok())
        .map(|m| m.len())
        .sum();
    if total >= MAX {
        eprintln!(
            "[tray-icon] cache budget exceeded ({}/{}) — refusing new icons",
            total, MAX
        );
        return false;
    }
    true
}

/// Finding 27: canonicalize an icon candidate and verify it stays under
/// its declared root. Blocks symlink-to-sensitive-file: `~/.local/share/
/// icons/hicolor/48x48/apps/foo.png -> /etc/passwd` is rejected rather
/// than handed to `std::fs::read` + `image::load_from_memory`.
///
/// Both canonicalizations can fail (broken symlink, race, missing root);
/// caller treats `None` as "try next candidate", which is the safe default.
fn resolve_icon(icon_name: &str) -> Option<String> {
    if icon_name.is_empty() {
        return None;
    }
    // Finding 09: SNI items come from untrusted D-Bus peers. Reject
    // absolute paths (a read primitive via existence check + decode).
    if icon_name.starts_with('/')
        || icon_name.contains("..")
        || icon_name.contains('/')
        || icon_name.contains('\\')
    {
        eprintln!("[tray-icon] rejecting unsafe icon_name: {:?}", icon_name);
        return None;
    }
    if !icon_name
        .chars()
        .all(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(c, '.' | '_' | '-'))
    {
        eprintln!(
            "[tray-icon] rejecting icon_name with invalid chars: {:?}",
            icon_name
        );
        return None;
    }

    // Cache directory. Content-hashed filenames below ensure iced's
    // internal image-handle cache invalidates whenever the bytes change.
    let runtime_dir = crate::libraries::process::mbs_subdir("mbs-tray");

    let safe_name: String = icon_name
        .chars()
        .map(|c| {
            if c.is_alphanumeric() || c == '-' || c == '_' {
                c
            } else {
                '_'
            }
        })
        .collect();

    // Fast path: if a previously-normalized version is already cached, reuse.
    // Files are named "icon-<safe>.<ext>" — we check all possible extensions.
    for ext in ["png", "svg", "xpm"] {
        let cached = runtime_dir.join(format!("icon-{}.{}", safe_name, ext));
        if cached.exists()
            && std::fs::metadata(&cached)
                .map(|m| m.len() > 0)
                .unwrap_or(false)
        {
            // Validate that the file is actually a fully decodable image
            // AND that it's larger than a minimum threshold (Steam's is 3KB but structurally broken)
            let is_valid = std::fs::metadata(&cached).map(|m| m.len() > 100).unwrap_or(false)
                && std::fs::read(&cached)
                    .ok()
                    .and_then(|bytes| image::load_from_memory(&bytes).ok())
                    .is_some();
            
            if is_valid {
                return Some(cached.to_string_lossy().into_owned());
            } else {
                eprintln!("[tray-icon] cached file {:?} is corrupt or too small, deleting", cached);
                let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&cached);
            }
        }
    }

    // Finding 06: refuse NEW resolutions when the cache is over budget.
    // Cached hits above already returned; existing icons stay visible.
    if !tray_cache_budget_ok(&runtime_dir) {
        return None;
    }

    // Locate the source file — theme search only (finding 09).
    let source: std::path::PathBuf = {
        let home = dirs::home_dir().unwrap_or_else(|| std::path::PathBuf::from("/tmp"));
        let roots = [
            std::path::PathBuf::from("/run/current-system/sw/share/icons/hicolor"),
            std::path::PathBuf::from("/usr/share/icons/hicolor"),
            std::path::PathBuf::from("/usr/local/share/icons/hicolor"),
            home.join(".local/share/icons/hicolor"),
            home.join(".local/share/flatpak/exports/share/icons/hicolor"),
            home.join(".nix-profile/share/icons/hicolor"),
        ];
        let sizes = [
            "48x48", "64x64", "128x128", "256x256", "512x512", "scalable", "symbolic",
        ];
        let exts = ["png", "svg", "xpm"];

        let mut found: Option<std::path::PathBuf> = None;
        'search: for root in &roots {
            for size in &sizes {
                for ext in &exts {
                    let candidate = root
                        .join(size)
                        .join("apps")
                        .join(format!("{}.{}", icon_name, ext));
                    if candidate.exists() {
                        // Finding 27: canonicalize + verify under root.
                        if let Some(canon) = crate::libraries::process::safe_icon_candidate(&candidate, root) {
                            found = Some(canon);
                            break 'search;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if found.is_none() {
            'search2: for pix in ["/run/current-system/sw/share/pixmaps", "/usr/share/pixmaps"] {
                let pix_root = std::path::PathBuf::from(pix);
                for ext in &exts {
                    let candidate = pix_root.join(format!("{}.{}", icon_name, ext));
                    if candidate.exists() {
                        if let Some(canon) = crate::libraries::process::safe_icon_candidate(&candidate, &pix_root) {
                            found = Some(canon);
                            break 'search2;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        found?
    };

    // Finding 27: cap source file size before decode. `image::load_from_memory`
    // fully decodes into memory; a 500 MB PNG in an icon theme would OOM
    // the shell before any post-decode check could fire. 4 MB is generous
    // for a real tray icon (typical: 2-40 KB).
    const MAX_ICON_BYTES: u64 = 4 * 1024 * 1024;
    match std::fs::metadata(&source) {
        Ok(meta) if meta.len() > MAX_ICON_BYTES => {
            eprintln!(
                "[tray-icon] {} exceeds {} byte cap ({} bytes), skipping",
                icon_name,
                MAX_ICON_BYTES,
                meta.len()
            );
            return None;
        }
        Ok(_) => {}
        Err(e) => {
            eprintln!("[tray-icon] {} metadata failed: {}", icon_name, e);
            return None;
        }
    }

    // Decide destination extension. SVG → keep as SVG (iced has svg handle).
    // Everything else → normalize to PNG (ImageMagick rewrites cleanly).
    let src_ext = source.extension().and_then(|s| s.to_str()).unwrap_or("png");
    let is_svg_src = src_ext.eq_ignore_ascii_case("svg");

    // Base dest paths (no hash yet)
    let base_dest = if is_svg_src {
        runtime_dir.join(format!("icon-{}.svg", safe_name))
    } else {
        runtime_dir.join(format!("icon-{}.png", safe_name))
    };

    // Helper: rename file to include a content hash, invalidating iced's
    // image cache whenever bytes change. Returns the final path.
    let hash_and_finalize = |path: &std::path::Path| -> Option<String> {
        let bytes = std::fs::read(path).ok()?;
        let hash = sha2::Sha256::digest(&bytes);
        let hex = format!("{:x}", hash);
        let short = &hex[..8];
        let ext = path.extension().and_then(|s| s.to_str()).unwrap_or("png");
        let stem = path.file_stem().and_then(|s| s.to_str())?;
        let final_name = format!("{}-{}.{}", stem, short, ext);
        let final_path = path.with_file_name(final_name);
        if final_path != path {
            std::fs::rename(path, &final_path).ok()?;
        }
        Some(final_path.to_string_lossy().into_owned())
    };

    // Finding 07: ImageMagick availability probe removed entirely.
    // The tray renderer now has zero subprocess decoders.

    // ── SVG path: no re-encode, just copy ──────────────────────────
    if is_svg_src {
        match std::fs::copy(&source, &base_dest) {
            Ok(_) => return hash_and_finalize(&base_dest),
            Err(e) => {
                eprintln!("[tray-icon] {} svg copy failed: {}", icon_name, e);
                return None;
            }
        }
    }

    // ── Raster path: ALWAYS normalize via ImageMagick ──────────────
    // Rationale: some shipped PNGs (notably Steam's steam_tray_mono.png)
    // are structurally valid enough that `image` crate's header parser
    // accepts them, but iced's render pipeline fails at pixel data (or
    // fails to render silently). Re-encoding through ImageMagick strips
    // malformed chunks (broken iCCP, etc.) and guarantees a clean PNG
    // iced can render.
    // Finding 27-residual: dimension gate BEFORE decode. A 4 MB PNG can
    // decompress to hundreds of MB of RGBA (bomb ratio ~1000:1). The
    // 4 MB input cap (batch 4) bounds the compressed size but not the
    // decoded output. `into_dimensions()` reads only the header —
    // typically <1KB — so rejecting early avoids the pixel allocation.
    // Real tray icons are ≤256×256; 1024×1024 gives 4× headroom.
    if let Ok(bytes) = std::fs::read(&source) {
        let dims = image::ImageReader::new(std::io::Cursor::new(&bytes))
            .with_guessed_format()
            .ok()
            .and_then(|r| r.into_dimensions().ok());
        match dims {
            Some((w, h)) if w <= 1024 && h <= 1024 => {
                if let Ok(img) = image::load_from_memory(&bytes) {
                    let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&base_dest);
                    if img.save(&base_dest).is_ok() {
                        return hash_and_finalize(&base_dest);
                    }
                }
            }
            other => {
                eprintln!(
                    "[tray-icon] {} dimension gate rejected {:?} (cap 1024x1024)",
                    icon_name, other
                );
            }
        }
    }

    // Finding 07: no ImageMagick fallback. `image` crate is the only
    // decoder. If it fails, we return None and the renderer shows the
    // item title's first letter. No subprocess, no RCE surface.
    eprintln!(
        "[tray-icon] {} `image` crate failed to decode; no fallback (finding 07)",
        icon_name
    );
    None
}

fn save_pixmap(id: &str, w: u32, h: u32, data: &[u8]) -> Option<String> {
    if w == 0 || h == 0 {
        return None;
    }
    if w > 512 || h > 512 {
        eprintln!("[tray-icon] rejecting oversize pixmap {}×{}", w, h);
        return None;
    }
    if data.len() != (w as usize * h as usize * 4) {
        return None;
    }

    let mut rgba = Vec::with_capacity(data.len());
    for chunk in data.as_chunks::<4>().0 {
        rgba.push(chunk[1]);
        rgba.push(chunk[2]);
        rgba.push(chunk[3]);
        rgba.push(chunk[0]);
    }
    let img: image::RgbaImage = image::ImageBuffer::from_raw(w, h, rgba)?;
    let safe: String = id
        .chars()
        .map(|c| if c.is_alphanumeric() { c } else { '_' })
        .collect();
    let icon_dir = crate::libraries::process::mbs_subdir("mbs-tray");

    // Append a content hash so Iced's image cache invalidates when the data changes
    use sha2::Digest;
    let hash = sha2::Sha256::digest(data);
    let short = format!("{:x}", hash)[..8].to_string();
    let path = icon_dir.join(format!("mbs-tray-{}-{}.png", safe, short));

    if path.exists() {
        return Some(path.to_string_lossy().into_owned());
    }

    // Write atomically to prevent Iced from reading a half-written file
    let tmp_path = path.with_file_name(format!(".tmp-{}.png", short));
    img.save(&tmp_path).ok()?;
    std::fs::rename(&tmp_path, &path).ok()?;
    Some(path.to_string_lossy().into_owned())
}

//! --tray-context-menu <json> <bus> <menu_path> <w> <h>.
//! Spawns the tray-context child process.


pub fn run(args: &[String]) {
    if let Some(idx) = args.iter().position(|a| a == "--tray-context-menu") {
        let json_path = args.get(idx + 1).cloned().unwrap_or_default();
        let bus = args.get(idx + 2).cloned().unwrap_or_default();
        let menu_path = args.get(idx + 3).cloned().unwrap_or_default();
        let w = args
            .get(idx + 4)
            .and_then(|s| s.parse().ok())
            .unwrap_or(250u32);
        let h = args
            .get(idx + 5)
            .and_then(|s| s.parse().ok())
            .unwrap_or(400u32);
        if let Ok(json) = std::fs::read_to_string(&json_path) {
            if let Ok(items) =
                serde_json::from_str::<Vec<crate::bar::tray::TrayMenuItem>>(&json)
            {
                let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&json_path);
                std::process::exit(
                    match crate::bar::tray::context::run(items, bus, menu_path, w, h) {
                        Ok(_) => 0,
                        Err(_) => 1,
                    },
                );
            }
        }
        std::process::exit(1);
    }
}

==> /home/moonburst/projects/moonbeauty/src/bar/tray/context.rs <==
use crate::bar::tray::watcher::TrayMenuItem;
use crate::libraries::config::theme::ShellTheme;
use crate::libraries::config::ShellSettings;
use crate::libraries::style::shape_box::{ShapeBox, ShapeType};
use iced::widget::{button, column, container, text, Stack};
use iced::{Element, Length, Task};
use iced_layershell::reexport::{Anchor, KeyboardInteractivity, Layer};
use iced_layershell::settings::{LayerShellSettings, Settings};

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum Message {
    Dismiss,
    ClickItem(i32),
}

impl TryInto<iced_layershell::actions::LayershellCustomActionWithId> for Message {
    type Error = Message;
    fn try_into(
        self,
    ) -> Result<iced_layershell::actions::LayershellCustomActionWithId, Self::Error> {
        Err(self)
    }
}

pub struct App {
    items: Vec<TrayMenuItem>,
    bus: String,
    menu_path: String,
    settings: ShellSettings,
    theme: ShellTheme,
}

#[allow(dead_code)]
impl App {
    fn new_app(flags: (Vec<TrayMenuItem>, String, String, ShellSettings)) -> (Self, Task<Message>) {
        let (items, bus, menu_path, settings) = flags;
        let theme = ShellTheme::from_settings(&settings);
        (
            Self {
                items,
                bus,
                menu_path,
                settings,
                theme,
            },
            Task::none(),
        )
    }

    fn namespace(&self) -> String {
        "mbs-tray-context".into()
    }

    fn update(&mut self, m: Message) -> Task<Message> {
        match m {
            Message::Dismiss => {
                std::process::exit(0);
            }
            Message::ClickItem(id) => {
                let bus = self.bus.clone();
                let menu_path = self.menu_path.clone();
                std::thread::spawn(move || {
                    if let Ok(rt) = tokio::runtime::Runtime::new() {
                        rt.block_on(async {
                            let _ =
                                crate::bar::tray::watcher::trigger_menu_item(&bus, &menu_path, id)
                                    .await;
                        });
                    }
                });
                std::process::exit(0);
            }
        }
    }

    fn subscription(&self) -> iced::Subscription<Message> {
        iced::event::listen_with(|event, _status, _window| {
            let iced::Event::Keyboard(iced::keyboard::Event::KeyPressed { key, .. }) = event else {
                return None;
            };
            {
                if key == iced::keyboard::Key::Named(iced::keyboard::key::Named::Escape) {
                    Some(Message::Dismiss)
                } else {
                    None
                }
            }
        })
    }

    fn view(&self) -> Element<'_, Message> {
        let theme = &self.theme;
        let fs = self.settings.tooltip_font_size;
        let surface_alt = theme.surface_alt;

        let mut col = column![].spacing(4).padding(16);

        for item in &self.items {
            if !item.visible {
                continue;
            }

            if item.label == "-" {
                let sep = container(text(""))
                    .width(Length::Fill)
                    .height(Length::Fixed(1.0))
                    .style(move |_t| container::Style {
                        background: Some(iced::Background::Color(surface_alt)),
                        ..Default::default()
                    });
                col = col.push(container(sep).padding([4, 0]));
                continue;
            }

            let fg = if item.enabled {
                theme.text
            } else {
                theme.muted
            };

            let btn = button(
                container(text(&item.label).size((fs) as f32).color(fg))
                    .width(Length::Fill)
                    .height(Length::Fill)
                    .align_y(iced::alignment::Vertical::Center)
                    .align_x(iced::alignment::Horizontal::Left)
                    .padding([0, 12]),
            )
            .on_press(Message::ClickItem(item.id))
            .padding(0)
            .width(Length::Fill)
            .height(Length::Fixed(32.0))
            .style(move |_t, status| {
                let bg = match status {
                    button::Status::Hovered | button::Status::Pressed => {
                        Some(iced::Background::Color(surface_alt))
                    }
                    _ => None,
                };
                button::Style {
                    background: bg,
                    ..Default::default()
                }
            });

            col = col.push(btn);
        }

        let bg_shape = ShapeBox::new()
            .shape(ShapeType::Hexagon { cut: 16 })
            .background(theme.background)
            .border(theme.text, 1.5)
            .size(Length::Fill, Length::Fill);

        let content = Stack::new().push(bg_shape.view()).push(col);
        container(content)
            .width(Length::Fill)
            .height(Length::Fill)
            .into()
    }
}

pub fn run(
    items: Vec<TrayMenuItem>,
    bus: String,
    menu_path: String,
    width: u32,
    height: u32,
) -> Result<(), iced_layershell::Error> {
    let s = ShellSettings::load();
    let bar_h = s.bar_height as i32;
    let layer = LayerShellSettings {
        size: Some((width, height)),
        exclusive_zone: -1,
        anchor: Anchor::Top | Anchor::Right,
        layer: Layer::Overlay,
        keyboard_interactivity: KeyboardInteractivity::Exclusive,
        start_mode: std::env::var("MBS_OUTPUT")
            .ok()
            .map(iced_layershell::settings::StartMode::TargetScreen)
            .unwrap_or(iced_layershell::settings::StartMode::Active),
        margin: (bar_h + 8, 16, 0, 0),
        ..Default::default()
    };
    let _items_for_boot = items.clone();
    let _bus_for_boot = bus.clone();
    let _menu_for_boot = menu_path.clone();
    let _settings_for_boot = s.clone();
    iced_layershell::application(
        move || {
            App::new_app((
                _items_for_boot.clone(),
                _bus_for_boot.clone(),
                _menu_for_boot.clone(),
                _settings_for_boot.clone(),
            ))
        },
        || "mbs-tray-context".to_string(),
        App::update,
        App::view,
    )
    .subscription(App::subscription)
    .style(|_state, _theme| iced::theme::Style {
        background_color: iced::Color::TRANSPARENT,
        text_color: iced::Color::WHITE,
    })
    .settings(Settings {
        layer_settings: layer,
        ..Default::default()
    })
    .run()
}

use serde::Deserialize;
use tokio::process::Command;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum WeatherAlert {
    None,
    Upcoming(String),
    Danger(String),
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct WeatherData {
    pub temp_f: i32,
    pub temp_c: i32,
    pub icon: &'static str,
    pub desc: &'static str,
    pub alert: WeatherAlert,
    pub tooltip_lines: Vec<String>,
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
struct OpenMeteoResponse {
    current: Option<CurrentMeteo>,
    hourly: Option<HourlyMeteo>,
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
struct CurrentMeteo {
    time: Option<String>,
    temperature_2m: Option<f32>,
    weather_code: Option<u16>,
    wind_speed_10m: Option<f32>,
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
struct HourlyMeteo {
    time: Vec<String>,
    temperature_2m: Vec<f32>,
    weather_code: Vec<u16>,
    precipitation_probability: Option<Vec<u8>>,
    precipitation: Option<Vec<f32>>,
    wind_speed_10m: Option<Vec<f32>>,
}

pub struct WeatherBackend;

impl WeatherBackend {
    pub async fn fetch() -> Result<WeatherData, Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
        let (lat, lon) = Self::detect_coords().await;
        let url = format!(
            "https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?latitude={}&longitude={}&current=temperature_2m,weather_code,wind_speed_10m&hourly=temperature_2m,precipitation_probability,precipitation,weather_code,wind_speed_10m&forecast_days=2&timezone=auto",
            lat, lon
        );

        let output = Command::new("curl")
            .args(["-s", "--max-time", "6", &url])
            .output()
            .await?;

        if !output.status.success() {
            return Err("curl failed".into());
        }

        let res: OpenMeteoResponse = serde_json::from_slice(&output.stdout)?;
        let cur = res.current.ok_or("No current")?;
        let hourly = res.hourly.ok_or("No hourly")?;

        let cur_c = cur.temperature_2m.unwrap_or(20.0).round() as i32;
        let cur_f = (cur_c as f32 * 9.0 / 5.0 + 32.0).round() as i32;
        let (cur_desc, cur_icon) = Self::wmo_info(cur.weather_code.unwrap_or(0));
        let cur_wind = cur.wind_speed_10m.unwrap_or(0.0) as i32;

        let now_iso = cur
            .time
            .as_deref()
            .unwrap_or("")
            .get(0..13)
            .unwrap_or("")
            .to_string();
        let start_idx = hourly
            .time
            .iter()
            .position(|t| t.get(0..13) == Some(&now_iso))
            .unwrap_or(0);

        let mut alert = WeatherAlert::None;
        let mut lines = Vec::new();

        // Format "Now" line
        lines.push(format!(
            "Now:      {} {}°F / {}°C, {} (Wind {}km/h)",
            cur_icon, cur_f, cur_c, cur_desc, cur_wind
        ));

        // Scan 24h and format lines
        for offset in 1..=24 {
            let idx = start_idx + offset;
            if idx >= hourly.time.len() {
                break;
            }

            let tc = hourly
                .temperature_2m
                .get(idx)
                .copied()
                .unwrap_or(20.0)
                .round() as i32;
            let tf = (tc as f32 * 9.0 / 5.0 + 32.0).round() as i32;
            let code = hourly.weather_code.get(idx).copied().unwrap_or(0);
            let (desc, icon) = Self::wmo_info(code);
            let prob = hourly
                .precipitation_probability
                .as_ref()
                .and_then(|p| p.get(idx).copied())
                .unwrap_or(0);
            let p_mm = hourly
                .precipitation
                .as_ref()
                .and_then(|p| p.get(idx).copied())
                .unwrap_or(0.0);
            let wind = hourly
                .wind_speed_10m
                .as_ref()
                .and_then(|w| w.get(idx).copied())
                .unwrap_or(0.0);

            // Evaluate hazards (ported from Lua/Python)
            let (hazard, cause) = Self::evaluate_hazard(tf, code, p_mm, prob, wind);

            // Update global alert
            if hazard == "danger" {
                if offset <= 1 {
                    alert = WeatherAlert::Danger(cause.clone());
                } else if offset <= 3 && alert == WeatherAlert::None {
                    alert = WeatherAlert::Upcoming(format!("{} in {}h", cause, offset));
                }
            } else if hazard == "warning" && offset <= 3 && alert == WeatherAlert::None {
                alert = WeatherAlert::Upcoming(format!("{} in {}h", cause, offset));
            }

            let t_raw = &hourly.time[idx];
            let hour_str = t_raw.get(11..16).unwrap_or("12:00");
            let prefix = if hazard == "danger" {
                "⚠ "
            } else if hazard == "warning" {
                "· "
            } else {
                ""
            };

            lines.push(format!(
                "{}: {}{} {}°F / {}°C, {} ({}%)",
                hour_str, prefix, icon, tf, tc, desc, prob
            ));
        }

        Ok(WeatherData {
            temp_f: cur_f,
            temp_c: cur_c,
            icon: cur_icon,
            desc: cur_desc,
            alert,
            tooltip_lines: lines,
        })
    }

    async fn detect_coords() -> (String, String) {
        // ip-api.com's free tier is HTTP-only (HTTPS is a paid upgrade).
        // Use ipapi.co (HTTPS on free tier) so a network attacker can't
        // inject a fake lat/lon. Response keys differ: latitude/longitude.
        if let Ok(out) = Command::new("curl")
            .args(["-s", "--max-time", "3", "https://ipapi.co/json/"])
            .output()
            .await
        {
            if let Ok(val) = serde_json::from_slice::<serde_json::Value>(&out.stdout) {
                if let (Some(lat), Some(lon)) =
                    (val["latitude"].as_f64(), val["longitude"].as_f64())
                {
                    return (lat.to_string(), lon.to_string());
                }
            }
        }
        ("40.7128".into(), "-74.0060".into())
    }

    fn evaluate_hazard(
        temp_f: i32,
        code: u16,
        precip_mm: f32,
        precip_prob: u8,
        wind_kmh: f32,
    ) -> (&'static str, String) {
        if temp_f >= 90 {
            return ("danger", "Dangerous Heat".into());
        }
        if temp_f <= 32 {
            return ("danger", "Freezing Temp".into());
        }
        if code == 95 || code == 96 || code == 99 {
            return ("danger", "Severe Storm".into());
        }
        if code == 82 {
            return ("danger", "Violent Downpour".into());
        }
        if code == 66 || code == 67 {
            return ("danger", "Freezing Rain".into());
        }
        if code == 75 || code == 86 {
            return ("danger", "Blizzard".into());
        }
        if wind_kmh >= 60.0 {
            return ("danger", "Gale Winds".into());
        }
        if precip_mm >= 8.0 {
            return ("danger", "Flooding Risk".into());
        }

        if temp_f >= 85 {
            return ("warning", "Heat Alert".into());
        }
        if temp_f <= 40 {
            return ("warning", "Cold Alert".into());
        }
        if code == 65 {
            return ("warning", "Heavy Rain".into());
        }
        if code == 61 || code == 63 || code == 80 || code == 81 || code == 55 {
            return ("warning", "Rain Alert".into());
        }
        if (code == 51 || code == 53) && precip_prob >= 40 {
            return ("warning", "Drizzle".into());
        }
        if precip_prob >= 50 || precip_mm >= 1.0 {
            return ("warning", "Rain Likely".into());
        }
        if wind_kmh >= 45.0 {
            return ("warning", "High Winds".into());
        }

        ("none", String::new())
    }

    fn wmo_info(code: u16) -> (&'static str, &'static str) {
        match code {
            0 => ("Clear", "☀"),
            1 => ("Mainly Clear", "☀"),
            2 => ("Partly Cloudy", "☁"),
            3 => ("Overcast", "☁"),
            45 | 48 => ("Fog", "🌫"),
            51..=55 => ("Drizzle", "☂"),
            61..=65 => ("Rain", "☂"),
            71..=77 => ("Snow", "❄"),
            80..=82 => ("Showers", "☂"),
            95..=99 => ("Thunderstorm", "⚡"),
            _ => ("Fair", "☀"),
        }
    }
}

use iced::widget::{column, container, row, text, Stack};
use iced::{Alignment, Color, Element, Length, Padding, Task};
use std::time::Instant;

use crate::bar::weather::client::{WeatherAlert, WeatherData};
use crate::bar::weather::WeatherBackend;
use crate::libraries::config::theme::ShellTheme;
use crate::libraries::config::ShellSettings;
use crate::libraries::style::shape_box::SlantSide;
use crate::libraries::style::TextExt;

pub use crate::overlays::tooltip_common::slanted_row;
use crate::overlays::tooltip_common::InBarTooltipConfig;

const AUTO_MS: u128 = 20_000;

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum Message {
    Tick,
    Loaded(Option<WeatherData>),
    Dismiss,
}

pub struct App {
    opened: Instant,
    weather: Option<WeatherData>,
    fetched: bool,
    grow_right: bool,
    w: u32,
    h: u32,
    drop_ms: f32,
    expand_ms: f32,
    w_start: f32,
    slant_l: SlantSide,
    #[allow(dead_code)]
    slant_r: SlantSide,
    closing_at: Option<crate::overlays::tooltip_engine::ClosingState>,
    anim_frame: u64,
    // Cached at boot so view() doesn't reload from disk at 60fps
    // during the drop/expand animation (~400ms of ~24 frames each).
    settings: ShellSettings,
    theme: ShellTheme,
    pub should_close: bool,
}

impl App {
    pub fn new_in_bar(cfg: &InBarTooltipConfig) -> (Self, Task<Message>) {
        let s = ShellSettings::load();
        let app = Self {
            opened: Instant::now(),
            weather: None,
            fetched: false,
            grow_right: cfg.grow_right,
            w: cfg.w,
            w_start: cfg.cap_w,
            slant_l: cfg.slant_l,
            slant_r: cfg.slant_r,
            h: cfg.h,
            drop_ms: cfg.drop_ms,
            expand_ms: cfg.expand_ms,
            closing_at: None,
            anim_frame: 0,
            settings: s.clone(),
            theme: ShellTheme::from_settings(&s),
            should_close: false,
        };
        let task = Task::perform(
            async { WeatherBackend::fetch().await.ok() },
            Message::Loaded,
        );
        (
            app,
            Task::batch(vec![
                task,
                Task::perform(
                    async { tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(4)).await },
                    |_| Message::Tick,
                ),
            ]),
        )
    }

    fn snapshot_for_close(&self) -> crate::overlays::tooltip_engine::ClosingState {
        let cur = crate::overlays::tooltip_engine::compute(
            self.opened.elapsed().as_millis() as f32,
            self.w_start,
            self.w as f32,
            self.h as f32,
            self.theme.slant_width,
            self.settings.bar_height.max(1) as f32,
            self.drop_ms,
            self.expand_ms,
        );
        crate::overlays::tooltip_engine::ClosingState {
            started: Instant::now(),
            from_w: cur.w,
            from_h: cur.h,
            from_opacity: cur.opacity,
        }
    }

    pub fn update(&mut self, m: Message) -> Task<Message> {
        match m {
            Message::Tick => {
                self.anim_frame = self.anim_frame.wrapping_add(1);
                let elapsed_ms = self.opened.elapsed().as_millis() as u64;
                if std::env::var_os("MBS_TICK_DIAG").is_some() {
                    eprintln!("[tick] frame={} elapsed={}ms", self.anim_frame, elapsed_ms);
                }

                if let Some(t) = &self.closing_at {
                    if t.started.elapsed().as_millis() > (self.drop_ms * 3.0) as u128 {
                        self.should_close = true;
                        return Task::none();
                    }
                } else if self.opened.elapsed().as_millis() > AUTO_MS {
                    self.should_close = true;
                    return Task::none();
                }

                let next_ms: u64 = if elapsed_ms < 2000 || self.closing_at.is_some() {
                    std::env::var("MBS_TICK_MS")
                        .ok()
                        .and_then(|s| s.parse().ok())
                        .filter(|n| *n >= 1 && *n <= 100)
                        .unwrap_or(4)
                } else {
                    100
                };

                return Task::perform(
                    async move { tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(next_ms)).await },
                    |_| Message::Tick,
                );
            }
            Message::Loaded(w) => {
                self.weather = w;
                self.fetched = true;
            }
            Message::Dismiss => {
                if self.closing_at.is_none() {
                    let snap = self.snapshot_for_close();
                    self.closing_at = Some(snap);
                }
                // Reschedule Tick so the close animation advances to should_close.
                return Task::perform(
                    async {
                        tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(4)).await
                    },
                    |_| Message::Tick,
                );
            }
        }
        Task::none()
    }

    pub fn view(&self) -> Element<'_, Message> {
        let settings = &self.settings;
        let theme = &self.theme;
        let anim = if let Some(t) = &self.closing_at {
            crate::overlays::tooltip_engine::compute_close_from(
                t.started.elapsed().as_millis() as f32,
                t.from_w,
                t.from_h,
                t.from_opacity,
                self.w_start,
                self.w as f32,
                theme.slant_width,
                settings.bar_height as f32,
                self.drop_ms,
            )
        } else {
            crate::overlays::tooltip_engine::compute(
                self.opened.elapsed().as_millis() as f32,
                self.w_start,
                self.w as f32,
                self.h as f32,
                theme.slant_width,
                settings.bar_height as f32,
                self.drop_ms,
                self.expand_ms,
            )
        };

        let slant_h = theme.slant_width * (anim.h / settings.bar_height.max(1) as f32);
        let bg = crate::overlays::tooltip_engine::ParallelogramBg {
            w: anim.w,
            h: anim.h,
            slant: slant_h,
            slant_right: self.slant_l == SlantSide::Right,
            background: theme.background,
            border_color: theme.text,
            border_width: theme.control_border_width,
            frame: self.opened.elapsed().as_millis() as u64,
        };

        let content: Element<'_, Message> = self.build_content(theme, settings, anim.opacity);
        let clipped = crate::overlays::tooltip_engine::clip_content(
            content,
            anim.w,
            anim.h,
            if self.grow_right {
                iced::alignment::Horizontal::Left
            } else {
                iced::alignment::Horizontal::Right
            },
        );
        let stacked: Element<'_, Message> = Stack::new().push(bg.view()).push(clipped).into();
        crate::overlays::tooltip_engine::align_to_side(
            stacked,
            if self.grow_right {
                iced::alignment::Horizontal::Left
            } else {
                iced::alignment::Horizontal::Right
            },
        )
    }

    fn build_content<'a>(
        &'a self,
        t: &ShellTheme,
        settings: &ShellSettings,
        alpha: f32,
    ) -> Element<'a, Message> {
        let a = move |c: Color| Color {
            a: c.a * alpha,
            ..c
        };
        let text_col = a(t.text);
        let _muted = a(t.muted);
        let danger = a(t.danger);
        let warning = a(t.warning);

        let fs = settings.tooltip_font_size;
        let total_h = self.h as f32;
        let bar_h = settings.bar_height.max(1) as f32;
        let slant_h = t.slant_width * (total_h / bar_h);
        let slant_right = self.slant_l == SlantSide::Right;
        let _half_tt = settings.control_border_width * 0.5;
        let safe = 16.0;
        let vpad = 14.0;
        let gap = 8.0;
        let w_f = self.w as f32;

        let mut y = vpad;
        let mut col = column![].spacing(gap).width(Length::Fill);

        // Header
        let header_h = fs as f32 + 16.0;
        let title = match &self.weather.as_ref().map(|w| &w.alert) {
            Some(WeatherAlert::Danger(_)) => "DANGER",
            Some(WeatherAlert::Upcoming(_)) => "WARNING",
            _ => "LOCAL WEATHER",
        };
        let header_el = row![
            text(title).size((fs.max(12)) as f32).bold().color(
                if let Some(WeatherAlert::Danger(_)) = self.weather.as_ref().map(|w| &w.alert) {
                    danger
                } else {
                    text_col
                }
            ),
            iced::widget::space::horizontal(),
        ]
        .align_y(Alignment::Center)
        .width(Length::Fill)
        .into();
        col = col.push(slanted_row(
            header_el,
            y + header_h * 0.5,
            total_h,
            slant_h,
            slant_right,
            safe,
            w_f,
            header_h,
        ));
        y += header_h + gap;

        if let Some(wx) = &self.weather {
            let cell_h = fs as f32 + 12.0;
            let mut list_col = column![].spacing(2).width(Length::Fill);

            for (i, line) in wx.tooltip_lines.iter().take(12).enumerate() {
                let color = if line.contains("Danger") || line.contains("Storm") {
                    danger
                } else if line.contains("Alert") || line.contains("Rain") || line.contains("Snow") {
                    warning
                } else {
                    text_col
                };

                let txt = if i == 0 {
                    text(line)
                        .size((fs) as f32)
                        .font(iced::Font::MONOSPACE)
                        .bold()
                        .color(color)
                        .wrapping(iced::widget::text::Wrapping::None)
                } else {
                    text(line)
                        .size((fs) as f32)
                        .font(iced::Font::MONOSPACE)
                        .color(color)
                        .wrapping(iced::widget::text::Wrapping::None)
                };
                let row_el = row![txt]
                    .align_y(Alignment::Center)
                    .width(Length::Fill)
                    .into();

                list_col = list_col.push(slanted_row(
                    row_el,
                    y + cell_h * 0.5,
                    total_h,
                    slant_h,
                    slant_right,
                    safe,
                    w_f,
                    cell_h,
                ));
                y += cell_h + 2.0;
            }

            col = col.push(list_col);
        } else if self.fetched {
            col = col.push(slanted_row(
                text("Weather unavailable").into(),
                y + 20.0,
                total_h,
                slant_h,
                slant_right,
                safe,
                w_f,
                40.0,
            ));
        }

        container(col)
            .padding(Padding {
                top: vpad,
                right: 0.0,
                bottom: vpad,
                left: 20.0,
            })
            .width(Length::Fixed(self.w as f32))
            .height(Length::Fixed(self.h as f32))
            .clip(true)
            .into()
    }
}

use super::{label, CapsuleAction};
use crate::libraries::config::theme::ShellTheme;
use iced::{Color, Element};
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex, OnceLock};

// Cache reminders with an mtime check so view() stats once instead of
// re-parsing JSON at up to 60 Hz during tray animation.
struct RemindersCache {
    mtime: Option<std::time::SystemTime>,
    entries: Arc<Vec<crate::overlays::reminders::ReminderEntry>>,
}

static REMINDERS_PATH: OnceLock<std::path::PathBuf> = OnceLock::new();
static REMINDERS_CACHE: Mutex<Option<RemindersCache>> = Mutex::new(None);

fn reminders_path() -> &'static std::path::Path {
    REMINDERS_PATH.get_or_init(|| crate::overlays::reminders::RemindersOverlay::storage_path())
}

fn load_cached() -> Arc<Vec<crate::overlays::reminders::ReminderEntry>> {
    let path = reminders_path();
    let mtime = std::fs::metadata(path).ok().and_then(|m| m.modified().ok());
    let mut g = REMINDERS_CACHE.lock().unwrap();
    if let Some(c) = g.as_ref() {
        if c.mtime == mtime {
            return Arc::clone(&c.entries);
        }
    }
    let entries = Arc::new(crate::overlays::reminders::RemindersOverlay::load());
    *g = Some(RemindersCache {
        mtime,
        entries: Arc::clone(&entries),
    });
    entries
}

pub(super) fn render<'a, Message: 'a>(
    theme: &ShellTheme,
) -> (Element<'a, Message>, CapsuleAction, Color) {
    let entries = load_cached();
    let now = chrono::Local::now().timestamp();
    let active: Vec<_> = entries.iter().filter(|e| e.target_epoch > now).collect();
    let (txt, col) = if let Some(first) = active.iter().min_by_key(|e| e.target_epoch) {
        let diff = (first.target_epoch - now).max(0);
        let label = if diff >= 3600 {
            format!("⏰ {}h {}m", diff / 3600, (diff % 3600) / 60)
        } else if diff >= 60 {
            format!("⏰ {}m {}s", diff / 60, diff % 60)
        } else {
            format!("⏰ {}s", diff)
        };
        (label, theme.warning)
    } else {
        ("No Alarm".to_string(), theme.text)
    };
    let elem = label::<Message>(&[(txt, col)], theme.font_size_normal);
    (
        elem,
        CapsuleAction::OpenOverlay("alarm".into()),
        theme.border,
    )
}

use super::{label, CapsuleAction};
use crate::libraries::backend::UnifiedTelemetry;
use crate::libraries::config::theme::ShellTheme;
use iced::{Color, Element};

/// Shared audio/mic capsule render. Sink and source differ only in the
/// label, muted-string, action, and which `AudioStatus` field to read.
fn render_status<'a, Message: 'a>(
    label_text: &'static str,
    volume_pct: u8,
    is_muted: bool,
    mute_str: &'static str,
    action: CapsuleAction,
    theme: &ShellTheme,
) -> (Element<'a, Message>, CapsuleAction, Color) {
    let val_col = if is_muted { theme.danger } else { theme.text };
    let val_str = if is_muted {
        mute_str.to_string()
    } else {
        format!("{}%", volume_pct)
    };
    let elem = label::<Message>(
        &[
            (label_text.to_string(), theme.success),
            (" ".to_string(), theme.success),
            (val_str, val_col),
        ],
        theme.font_size_normal,
    );
    let border = if is_muted { theme.danger } else { theme.border };
    (elem, action, border)
}

pub(super) fn render<'a, Message: 'a>(
    telemetry: &'a UnifiedTelemetry,
    theme: &ShellTheme,
) -> (Element<'a, Message>, CapsuleAction, Color) {
    render_status(
        "Audio:",
        telemetry.audio.volume_pct,
        telemetry.audio.is_muted,
        "Mute",
        CapsuleAction::ToggleSinkMute,
        theme,
    )
}

pub(super) fn render_mic<'a, Message: 'a>(
    telemetry: &'a UnifiedTelemetry,
    theme: &ShellTheme,
) -> (Element<'a, Message>, CapsuleAction, Color) {
    render_status(
        "Mic:",
        telemetry.mic.volume_pct,
        telemetry.mic.is_muted,
        "MUTED",
        CapsuleAction::ToggleSourceMute,
        theme,
    )
}

use super::{label, CapsuleAction};
use crate::libraries::backend::UnifiedTelemetry;
use crate::libraries::config::theme::ShellTheme;
use iced::{Color, Element};

pub(super) fn render<'a, Message: 'a>(
    telemetry: &'a UnifiedTelemetry,
    theme: &ShellTheme,
) -> (Element<'a, Message>, CapsuleAction, Color) {
    if !telemetry.battery.has_battery {
        let elem = label::<Message>(
            &[
                ("⚡ AC:".to_string(), theme.text),
                (" Online".to_string(), theme.success),
            ],
            theme.font_size_normal,
        );
        return (
            elem,
            CapsuleAction::OpenOverlay("power".into()),
            theme.border,
        );
    }
    let pct = telemetry.battery.percent;
    let status = telemetry.battery.status.to_lowercase();
    let icon = if status.contains("charging") {
        "⚡ "
    } else if pct <= 20 {
        "🪫 "
    } else {
        "🔋 "
    };
    let val_col =
        if status.contains("charging") || status.contains("full") || status.contains("mains") {
            theme.success
        } else if pct <= 20 {
            theme.danger
        } else if pct <= 40 {
            theme.warning
        } else {
            theme.text
        };
    let elem = label::<Message>(
        &[
            (format!("{}BAT:", icon), theme.text),
            (
                format!(" {}% ({:.1}W)", pct, telemetry.battery.power_w),
                val_col,
            ),
        ],
        theme.font_size_normal,
    );
    (elem, CapsuleAction::OpenOverlay("power".into()), val_col)
}

use super::{label, CapsuleAction};
use crate::libraries::backend::UnifiedTelemetry;
use crate::libraries::config::theme::ShellTheme;
use iced::{Color, Element};

pub(super) fn render<'a, Message: 'a>(
    telemetry: &'a UnifiedTelemetry,
    theme: &ShellTheme,
) -> (Element<'a, Message>, CapsuleAction, Color) {
    let cpu_danger = telemetry.cpu.temp_c >= theme.cpu_temp_danger
        || u32::from(telemetry.cpu.usage_pct) >= theme.cpu_usage_danger;
    let cpu_warn = telemetry.cpu.temp_c >= theme.cpu_temp_warn
        || u32::from(telemetry.cpu.usage_pct) >= theme.cpu_usage_warn;
    let val_col = if cpu_danger {
        theme.danger
    } else if cpu_warn {
        theme.warning
    } else {
        theme.text
    };
    let border_col = if val_col == theme.text {
        theme.border
    } else {
        val_col
    };

    let trimmed = telemetry.cpu.usage_pct.to_string();
    let leading_zero_count = 3usize.saturating_sub(trimmed.len());
    let zero_pad: String = "0".repeat(leading_zero_count);

    let mut segments: Vec<(String, Color)> = vec![
        ("CPU:".to_string(), theme.success),
        (" ".to_string(), theme.success),
    ];
    if !zero_pad.is_empty() {
        segments.push((zero_pad, theme.background));
    }
    segments.push((format!("{}% {}°C", trimmed, telemetry.cpu.temp_c), val_col));
    let elem = label::<Message>(&segments, theme.font_size_normal);
    (elem, CapsuleAction::OpenOverlay("cpu".into()), border_col)
}

use super::{label, CapsuleAction};
use crate::libraries::backend::UnifiedTelemetry;
use crate::libraries::config::settings::ShellSettings;
use crate::libraries::config::theme::ShellTheme;
use iced::{Color, Element};

pub(super) fn render<'a, Message: 'a>(
    telemetry: &'a UnifiedTelemetry,
    theme: &ShellTheme,
    settings: &ShellSettings,
) -> (Element<'a, Message>, CapsuleAction, Color) {
    let (tw, td, vw, vd) = if telemetry.gpu_selected_idx == 0 {
        (
            theme.gpu0_temp_warn,
            theme.gpu0_temp_danger,
            theme.gpu0_vram_warn,
            theme.gpu0_vram_danger,
        )
    } else {
        (
            settings.gpu1.temp_warn,
            settings.gpu1.temp_danger,
            settings.gpu1.vram_warn,
            settings.gpu1.vram_danger,
        )
    };
    let temp_col = if telemetry.gpu.temp_c >= td {
        theme.danger
    } else if telemetry.gpu.temp_c >= tw {
        theme.warning
    } else {
        theme.text
    };
    let vram_col = if telemetry.gpu.vram_free_gib <= vd {
        theme.danger
    } else if telemetry.gpu.vram_free_gib <= vw {
        theme.warning
    } else {
        theme.text
    };
    let name = if telemetry.gpu.name.is_empty() {
        "GPU".to_string()
    } else {
        telemetry.gpu.name.clone()
    };
    let usage_danger = telemetry.gpu.usage_pct >= 90;
    let usage_warn = telemetry.gpu.usage_pct >= 75;
    let usage_col = if usage_danger {
        theme.danger
    } else if usage_warn {
        theme.warning
    } else {
        theme.text
    };

    let val_col = if telemetry.gpu.temp_c >= td || telemetry.gpu.vram_free_gib <= vd || usage_danger
    {
        theme.danger
    } else if telemetry.gpu.temp_c >= tw || telemetry.gpu.vram_free_gib <= vw || usage_warn {
        theme.warning
    } else {
        theme.text
    };

    let mut segments: Vec<(String, Color)> = vec![(format!("{}:", name), theme.success)];
    let push_num =
        |segments: &mut Vec<(String, Color)>, val: u32, width: usize, suffix: &str, col: Color| {
            let s = val.to_string();
            let pad_count = width.saturating_sub(s.len());
            segments.push((" ".to_string(), val_col));
            if pad_count > 0 {
                segments.push(("0".repeat(pad_count), theme.background));
            }
            segments.push((format!("{}{}", s, suffix), col));
        };
    push_num(
        &mut segments,
        telemetry.gpu.usage_pct as u32,
        3,
        "%",
        usage_col,
    );
    push_num(&mut segments, telemetry.gpu.temp_c, 3, "°C", temp_col);
    push_num(&mut segments, telemetry.gpu.power_w, 3, "W", val_col);
    push_num(
        &mut segments,
        telemetry.gpu.vram_free_gib,
        2,
        "GiB",
        vram_col,
    );
    let elem = label::<Message>(&segments, theme.font_size_normal);
    let border_col = if val_col == theme.text {
        theme.border
    } else {
        val_col
    };
    (elem, CapsuleAction::OpenOverlay("gpu".into()), border_col)
}

use super::{label, CapsuleAction};
use crate::libraries::backend::UnifiedTelemetry;
use crate::libraries::config::theme::ShellTheme;
use iced::{Color, Element};

pub(super) fn render<'a, Message: 'a>(
    telemetry: &'a UnifiedTelemetry,
    theme: &ShellTheme,
) -> (Element<'a, Message>, CapsuleAction, Color) {
    let display = match &telemetry.mpris {
        Some(m) if !m.title.is_empty() && !m.artist.is_empty() => {
            format!("{} - {}", m.artist, m.title)
        }
        Some(m) if !m.title.is_empty() => m.title.clone(),
        Some(m) if !m.artist.is_empty() => m.artist.clone(),
        _ => "No Track".into(),
    };
    let truncated: String = if display.chars().count() > 20 {
        let s: String = display.chars().take(20).collect();

use super::{label, CapsuleAction};
use crate::libraries::backend::UnifiedTelemetry;
use crate::libraries::config::theme::ShellTheme;
use iced::{Color, Element};

pub(super) fn render<'a, Message: 'a>(
    telemetry: &'a UnifiedTelemetry,
    theme: &ShellTheme,
) -> (Element<'a, Message>, CapsuleAction, Color) {
    let (display, _total) = if telemetry.ram.effective_avail_gib > 0.0 {
        (
            telemetry.ram.effective_avail_gib,
            telemetry.ram.total_gib + telemetry.ram.zram_saved_gib,
        )
    } else {
        (telemetry.ram.available_gib, telemetry.ram.total_gib)
    };
    let warn_gib = theme.ram_warn_gib as f32;
    let danger_gib = theme.ram_danger_gib as f32;
    let val_col = if display <= danger_gib {
        theme.danger
    } else if display <= warn_gib {
        theme.warning
    } else {
        theme.text
    };

    let mut segments: Vec<(String, Color)> = vec![("RAM:".to_string(), theme.success)];
    if display == 0.0 {
        segments.push((" -- GiB".to_string(), val_col));
    } else {
        let num_str = format!("{:.1}", display);
        let (int_part, frac_part) = num_str.split_once('.').unwrap_or((num_str.as_str(), ""));
        let pad_count = 2usize.saturating_sub(int_part.len());
        segments.push((" ".to_string(), val_col));
        if pad_count > 0 {
            segments.push(("0".repeat(pad_count), theme.background));
        }
        segments.push((format!("{}.{} GiB", int_part, frac_part), val_col));
    }
    let elem = label::<Message>(&segments, theme.font_size_normal);
    let border_col = if display <= danger_gib {
        theme.danger
    } else if display <= warn_gib {
        theme.warning
    } else {
        theme.border
    };
    (elem, CapsuleAction::OpenOverlay("ram".into()), border_col)
}

use crate::libraries::style::shape_box::{ShapeBox, ShapeType, SlantSide};

mod alarm;

// ══════════════ Shared helpers ══════════════

thread_local! {
    static LABEL_W: std::cell::Cell<f32> = const { std::cell::Cell::new(0.0) };
}

fn est_text_width(txt: &str, size: u16) -> f32 {
    let em = size as f32;
    // Fira Code is monospaced: every character (including spaces) 
    // takes exactly the same width. We use 0.65em to provide a safe margin.
    txt.chars().count() as f32 * (em * 0.65)
}

fn label<'a, Message: 'a>(segments: &[(String, Color)], size: u16) -> Element<'a, Message> {
    let mut r: Row<'a, Message, iced::Theme, iced::Renderer> = Row::new();
    r = r.spacing(0).align_y(Alignment::Center);
    let mut total_w = 0.0;
    for (txt, col) in segments {
        total_w += est_text_width(txt, size);
        if txt.is_empty() {
            continue;
        }
        r = r.push(
            text(txt.clone())
                .size(size as f32)
                .wrapping(iced::widget::text::Wrapping::None)
                .font(shell_font(iced::font::Weight::Bold))
                .color(*col),
        );
    }
    LABEL_W.with(|w| w.set(total_w));
    r.into()
}

static CAPSULE_WIDTHS: OnceLock<Mutex<std::collections::HashMap<String, f32>>> = OnceLock::new();

fn widths_map() -> &'static Mutex<std::collections::HashMap<String, f32>> {
    CAPSULE_WIDTHS.get_or_init(|| Mutex::new(std::collections::HashMap::new()))
}

pub fn record_width(id: &str, w: f32) {
    if let Ok(mut m) = widths_map().lock() {
        let old = m.get(id).copied();
        if old != Some(w) && std::env::var_os("MBS_DEBUG").is_some() {
            eprintln!("[capsule-width] {} = {:.1}px", id, w);
        }
        m.insert(id.to_string(), w);
    }
}

pub fn tooltip_bias(id: &str, theme: &ShellTheme) -> (i32, i32) {
    match id {
        "tray" => tray::tooltip_bias(theme),
        _ => (0, 0),
    }
}
pub fn lookup_width(id: &str) -> Option<f32> {
    widths_map().lock().ok().and_then(|m| m.get(id).copied())
}

pub fn compute_expanded_visible_width(settings: &ShellSettings, item_count: usize) -> f32 {
    let shown = item_count.min(8);
    let icon_size = settings.tray_icon_size as f32;
    let icon_slot = icon_size + 8.0;
    let close_slot = 24.0;
    let spacing = 4.0;
    let empty_w = if item_count == 0 { 150.0 } else { 0.0 };
    let content_w = close_slot
        + if shown > 0 { spacing } else { 0.0 }
        + (icon_slot + spacing) * shown as f32
        + empty_w;
    // Added a 40px buffer so the last item doesn't get clipped
    content_w + 40.0 + 24.0
}

// ══════════════ Public API ══════════════

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum CapsuleAction {
    OpenOverlay(String),
    TogglePlayPause,
    NextTrack,
    PreviousTrack,
    CycleAudioSink,
    ToggleSinkMute,
    ToggleSourceMute,
    CycleGpu,
    CycleGpuTarget,
    ToggleNotificationDnd,
    ToggleCustomMode,
    ToggleTrayExpanded,
    TrayActivate(crate::bar::tray::TrayItem),
    TrayContextMenu(crate::bar::tray::TrayItem),
    CancelTooltip(String),
}

pub struct CapsuleRenderer;

impl CapsuleRenderer {
    pub fn render<'a, Message: 'static + Clone>(
        id: &str,
        telemetry: &'a UnifiedTelemetry,
        theme: &ShellTheme,
        settings: &ShellSettings,
        slant_left: SlantSide,
        slant_right: SlantSide,
        module_shape: &str,
        region: &str,
        on_action: impl Fn(CapsuleAction) -> Message + 'static + Copy,
    ) -> Element<'a, Message> {
        LABEL_W.with(|w| w.set(0.0));
        let (content, action, border_color): (Element<'a, Message>, CapsuleAction, Color) = match id
        {
            "calendar" => calendar::render::<Message>(theme),
            "music" => music::render::<Message>(telemetry, theme),
            "alarm" => alarm::render::<Message>(theme),
            "weather" => weather::render::<Message>(telemetry, theme),
            "unified" => unified::render::<Message>(telemetry, theme),
            "notify" | "notifications" => notify::render::<Message>(theme),
            "clock" => clock::render::<Message>(telemetry, theme),
            "audio" => audio::render::<Message>(telemetry, theme),
            "mic" => audio::render_mic::<Message>(telemetry, theme),
            "net" => net::render::<Message>(telemetry, theme),
            "cpu" => cpu::render::<Message>(telemetry, theme),
            "gpu" => gpu::render::<Message>(telemetry, theme, settings),
            "ram" => ram::render::<Message>(telemetry, theme),
            "battery" => battery::render::<Message>(telemetry, theme),
            "custom" => custom::render::<Message>(theme),
            "tray" => tray::render::<Message>(theme, region),
            _ => custom::fallback::<Message>(id, theme),
        };

        let text_w = LABEL_W.with(|w| w.get());
        
        // Let all capsules dynamically size to their text content.
        // Fira Code (monospace) ensures numbers don't cause jitter.
        let bounding_w = if id == "tray" {
            settings.tray_width as f32 + theme.slant_width * 2.0
        } else {
            // Add a 16px buffer so the text never touches the slanted edges
            text_w + theme.slant_width * 2.0 + settings.capsule_internal_padding as f32 + 16.0
        };
        record_width(id, bounding_w);

        let border_color = if border_color == theme.border {
            theme.text
        } else {
            border_color
        };

        let shape_type = match module_shape {
            "hexagon" => ShapeType::Hexagon {
                cut: (theme.slant_width * 1.5) as u16,
            },
            "rounded" => ShapeType::Rounded(((theme.slant_width * 1.5) as u16).max(4)),
            "flat" => ShapeType::Flat,
            _ => ShapeType::Slant {
                left: slant_left,
                right: slant_right,
            },
        };

        let background_shape = ShapeBox::new()
            .shape(shape_type)
            .background(theme.background)
            .border(border_color, theme.control_border_width)
            .slant_width(theme.slant_width)
            .size(Length::Fixed(bounding_w), Length::Fill);

        let button_content = container(content)
            .width(Length::Fixed(bounding_w))
            .height(Length::Fill)
            .align_x(Alignment::Center)
            .align_y(Alignment::Center);

        let action_btn = button(
            Stack::new()
                .push(background_shape.view())
                .push(button_content),
        )
        .on_press(on_action(action))
        .padding(0)
        .width(Length::Fixed(bounding_w))
        .style(|_t, _s| button::Style {
            background: None,
            ..Default::default()
        });

        if id == "alarm" {
            let id_str = id.to_string();
            MouseArea::new(action_btn)
                .on_right_press(on_action(CapsuleAction::CancelTooltip(id_str)))
                .into()
        } else if id == "gpu" {
            MouseArea::new(action_btn)
                .on_right_press(on_action(CapsuleAction::CycleGpuTarget))
                .into()
        } else {
            action_btn.into()
        }
    }

    pub fn render_tray_expanded<'a, Message: 'static + Clone>(
        items: &[crate::bar::tray::TrayItem],
        theme: &ShellTheme,
        settings: &ShellSettings,
        slant_left: SlantSide,
        slant_right: SlantSide,
        region: &str,
        display_width: f32,
        on_action: impl Fn(CapsuleAction) -> Message + 'static + Copy,
    ) -> Element<'a, Message> {
        tray::render_expanded(
            items,
            theme,
            settings,
            slant_left,
            slant_right,
            region,
            display_width,
            on_action,
        )
    }
}
