use iced::widget::{button, container, text, tooltip, MouseArea, Row, Stack};
use iced::{Alignment, Color, Element, Length};
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::sync::{Mutex, OnceLock};

use super::{label, CapsuleAction};

static RGBA_CACHE: OnceLock<Mutex<HashMap<String, iced::widget::image::Handle>>> = OnceLock::new();

fn cached_rgba_handle(path: &str) -> Option<iced::widget::image::Handle> {
    let cache = RGBA_CACHE.get_or_init(|| Mutex::new(HashMap::new()));
    let mut g = cache.lock().unwrap();
    if let Some(h) = g.get(path) {
        return Some(h.clone());
    }

    let bytes = std::fs::read(path).ok()?;
    
    // Try Rust image crate first. If it fails, fallback to ImageMagick.
    let rgba = match image::load_from_memory(&bytes) {
        Ok(img) => img.to_rgba8(),
        Err(_) => {
            eprintln!("[tray-render] image crate failed, trying ImageMagick for {:?}", path);
            let out = std::process::Command::new("convert")
                .args([path, "-depth", "8", "rgba:-"])
                .output()
                .ok()?;
            if !out.status.success() { return None; }
            let raw = out.stdout;
            let dims = std::process::Command::new("identify")
                .args(["-format", "%w %h", path])
                .output().ok()?;
            let dims_str = String::from_utf8_lossy(&dims.stdout);
            let mut parts = dims_str.split_whitespace();
            let w = parts.next()?.parse::<u32>().ok()?;
            let h = parts.next()?.parse::<u32>().ok()?;
            if raw.len() != (w * h * 4) as usize { return None; }
            image::RgbaImage::from_raw(w, h, raw)?
        }
    };
    
    // Check if the image is completely transparent. If so, force the text fallback.
    let mut has_visible_pixel = false;
    for pixel in rgba.pixels() {
        if pixel[3] > 10 { 
            has_visible_pixel = true; 
            break; 
        }
    }
    if !has_visible_pixel {
        eprintln!("[tray-render] image {:?} is fully transparent, using fallback", path);
        return None;
    }

    
    let (w, h) = rgba.dimensions();
    let handle = iced::widget::image::Handle::from_rgba(w, h, rgba.into_raw());
    g.insert(path.to_string(), handle.clone());
    Some(handle)
}

use crate::libraries::config::settings::ShellSettings;
use crate::libraries::config::theme::ShellTheme;
use crate::libraries::style::TextExt;
use crate::libraries::style::shape_box::{ShapeBox, ShapeType, SlantSide};

pub(super) fn render<'a, Message: 'a>(
    theme: &ShellTheme,
    region: &str,
) -> (Element<'a, Message>, CapsuleAction, Color) {
    let arrow = match region {
        "left" => "\u{25B6}",
        "right" => "\u{25C0}",
        _ => "\u{25BC}",
    };
    let elem = label::<Message>(&[(arrow.to_string(), theme.text)], theme.font_size_normal);
    (elem, CapsuleAction::ToggleTrayExpanded, theme.text)
}

/// Tray bias — the arrow (▼/◀/▶) is a single character centered
/// inside a `settings.tray_width`-wide pill. The default +32 global
/// offset would place the tooltip's left edge 32px from the pill's
/// container left. But the arrow's visual center is at
/// `pill_width/2`, so the tooltip appears shifted right by
/// `pill_width/2 - 32`. For typical `tray_width = 60`, that's a
/// +~-2 drift — subtle but every tray tooltip accumulates it.
///
/// The bias pulls the tooltip inward on the grow_right side so its
/// left edge aligns with the arrow's left edge, and pulls inward on
/// the grow_left side for the same reason (arrow's right edge).
pub(super) fn tooltip_bias(theme: &ShellTheme) -> (i32, i32) {
    // Arrow glyph width ~ theme.font_size_normal * 0.6 (ASCII-ish).
    let arrow_w = theme.font_size_normal as f32 * 0.6;
    // Default user offset (32) already shifts 32px inward.
    // Actual pill padding + slant ≈ (slant + 12). Difference is what
    // we need to correct. Rounded to i32 for the caller.
    let pad = theme.slant_width + 12.0;
    let bias = (pad - arrow_w / 2.0 - 8.0).round() as i32;
    (bias, bias)
}

static SVG_HANDLE_CACHE: OnceLock<
    Mutex<std::collections::HashMap<String, iced::widget::svg::Handle>>,
> = OnceLock::new();

fn cached_svg_handle(path: &str) -> iced::widget::svg::Handle {
    let cache = SVG_HANDLE_CACHE.get_or_init(|| Mutex::new(std::collections::HashMap::new()));
    let mut g = cache.lock().unwrap();
    if let Some(h) = g.get(path) {
        return h.clone();
    }
    let h = iced::widget::svg::Handle::from_path(path);
    g.insert(path.to_string(), h.clone());
    h
}

pub(super) fn render_expanded<'a, Message: 'static + Clone>(
    items: &[crate::bar::tray::TrayItem],
    theme: &ShellTheme,
    settings: &ShellSettings,
    slant_left: SlantSide,
    slant_right: SlantSide,
    region: &str,
    display_width: f32,
    on_action: impl Fn(CapsuleAction) -> Message + 'static + Copy,
) -> Element<'a, Message> {
    let icon_size = settings.tray_icon_size.max(16) as f32;
    let fallback_bg = theme.surface_alt;
    let fallback_border = theme.border;
    let fallback_fg = theme.text;
    let icon_pad = 4.0_f32;
    let icon_slot = icon_size + icon_pad * 2.0;
    let close_slot = 24.0_f32;
    let spacing = 4.0_f32;

    let shown = items.len().min(8);
    let empty_w = if items.is_empty() { 150.0 } else { 0.0 };
    let content_w = close_slot
        + if shown > 0 { spacing } else { 0.0 }
        + (icon_slot + spacing) * shown as f32
        + empty_w;
    let _full_min_width = content_w + theme.slant_width * 2.0 + 32.0;
    let bounding_w = display_width + theme.slant_width * 2.0;
    let show_icons = display_width > settings.tray_width as f32 + 3.0;

    let hover_bg = theme.surface_alt;
    let fg = theme.text;

    let close_arrow = match region {
        "left" => "◀",
        "right" => "▶",
        _ => "▲",
    };
    let close_btn = button(text(close_arrow).size(16).color(theme.text))
        .on_press(on_action(CapsuleAction::ToggleTrayExpanded))
        .padding(0)
        .width(Length::Fixed(close_slot))
        .height(Length::Fixed(close_slot))
        .style(move |_t, status| {
            let bg = match status {
                button::Status::Hovered | button::Status::Pressed => {
                    Some(iced::Background::Color(hover_bg))
                }
                _ => None,
            };
            button::Style {
                background: bg,
                border: iced::Border {
                    radius: 4.0.into(),
                    ..Default::default()
                },
                text_color: fg,
                ..Default::default()
            }
        });

    let mk_fallback = |item: &crate::bar::tray::TrayItem| -> Element<'a, Message> {
        let initial = item
            .title
            .chars()
            .next()
            .or_else(|| item.id.chars().next())
            .unwrap_or('?')
            .to_uppercase()
            .to_string();
        container(text(initial).size(icon_size * 0.6).color(fallback_fg).bold())
            .width(Length::Fixed(icon_size))
            .height(Length::Fixed(icon_size))
            .center_x(Length::Fill)
            .center_y(Length::Fill)
            .style(move |_t| container::Style {
                background: Some(iced::Background::Color(fallback_bg)),
                border: iced::Border {
                    color: fallback_border,
                    width: 1.0,
                    radius: 4.0.into(),
                },
                ..Default::default()
            })
            .into()
    };

    let mut icons_row = Row::new().spacing(spacing).align_y(Alignment::Center);
    for item in items.iter().take(shown) {
        let icon_elem: Element<'a, Message> = match &item.icon_path {
            Some(p) if std::path::Path::new(p).exists() && p.ends_with(".svg") => {
                iced::widget::svg(cached_svg_handle(p))
                    .width(Length::Fixed(icon_size))
                    .height(Length::Fixed(icon_size))
                    .into()
            }
            Some(p) if std::path::Path::new(p).exists() => cached_rgba_handle(p)
                .map(|handle| {
                    iced::widget::image(handle)
                        .width(Length::Fixed(icon_size))
                        .height(Length::Fixed(icon_size))
                        .into()
                })
                .unwrap_or_else(|| mk_fallback(item)),
            _ => mk_fallback(item),
        };

        let activate_item = item.clone();
        let ctx_item = item.clone();

        let icon_box = container(icon_elem)
            .padding(icon_pad)
            .center_x(Length::Fixed(icon_slot))
            .center_y(Length::Fixed(icon_slot));

        let clickable = MouseArea::new(icon_box)
            .on_press(on_action(CapsuleAction::TrayActivate(activate_item)))
            .on_right_press(on_action(CapsuleAction::TrayContextMenu(ctx_item)));

        let interactive: Element<'a, Message> = if !item.tooltip.is_empty() {
            let tt_text = item.tooltip.clone();
            let tt_bg = theme.surface_alt;
            let tt_fg = theme.text;
            let tt_border = theme.border;
            tooltip(
                clickable,
                container(text(tt_text).size(11).color(tt_fg))
                    .padding(6)
                    .style(move |_t| container::Style {
                        background: Some(iced::Background::Color(tt_bg)),
                        border: iced::Border {
                            color: tt_border,
                            width: 1.0,
                            radius: 4.0.into(),
                        },
                        ..Default::default()
                    }),
                tooltip::Position::Bottom,
            )
            .into()
        } else {
            clickable.into()
        };

        icons_row = icons_row.push(interactive);
    }

    let pad_x = theme.slant_width.round() as u16;
    let mut content = if region == "right" {
        let mut r = Row::new().spacing(spacing).align_y(Alignment::Center);
        if show_icons {
            r = r.push(icons_row);
        }
        r = r.push(close_btn);
        r
    } else {
        let mut r = Row::new().spacing(spacing).align_y(Alignment::Center);
        r = r.push(close_btn);
        if show_icons {
            r = r.push(icons_row);
        }
        r
    }
    .padding([0, pad_x]);
    if items.is_empty() {
        content = content.push(
            container(text("Empty").size(11).color(theme.muted))
                .width(Length::Fixed(bounding_w - pad_x as f32 * 2.0))
                .center_x(Length::Fill)
                .clip(true),
        );
    }

    let shape_type = ShapeType::Slant {
        left: slant_left,
        right: slant_right,
    };

    let background_shape = ShapeBox::new()
        .shape(shape_type)
        .background(theme.background)
        .border(theme.text, theme.control_border_width)
        .slant_width(theme.slant_width)
        .size(Length::Fixed(bounding_w), Length::Fill);

    container(
        Stack::new().push(background_shape.view()).push(
            container(content)
                .width(Length::Fixed(bounding_w))
                .height(Length::Fill)
                .align_x(Alignment::Center)
                .align_y(Alignment::Center),
        ),
    )
    .width(Length::Fixed(bounding_w))
    .clip(true)
    .into()
}

//! Bar layout geometry — capsule positions and widths.
//!
//! These functions translate `ShellSettings` into pixel coordinates for
//! capsule centers. They're used by the `Message::TopBar` handler to
//! anchor tooltips under the correct capsule.

use crate::libraries::config::ShellSettings;

pub fn capsule_min_width(id: &str) -> f32 {
    match id {
        "calendar" => 110.0,
        "music" => 140.0,
        "alarm" => 90.0,
        "weather" => 95.0,
        "unified" => 80.0,
        "notify" => 120.0,
        "clock" => 85.0,
        "audio" => 95.0,
        "mic" => 80.0,
        "net" => 145.0,
        "cpu" => 115.0,
        "gpu" => 150.0,
        "ram" => 105.0,
        "battery" => 85.0,
        _ => 80.0,
    }
}

pub fn capsule_actual_width(id: &str) -> f32 {
    crate::bar::capsules::lookup_width(id).unwrap_or_else(|| capsule_min_width(id))
}

pub fn row_width(items: &[&String], sp: f32, settings: &ShellSettings) -> f32 {
    let n = items.len();
    items
        .iter()
        .enumerate()
        .map(|(i, id)| {
            let w = if id.as_str() == "tray" {
                settings.tray_width as f32
            } else {
                capsule_actual_width(id.as_str())
            };
            if i + 1 < n {
                w + sp
            } else {
                w
            }
        })
        .sum()
}

pub fn capsule_center_x(s: &ShellSettings, sw: u32, target: &str) -> i32 {
    let sw_f = sw as f32;
    let sp = s.capsule_spacing as f32;
    let pad = 16.0;

    let visible = |id: &String| s.visible_capsules.get(id).copied().unwrap_or(true);
    let left_items: Vec<&String> = s.bar_left.iter().filter(|id| visible(id)).collect();
    let center_items: Vec<&String> = s.bar_center.iter().filter(|id| visible(id)).collect();
    let right_items: Vec<&String> = s.bar_right.iter().filter(|id| visible(id)).collect();

    let w_of = |id: &str| -> f32 {
        if id == "tray" {
            s.tray_width as f32
        } else {
            capsule_actual_width(id)
        }
    };

    // 1. bar_left
    let mut x = pad;
    for (i, id) in left_items.iter().enumerate() {
        let w = w_of(id.as_str());
        if id.as_str() == target {
            return (x + w / 2.0) as i32;
        }
        x += w + if i + 1 < left_items.len() { sp } else { 0.0 };
    }

    // 2. bar_center
    let left_w = row_width(&left_items, sp, s);
    let right_w = row_width(&right_items, sp, s);
    let center_w = row_width(&center_items, sp, s);
    let avail = sw_f - 2.0 * pad;
    let fill_w = ((avail - left_w - center_w - right_w) / 2.0).max(0.0);
    let mut x = pad + left_w + fill_w;
    for (i, id) in center_items.iter().enumerate() {
        let w = w_of(id.as_str());
        if id.as_str() == target {
            return (x + w / 2.0) as i32;
        }
        x += w + if i + 1 < center_items.len() { sp } else { 0.0 };
    }

    // 3. bar_right
    let mut x = pad + avail - right_w;
    for (i, id) in right_items.iter().enumerate() {
        let w = w_of(id.as_str());
        if id.as_str() == target {
            return (x + w / 2.0) as i32;
        }
        x += w + if i + 1 < right_items.len() { sp } else { 0.0 };
    }

    200
}

use iced::widget::{container, row, Row, Stack};
use iced::{Alignment, Element, Length};

use super::capsules::{CapsuleAction, CapsuleRenderer};
use crate::bar::tray::TrayItem;
use crate::libraries::backend::UnifiedTelemetry;

pub struct TopBar;

#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
fn render_capsule_slot<'a>(
    id: &str,
    telemetry: &'a UnifiedTelemetry,
    theme: &ShellTheme,
    settings: &ShellSettings,
    sl: SlantSide,
    sr: SlantSide,
    region: &str,
    tray_expanded: bool,
    tray_items: &'a [TrayItem],
    tray_anim_width: f32,
) -> Element<'a, TopBarMessage> {
    if id == "tray" && (tray_expanded || tray_anim_width > settings.tray_width as f32 + 0.5) {
        CapsuleRenderer::render_tray_expanded(
            tray_items, theme, settings, sl, sr, region, tray_anim_width, TopBarMessage::Action,
        )
    } else {
        let cap = CapsuleRenderer::render(
            id, telemetry, theme, settings, sl, sr, &settings.module_shape, region, TopBarMessage::Action,
        );
        if id == "tray" {
            container(cap).width(Length::Fixed(settings.tray_width as f32)).into()
        } else {
            cap
        }
    }
}

impl TopBar {
    pub fn view<'a>(
        settings: &ShellSettings,
        theme: &ShellTheme,
        telemetry: &'a UnifiedTelemetry,
        tray_expanded: bool,
        tray_items: &'a [TrayItem],
        tray_anim_width: f32,
    ) -> Element<'a, TopBarMessage> {
        let spacing_px = settings.capsule_spacing as f32;

        let mut left_row = Row::new().spacing(spacing_px).align_y(Alignment::Center);
        for id in &settings.bar_left {
            if settings.visible_capsules.get(id).copied().unwrap_or(true) {
                let (sl, sr) = match settings.slant_mode.as_str() {
                    "left" => (SlantSide::Left, SlantSide::Left),
                    "right" => (SlantSide::Right, SlantSide::Right),
                    _ => (SlantSide::Left, SlantSide::Left),
                };
                left_row = left_row.push(render_capsule_slot(id, telemetry, theme, settings, sl, sr, "left", tray_expanded, tray_items, tray_anim_width));
            }
        }

        let mut center_row = Row::new().spacing(spacing_px).align_y(Alignment::Center);
        let visible_center: Vec<&String> = settings
            .bar_center
            .iter()
            .filter(|id| settings.visible_capsules.get(*id).copied().unwrap_or(true))
            .collect();
        let keystone_idx = visible_center.len() / 2;

        for (i, id) in visible_center.iter().enumerate() {
            let (sl, sr) = match settings.slant_mode.as_str() {
                "left" => (SlantSide::Left, SlantSide::Left),
                "right" => (SlantSide::Right, SlantSide::Right),
                _ => {
                    if i == keystone_idx {
                        (SlantSide::Left, SlantSide::Right)
                    } else if i < keystone_idx {
                        (SlantSide::Left, SlantSide::Left)
                    } else {
                        (SlantSide::Right, SlantSide::Right)
                    }
                }
            };
            center_row = center_row.push(render_capsule_slot(id, telemetry, theme, settings, sl, sr, "center", tray_expanded, tray_items, tray_anim_width));
        }

        let mut right_row = Row::new().spacing(spacing_px).align_y(Alignment::Center);
        for id in &settings.bar_right {
            if settings.visible_capsules.get(id).copied().unwrap_or(true) {
                let (sl, sr) = match settings.slant_mode.as_str() {
                    "left" => (SlantSide::Left, SlantSide::Left),
                    "right" => (SlantSide::Right, SlantSide::Right),
                    _ => (SlantSide::Right, SlantSide::Right),
                };
                right_row = right_row.push(render_capsule_slot(id, telemetry, theme, settings, sl, sr, "right", tray_expanded, tray_items, tray_anim_width));
            }
        }

        // Summary log every time tray state changes
        {
            use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};
            static LAST_EXPANDED: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
            let was = LAST_EXPANDED.swap(tray_expanded, Ordering::Relaxed);
            if was != tray_expanded {
                let mut total = 0.0f32;
                let mut count = 0;
                for id in settings
                    .bar_left
                    .iter()
                    .chain(settings.bar_center.iter())
                    .chain(settings.bar_right.iter())
                {
                    if settings.visible_capsules.get(id).copied().unwrap_or(true) {
                        if let Some(w) = super::capsules::lookup_width(id) {
                            total += w;
                            count += 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
                eprintln!(
                    "[bar-layout] {} visible capsules, sum={:.1}px",
                    count, total
                );
            }
        }

        let bar_shape = match settings.bar_shape.as_str() {
            "hexagon" => ShapeType::Hexagon {
                cut: (theme.slant_width * 1.5) as u16,
            },
            "rounded" => ShapeType::Rounded(((theme.slant_width * 1.5) as u16).max(4)),
            "flat" => ShapeType::Flat,
            _ => ShapeType::Slant {
                left: SlantSide::Left,
                right: SlantSide::Right,
            },
        };

        let bar_background = ShapeBox::new()
            .shape(bar_shape)
            .background(theme.background)
            .border(theme.border, theme.border_width)
            .slant_width(theme.slant_width * 1.5)
            .size(Length::Fill, Length::Fixed(settings.bar_height as f32));

        let content = row![
            left_row,
            iced::widget::space::horizontal(),
            center_row,
            iced::widget::space::horizontal(),
            right_row,
        ]
        .padding([4, 24])
        .align_y(Alignment::Center)
        .width(Length::Fill)
        .height(Length::Fixed(settings.bar_height as f32));

        container(Stack::new().push(bar_background.view()).push(content))
            .width(Length::Fill)
            .height(Length::Fixed(settings.bar_height as f32))
            .into()
    }
}

//! Tooltip child process spawning.
//!
//! Height calculation, offset bias env helpers, and Wayland output lookup.

use crate::libraries::backend::UnifiedTelemetry;
use crate::libraries::config::ShellSettings;

/// Read per-capsule offset bias from env, added on top of global offsets.
pub fn read_offset_extra() -> (i32, i32) {
    let read = |key: &str| -> i32 {
        std::env::var(key)
            .ok()
            .and_then(|s| s.parse().ok())
            .unwrap_or(0)
    };
    (
        read("MBS_TOOLTIP_OFFSET_LEFT_EXTRA"),
        read("MBS_TOOLTIP_OFFSET_RIGHT_EXTRA"),
    )
}

/// Compute the popup height for a given tooltip id.
///
/// Priority:
///   1. If `settings.tooltip_sizes` contains an entry for this id, return
///      its height (produced by dragging the resize box in Settings → Bar Layout).
///   2. Otherwise, derive height from current telemetry content size
///      (weather forecast line count, CPU/GPU/RAM process count, etc.).
pub fn compute_height(id: &str, settings: &ShellSettings, telemetry: &UnifiedTelemetry) -> u32 {
    // User-dragged override wins.
    if let Some((w, h)) = settings.tooltip_sizes.get(id) {
        eprintln!(
            "[compute-h] id={} EXPLICIT OVERRIDE {}x{} (from tooltip_sizes)",
            id, w, h
        );
        return *h;
    }

    // No override: derive from content.
    let bar_h = settings.bar_height;
    let content_h: u32 = match id {
        "weather" => {
            let lines = telemetry
                .weather
                .as_ref()
                .map(|w| w.tooltip_lines.len().min(15) as u32)
                .unwrap_or(1);
            lines * 24 + 40
        }
        "calendar" => {
            use chrono::Datelike;
            let now = chrono::Local::now();
            let first =
                chrono::NaiveDate::from_ymd_opt(now.year(), now.month(), 1).unwrap_or_default();
            let (ny, nm) = if now.month() == 12 {
                (now.year() + 1, 1)
            } else {
                (now.year(), now.month() + 1)
            };
            let next = chrono::NaiveDate::from_ymd_opt(ny, nm, 1).unwrap_or_default();
            let days = next.signed_duration_since(first).num_days() as u32;
            let offset = first.weekday().num_days_from_sunday();
            let weeks = (offset + days).div_ceil(7);
            40 + 36 + 24 + weeks * 50 + 20
        }
        "cpu" => telemetry.cpu.top_procs.len().min(10) as u32 * 24 + 100,
        "gpu" => telemetry.gpu.top_procs.len().min(10) as u32 * 24 + 100,
        "ram" => telemetry.ram.top_procs.len().min(10) as u32 * 24 + 100,
        "net" => 450,
        "music" => 520,
        "unified" => 400,
        "custom" => 300,
        "clock" => 320,
        _ => 400,
    };
    let total = content_h + bar_h + 20;
    eprintln!(
        "[compute-h] id={} DEFAULT content_h={} bar_h={} total={} (no override)",
        id, content_h, bar_h, total
    );
    total
}

// Wayland output lookup — resolve primary/focused output and screen width.

pub fn resolve_primary_output() -> Option<String> {
    let out = std::process::Command::new("swaymsg")
        .args(["-t", "get_outputs", "-r"])
        .output()
        .ok()?;
    if !out.status.success() {
        return None;
    }
    let v: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_slice(&out.stdout).ok()?;
    let arr = v.as_array()?;
    // Prefer "primary"
    for o in arr {
        if o.get("primary").and_then(|p| p.as_bool()) == Some(true) {
            if let Some(name) = o.get("name").and_then(|n| n.as_str()) {
                return Some(name.to_string());
            }
        }
    }
    // Fallback: focused
    for o in arr {
        if o.get("focused").and_then(|f| f.as_bool()) == Some(true) {
            if let Some(name) = o.get("name").and_then(|n| n.as_str()) {
                return Some(name.to_string());
            }
        }
    }
    None
}

pub fn get_screen_width_for(output: Option<&str>) -> u32 {
    if let Ok(o) = std::process::Command::new("swaymsg")
        .args(["-t", "get_outputs", "-r"])
        .output()
    {
        if o.status.success() {
            if let Ok(v) = serde_json::from_slice::<serde_json::Value>(&o.stdout) {
                if let Some(arr) = v.as_array() {
                    if let Some(name) = output {
                        for out in arr {
                            if out.get("name").and_then(|n| n.as_str()) == Some(name) {
                                if let Some(w) = out
                                    .get("rect")
                                    .and_then(|r| r.get("width"))
                                    .and_then(|w| w.as_u64())
                                {
                                    return if w > 0 { w as u32 } else { 1920 };
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    for out in arr {
                        if out.get("focused").and_then(|f| f.as_bool()) == Some(true) {
                            if let Some(w) = out
                                .get("rect")
                                .and_then(|r| r.get("width"))
                                .and_then(|w| w.as_u64())
                            {
                                return if w > 0 { w as u32 } else { 1920 };
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    1920
}

//! Lockscreen keyboard event to Key mapping.
//!
//! Extracted from handle_lock_keypress in main.rs so the logic is
//! testable without spinning up a lockscreen. The wrapper in main.rs
//! applies the Status::Captured filter and wraps the result in
//! Message::Lock(LockMessage::KeyPress(..)).

pub fn resolve_lock_key(event: iced::Event) -> Option<iced::keyboard::Key> {
    let iced::Event::Keyboard(iced::keyboard::Event::KeyPressed {
        modified_key, text, ..
    }) = event
    else {
        return None;
    };
    use iced::keyboard::{key::Named, Key};

    // 1. Named keys first (control chars would be rejected by text filter).
    if let Key::Named(named) = &modified_key {
        if matches!(named, Named::Enter | Named::Backspace | Named::Tab) {
            return Some(modified_key);
        }
    }

    // 2. Printable characters: prefer `text`.
    if let Some(t) = text {
        if !t.is_empty() && !t.chars().any(|c| c.is_control()) {
            return Some(Key::Character(t));
        }
    }

    // 3. Fallback: modified_key.
    if let Key::Character(c) = modified_key {
        if !c.is_empty() {
            return Some(Key::Character(c));
        }
    }

    None
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use iced::keyboard::key::{NativeCode, Physical};
    use iced::keyboard::{Key, Location, Modifiers};

    /// Build a KeyPressed event with the given modified_key and text fields.
    /// `key` is set equal to `modified_key` — resolve_lock_key doesn't read
    /// it, so the choice is arbitrary but documented here.
    fn key_pressed(modified_key: Key, text: Option<&'static str>) -> iced::Event {
        iced::Event::Keyboard(iced::keyboard::Event::KeyPressed {
            key: modified_key.clone(),
            modified_key,
            physical_key: Physical::Unidentified(NativeCode::Unidentified),
            location: Location::Standard,
            modifiers: Modifiers::default(),
            text: text.map(Into::into),
            repeat: false,
        })
    }

    /// Regression: Enter's `text` field is `\r` (a control character). If
    /// the printable filter runs first, Enter is silently dropped and the
    /// coordinator never sees Submit — the lockscreen stays locked.
    #[test]
    fn enter_returns_named_enter_despite_control_char_text() {
        use iced::keyboard::key::Named;
        let ev = key_pressed(Key::Named(Named::Enter), Some("\r"));
        assert!(matches!(
            resolve_lock_key(ev),
            Some(Key::Named(Named::Enter))
        ));
    }

    /// Regression: same trap as Enter — Tab's `text` is `\t`.
    #[test]
    fn tab_returns_named_tab() {
        use iced::keyboard::key::Named;
        let ev = key_pressed(Key::Named(Named::Tab), Some("\t"));
        assert!(matches!(resolve_lock_key(ev), Some(Key::Named(Named::Tab))));
    }

    #[test]
    fn backspace_returns_named_backspace() {
        use iced::keyboard::key::Named;
        let ev = key_pressed(Key::Named(Named::Backspace), None);
        assert!(matches!(
            resolve_lock_key(ev),
            Some(Key::Named(Named::Backspace))
        ));
    }

    /// Regression: `key` field ignores modifiers (Shift+P → "p"). The
    /// resolve function must prefer `text` so the uppercase "P" survives.
    #[test]
    fn shift_p_returns_uppercase() {
        let ev = key_pressed(Key::Character("P".into()), Some("P"));
        assert!(matches!(
            resolve_lock_key(ev),
            Some(Key::Character(c)) if c == "P"
        ));
    }

    #[test]
    fn plain_lowercase_passes_through() {
        let ev = key_pressed(Key::Character("p".into()), Some("p"));
        assert!(matches!(
            resolve_lock_key(ev),
            Some(Key::Character(c)) if c == "p"
        ));
    }

    /// Fallback path: no `text` provided, falls back to `modified_key`.
    #[test]
    fn character_without_text_uses_modified_key() {
        let ev = key_pressed(Key::Character("P".into()), None);
        assert!(matches!(
            resolve_lock_key(ev),
            Some(Key::Character(c)) if c == "P"
        ));
    }

    /// Modifier keys (Shift, Ctrl, etc.) produce no text and shouldn't
    /// be forwarded to the password buffer.
    #[test]
    fn modifier_only_returns_none() {
        use iced::keyboard::key::Named;
        let ev = key_pressed(Key::Named(Named::Shift), None);
        assert!(resolve_lock_key(ev).is_none());
    }
}

//! Multi-monitor lock coordinator.
//!
//! Coordinator owns the password buffer. Each child is a pure display —
//! it forwards every keystroke over IPC and renders whatever dot count
//! the coordinator broadcasts. Result: typing on DP-1 makes dots appear
//! on DP-1 AND DP-2 simultaneously. Enter from any monitor triggers auth.
//!
//! Child protocol:
//!   →  Key(String)      single char or IME cluster
//!   →  Backspace
//!   →  Submit
//!   ←  BufferUpdate(usize)  current char count in coordinator's buffer
//!   ←  Reset                auth failed, clear everything
//!   ←  Success              auth succeeded, prepare to be killed
//!
//! Hotplug: subscribe to `swaymsg -t subscribe -m '["output"]'`.
//! `added` → spawn child; `removed` → keep child as blocker.

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use zeroize::{Zeroize, Zeroizing};
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::process::{Child, Command, Stdio};
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
use std::time::Duration;
use tokio::io::{AsyncBufReadExt, AsyncWriteExt, BufReader};
use tokio::net::unix::OwnedWriteHalf;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum LockIpc {
    // ── Client → Coordinator ──
    Key(String),
    Backspace,
    Submit,
    // ── Coordinator → Client ──
    BufferUpdate(usize),
    Reset,
    Success,
}

struct Peer {
    id: usize,
    writer: OwnedWriteHalf,
}

/// Resolve the effective user name. Uses `id -un` (the source of truth
/// for the calling process's euid) before falling back to env vars.
/// `$USER` is not always set — e.g. when launched via `nix develop -c`,
/// `systemd --user`, or certain sway exec contexts. If we fell back to
/// "root" here, pamtester would try to authenticate as root and always fail.
fn resolve_user() -> String {
    use std::sync::OnceLock;
    static CACHE: OnceLock<String> = OnceLock::new();
    CACHE
        .get_or_init(|| {
            let id_bin = find_bin("id").unwrap_or_else(|| std::path::PathBuf::from("id"));
            if let Ok(out) = std::process::Command::new(&id_bin).arg("-un").output() {
                if out.status.success() {
                    let s = String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout).trim().to_string();
                    if !s.is_empty() {
                        return s;
                    }
                }
            }
            std::env::var("USER")
                .or_else(|_| std::env::var("LOGNAME"))
                .unwrap_or_else(|_| "root".into())
        })
        .clone()
}

/// First 8 hex chars of SHA-256(input) for debug logging without logging plaintext.
fn sha256_prefix(s: &str) -> String {
    use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
    let mut h = Sha256::new();
    h.update(s.as_bytes());
    let r = h.finalize();
    format!("{:02x}{:02x}{:02x}{:02x}", r[0], r[1], r[2], r[3])
}

/// Locate a binary reliably even when PATH is empty. NixOS puts most tools
/// in /run/current-system/sw/bin, wrappers in /run/wrappers/bin, and user
/// nix profile in ~/.nix-profile/bin. Fall back to PATH last.
fn find_bin(name: &str) -> Option<std::path::PathBuf> {
    let fallbacks: &[&str] = match name {
        "pamtester" => &[
            "/run/current-system/sw/bin/pamtester",
            "/usr/bin/pamtester",
            "/usr/local/bin/pamtester",
            "/nix/var/nix/profiles/default/bin/pamtester",
        ],
        "sudo" => &["/run/wrappers/bin/sudo", "/usr/bin/sudo", "/bin/sudo"],
        "su" => &["/run/wrappers/bin/su", "/usr/bin/su", "/bin/su"],
        "swaymsg" => &["/run/current-system/sw/bin/swaymsg", "/usr/bin/swaymsg"],
        "id" => &["/usr/bin/id", "/bin/id"],
        "script" => &["/usr/bin/script", "/bin/script"],
        "which" => &["/usr/bin/which", "/bin/which"],
        _ => &[],
    };
    for p in fallbacks {
        if std::path::Path::new(p).exists() {
            return Some(std::path::PathBuf::from(p));
        }
    }
    if let Ok(path_env) = std::env::var("PATH") {
        for dir in path_env.split(':') {
            let c = std::path::Path::new(dir).join(name);
            if c.exists() {
                return Some(c);
            }
        }
    }
    None
}

/// Sweep stale lockscreen sockets whose embedded PID is not a live
/// coordinator. Called from spawn() before binding the new socket so
/// the sweep can't race with our own freshly-created file.
fn sweep_stale_lockscreen_sockets(runtime_dir: &str, current_pid: u32) {
    let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(runtime_dir) else {
        return;
    };
    let mut cleaned = 0u32;
    for entry in entries.flatten() {
        let name = entry.file_name();
        let Some(s) = name.to_str() else {
            continue;
        };
        let Some(rest) = s.strip_prefix("moon-beauty-lock-") else {
            continue;
        };
        let Some(pid_str) = rest.strip_suffix(".sock") else {
            continue;
        };
        let Ok(pid) = pid_str.parse::<u32>() else {
            continue;
        };
        if pid == current_pid {
            continue;
        }
        let cmdline = std::fs::read(format!("/proc/{}/cmdline", pid)).ok();
        let is_live = cmdline
            .as_ref()
            .map(|c| c.split(|b| *b == 0).any(|part| part == b"--lockscreen"))
            .unwrap_or(false);
        if is_live {
            continue;
        }
        if std::fs::remove_file(entry.path()).is_ok() {
            cleaned += 1;
            eprintln!(
                "[lock-coord] cleaned stale socket {:?} (pid {} no longer a coordinator)",
                entry.path(),
                pid
            );
        }
    }
    if cleaned > 0 {
        eprintln!("[lock-coord] swept {} stale socket file(s)", cleaned);
    }
}

/// Kill all children, wait for them, remove the socket file. Called from
/// the SIGTERM/SIGINT handler before std::process::exit(0).
fn shutdown_lockscreen_children(
    children: &Arc<Mutex<HashMap<String, Child>>>,
    socket_path: &std::path::Path,
) {
    if let Ok(mut g) = children.lock() {
        for (_, mut child) in g.drain() {
            let _ = child.kill();
            let _ = child.wait();
        }
    }
    let _ = std::fs::remove_file(socket_path);
    eprintln!("[lock-coord] shutdown complete");
}

fn sudo_is_nopasswd() -> bool {
    // Detect whether `sudo` requires a password on this host.
    //
    // Runs `sudo -k -n -v`:
    //   -k  invalidate any cached sudo timestamp (avoids false positives)
    //   -n  never prompt (fails immediately if a password would be needed)
    //   -v  validate (renew) the sudo timestamp
    //
    // Exit 0 = sudo did NOT need a password → NOPASSWD rule active.
    // Exit !=0 = sudo needs a password, or sudo is missing.
    //
    // On a NOPASSWD host, `sudo -v` in authenticate() would return 0
    // with ANY input, making sudo useless as an auth oracle. This check
    // short-circuits that strategy.
    let sudo_bin = find_bin("sudo").unwrap_or_else(|| std::path::PathBuf::from("sudo"));
    std::process::Command::new(&sudo_bin)
        .args(["-k", "-n", "-v"])
        .stdout(Stdio::null())
        .stderr(Stdio::null())
        .status()
        .map(|s| s.success())
        .unwrap_or(false)
}

pub struct LockCoordinator;

impl LockCoordinator {
    /// Interactive auth test — run with `--test-lock-auth`. Reads password
    /// from stdin (masked), runs every strategy, reports results.
    pub fn run_auth_test() {
        use std::io::{stdin, BufRead};

        eprintln!("=== Lock auth test ===");
        eprintln!("This bypasses the lock screen and tests the auth logic directly.");
        eprintln!();

        let rt = tokio::runtime::Runtime::new().expect("rt");
        rt.block_on(async {
            // Test sudo availability
            eprintln!("── Environment ──");
            eprintln!("USER = {:?}", std::env::var("USER"));
            match tokio::process::Command::new("which")
                .arg("sudo")
                .output()
                .await
            {
                Ok(out) => eprintln!("sudo = {:?}", String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout).trim()),
                Err(_) => eprintln!("sudo = NOT FOUND"),
            }
            match tokio::process::Command::new("which")
                .arg("pamtester")
                .output()
                .await
            {
                Ok(out) => {
                    let p = String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout).trim().to_string();
                    if p.is_empty() {
                        eprintln!("pamtester = not installed");
                    } else {
                        eprintln!("pamtester = {:?}", p);
                    }
                }
                Err(_) => eprintln!("pamtester = not installed"),
            }
            eprintln!();

            // Prompt for password
            eprintln!("── Input ──");
            eprint!("Enter password (visible for debugging): ");
            use std::io::Write;
            std::io::stderr().flush().ok();
            let mut input = String::new();
            stdin().lock().read_line(&mut input).ok();
            let mut password =
                Zeroizing::new(input.trim_end_matches(['\r', '\n']).to_string());
            input.zeroize();
            eprintln!(
                "len={} first={:?} last={:?}",
                password.chars().count(),
                password.chars().next(),
                password.chars().last()
            );
            eprintln!();

            // Run authenticate with full logging
            eprintln!("── Running strategies ──");
            let ok = Self::authenticate(&password).await;
            eprintln!();
            if ok {
                eprintln!("RESULT: ✓ auth succeeded");
                password.zeroize();
                std::process::exit(0);
            } else {
                eprintln!("RESULT: ✗ all strategies failed");
                password.zeroize();
                std::process::exit(1);
            }
        });
    }

    pub fn spawn() -> ! {
        let runtime_dir = std::env::var("XDG_RUNTIME_DIR").unwrap_or_else(|_| {
            eprintln!("[lock-coord] FATAL: XDG_RUNTIME_DIR is not set; refusing to place lockscreen socket in shared /tmp");
            std::process::exit(1);
        });
        eprintln!("[lock-coord-v225] START pid={}", std::process::id());
        let pid = std::process::id();
        let socket_path =
            PathBuf::from(&runtime_dir).join(format!("moon-beauty-lock-{}.sock", pid));
        sweep_stale_lockscreen_sockets(&runtime_dir, pid);
        let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&socket_path);

        #[cfg(not(feature = "lock-debug-bypass"))]
        if std::env::var_os("MBS_LOCK_DEBUG_PASS").is_some() {
            eprintln!("[lock-coord] NOTE: MBS_LOCK_DEBUG_PASS set but lock-debug-bypass feature is not compiled in; NO effect");
        }
        #[cfg(feature = "lock-debug-bypass")]
        if let Ok(v) = std::env::var("MBS_LOCK_DEBUG_PASS") {
            eprintln!(
                "[lock-coord] WARNING: MBS_LOCK_DEBUG_PASS is set (len={}); bypass armed (COMPILE-TIME FEATURE — DO NOT SHIP)",
                v.len()
            );
        }

        {
            let u = resolve_user();
            eprintln!("[lock-coord] user resolved via id -un → {}", u);
        }

        let children: Arc<Mutex<HashMap<String, Child>>> = Arc::new(Mutex::new(HashMap::new()));
        // Which output's child currently holds the Exclusive keyboard
        // grab. Only one child may be primary: Wayland allows one
        // Exclusive layer surface per seat, and spawning all three as
        // Exclusive lets sway rotate focus mid-typing, dropping chars
        // from the coordinator's buffer.
        let primary_output: Arc<Mutex<Option<String>>> = Arc::new(Mutex::new(None));

        // Startup diagnostic: report what auth strategies are usable.
        // Logs a clear WARNING when no strategy can succeed — the
        // lockscreen will fail closed (refuse all passwords) rather than
        // silently accept any input.
        {
            let pam_bin = find_bin("pamtester");
            let sudo_bin = find_bin("sudo");
            let sudo_nopasswd = if sudo_bin.is_some() {
                sudo_is_nopasswd()
            } else {
                false
            };
            eprintln!(
                "[lock-coord] auth: pamtester={:?} sudo={:?} sudo_nopasswd={}",
                pam_bin, sudo_bin, sudo_nopasswd
            );
            let usable = pam_bin.is_some() as u32 + (sudo_bin.is_some() && !sudo_nopasswd) as u32;
            if usable == 0 {
                eprintln!(
                    "[lock-coord] WARNING: no working auth strategy. \
                     The lockscreen will FAIL CLOSED — even the correct \
                     password will not unlock. Fix one of: (a) install \
                     pamtester AND enable security.pam.services.login, \
                     (b) remove NOPASSWD from the invoking user's sudoers \
                     rule."
                );
            }
        }

        eprintln!("[lock-coord-v225] binding socket at {:?}", socket_path);
        let listener = match std::os::unix::net::UnixListener::bind(&socket_path) {
            Ok(l) => {
                let _ = std::fs::set_permissions(&socket_path, {
                    use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
                    std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o600)
                });
                eprintln!("[lock-coord-v225] socket bound OK");
                l
            }
            Err(e) => {
                eprintln!("[lock-coord] bind failed: {}", e);
                Self::kill_all(&children);
                std::process::exit(1);
            }
        };
        listener.set_nonblocking(true).ok();

        // Initial spawn
        let outputs = Self::list_outputs();
        if outputs.is_empty() {
            eprintln!("[lock-coord] no outputs — spawning single instance");
            *primary_output.lock().unwrap() = Some(String::new());
            Self::spawn_child("", &socket_path, &children, true);
        } else {
            eprintln!(
                "[lock-coord] spawning {} children for {:?}",
                outputs.len(),
                outputs
            );
            for (idx, output) in outputs.iter().enumerate() {
                let is_primary = idx == 0;
                if is_primary {
                    *primary_output.lock().unwrap() = Some(output.clone());
                }
                eprintln!(
                    "[lock-coord-v225] spawning child for output={:?} primary={}",
                    output, is_primary
                );
                Self::spawn_child(output, &socket_path, &children, is_primary);
            }
        }

        let rt = tokio::runtime::Runtime::new().expect("rt");
        rt.block_on(async move {
            let listener = match tokio::net::UnixListener::from_std(listener) {
                Ok(l) => l,
                Err(e) => {
                    eprintln!("[lock-coord] tokio listener: {}", e);
                    Self::kill_all(&children);
                    std::process::exit(1);
                }
            };

            let (event_tx, mut event_rx) = tokio::sync::mpsc::channel::<(usize, LockIpc)>(256);
            let mut peers: Vec<Peer> = Vec::new();
            let mut buffer = String::new();
            let mut next_id: usize = 1;
            // Rate-limit Submit to mitigate PAM/sudo account-lockout DoS.
            let mut last_failed_submit: Option<std::time::Instant> = None;
            let mut fail_streak: u32 = 0;

            // Hotplug watcher
            let children_watch = children.clone();
            let socket_watch = socket_path.clone();
            let primary_output_watch = primary_output.clone();
            tokio::spawn(async move {
                let mut cmd = match tokio::process::Command::new("swaymsg")
                    .args(["-t", "subscribe", "-m", r#"["output"]"#])
                    .stdout(Stdio::piped())
                    .stderr(Stdio::null())
                    .spawn()
                {
                    Ok(c) => c,
                    Err(e) => {
                        eprintln!("[lock-coord] hotplug watcher: {}", e);
                        return;
                    }
                };
                let Some(out) = cmd.stdout.take() else { return; };
                let mut lines = BufReader::new(out).lines();
                while let Ok(Some(line)) = lines.next_line().await {
                    let Ok(v) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(&line) else {
                        continue;
                    };
                    let change = v.get("change").and_then(|c| c.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
                    let output = v.get("output").and_then(|o| o.as_str()).unwrap_or("").to_string();
                    match change {
                        "added" => {
                            tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(300)).await;
                            let is_primary = {
                                let mut po = primary_output_watch.lock().unwrap();
                                if po.as_deref() == Some(output.as_str()) {
                                    *po = None;
                                    true
                                } else if po.is_none() {
                                    *po = Some(output.clone());
                                    true
                                } else {
                                    false
                                }
                            };
                            if let Ok(mut map) = children_watch.lock() {
                                if let Some(mut old) = map.remove(&output) {
                                    eprintln!(
                                        "[lock-coord] hotplug: replacing child for {:?}",
                                        output
                                    );
                                    let _ = old.kill();
                                    let _ = old.wait();
                                }
                            }
                            Self::spawn_child(&output, &socket_watch, &children_watch, is_primary);
                        }
                        "removed" => {
                            // Do NOT kill the child. On TTY switch, sway
                            // may emit "removed" for temporarily unavailable
                            // outputs; keeping the child alive as a blocker
                            // avoids an unlocked-screen window.
                            eprintln!(
                                "[lock-coord] hotplug: output removed: {:?} (child kept as blocker)",
                                output
                            );
                        }
                        _ => {}
                    }
                }
            });


            // ── TTY return watcher ──
            // When switching to another VT and back, sway drops the layer
            // surfaces held by lockscreen children without sending Closed.
            // Respawn primary-first on return-to-desktop so sway gets fresh
            // surfaces with only one Exclusive keyboard grab.
            let children_tty = children.clone();
            let socket_tty = socket_path.clone();
            let primary_tty = primary_output.clone();
            tokio::spawn(async move {
                let read_tty = || {
                    std::fs::read_to_string("/sys/class/tty/tty0/active")
                        .ok()
                        .map(|s| s.trim().to_string())
                };
                let desktop_tty = match read_tty() {
                    Some(v) => v,
                    None => {
                        eprintln!(
                            "[lock-coord] TTY watcher disabled: \
                             /sys/class/tty/tty0/active unreadable"
                        );
                        return;
                    }
                };
                eprintln!(
                    "[lock-coord] TTY watcher active (desktop_tty={:?})",
                    desktop_tty
                );
                let mut last_tty = Some(desktop_tty.clone());
                loop {
                    tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(250)).await;
                    let now_tty = read_tty();
                    if now_tty == last_tty {
                        continue;
                    }
                    // Transition: only act on return-to-desktop.
                    if now_tty.as_deref() == Some(desktop_tty.as_str())
                        && last_tty.as_deref() != Some(desktop_tty.as_str())
                    {
                        eprintln!(
                            "[lock-coord] TTY return to desktop (from {:?}): respawning",
                            last_tty
                        );
                        let current_primary: Option<String> =
                            primary_tty.lock().ok().and_then(|g| g.clone());
                        let mut outputs: Vec<(String, bool)> = Vec::new();
                        if let Ok(mut g) = children_tty.lock() {
                            for (output, mut child) in g.drain() {
                                let _ = child.kill();
                                let _ = child.wait();
                                let is_primary =
                                    current_primary.as_deref() == Some(output.as_str());
                                outputs.push((output, is_primary));
                            }
                        }
                        // Primary first.
                        outputs.sort_by_key(|(_, is_primary)| !*is_primary);
                        // Let sway settle before spawning fresh surfaces.
                        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(300)).await;
                        for (idx, (output, is_primary)) in outputs.iter().enumerate() {
                            if idx > 0 {
                                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(200)).await;
                            }
                            eprintln!(
                                "[lock-coord] TTY respawn: {:?} primary={}",
                                output, is_primary
                            );
                            Self::spawn_child(
                                output,
                                &socket_tty,
                                &children_tty,
                                *is_primary,
                            );
                        }
                    }
                    last_tty = now_tty;
                }
            });

            // ── Watchdog: respawn dead children ──
            let children_watchdog = children.clone();
            let socket_watchdog = socket_path.clone();
            let primary_output_watchdog = primary_output.clone();
            tokio::spawn(async move {
                let mut interval = tokio::time::interval(Duration::from_millis(200));
                interval.tick().await;
                loop {
                    interval.tick().await;
                    let mut dead: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
                    {
                        let mut map = children_watchdog.lock().unwrap();
                        for (output, child) in map.iter_mut() {
                            match child.try_wait() {
                                Ok(Some(status)) => {
                                    eprintln!(
                                        "[lock-coord] WATCHDOG: child output={:?} died: {:?}",
                                        output, status
                                    );
                                    dead.push(output.clone());
                                }
                                Ok(None) => {}
                                Err(e) => eprintln!(
                                    "[lock-coord] WATCHDOG: try_wait {:?} err: {}",
                                    output, e
                                ),
                            }
                        }
                        for output in &dead {
                            map.remove(output);
                        }
                    }
                    for output in dead {
                        let is_primary = primary_output_watchdog
                            .lock()
                            .unwrap()
                            .as_deref()
                            == Some(output.as_str());
                        eprintln!(
                            "[lock-coord] WATCHDOG: respawning {:?} primary={}",
                            output, is_primary
                        );
                        Self::spawn_child(
                            &output,
                            &socket_watchdog,
                            &children_watchdog,
                            is_primary,
                        );
                    }
                }
            });

            // ── Signal handlers ──
            // Ignore SIGUSR1/USR2/SIGHUP so session events don't kill the
            // coordinator and orphan lockscreen children.
            let children_sig = children.clone();
            let socket_path_sig = socket_path.clone();
            tokio::spawn(async move {
                use tokio::signal::unix::{signal, SignalKind};
                let Ok(mut usr1) = signal(SignalKind::user_defined1()) else { return; };
                let Ok(mut usr2) = signal(SignalKind::user_defined2()) else { return; };
                let Ok(mut hup)  = signal(SignalKind::hangup())      else { return; };
                let Ok(mut term) = signal(SignalKind::terminate())   else { return; };
                let Ok(mut intr) = signal(SignalKind::interrupt())   else { return; };
                loop {
                    tokio::select! {
                        _ = usr1.recv() => eprintln!("[lock-coord] SIGUSR1 ignored"),
                        _ = usr2.recv() => eprintln!("[lock-coord] SIGUSR2 ignored"),
                        _ = hup.recv()  => eprintln!("[lock-coord] SIGHUP ignored"),
                        _ = term.recv() => {
                            eprintln!("[lock-coord] SIGTERM received — shutting down cleanly");
                            shutdown_lockscreen_children(&children_sig, &socket_path_sig);
                            std::process::exit(0);
                        },
                        _ = intr.recv() => {
                            eprintln!("[lock-coord] SIGINT received — shutting down cleanly");
                            shutdown_lockscreen_children(&children_sig, &socket_path_sig);
                            std::process::exit(0);
                        },
                    }
                }
            });

            loop {
                tokio::select! {
                    Ok((stream, _)) = listener.accept() => {
                        let id = next_id;
                        next_id += 1;
                        let (reader, writer) = stream.into_split();
                        let tx = event_tx.clone();
                        tokio::spawn(async move {
                            let mut lines = BufReader::new(reader).lines();
                            while let Ok(Some(line)) = lines.next_line().await {
                                if let Ok(msg) = serde_json::from_str::<LockIpc>(&line) {
                                    if tx.send((id, msg)).await.is_err() { break; }
                                }
                            }
                        });
                        // Send current buffer immediately
                        let mut w = writer;
                        let msg = LockIpc::BufferUpdate(buffer.chars().count());
                        let _ = Self::write_msg(&mut w, &msg).await;
                        peers.push(Peer { id, writer: w });
                        eprintln!("[lock-coord] peer {} connected ({} total)", id, peers.len());
                    }

                    Some((peer_id, msg)) = event_rx.recv() => {
                        match msg {
                            LockIpc::Key(s) => {
                                // Cap buffer and per-message length.
                                const MAX_BUF: usize = 256;
                                const MAX_PER_KEY: usize = 64;
                                let room = MAX_BUF.saturating_sub(buffer.chars().count());
                                if room == 0 {
                                    eprintln!(
                                        "[lock-coord] buffer at cap ({}), ignoring Key",
                                        MAX_BUF
                                    );
                                } else {
                                    let take = MAX_PER_KEY.min(room);
                                    let added: usize =
                                        s.chars().take(take).map(|c| buffer.push(c)).count();
                                    if std::env::var_os("MBS_LOCK_DEBUG").is_some() {
                                        eprintln!(
                                            "[lock-coord] key from peer {}: +{} chars → len={}",
                                            peer_id,
                                            added,
                                            buffer.chars().count()
                                        );
                                    }
                                    let n = buffer.chars().count();
                                    Self::broadcast(&mut peers, &LockIpc::BufferUpdate(n)).await;
                                }
                            }
                            LockIpc::Backspace => {
                                buffer.pop();
                                let n = buffer.chars().count();
                                Self::broadcast(&mut peers, &LockIpc::BufferUpdate(n)).await;
                            }
                            LockIpc::Submit => {
                                // Exponential backoff (1s * 2^fail_streak, capped at 16s)
                                // limits rapid PAM/sudo auth spawns. Empty submissions are
                                // rejected before incrementing fail_streak.
                                let now = std::time::Instant::now();
                                let exponent = fail_streak.min(4);
                                let min_delay = Duration::from_millis(
                                    1000u64.saturating_mul(1u64 << exponent),
                                );
                                let too_soon = last_failed_submit
                                    .map(|prev| now.duration_since(prev) < min_delay)
                                    .unwrap_or(false);
                                if buffer.is_empty() {
                                    eprintln!(
                                        "[lock-coord] ignoring empty Submit (finding 30)"
                                    );
                                } else if too_soon {
                                    eprintln!(
                                        "[lock-coord] Submit rate-limited (fail_streak={}, min_delay={:?})",
                                        fail_streak, min_delay
                                    );
                                } else {
                                    eprintln!(
                                        "[lock-coord] submit from peer {} (len={})",
                                        peer_id, buffer.chars().count()
                                    );
                                    let ok = Self::authenticate(&buffer).await;
                                    if ok {
                                        eprintln!("[lock-coord] SUCCESS");
                                        Self::broadcast(&mut peers, &LockIpc::Success).await;
                                        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(200)).await;
                                        Self::kill_all(&children);
                                        let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&socket_path);
                                        // std::process::exit skips Drop; zeroize explicitly.
                                        buffer.zeroize();
                                        std::process::exit(0);
                                    } else {
                                        fail_streak = fail_streak.saturating_add(1);
                                        last_failed_submit = Some(now);
                                        eprintln!(
                                            "[lock-coord] auth failed (fail_streak={})",
                                            fail_streak
                                        );
                                        // Zeroize before clear so password bytes aren't left in freed capacity.
                                        buffer.zeroize();
                                        buffer.clear();
                                        Self::broadcast(&mut peers, &LockIpc::Reset).await;
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            _ => {}
                        }
                    }

                    else => break,
                }
            }
            std::process::exit(0);
        })
    }

    async fn write_msg(w: &mut OwnedWriteHalf, msg: &LockIpc) -> std::io::Result<()> {
        let mut line = serde_json::to_string(msg).unwrap_or_default();
        line.push('\n');
        w.write_all(line.as_bytes()).await
    }

    async fn broadcast(peers: &mut Vec<Peer>, msg: &LockIpc) {
        let mut dead = Vec::new();
        for (i, peer) in peers.iter_mut().enumerate() {
            if Self::write_msg(&mut peer.writer, msg).await.is_err() {
                dead.push(i);
            }
        }
        for i in dead.into_iter().rev() {
            let p = peers.remove(i);
            eprintln!("[lock-coord] peer {} removed", p.id);
        }
    }

    fn spawn_child(
        output: &str,
        socket_path: &PathBuf,
        children: &Arc<Mutex<HashMap<String, Child>>>,
        is_primary: bool,
    ) {
        if let Ok(map) = children.lock() {
            if map.contains_key(output) {
                return;
            }
        }
        let Ok(exe) = std::env::current_exe() else {
            return;
        };
        let mut cmd = Command::new(&exe);
        cmd.arg("--lockscreen-instance")
            .env("MBS_LOCK_SOCKET", socket_path)
            .env("MBS_LOCK_PRIMARY", if is_primary { "1" } else { "0" })
            .env("RUST_BACKTRACE", "1")
            .stdout(Stdio::null())
            .stderr(Stdio::inherit());
        if !output.is_empty() {
            cmd.arg(output).env("MBS_LOCK_OUTPUT", output);
        }
        match cmd.spawn() {
            Ok(child) => {
                eprintln!(
                    "[lock-coord] spawned pid={} for output={:?}",
                    child.id(),
                    output
                );
                if let Ok(mut map) = children.lock() {
                    map.insert(output.to_string(), child);
                }
            }
            Err(e) => eprintln!("[lock-coord] spawn failed for {:?}: {}", output, e),
        }
    }

    fn kill_all(children: &Arc<Mutex<HashMap<String, Child>>>) {
        if let Ok(mut map) = children.lock() {
            for (_name, mut c) in map.drain() {
                let _ = c.kill();
                let _ = c.wait();
            }
        }
    }

    async fn authenticate(password: &str) -> bool {
        use tokio::io::AsyncWriteExt as _;
        let clean = password.trim();
        if clean.is_empty() {
            eprintln!("[lock-coord] auth: empty password");
            return false;
        }

        // ── Debug bypass: compile-time opt-in only ──
        #[cfg(feature = "lock-debug-bypass")]
        if let Ok(debug_pass) = std::env::var("MBS_LOCK_DEBUG_PASS") {
            if !debug_pass.is_empty() && debug_pass == clean {
                eprintln!("[lock-coord] DEBUG BYPASS (compile-time feature): matched");
                return true;
            }
        }

        if std::env::var_os("MBS_LOCK_DEBUG").is_some() {
            eprintln!(
                "[lock-coord] auth attempt: len={} sha256_prefix={}",
                clean.chars().count(),
                sha256_prefix(clean),
            );
        } else {
            eprintln!("[lock-coord] auth attempt: len={}", clean.chars().count());
        }

        // Zeroizing overwrites the password bytes on drop, including on early returns.
        let pass_line = Zeroizing::new(format!("{}\n", clean));

        // ── Strategy 0: pamtester ──
        {
            let user = resolve_user();
            let pam_bin =
                find_bin("pamtester").unwrap_or_else(|| std::path::PathBuf::from("pamtester"));
            eprintln!("[lock-coord] trying pamtester login {} authenticate", user);
            match tokio::process::Command::new(&pam_bin)
                .args(["login", &user, "authenticate"])
                .stdin(Stdio::piped())
                .stdout(Stdio::piped())
                .stderr(Stdio::piped())
                .spawn()
            {
                Ok(mut c) => {
                    if let Some(mut stdin) = c.stdin.take() {
                        let _ = stdin.write_all(pass_line.as_bytes()).await;
                        drop(stdin);
                    }
                    match tokio::time::timeout(
                        std::time::Duration::from_secs(5),
                        c.wait_with_output(),
                    )
                    .await
                    {
                        Ok(Ok(out)) => {
                            let success = out.status.success();
                            let err = String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stderr);
                            eprintln!(
                                "[lock-coord] pamtester exit={:?} success={} stderr={:?}",
                                out.status.code(),
                                success,
                                err.trim().chars().take(200).collect::<String>()
                            );
                            if success {
                                return true;
                            }
                        }
                        Ok(Err(e)) => eprintln!("[lock-coord] pamtester wait: {}", e),
                        Err(_) => eprintln!("[lock-coord] pamtester TIMEOUT"),
                    }
                }
                Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {
                    eprintln!("[lock-coord] pamtester not installed");
                }
                Err(e) => eprintln!("[lock-coord] pamtester spawn: {}", e),
            }
        }

        // ── Strategy 1: sudo -S -k -v, guarded by NOPASSWD check ──
        if sudo_is_nopasswd() {
            eprintln!("[lock-coord] sudo is NOPASSWD — refusing to use it as auth oracle");
        } else {
            let sudo_bin = find_bin("sudo").unwrap_or_else(|| std::path::PathBuf::from("sudo"));
            eprintln!("[lock-coord] trying sudo -v");
            match tokio::process::Command::new(&sudo_bin)
                .args(["-S", "-k", "-v"])
                .stdin(Stdio::piped())
                .stdout(Stdio::piped())
                .stderr(Stdio::piped())
                .spawn()
            {
                Ok(mut c) => {
                    if let Some(mut stdin) = c.stdin.take() {
                        let _ = stdin.write_all(pass_line.as_bytes()).await;
                        drop(stdin);
                    }
                    match tokio::time::timeout(
                        std::time::Duration::from_secs(5),
                        c.wait_with_output(),
                    )
                    .await
                    {
                        Ok(Ok(out)) => {
                            let success = out.status.success();
                            let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stderr);
                            eprintln!(
                                "[lock-coord] sudo -v exit={:?} success={} stderr={:?}",
                                out.status.code(),
                                success,
                                stderr.trim().chars().take(200).collect::<String>()
                            );
                            if success {
                                return true;
                            }
                        }
                        Ok(Err(e)) => eprintln!("[lock-coord] sudo wait: {}", e),
                        Err(_) => eprintln!("[lock-coord] sudo TIMEOUT"),
                    }
                }
                Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {
                    eprintln!("[lock-coord] sudo not installed");
                }
                Err(e) => eprintln!("[lock-coord] sudo spawn: {}", e),
            }
        }

        eprintln!("[lock-coord] ALL AUTH STRATEGIES FAILED");
        false
    }

    fn list_outputs() -> Vec<String> {
        let sway_bin = find_bin("swaymsg").unwrap_or_else(|| std::path::PathBuf::from("swaymsg"));
        let out = Command::new(&sway_bin)
            .args(["-t", "get_outputs", "-r"])
            .output()
            .ok();
        let Some(out) = out else {
            return Vec::new();
        };
        if !out.status.success() {
            return Vec::new();
        }
        let Ok(v) = serde_json::from_slice::<serde_json::Value>(&out.stdout) else {
            return Vec::new();
        };
        let Some(arr) = v.as_array() else {
            return Vec::new();
        };
        arr.iter()
            .filter(|o| o.get("active").and_then(|a| a.as_bool()) != Some(false))
            .filter_map(|o| o.get("name").and_then(|n| n.as_str()).map(String::from))
            .collect()
    }
}
