use super::coordinator::LockIpc;
use chrono::Local;
use iced::widget::{column, container, text};
use iced::{Alignment, Element, Length, Padding};
use std::sync::mpsc;

use crate::libraries::config::theme::ShellTheme;
use crate::libraries::style::shape_box::{ShapeBox, ShapeType};
use crate::libraries::style::TextExt;

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum LockMessage {
    KeyPress(iced::keyboard::Key),
    Tick,
    PollIpc,
    AuthFailed,
    AuthSuccess,
}

pub struct LockscreenOverlay {
    pub buffer_len: usize,
    pub auth_failed: bool,
    pub is_caps_lock: bool,
    /// Snapshot of `ShellSettings::global_padding` at construction time.
    /// Read in `view()` (which runs at 60fps), so we cache it here instead
    /// of calling `ShellSettings::load()` on every frame.
    cached_global_padding: u16,
    ipc_tx: Option<mpsc::Sender<LockIpc>>,
    ipc_rx: Option<mpsc::Receiver<LockIpc>>,
    pending_sends: u32,
}

impl Default for LockscreenOverlay {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

impl LockscreenOverlay {
    pub fn empty() -> Self {
        Self {
            buffer_len: 0,
            auth_failed: false,
            is_caps_lock: false,
            cached_global_padding: 12,
            ipc_tx: None,
            ipc_rx: None,
            pending_sends: 0,
        }
    }

    pub fn new() -> Self {
        // Only --lockscreen-instance children have MBS_LOCK_SOCKET. Bar,
        // notif-surface, and tooltip processes do not.
        let (ipc_tx, ipc_rx) = if std::env::var_os("MBS_LOCK_SOCKET").is_none() {
            (None, None)
        } else {
            match Self::connect_coordinator() {
                Some(pair) => {
                    eprintln!("[lock-child] connected to coordinator");
                    (Some(pair.0), Some(pair.1))
                }
                None => {
                    eprintln!("[lock-child] !!! socket set but connect failed");
                    (None, None)
                }
            }
        };
        let cached_global_padding = crate::libraries::config::ShellSettings::load().global_padding;
        Self {
            buffer_len: 0,
            auth_failed: false,
            is_caps_lock: Self::check_caps_lock(),
            cached_global_padding,
            ipc_tx,
            ipc_rx,
            pending_sends: 0,
        }
    }

    /// Connect to coordinator. Returns (tx_to_send_keys, rx_for_updates).
    /// Uses two threads: one reads coordinator messages, one writes ours.
    fn connect_coordinator() -> Option<(mpsc::Sender<LockIpc>, mpsc::Receiver<LockIpc>)> {
        let path = match std::env::var("MBS_LOCK_SOCKET") {
            Ok(p) => {
                eprintln!("[lock-child-v225] socket env set: {:?}", p);
                p
            }
            Err(_) => {
                eprintln!("[lock-child-v225] MBS_LOCK_SOCKET NOT SET");
                return None;
            }
        };
        eprintln!(
            "[lock-child-v225] attempting UnixStream::connect({:?})",
            path
        );
        let stream = match std::os::unix::net::UnixStream::connect(&path) {
            Ok(s) => {
                eprintln!("[lock-child-v225] socket CONNECTED");
                s
            }
            Err(e) => {
                eprintln!("[lock-child-v225] connect failed: {}", e);
                return None;
            }
        };
        let reader_stream = stream.try_clone().ok()?;
        let writer_stream = stream;

        let (out_tx, out_rx) = mpsc::channel::<LockIpc>();
        let (in_tx, in_rx) = mpsc::channel::<LockIpc>();

        // Reader thread: coordinator → us
        std::thread::spawn(move || {
            use std::io::{BufRead, BufReader};
            let reader = BufReader::new(reader_stream);
            for line in reader.lines() {
                let Ok(line) = line else {
                    break;
                };
                let Ok(msg) = serde_json::from_str::<LockIpc>(&line) else {
                    continue;
                };
                if in_tx.send(msg).is_err() {
                    break;
                }
            }
            eprintln!("[lock-child] coordinator reader closed");
        });

        // Writer thread: us → coordinator
        std::thread::spawn(move || {
            use std::io::Write;
            let mut w = writer_stream;
            while let Ok(msg) = out_rx.recv() {
                let mut line = serde_json::to_string(&msg).unwrap_or_default();
                line.push('\n');
                if w.write_all(line.as_bytes()).is_err() {
                    break;
                }
            }
            eprintln!("[lock-child] coordinator writer closed");
        });

        Some((out_tx, in_rx))
    }

    pub fn check_caps_lock() -> bool {
        for i in 0..6 {
            let p = format!("/sys/class/leds/input{}::capslock/brightness", i);
            if let Ok(c) = std::fs::read_to_string(p) {
                if c.trim() == "1" {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        false
    }

    /// Drain pending IPC messages. Returns `Some(LockMessage::AuthSuccess)`
    /// when the coordinator signals success, or `None` otherwise.
    pub fn drain_ipc(&mut self) -> Option<LockMessage> {
        let mut result = None;
        let rx = self.ipc_rx.as_ref()?;
        while let Ok(msg) = rx.try_recv() {
            match msg {
                LockIpc::BufferUpdate(n) => {
                    self.pending_sends = self.pending_sends.saturating_sub(1);
                    if self.pending_sends == 0 {
                        // No in-flight sends — coordinator's count reflects
                        // every keystroke we've made, adopt it.
                        self.buffer_len = n;
                    }
                    self.auth_failed = false;
                }
                LockIpc::Reset => {
                    self.buffer_len = 0;
                    self.pending_sends = 0;
                    self.auth_failed = true;
                }
                LockIpc::Success => {
                    result = Some(LockMessage::AuthSuccess);
                }
                _ => {}
            }
        }
        result
    }

    /// Forward a key event to the coordinator with optimistic local updates
    /// so dots appear immediately; coordinator's BufferUpdate reconciles drift.
    pub fn forward_key(&mut self, key: &iced::keyboard::Key) {
        let (msg, delta) = match key {
            iced::keyboard::Key::Character(c) => (Some(LockIpc::Key(c.to_string())), 1_i32),
            iced::keyboard::Key::Named(iced::keyboard::key::Named::Backspace) => {
                (Some(LockIpc::Backspace), -1_i32)
            }
            iced::keyboard::Key::Named(iced::keyboard::key::Named::Enter) => {
                (Some(LockIpc::Submit), 0_i32)
            }
            _ => (None, 0_i32),
        };

        let Some(msg) = msg else {
            return;
        };
        if let Some(tx) = self.ipc_tx.as_ref() {
            if tx.send(msg).is_err() {
                // Channel dead; don't apply optimistic update that will
                // never be reconciled.
                return;
            }
        }
        self.pending_sends = self.pending_sends.saturating_add(1);

        // Optimistic local update — instant visual feedback
        if delta > 0 {
            self.buffer_len = self.buffer_len.saturating_add(delta as usize);
        } else if delta < 0 {
            self.buffer_len = self.buffer_len.saturating_sub((-delta) as usize);
        }
    }

    pub fn view<'a>(&'a self, theme: &'a ShellTheme) -> Element<'a, LockMessage> {
        let time_str = Local::now().format("%H:%M").to_string();
        let date_str = Local::now().format("%A, %B %d").to_string();

        let card_w = 640.0_f32;
        let card_h = 460.0_f32;
        let cut_f = theme.overlay_cut;
        let angle_deg = theme.overlay_angle;

        // Bordered password field
        let (display_text, display_color, field_border) = if self.auth_failed {
            ("Incorrect password".to_string(), theme.danger, theme.danger)
        } else if self.buffer_len == 0 {
            ("Enter password…".to_string(), theme.muted, theme.border)
        } else {
            let mut s = String::new();
            for i in 0..self.buffer_len {
                if i > 0 && i % 4 == 0 {
                    s.push(' ');
                }
                s.push('•');
            }
            (s, theme.text_strong, theme.border)
        };

        // Octagon password field — same ShapeType::Hexagon family used by
        // other overlay fields. Dimensions scale with global_padding (at
        // pad=12 default: 360x56 cut=16), clamped so it never overflows the card.
        let pad = self.cached_global_padding as f32;
        let field_w = (280.0 + pad * 6.67).min(520.0);
        let field_h = (40.0 + pad * 1.33).min(80.0);
        let cut_u16 = (pad * 1.33).clamp(8.0, 28.0) as u16;

        {
            use std::sync::OnceLock;
            static ONCE: OnceLock<()> = OnceLock::new();
            ONCE.get_or_init(|| {
                eprintln!(
                    "[lock-child] field: global_padding={} → w={:.0} h={:.0} cut={}",
                    self.cached_global_padding, field_w, field_h, cut_u16
                );
            });
        }

        let field_bg = ShapeBox::new()
            .shape(ShapeType::Hexagon { cut: cut_u16 })
            .background(theme.surface_alt)
            .border(field_border, theme.control_border_width.min(2.0))
            .size(Length::Fixed(field_w), Length::Fixed(field_h));

        let field_text = container(
            text(display_text)
                .size(18)
                .bold()
                .color(display_color)
                .align_x(Alignment::Center)
                .wrapping(iced::widget::text::Wrapping::None),
        )
        .width(Length::Fixed(field_w))
        .height(Length::Fixed(field_h))
        .align_x(Alignment::Center)
        .align_y(Alignment::Center)
        .padding(Padding {
            top: 0.0,
            right: cut_u16 as f32 + 4.0,
            bottom: 0.0,
            left: cut_u16 as f32 + 4.0,
        });

        let field_stack = iced::widget::Stack::new()
            .push(field_bg.view())
            .push(field_text);

        let dots_row = container(field_stack)
            .width(Length::Fill)
            .align_x(Alignment::Center)
            .clip(true)
            .padding(Padding {
                top: 28.0,
                right: 0.0,
                bottom: 0.0,
                left: 0.0,
            });

        let mut inner: iced::widget::Column<'a, LockMessage> = column![
            text(time_str).size(64).bold().color(theme.text_strong),
            text(date_str).size(16).color(theme.muted),
        ]
        .spacing(2)
        .align_x(Alignment::Center);

        inner = inner.push(dots_row);

        if self.is_caps_lock {
            inner = inner.push(
                container(text("⇪ CAPS LOCK ON").size(11).bold().color(theme.warning)).padding(
                    Padding {
                        top: 12.0,
                        right: 0.0,
                        bottom: 0.0,
                        left: 0.0,
                    },
                ),
            );
        }

        inner = inner.push(
            container(
                text("Type to unlock  •  Enter to submit")
                    .size(10)
                    .color(theme.muted),
            )
            .padding(Padding {
                top: 24.0,
                right: 0.0,
                bottom: 0.0,
                left: 0.0,
            }),
        );

            .width(Length::Fixed(card_w - 80.0))
            .height(Length::Fixed(card_h - 80.0))
            .align_x(Alignment::Center)
            .align_y(Alignment::Center)
            .clip(true);

        let card_bg = ShapeBox::new()
            .shape(ShapeType::AngledHexagon {
                cut: cut_f,
                angle_deg,

            .background(theme.background)

pub fn run(args: &[String]) {
    // ── Multi-monitor lock coordinator (parent mode) ──
    // If called as `--lockscreen` (and NOT `--lockscreen-instance`),
    // act as the coordinator: spawn one child per output, broker auth,
    // watch hotplug. Blocks forever (exits via process::exit).
    if args.iter().any(|a| a == "--lockscreen")
        && !args.iter().any(|a| a == "--lockscreen-instance")
    {
        crate::overlays::lockscreen::LockCoordinator::spawn();
    }
}

use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::sync::mpsc::SyncSender;
use zbus::zvariant::OwnedValue;

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct IncomingNotification {
    pub id: u32,
    pub app_name: String,
    pub summary: String,
    pub body: String,
    pub is_urgent: bool,
    pub is_resident: bool,
    pub desktop_entry: Option<String>,
    pub actions: Vec<String>,
}

pub struct NotifServer {
    // Bounded channel so a flood of notifications cannot OOM the shell.
    tx: SyncSender<IncomingNotification>,
}

fn next_id() -> u32 {
    use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU32, Ordering};
    static NEXT: AtomicU32 = AtomicU32::new(1);
    NEXT.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed)
}

#[zbus::interface(name = "org.freedesktop.Notifications")]
impl NotifServer {
    fn notify(
        &self,
        app_name: String,
        replaces_id: u32,
        _app_icon: String,
        summary: String,
        body: String,
        actions: Vec<String>,
        hints: HashMap<String, OwnedValue>,
        _expire_timeout: i32,
    ) -> u32 {
        // Cap payload fields at ingress before try_send into the bounded channel.
        const MAX_APP_NAME: usize = 128;
        const MAX_SUMMARY: usize = 512;
        const MAX_BODY: usize = 4096;
        const MAX_ACTIONS: usize = 16;
        const MAX_ACTION_LEN: usize = 256;
        let cap = |s: String, n: usize| -> String {
            if s.chars().count() <= n {
                s
            } else {
                s.chars().take(n).collect()
            }
        };
        let app_name = cap(app_name, MAX_APP_NAME);
        let summary = cap(summary, MAX_SUMMARY);
        let body = cap(body, MAX_BODY);
        let actions: Vec<String> = actions
            .into_iter()
            .take(MAX_ACTIONS)
            .map(|a| cap(a, MAX_ACTION_LEN))
            .collect();
        
        let id = if replaces_id != 0 {
            replaces_id
        } else {
            next_id()
        };
        eprintln!(
            "[notif-raw] app={:?} summary={:?} body={:?}",
            app_name, summary, body
        );
        // Hints HashMap is deserialized by zbus before this fn runs, and
        // can hold up to the D-Bus message-size cap. We only read two
        // keys; cap at ingress so a hostile sender can't pin a large map
        // in the bounded channel.
        let hints: HashMap<String, OwnedValue> = hints.into_iter().take(32).collect();

        let is_urgent = hints
            .get("urgency")
            .and_then(|v| u8::try_from(v).ok())
            .map(|u| u == 2)
            .unwrap_or(false);
        let is_resident = hints
            .get("resident")
            .and_then(|v| match &**v {
                zbus::zvariant::Value::Bool(b) => Some(*b),
                zbus::zvariant::Value::U8(n) => Some(*n != 0),
                _ => None,
            })
            .unwrap_or(false);
        let desktop_entry = hints
            .get("desktop-entry")
            .or_else(|| hints.get("desktop_entry"))
            .and_then(|v| match &**v {
                zbus::zvariant::Value::Str(s) => Some(s.as_str().to_string()),
                _ => None,
            });
        // Non-blocking try_send: drop payload on full channel while still returning
        // id immediately per the freedesktop notifications spec.
        if let Err(e) = self.tx.try_send(IncomingNotification {
            id,
            app_name,
            summary,
            body,
            is_urgent,
            is_resident,
            desktop_entry,
            actions,
        }) {
            crate::dbg_log!("[notif] dropped (channel not ready: {:?})", e);
        }
        id
    }

    fn close_notification(&self, _id: u32) {}

    fn get_capabilities(&self) -> Vec<String> {
        vec!["body".into(), "actions".into()]
    }

    fn get_server_information(&self) -> (String, String, String, String) {
        (
            "MoonBeautyShell".into(),
            "MoonBeauty".into(),
            "1.0".into(),
            "1.2".into(),
        )
    }
}

use std::sync::OnceLock;
static DBUS_CONN: OnceLock<zbus::Connection> = OnceLock::new();

async fn emit_activation_token_async(conn: &zbus::Connection, id: u32, token: &str) {
    let body = (id, token.to_string());
    match conn
        .emit_signal(
            None::<&str>,
            "/org/freedesktop/Notifications",
            "org.freedesktop.Notifications",
            "ActivationToken",
            &body,
        )
        .await
    {
        Ok(_) => eprintln!("[activation-token] sent id={} len={}", id, token.len()),
        Err(e) => eprintln!("[activation-token] emit failed: {e}"),
    }
}

async fn emit_action_invoked_async(conn: &zbus::Connection, id: u32, key: &str) {
    let body = (id, key.to_string());
    match conn
        .emit_signal(
            None::<&str>,
            "/org/freedesktop/Notifications",
            "org.freedesktop.Notifications",
            "ActionInvoked",
            &body,
        )
        .await
    {
        Ok(_) => eprintln!("[action-invoked] sent id={} key={:?}", id, key),
        Err(e) => eprintln!("[action-invoked] emit failed: {e}"),
    }
}

async fn emit_notification_closed_async(conn: &zbus::Connection, id: u32, reason: u32) {
    match conn
        .emit_signal(
            None::<&str>,
            "/org/freedesktop/Notifications",
            "org.freedesktop.Notifications",
            "NotificationClosed",
            &(id, reason),
        )
        .await
    {
        Ok(_) => eprintln!("[notif-closed] sent id={} reason={}", id, reason),
        Err(e) => eprintln!("[notif-closed] emit failed: {e}"),
    }
}

/// Standard freedesktop notification click handshake:
///   1. (caller generated Wayland xdg-activation token)
///   2. Emit ActivationToken(id, token) BEFORE ActionInvoked
///   3. Emit ActionInvoked(id, action_key) if a matching key was registered
///   4. Emit NotificationClosed(id, 2) unless resident
pub async fn emit_click_handshake(
    id: u32,
    activation_token: Option<String>,
    action_key: Option<String>,
    is_resident: bool,
) {
    let Some(conn) = DBUS_CONN.get().cloned() else {
        eprintln!("[click-handshake] daemon connection not ready");
        return;
    };
    if let Some(token) = activation_token {
        if !token.is_empty() {
            emit_activation_token_async(&conn, id, &token).await;
        }
    }
    if let Some(key) = action_key {
        emit_action_invoked_async(&conn, id, &key).await;
    }
    if !is_resident {
        emit_notification_closed_async(&conn, id, 2).await;
    }
}

pub async fn emit_notification_closed(id: u32, reason: u32) {
    let Some(conn) = DBUS_CONN.get().cloned() else {
        eprintln!("[notif-closed] daemon connection not ready");
        return;
    };
    emit_notification_closed_async(&conn, id, reason).await;
}

pub fn emit_action_invoked(id: u32, key: &str) {
    let key_owned = key.to_string();
    std::thread::spawn(move || {
        let Ok(rt) = tokio::runtime::Builder::new_current_thread()
            .enable_all()
            .build()
        else {
            return;
        };
        rt.block_on(emit_click_handshake(id, None, Some(key_owned), false));
    });
}

pub fn spawn(tx: SyncSender<IncomingNotification>) {
    std::thread::spawn(move || {
        let rt = match tokio::runtime::Builder::new_current_thread()
            .enable_all()
            .build()
        {
            Ok(r) => r,
            Err(e) => {
                eprintln!("[notif_dbus] rt build: {e}");
                return;
            }
        };
        rt.block_on(async move {
            let server = NotifServer { tx };
            let conn = zbus::connection::Builder::session()
                .and_then(|b| b.name("org.freedesktop.Notifications"))
                .and_then(|b| b.serve_at("/org/freedesktop/Notifications", server))
                .expect("zbus builder")
                .build()
                .await;
            match conn {
                Ok(c) => {
                    eprintln!("[notif_dbus] org.freedesktop.Notifications owned");
                    let _ = DBUS_CONN.set(c.clone());
                    std::future::pending::<()>().await;
                }
                Err(e) => eprintln!("[notif_dbus] serve failed: {e}"),
            }
        });
    });
}

//! Notification CLI handlers: --notify, --activate-latest-notif,
//! --dismiss-notif, --notif-history.
//!
//! Extracted from `main.rs`. All branches are terminal (exit on match,
//! no-op otherwise), so combined execution is safe regardless of which
//! other CLI block would have run first in main().

use crate::libraries::ipc::IpcCommand;

use crate::libraries::ipc::send_ipc_sync;

pub fn run(args: &[String]) {
    fn write_notif_cmd(cmd: &[u8], tag: &str) -> ! {
        let cmd_path =
            crate::libraries::process::mbs_runtime_dir().join("moonbeauty-notif-cmd");
        let tmp_path = cmd_path.with_extension("tmp");
        if let Err(e) = crate::libraries::process::private_write_file(&tmp_path, cmd)
            .and_then(|_| std::fs::rename(&tmp_path, &cmd_path))
        {
            eprintln!("[{tag}] failed to write {:?}: {e}", cmd_path);
            std::process::exit(1);
        }
        std::process::exit(0);
    }

    // Notification CLI actions
    if args.iter().any(|a| a == "--activate-latest-notif") {
        write_notif_cmd(b"activate-latest", "activate-latest");
    }
    if args.iter().any(|a| a == "--dismiss-notif") {
        write_notif_cmd(b"dismiss", "dismiss-notif");
    }
    if args.iter().any(|a| a == "--notif-history") {
        match send_ipc_sync(&IpcCommand::ToggleHistory) {
            Ok(_) => std::process::exit(0),
            Err(e) => {
                eprintln!("[notif-history] IPC failed: {e}");
                std::process::exit(1);
            }
        }
    }

    // CLI Notification Push: moonbeauty --notify "LusterDawn" "Message"
    if args.len() >= 3
        && (args[1] == "--notify" || (args.len() >= 4 && args[1] == "--ipc" && args[2] == "notify"))
    {
        let summary = if args[1] == "--notify" {
            &args[2]
        } else {
            &args[3]
        };
        let body = if args[1] == "--notify" {
            args.get(3).map(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or("")
        } else {
            args.get(4).map(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or("")
        };
        let _ = std::process::Command::new("notify-send")
            .args(["-a", "Desktop", "--", summary, body])
            .spawn();
        std::process::exit(0);
    }
}

use chrono::Local;
