                ]
                .spacing(4)
                .width(Length::Fill);

                let inner_row = row![icon_elem, container(text_col).width(Length::Fill),]
                    .spacing(16)
                    .align_y(iced::alignment::Vertical::Top);

                let row_content = container(inner_row)
                    .width(Length::Fixed(row_w))
                    .height(Length::Fixed(row_h))
                    .padding(iced::Padding {
                        top: 12.0,
                        right: 20.0,
                        bottom: 12.0,
                        left: 20.0,
                    })
                    .align_y(iced::alignment::Vertical::Top);

                let stack = Stack::new().push(row_bg.view()).push(row_content);

                let btn = button(stack)
                    .on_press(NotifMessage::HistoryDeleteSelected)
                    .padding(0)
                    .width(Length::Fixed(row_w))
                    .height(Length::Fixed(row_h))
                    .style(|_t, _s| button::Style {
                        background: None,
                        ..Default::default()
                    });

                list_col = list_col.push(btn);
            }
        }

        let pos_label = if let Some(id) = self.selected_history_id {
            if let Some(i) = self.history.iter().position(|t| t.id == id) {
                // Render order is reversed: position in list (1-indexed, top-down)
                // = history.len() - i
                format!("{} / {}", self.history.len() - i, self.history.len())
            } else {
                format!("{} items", self.history.len())
            }
        } else if !self.history.is_empty() {
            format!("{} items", self.history.len())
        } else {
            String::new()
        };

        let header_row = container(
            row![
                text("📜 NOTIFICATION HISTORY")
                    .size(fs)
                    .bold()
                    .color(theme.text),
                iced::widget::space::horizontal(),
                text(pos_label).size(fs_sm).bold().color(theme.muted),
                button(text("Clear All").size(fs_sm).bold().color(theme.danger))
                    .on_press(NotifMessage::ClearHistory)
                    .padding([6, 12])
                    .style(move |_t, _s| button::Style {
                        background: Some(iced::Background::Color(theme.background)),
                        border: iced::Border {
                            color: theme.danger,
                            width: 1.0,
                            radius: 4.0.into()
                        },
                        ..Default::default()
                    }),
            ]
            .align_y(iced::alignment::Vertical::Center),
        )
        .width(Length::Fill)
        .padding(Padding {
            top: 0.0,
            right: header_inset,
            bottom: 0.0,
            left: header_inset,
        });

        let list_container = container(
            scrollable(list_col)
                .id(iced::widget::Id::new("history_list"))
                .height(Length::Fill),
        )
        .width(Length::Fill)
        .height(Length::Fill)
        .padding(Padding {
            top: 0.0,
            right: body_inset,
            bottom: 0.0,
            left: body_inset,
        });

        let footer_row = container(
            text("↑/↓ Navigate  •  Enter to jump  •  Delete to remove  •  ESC to dismiss")
                .size(fs_sm)
                .color(theme.muted)
                .align_x(Alignment::Center),
        )
        .width(Length::Fill)
        .padding(Padding {
            top: 0.0,
            right: footer_inset,
            bottom: 0.0,
            left: footer_inset,
        });

        let card_bg = ShapeBox::new()
            .shape(ShapeType::AngledHexagon {
                cut: cut_f,
                angle_deg,
            })
            .background(theme.background)
            .border(theme.border, theme.border_width)
            .size(Length::Fixed(win_w), Length::Fixed(win_h));

        let card_content = container(
            column![header_row, list_container, footer_row]
                .spacing(14)
                .padding(Padding {
                    top: pad_top,
                    right: 0.0,
                    bottom: pad_bottom,
                    left: 0.0,
                }),
        )
        .width(Length::Fixed(win_w))
        .height(Length::Fixed(win_h))
        .style(|_t| iced::widget::container::Style::default());

        let card = Stack::new().push(card_bg.view()).push(card_content);

        container(card)
            .center_x(Length::Fill)
            .center_y(Length::Fill)
            .style(|_t| iced::widget::container::Style::default())
            .into()
    }
}

/// True when `text` looks like a clean person-name summary:
/// short, no separators, no action verbs, all words capitalised,
/// and no generic notification vocabulary.
fn looks_like_clean_name(text: &str) -> bool {
    let trimmed = text.trim();
    if trimmed.is_empty() || trimmed.chars().count() > 40 {
        return false;
    }
    if trimmed.contains(':')
        || trimmed.contains(" - ")
        || trimmed.contains('/')
        || trimmed.contains('(')
        || trimmed.contains(')')
    {
        return false;
    }
    if looks_like_action(trimmed) {
        return false;
    }
    let words: Vec<&str> = trimmed.split_whitespace().collect();
    if words.is_empty() || words.len() > 4 {
        return false;
    }
    const GENERIC: &[&str] = &[
        "new",
        "message",
        "messages",
        "voice",
        "activity",
        "notification",
        "notifications",
        "alert",
        "alerts",
        "system",
        "test",
        "app",
        "you",
        "have",
        "a",
        "an",
        "the",
        "this",
        "that",
        "incoming",
        "audio",
        "video",
        "call",
        "missed",
        "recent",
        "update",
        "updates",
        "reminder",
        "warning",
        "info",
        "success",
        "error",
        "received",
        "unread",
        "from",
        "to",
        "in",
        "on",
        "at",
        "by",
        "here",
        "there",
    ];
    words.iter().all(|w| {
        let starts_upper = w.chars().next().map(|c| c.is_uppercase()).unwrap_or(false);
        let is_generic = GENERIC.iter().any(|g| g.eq_ignore_ascii_case(w));
        starts_upper && !is_generic
    })
}

fn looks_like_action(text: &str) -> bool {
    const VERBS: &[&str] = &[
        "spoke",
        "speaks",
        "said",
        "says",
        "sent",
        "sends",
        "started",
        "starts",
        "called",
        "calls",
        "joined",
        "joins",
        "left",
        "leaves",
        "replied",
        "replies",
        "mentioned",
        "mentions",
        "pinged",
        "pings",
        "posted",
        "posts",
        "reacted",
        "reacts",
        "uploaded",
        "uploads",
        "shared",
        "shares",
        "playing",
        "paused",
        "changed",
        "updated",
    ];
    VERBS
        .iter()
        .any(|v| text.split_whitespace().any(|w| w.eq_ignore_ascii_case(v)))
}

/// Extract a leading name from "Alice spoke in room" -> "Alice".
/// Rejects generic sentence prefixes ("New", "Voice", "Audio", …).
fn extract_leading_name(text: &str) -> Option<String> {
    const GENERIC_PREFIX: &[&str] = &[
        "new",
        "a",
        "an",
        "the",
        "this",
        "that",
        "voice",
        "audio",
        "video",
        "incoming",
        "notification",
        "system",
        "app",
        "activity",
        "alert",
    ];
    let words: Vec<&str> = text.split_whitespace().collect();
    if words.is_empty() {
        return None;
    }
    if GENERIC_PREFIX
        .iter()
        .any(|p| words[0].eq_ignore_ascii_case(p))
    {
        return None;
    }
    let is_name_word = |w: &str| -> bool {
        !w.is_empty()
            && w.chars()
                .all(|c| c.is_alphabetic() || c == '-' || c == '_' || c == '.')
            && w.chars().next().map(|c| c.is_uppercase()).unwrap_or(false)
    };
    let mut name_parts = Vec::new();
    for w in words.iter().take(3) {
        if is_name_word(w) {
            name_parts.push(*w);
        } else {
            break;
        }
    }
    if name_parts.is_empty() {
        None
    } else {
        Some(name_parts.join(" "))
    }
}

/// Try to find a person name inside a summary that is NOT of the
/// form "… from Name". Handles common Electron/Horizon shapes:
///   "Genesis Frost: New Message"  -> "Genesis Frost"
///   "Genesis Frost - New Message" -> "Genesis Frost"
///   "Genesis Frost spoke in…"     -> "Genesis Frost"
fn extract_name_from_summary(text: &str) -> Option<String> {
    const MAX_NAME_CHARS: usize = 40;
    // 1) "Name: rest" — split on the first colon
    if let Some(idx) = text.find(':') {
        let candidate = text[..idx].trim();
        if !candidate.is_empty()
            && candidate.chars().count() <= MAX_NAME_CHARS
            && candidate.chars().any(|c| c.is_alphabetic())
        {
            return Some(candidate.to_string());
        }
    }
    // 2) "Name - rest" — split on " - "
    if let Some(idx) = text.find(" - ") {
        let candidate = text[..idx].trim();
        if !candidate.is_empty() && candidate.chars().count() <= MAX_NAME_CHARS {
            return Some(candidate.to_string());
        }
    }
    // 3) "Name <verb> rest" — leading words before the first action verb
    let words: Vec<&str> = text.split_whitespace().collect();
    for (i, w) in words.iter().enumerate() {
        if looks_like_action(w) && i > 0 {
            let candidate = words[..i].join(" ");
            if candidate.chars().count() <= MAX_NAME_CHARS {
                return Some(candidate);
            }
            break;
        }
    }
    None
}

fn extract_from_phrase(text: &str) -> Option<String> {
    let lower = text.to_lowercase();
    let idx = lower.find(" from ")?;
    let after = text[idx + 6..].trim();
    if after.is_empty() {
        return None;
    }
    let name: String = after
        .split_whitespace()
        .take(3)
        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
        .join(" ");
    let trimmed = name.trim_end_matches(|c: char| !c.is_alphanumeric() && c != '.' && c != '-');
    if trimmed.is_empty() {
        None
    } else {
        Some(trimmed.to_string())
    }
}

pub fn dnd_flag_path() -> PathBuf {
    crate::libraries::process::mbs_runtime_dir().join("moonbeauty-dnd")
}

struct DndCache {
    active: bool,
    fetched_at: Instant,
}

static DND_CACHE: std::sync::OnceLock<std::sync::Mutex<DndCache>> = std::sync::OnceLock::new();

fn dnd_cache() -> &'static std::sync::Mutex<DndCache> {
    DND_CACHE.get_or_init(|| {
        std::sync::Mutex::new(DndCache {
            active: false,
            fetched_at: Instant::now() - std::time::Duration::from_secs(60),
        })
    })
}

pub fn dnd_active() -> bool {
    // 250 ms stat cache; polled at 2-5 Hz from bar capsules and tooltips.
    let mut g = dnd_cache().lock().unwrap();
    if g.fetched_at.elapsed() > std::time::Duration::from_millis(250) {
        g.active = dnd_flag_path().exists();
        g.fetched_at = Instant::now();
    }
    g.active
}

pub fn toggle_dnd() -> bool {
    let p = dnd_flag_path();
    let state = if p.exists() {
        let _ = fs::remove_file(&p);
        eprintln!("[dnd] flag file removed: {:?}", p);
        false
    } else {
        let _ = crate::libraries::process::private_write_file(&p, b"1");
        eprintln!("[dnd] flag file created: {:?}", p);
        true
    };
    // Propagate immediately instead of waiting for the 250 ms cache TTL.
    if let Ok(mut g) = dnd_cache().lock() {
        g.active = state;
        g.fetched_at = Instant::now();
    }
    state
}

pub fn held_notifs_path() -> PathBuf {
    crate::libraries::process::mbs_runtime_dir().join("moonbeauty-held-notifs.json")
}

pub fn load_held_notifs() -> Vec<NotificationToast> {
    // 16 MB cap prevents oversized files from OOMing on read.
    crate::libraries::process::read_json_capped::<Vec<NotificationToast>>(
        &held_notifs_path(),
        16 * 1024 * 1024,
    )
    .unwrap_or_default()
}

pub fn save_held_notifs(toasts: &[NotificationToast]) {
    let p = held_notifs_path();
    if toasts.is_empty() {
        let _ = fs::remove_file(&p);
    } else if let Ok(json) = serde_json::to_string(toasts) {
        let tmp = p.with_extension("tmp");
        if crate::libraries::process::private_write_file(&tmp, json.as_bytes()).is_ok() {
            let _ = fs::rename(&tmp, &p);
        }
    }
    let mtime = std::fs::metadata(&p).ok().and_then(|m| m.modified().ok());
    let mut g = held_cache().lock().unwrap();
    g.count = toasts.len();
    g.fetched_at = Instant::now();
    g.mtime = mtime;
}

struct HeldCache {
    count: usize,
    fetched_at: Instant,
    mtime: Option<std::time::SystemTime>,
}
static HELD_CACHE: std::sync::OnceLock<std::sync::Mutex<HeldCache>> = std::sync::OnceLock::new();

fn held_cache() -> &'static std::sync::Mutex<HeldCache> {
    HELD_CACHE.get_or_init(|| {
        std::sync::Mutex::new(HeldCache {
            count: 0,
            fetched_at: Instant::now() - std::time::Duration::from_secs(60),
            mtime: None,
        })
    })
}

pub fn held_notifs_count() -> usize {
    // Only re-parse when the file's mtime changes (stat once per call, 60 s fallback).
    let path = held_notifs_path();
    let mtime = std::fs::metadata(&path).ok().and_then(|m| m.modified().ok());
    let mut g = held_cache().lock().unwrap();
    if g.mtime != mtime || g.fetched_at.elapsed() > std::time::Duration::from_secs(60) {
        g.count = load_held_notifs().len();
        g.fetched_at = Instant::now();
        g.mtime = mtime;
    }
    g.count
}

pub fn take_held_notifs() -> Vec<NotificationToast> {
    let list = load_held_notifs();
    let _ = fs::remove_file(held_notifs_path());
    let mut g = held_cache().lock().unwrap();
    g.count = 0;
    g.fetched_at = Instant::now();
    g.mtime = None;
    list
}

// ── Cross-process active count ─────────────────────────────────────
//
// The bar's notification capsule needs to know how many notifications
// are currently on screen or queued. Those live in the notif-surface
// process's memory (`active_toasts` + `pending_toasts`), not the bar.
// The notif-surface writes this count to a small file on every change
// (plus a heartbeat), and the bar reads it with a short cache.

pub fn active_count_path() -> PathBuf {
    crate::libraries::process::mbs_runtime_dir().join("moonbeauty-active-count")
}

/// Notif-surface calls this on any change to active+pending count.
pub fn write_active_count(count: usize) {
    let p = active_count_path();
    let tmp = p.with_extension("tmp");
    if crate::libraries::process::private_write_file(&tmp, count.to_string().as_bytes()).is_ok() {
        let _ = fs::rename(tmp, p);
    }
}

struct ActiveCountCache {
    count: usize,
    fetched_at: Instant,
}
static ACTIVE_COUNT_CACHE: std::sync::OnceLock<std::sync::Mutex<ActiveCountCache>> =
    std::sync::OnceLock::new();

fn active_count_cache() -> &'static std::sync::Mutex<ActiveCountCache> {
    ACTIVE_COUNT_CACHE.get_or_init(|| {
        std::sync::Mutex::new(ActiveCountCache {
            count: 0,
            fetched_at: Instant::now() - std::time::Duration::from_secs(60),
        })
    })
}

/// Bar-side read. Cached 250ms (fast enough to feel instant on DND
/// toggle, slow enough to avoid hammering the file during animation).
pub fn read_active_count() -> usize {
    let mut g = active_count_cache().lock().unwrap();
    if g.fetched_at.elapsed() > std::time::Duration::from_millis(250) {
        g.count = read_active_count_uncached();
        g.fetched_at = Instant::now();
    }
    g.count
}

fn read_active_count_uncached() -> usize {
    let p = active_count_path();
    let Ok(meta) = fs::metadata(&p) else {
        return 0;
    };
    // Stale detection: if the notif-surface has been dead for >10s,
    // treat as 0 so the capsule doesn't show a phantom count forever.
    if let Ok(modified) = meta.modified() {
        if let Ok(elapsed) = modified.elapsed() {
            if elapsed.as_secs() > 10 {
                return 0;
            }
        }
    }
    fs::read_to_string(&p)
        .ok()
        .and_then(|s| s.trim().parse().ok())
        .unwrap_or(0)
}

//! Freeze-frame capture via grim.

pub fn capture_fullscreen() -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
    capture_output(None)
}

pub fn capture_output(name: Option<&str>) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
    let mut cmd = std::process::Command::new("grim");
    if let Some(n) = name {
        cmd.args(["-o", n]);
    }
    cmd.arg("-");
    let output = cmd.output().map_err(|e| format!("grim spawn: {e}"))?;
    if !output.status.success() {
        let err = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr);
        return Err(format!("grim failed: {}", err.trim()));
    }
    Ok(output.stdout)
}

//! Per-monitor freeze-frame selector.
//! Each fragment displays a local crop of the full desktop image.
//! Fragments coordinate cross-monitor drags via a shared state file.

use iced::widget::canvas::{Canvas, Frame, Geometry, Program};
use iced::widget::Stack;
use iced::{Color, Element, Length, Point, Rectangle, Size, Task, Theme};
use iced_layershell::reexport::{Anchor, KeyboardInteractivity, Layer};
use iced_layershell::settings::{LayerShellSettings, Settings};
use iced_layershell::to_layer_message;
use std::io::Write;
use std::path::PathBuf;

#[to_layer_message]
#[derive(Clone)]
pub enum Message {
    Tick,
    Press(Point),
    Drag(Point),
    Release(Point),
    Escape,
}

// Manual Debug impl because the macro injects variants that don't derive Debug
impl std::fmt::Debug for Message {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        f.write_str("Message")
    }
}

pub fn read_state_file(path: &std::path::Path) -> (String, i32, i32, i32, i32) {
    // Cap state-file read at 1KB (expected ~30 bytes); metadata check avoids
    // allocation on oversized files.
    const MAX_BYTES: u64 = 1024;
    if std::fs::metadata(path).map(|m| m.len()).unwrap_or(0) > MAX_BYTES {
        eprintln!(
            "[fragment] state file exceeds {} bytes, treating as idle",
            MAX_BYTES
        );
        return ("idle".into(), 0, 0, 0, 0);
    }
    let Ok(content) = std::fs::read_to_string(path) else {
        return ("idle".into(), 0, 0, 0, 0);
    };
    let mut it = content.lines();
    let state = it.next().unwrap_or("idle").trim().to_string();
    let sx = it
        .next()
        .and_then(|s| s.trim().parse::<i32>().ok())
        .unwrap_or(0);
    let sy = it
        .next()
        .and_then(|s| s.trim().parse::<i32>().ok())
        .unwrap_or(0);
    let cx = it
        .next()
        .and_then(|s| s.trim().parse::<i32>().ok())
        .unwrap_or(0);
    let cy = it
        .next()
        .and_then(|s| s.trim().parse::<i32>().ok())
        .unwrap_or(0);
    (state, sx, sy, cx, cy)
}

pub fn write_state_file(path: &std::path::Path, state: &str, sx: i32, sy: i32, cx: i32, cy: i32) {
    let tmp = path.with_extension("tmp");
    // Remove any stale tmp file, then open with O_EXCL via private_create_new
    // so symlinks at `tmp` are never followed; on EEXIST the next 16ms tick retries.
    let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&tmp);
    if let Ok(mut f) = crate::libraries::process::private_create_new(&tmp) {
        let _ = write!(f, "{}\n{}\n{}\n{}\n{}\n", state, sx, sy, cx, cy);
        let _ = f.sync_all();
        drop(f);
        let _ = std::fs::rename(&tmp, path);
    }
}

pub struct FragmentApp {
    gx: i32,
    gy: i32,
    handle: iced::widget::image::Handle,
    state_file: PathBuf,
    is_initiator: bool,
    render_rect: Option<Rectangle>,
}

impl Default for FragmentApp {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            gx: 0,
            gy: 0,
            handle: iced::widget::image::Handle::from_bytes(Vec::<u8>::new()),
            state_file: PathBuf::new(),
            is_initiator: false,
            render_rect: None,
        }
    }
}

impl FragmentApp {
    fn update(&mut self, message: Message) -> Task<Message> {
        match message {
            Message::Tick => {
                let (state, sx, sy, cx, cy) = read_state_file(&self.state_file);
                match state.as_str() {
                    "done" => std::process::exit(0),
                    "cancelled" => std::process::exit(130),
                    "dragging" => {
                        let lx0 = (sx - self.gx) as f32;
                        let ly0 = (sy - self.gy) as f32;
                        let lx1 = (cx - self.gx) as f32;
                        let ly1 = (cy - self.gy) as f32;
                        self.render_rect = Some(Rectangle {
                            x: lx0.min(lx1),
                            y: ly0.min(ly1),
                            width: (lx1 - lx0).abs(),
                            height: (ly1 - ly0).abs(),
                        });
                    }
                    _ => {
                        self.render_rect = None;
                    }
                }
                Task::none()
            }
            Message::Press(local) => {
                let (state, _, _, _, _) = read_state_file(&self.state_file);
                if state == "idle" {
                    self.is_initiator = true;
                    let gx = self.gx + local.x as i32;
                    let gy = self.gy + local.y as i32;
                    write_state_file(&self.state_file, "dragging", gx, gy, gx, gy);
                }
                Task::none()
            }
            Message::Drag(local) => {
                if !self.is_initiator {
                    let (state, _, _, _, _) = read_state_file(&self.state_file);
                    if state == "dragging" {
                        // We picked up the pointer mid-drag from another monitor.
                        self.is_initiator = true;
                    } else {
                        return Task::none();
                    }
                }
                let (state, sx, sy, _, _) = read_state_file(&self.state_file);
                if state == "dragging" {
                    let gx = self.gx + local.x as i32;
                    let gy = self.gy + local.y as i32;
                    write_state_file(&self.state_file, "dragging", sx, sy, gx, gy);
                }
                Task::none()
            }
            Message::Release(local) => {
                let (state, sx, sy, _, _) = read_state_file(&self.state_file);
                if state == "dragging" {
                    let gx = self.gx + local.x as i32;
                    let gy = self.gy + local.y as i32;
                    write_state_file(&self.state_file, "done", sx, sy, gx, gy);
                    std::process::exit(0);
                }
                Task::none()
            }
            Message::Escape => {
                let (state, _, _, _, _) = read_state_file(&self.state_file);
                if state != "done" {
                    write_state_file(&self.state_file, "cancelled", 0, 0, 0, 0);
                }
                std::process::exit(130);
            }
            _ => Task::none(),
        }
    }

    fn view(&self) -> Element<'_, Message> {
        let img = iced::widget::image(self.handle.clone())
            .width(Length::Fill)
            .height(Length::Fill)
            .content_fit(iced::ContentFit::Fill);

        let canvas = Canvas::new(FragmentCanvas {
            rect: self.render_rect,
        })
        .width(Length::Fill)
        .height(Length::Fill);

        Stack::new().push(img).push(canvas).into()
    }

    fn subscription(&self) -> iced::Subscription<Message> {
        iced::Subscription::batch([
            iced::time::every(std::time::Duration::from_millis(16)).map(|_| Message::Tick),
            iced::event::listen_with(|event, _status, _window| {
                let iced::Event::Keyboard(iced::keyboard::Event::KeyPressed { key, .. }) = event
                else {
                    return None;
                };
                match key {
                    iced::keyboard::Key::Named(iced::keyboard::key::Named::Escape) => {
                        Some(Message::Escape)
                    }
                    _ => None,
                }
            }),
        ])
    }
}

struct FragmentCanvas {
    rect: Option<Rectangle>,
}

impl Program<Message> for FragmentCanvas {
    type State = ();

    fn update(
        &self,
        _s: &mut (),
        event: &iced::Event,
        _bounds: Rectangle,
        cursor: iced::mouse::Cursor,
    ) -> Option<iced::widget::Action<Message>> {
        use iced::mouse;

        // Use unclamped cursor position so we get motion events even when the
        // cursor leaves this surface (which happens during a Wayland implicit
        // grab when dragging from one monitor to another).
        match event {
            iced::Event::Mouse(mouse::Event::ButtonPressed(mouse::Button::Left)) => {
                if let Some(p) = cursor.position() {
                    return Some(iced::widget::Action::publish(Message::Press(p)));
                }
            }
            iced::Event::Mouse(mouse::Event::CursorMoved { .. }) => {
                if let Some(p) = cursor.position() {
                    return Some(iced::widget::Action::publish(Message::Drag(p)));
                }
            }
            iced::Event::Mouse(mouse::Event::ButtonReleased(mouse::Button::Left)) => {
                if let Some(p) = cursor.position() {
                    return Some(iced::widget::Action::publish(Message::Release(p)));
                }
            }
            _ => {}
        }
        None
    }

    fn draw(
        &self,
        _s: &(),
        renderer: &iced::Renderer,
        _t: &Theme,
        bounds: Rectangle,
        _c: iced::mouse::Cursor,
    ) -> Vec<Geometry> {
        let mut frame = Frame::new(renderer, bounds.size());
        let dim = Color::from_rgba(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.55);

        match self.rect {
            Some(r) if r.width > 1.0 && r.height > 1.0 => {
                let sx = r.x.max(0.0);
                let sy = r.y.max(0.0);
                let ex = (r.x + r.width).min(bounds.width);
                let ey = (r.y + r.height).min(bounds.height);

                if sy > 0.0 {
                    frame.fill_rectangle(Point::ORIGIN, Size::new(bounds.width, sy), dim);
                }
                if ey < bounds.height {
                    frame.fill_rectangle(
                        Point::new(0.0, ey),
                        Size::new(bounds.width, bounds.height - ey),
                        dim,
                    );
                }
                if sy < ey {
                    if sx > 0.0 {
                        frame.fill_rectangle(Point::new(0.0, sy), Size::new(sx, ey - sy), dim);
                    }
                    if ex < bounds.width {
                        frame.fill_rectangle(
                            Point::new(ex, sy),
                            Size::new(bounds.width - ex, ey - sy),
                            dim,
                        );
                    }
                }

                let b = 1.5;
                let border = Color::WHITE;
                let w = (ex - sx).max(0.0);
                let h = (ey - sy).max(0.0);
                if w > 0.0 && h > 0.0 {
                    frame.fill_rectangle(Point::new(sx, sy), Size::new(w, b), border);
                    frame.fill_rectangle(Point::new(sx, ey - b), Size::new(w, b), border);
                    frame.fill_rectangle(Point::new(sx, sy), Size::new(b, h), border);
                    frame.fill_rectangle(Point::new(ex - b, sy), Size::new(b, h), border);

                    // Live Dimensions HUD
                    let dim_text = format!("{} x {}", w as u32, h as u32);
                    frame.fill_text(iced::widget::canvas::Text {
                        content: dim_text,
                        position: Point::new(ex + 8.0, ey + 8.0),
                        color: Color::WHITE,
                        size: iced::Pixels(16.0),
                        ..Default::default()
                    });
                }
            }
            _ => {
                frame.fill_rectangle(Point::ORIGIN, bounds.size(), dim);
            }
        }

        vec![frame.into_geometry()]
    }
}

pub fn run(
    monitor: String,
    gx: i32,
    gy: i32,
    local_png: PathBuf,
    state_file: PathBuf,
) -> Result<(), String> {
    // Reject arbitrary read/write paths: both must resolve under $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/mbs-tmp/.
    if !crate::libraries::process::path_is_under_mbs_tmp(&local_png) {
        return Err(format!("local_png outside mbs-tmp: {:?}", local_png));
    }
    if !crate::libraries::process::path_is_under_mbs_tmp(&state_file) {
        return Err(format!("state_file outside mbs-tmp: {:?}", state_file));
    }
    let bytes = std::fs::read(&local_png).map_err(|e| format!("read: {e}"))?;
    let handle = iced::widget::image::Handle::from_bytes(bytes);
    let app = FragmentApp {
        gx,
        gy,
        handle,
        state_file,
        is_initiator: false,
        render_rect: None,
    };

    // layer_settings is passed via the Settings struct, not a trait method
    let layer = LayerShellSettings {
        size: Some((0, 0)),
        exclusive_zone: -1,
        anchor: Anchor::Top | Anchor::Bottom | Anchor::Left | Anchor::Right,
        layer: Layer::Overlay,
        keyboard_interactivity: KeyboardInteractivity::Exclusive,
        events_transparent: false,
        start_mode: iced_layershell::settings::StartMode::TargetScreen(monitor),
        ..Default::default()
    };

    let _app_cell = std::sync::Arc::new(std::sync::Mutex::new(Some(app)));
    let _app_for_boot = _app_cell.clone();
    iced_layershell::application(
        move || {
            let _app = _app_for_boot
                .lock()
                .unwrap()
                .take()
                .expect("iced_layershell calls boot exactly once");
            (_app, iced::Task::none())
        },
        || "mbs-freeze-frag".to_string(),
        FragmentApp::update,
        FragmentApp::view,
    )
    .subscription(FragmentApp::subscription)
    .style(|_state, _theme| iced::theme::Style {
        background_color: iced::Color::TRANSPARENT,
        text_color: iced::Color::WHITE,
    })
    .settings(Settings {
        layer_settings: layer,
        ..Default::default()
    })
    .run()
    .map_err(|e| format!("run: {e:?}"))
}

//! Screenshot capture + annotator.
//!
//! Contents:
//! - `capture`   : grim wrappers (fullscreen / per-output PNG capture)
//! - `output`    : swaymsg output listing
//! - `fragment`  : per-monitor freeze-frame selector (cross-monitor drag state)
//! - `annotator` : annotation UI (rect/ellipse/arrow/pen/text/counter/redact)
//! - `ipc`       : Unix socket listener for --annotator-surface commands

pub(crate) fn magick_or_convert() -> Option<&'static str> {
    if std::process::Command::new("magick")
        .arg("--version")
        .output()
        .map(|o| o.status.success())
        .unwrap_or(false)
    {
        Some("magick")
    } else if std::process::Command::new("convert")
        .arg("--version")
        .output()
        .map(|o| o.status.success())
        .unwrap_or(false)
    {
        Some("convert")
    } else {
        None
    }
}

use std::process::Command;
pub fn list_all_outputs() -> Vec<(String, i32, i32, u32, u32)> {
    let out = Command::new("swaymsg")
        .args(["-t", "get_outputs", "-r"])
        .output()
        .ok()
        .and_then(|o| {
            if o.status.success() {
                String::from_utf8(o.stdout).ok()
            } else {
                None
            }
        });
    let Some(text) = out else {
        return Vec::new();
    };
    let Ok(v) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(&text) else {
        return Vec::new();
    };
    v.as_array()
        .map(|arr| {
            arr.iter()
                .filter_map(|o| {
                    let name = o.get("name")?.as_str()?.to_string();
                    let rect = o.get("rect")?;
                    let x = rect.get("x")?.as_i64()? as i32;
                    let y = rect.get("y")?.as_i64()? as i32;
                    let w = rect.get("width")?.as_i64()? as u32;
                    let h = rect.get("height")?.as_i64()? as u32;
                    Some((name, x, y, w, h))
                })
                .collect()
        })
        .unwrap_or_default()
}

//! Visible plate watermark — exact match of the QML QuickshotEngine.lua
//! `apply_watermark` function.
//!
//! - Tile 240x220 with the watermark text
//! - Text rotated 30° to create the diagonal pattern
//! - Fill (100, 0, 255) at 0.008 alpha — essentially invisible
//! - Pointsize 20 Liberation-Sans-Bold
//! - Tiled across the whole image
//! - png compression-level=1
//!
//! Reveal via B−G channel differencing (since the plate is purple, blue
//! minus green is the strongest signal).

use super::magick_or_convert;
use std::path::PathBuf;

fn private_dir() -> PathBuf {
    // mbs_subdir panics if $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR is unset (no /tmp fallback)
    // and enforces 0700 permissions.
    crate::libraries::process::mbs_subdir("mbs-watermark")
}

/// Build the watermark text that fills the 240x220 tile.
/// The QML version repeats the name with whitespace to fill horizontally.
fn watermark_text(text: &str) -> String {
    format!("{}        {}        {}", text, text, text)
}

/// Add the watermark. Matches QuickshotEngine.lua's apply_watermark exactly:
///
/// ```text
///     convert raw.png \
///       ( -size 240x220 xc:none -fill "rgba(100,0,255,0.008)" \
///         -font Liberation-Sans-Bold -pointsize 20 -gravity Center \
///         -annotate +0+0 "<repeated text>" \
///         -distort ScaleRotateTranslate 30 -write mpr:text +delete ) \
///       ( +clone -tile mpr:text -draw "color 0,0 reset" ) \
///       -compose Over -composite \
///       -define png:compression-level=1 out.png
/// ```
pub fn add_plate_watermark(bytes: &[u8], name: &str) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
    let bin = magick_or_convert().ok_or("ImageMagick not installed")?;

    let stamp = format!(
        "{}",
        std::time::SystemTime::now()
            .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
            .unwrap_or_default()
            .as_nanos()
    );
    let dir = private_dir();
    let tmp_in = dir.join(format!("plate-in-{}.png", stamp));
    let tmp_out = dir.join(format!("plate-out-{}.png", stamp));
    std::fs::write(&tmp_in, bytes).map_err(|e| format!("write: {e}"))?;

    let tile_text = watermark_text(name);

    let args = [
        tmp_in.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
        "(".into(),
        "-size".into(),
        "240x220".into(),
        "xc:none".into(),
        "-fill".into(),
        "rgba(100, 0, 255, 0.008)".into(),
        "-font".into(),
        "Liberation-Sans-Bold".into(),
        "-pointsize".into(),
        "20".into(),
        "-gravity".into(),
        "Center".into(),
        "-annotate".into(),
        "+0+0".into(),
        tile_text.clone(),
        "-distort".into(),
        "ScaleRotateTranslate".into(),
        "30".into(),
        "-write".into(),
        "mpr:text".into(),
        "+delete".into(),
        ")".into(),
        "(".into(),
        "+clone".into(),
        "-tile".into(),
        "mpr:text".into(),
        "-draw".into(),
        "color 0,0 reset".into(),
        ")".into(),
        "-compose".into(),
        "Over".into(),
        "-composite".into(),
        "-define".into(),
        "png:compression-level=1".into(),
        tmp_out.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
    ];

    // Bound ImageMagick resource use.
    let status = std::process::Command::new(bin)
        .args([
            "-limit", "memory", "512MiB", "-limit", "map", "1GiB", "-limit", "disk", "2GiB",
            "-limit", "width", "16384", "-limit", "height", "16384",
        ])
        .args(&args)
        .status()
        .map_err(|e| format!("spawn {bin}: {e}"))?;

    let result = if status.success() {
        std::fs::read(&tmp_out).map_err(|e| format!("read: {e}"))
    } else {
        Err(format!("{bin} exited nonzero"))
    };

    let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&tmp_in);
    let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&tmp_out);

    if result.is_ok() {
        eprintln!("[plate] {} (tiled 240x220 rotate 30°, alpha 0.008)", name);
    }
    result
}

/// Reveal the plate watermark by high-pass filtering the blue channel.
///
/// Exact port of QuickshotEngine.lua's C.reveal():
///
/// ```text
///     magick crop.png -channel B -separate \
///       ( +clone -blur 0x2 ) \
///       -compose Subtract -composite \
///       -auto-level -define png:compression-level=1 out.png
/// ```
///
/// The plate is purple (100, 0, 255) at 0.008 alpha → ~2 units of blue
/// offset per tile pixel. The blur removes low-frequency background;
/// subtracting leaves only the high-frequency watermark pattern. Auto-level
/// stretches that faint signal to full 0–255 for legibility.
///
/// Always returns the reveal image. The user reads the diagonal text pattern
/// (or its absence) directly — same behavior as the QML build.
pub fn reveal(bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
    let bin = magick_or_convert().ok_or("ImageMagick not installed")?;

    let stamp = format!(
        "{}",
        std::time::SystemTime::now()
            .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
            .unwrap_or_default()
            .as_nanos()
    );
    let dir = private_dir();
    let tmp_in = dir.join(format!("reveal-in-{}.png", stamp));
    let tmp_out = dir.join(format!("REVEALED_{}.png", stamp));

    // JXL decode via djxl before magick. Stock ImageMagick often lacks
    // a JXL delegate; when it lacks one, a failed decode can still exit
    // 0 while creating a directory at the output path, which then makes
    // std::fs::read fail with EISDIR — silently breaking reveal.
    let is_jxl = bytes.starts_with(&[0xFF, 0x0A])
        || bytes.starts_with(&[
            0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x0C, 0x4A, 0x58, 0x4C, 0x20, 0x0D, 0x0A, 0x87, 0x0A,
        ]);
    if is_jxl {
        let tmp_raw = dir.join(format!("reveal-raw-{}.jxl", stamp));
        std::fs::write(&tmp_raw, bytes).map_err(|e| format!("write: {e}"))?;
        let status = std::process::Command::new("djxl")
            .arg(&tmp_raw)
            .arg(&tmp_in)
            .status()
            .map_err(|e| format!("spawn djxl: {e}"))?;
        let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&tmp_raw);
        if !status.success() {
            return Err("djxl failed (install libjxl-tools)".into());
        }
    } else {
        std::fs::write(&tmp_in, bytes).map_err(|e| format!("write: {e}"))?;
    }

    // Bound ImageMagick resource use.
    let mut cmd = std::process::Command::new(bin);
    cmd.args([
        "-limit", "memory", "512MiB", "-limit", "map", "1GiB", "-limit", "disk", "2GiB", "-limit",
        "width", "16384", "-limit", "height", "16384",
    ]);
    cmd.args([
        tmp_in.to_str().unwrap(),
        "-channel",
        "B",
        "-separate",
        "(",
        "+clone",
        "-blur",
        "0x2",
        ")",
        "-compose",
        "Subtract",
        "-composite",
        "-auto-level",
        "-define",
        "png:compression-level=1",
        tmp_out.to_str().unwrap(),
    ]);
    let status = cmd.status().map_err(|e| format!("spawn {bin}: {e}"))?;

    let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&tmp_in);

    if !status.success() {
        let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&tmp_out);
        return Err(format!("{bin} exited nonzero"));
    }

    // Magick can exit 0 while writing a directory at the output path
    // when its decoder delegate is missing. Detect explicitly so the
    // caller sees a clear error instead of EISDIR from std::fs::read.
    if std::path::Path::new(&tmp_out).is_dir() {
        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&tmp_out);
        return Err(format!(
            "{bin} produced a directory at {tmp_out:?} — decoder delegate missing"
        ));
    }

    let result = std::fs::read(&tmp_out).map_err(|e| format!("read: {e}"))?;
    let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&tmp_out);

    // Diagnostic: compute signal strength as the standard deviation of the
    // auto-leveled image. High variance = distinctive pattern (watermark).
    // Low variance = flat noise (no watermark). Purely informational.
    if let Ok(img) = image::load_from_memory(&result) {
        let gray = img.to_luma8();
        let n = gray.pixels().count() as f64;
        if n > 0.0 {
            let mean: f64 = gray.pixels().map(|p| p[0] as f64).sum::<f64>() / n;
            let var: f64 = gray
                .pixels()
                .map(|p| (p[0] as f64 - mean).powi(2))
                .sum::<f64>()
                / n;
            let std_dev = var.sqrt();
            eprintln!(
                "[reveal] signal std_dev={:.1} (high variance = pattern present)",
                std_dev
            );
        }
    }

    Ok(result)
}

use crate::libraries::ipc::{IpcCommand, OverlayTarget};
use crate::libraries::process::resolve_exe;
use super::capture;
use super::output;
use super::fragment;

use crate::libraries::ipc::send_ipc_sync;

pub fn run_fragment(args: &[String]) {
    // Temporary: verify freeze-frame capture works before UI build
    // Child: render freeze-frame selector, write crop to disk
    if args.iter().any(|a| a == "--freeze-fragment") {
        let idx = args.iter().position(|a| a == "--freeze-fragment").unwrap();
        let monitor = args.get(idx + 1).cloned().unwrap_or_default();
        let gx: i32 = args.get(idx + 2).and_then(|s| s.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(0);
        let gy: i32 = args.get(idx + 3).and_then(|s| s.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(0);
        let local_png = args.get(idx + 4).cloned().unwrap_or_default();
        let state_file = args.get(idx + 5).cloned().unwrap_or_default();
        if monitor.is_empty() || local_png.is_empty() || state_file.is_empty() {
            eprintln!("usage: --freeze-fragment <name> <gx> <gy> <local.png> <state_file>");
            std::process::exit(2);
        }
        match fragment::run(
            monitor,
            gx,
            gy,
            std::path::PathBuf::from(local_png),
            std::path::PathBuf::from(state_file),
        ) {
            Ok(_) => std::process::exit(0),
            Err(e) => {
                eprintln!("[freeze-fragment] {e}");
                std::process::exit(1);
            }
        }
    }
}

pub fn run_orchestrator(args: &[String]) {
    // Orchestrator: capture focused output → spawn child → report crop
    if args.iter().any(|a| a == "--screenshot") {
        // Multi-monitor: capture the entire desktop once, then spawn one fragment
        // per monitor with a local crop. Fragments coordinate drags via a shared state file.
        let outputs = output::list_all_outputs();
        if outputs.is_empty() {
            eprintln!("[screenshot] no outputs found");
            std::process::exit(1);
        }

        let full_bytes = match capture::capture_output(None) {
            Ok(b) => b,
            Err(e) => {
                eprintln!("[screenshot] capture failed: {e}");
                std::process::exit(1);
            }
        };
        let full_img = match image::load_from_memory(&full_bytes) {
            Ok(i) => i.to_rgba8(),
            Err(e) => {
                eprintln!("[screenshot] decode failed: {e}");
                std::process::exit(1);
            }
        };

        // The full image's origin corresponds to (min_x, min_y) in global space.
        let min_x = outputs.iter().map(|(_, x, _, _, _)| *x).min().unwrap_or(0);
        let min_y = outputs.iter().map(|(_, _, y, _, _)| *y).min().unwrap_or(0);

        let state_file = crate::libraries::process::mbs_unique_tmp("mbs-freeze-state", "txt");
        fragment::write_state_file(&state_file, "idle", 0, 0, 0, 0);

        let exe = resolve_exe();
        let mut children: Vec<(String, std::process::Child)> = Vec::new();
        let mut local_png_paths: Vec<std::path::PathBuf> = Vec::new();

        for (name, x, y, w, h) in &outputs {
            let lx = (*x - min_x) as u32;
            let ly = (*y - min_y) as u32;
            if lx + *w > full_img.width() || ly + *h > full_img.height() {
                continue;
            }
            let crop = image::imageops::crop_imm(&full_img, lx, ly, *w, *h).to_image();
            let local_png = crate::libraries::process::mbs_unique_tmp(
                &format!("mbs-freeze-{}", name),
                "png",
            );
            let write_ok = match crate::libraries::process::private_create_new(&local_png) {
                Ok(mut f) => {
                    let ok = image::DynamicImage::ImageRgba8(crop)
                        .write_to(&mut f, image::ImageFormat::Png)
                        .is_ok();
                    if !ok {
                        let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&local_png);
                    }
                    ok
                }
                Err(_) => false,
            };
            if !write_ok {
                eprintln!("[screenshot] crop write failed: {}", local_png.display());
                continue;
            }
            local_png_paths.push(local_png.clone());

            match std::process::Command::new(&exe)
                .args([
                    "--freeze-fragment",
                    name,
                    &x.to_string(),
                    &y.to_string(),
                    local_png.to_str().unwrap_or(""),
                    state_file.to_str().unwrap_or(""),
                ])
                .spawn()
            {
                Ok(child) => children.push((name.to_string(), child)),
                Err(e) => eprintln!("[screenshot] spawn {} failed: {e}", name),
            }
        }

        if children.is_empty() {
            eprintln!("[screenshot] no fragments spawned");
            std::process::exit(1);
        }

        // Poll state file
        let mut rect: Option<(i32, i32, i32, i32)> = None;
        loop {
            let (state, sx, sy, cx, cy) = fragment::read_state_file(&state_file);
            if state == "done" {
                rect = Some((sx, sy, cx, cy));
                break;
            }
            if state == "cancelled" {
                break;
            }
            let mut any_alive = false;
            for (_, child) in children.iter_mut() {
                match child.try_wait() {
                    Ok(Some(_)) => {}
                    Ok(None) => any_alive = true,
                    Err(_) => {}
                }
            }
            if !any_alive {
                break;
            }
            std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(20));
        }

        for (_, mut child) in children.drain(..) {
            let _ = child.kill();
            let _ = child.wait();
        }

        // Clean up per-monitor crops
        for p in &local_png_paths {
            let _ = std::fs::remove_file(p);
        }
        let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&state_file);

        let Some((sx, sy, cx, cy)) = rect else {
            eprintln!("[screenshot] cancelled");
            std::process::exit(130);
        };

        let rx = (sx.min(cx) - min_x).max(0) as u32;
        let ry = (sy.min(cy) - min_y).max(0) as u32;
        let rw = (sx - cx).unsigned_abs();
        let rh = (sy - cy).unsigned_abs();

        if rw < 4 || rh < 4 || rx + rw > full_img.width() || ry + rh > full_img.height() {
            eprintln!("[screenshot] invalid selection");
            std::process::exit(130);
        }

        let cropped = image::imageops::crop_imm(&full_img, rx, ry, rw, rh).to_image();
        let out_path = crate::libraries::process::mbs_unique_tmp("mbs-freeze-out", "png");
        let save_ok = match crate::libraries::process::private_create_new(&out_path) {
            Ok(mut f) => {
                let ok = image::DynamicImage::ImageRgba8(cropped)
                    .write_to(&mut f, image::ImageFormat::Png)
                    .is_ok();
                if !ok {
                    let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&out_path);
                }
                ok
            }
            Err(_) => false,
        };
        if !save_ok {
            eprintln!("[screenshot] save crop failed");
            std::process::exit(1);
        }
        eprintln!("[screenshot] cropped → {}", out_path.display());

        let cmd = IpcCommand::Open(
            OverlayTarget::Annotator,
            Some(out_path.to_string_lossy().into_owned()),
        );
        match send_ipc_sync(&cmd) {
            Ok(_) => {}
            Err(e) => {
                eprintln!("[screenshot] annotator IPC failed: {e}");
                std::process::exit(1);
            }
        }
        std::process::exit(0);
    }
}
