//! Drag-to-resize canvas widget for tooltip dimensions in Bar Settings.
//!
//! Replaces the W/H sliders in the per-module row. Click anywhere in the
//! box to jump the size to that fraction of the allowed range, drag to
//! scrub, release to commit. Range maps linearly:
//!   x_norm ∈ [0,1] → w = min_w + x_norm·(max_w − min_w)

use super::settings::SettingsMessage;
use iced::widget::canvas::{self, Canvas, Frame, Geometry, Path, Stroke, Text};
use iced::{mouse, Color, Element, Length, Point, Rectangle, Size, Theme};

pub struct SizeResizer {
    pub id: String,
    pub w: u32,
    pub h: u32,
    pub min_w: u32,
    pub min_h: u32,
    pub max_w: u32,
    pub max_h: u32,
    pub bg: Color,
    pub fg: Color,
    pub border: Color,
    pub muted: Color,
    pub display_w: f32,
    pub display_h: f32,
}

/// Public because `Program::State` for a public canvas impl leaks it
/// into the type signature. Also derives Debug/Clone/PartialEq/Copy per
/// the trait's documentation hints (needed for state comparisons in some
/// iced versions; harmless here).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, Default, PartialEq)]
pub struct DragState {
    pub dragging: bool,
}

impl SizeResizer {
    pub fn view(self) -> Element<'static, SettingsMessage> {
        let w = self.display_w;
        let h = self.display_h;
        Canvas::new(self)
            .width(Length::Fixed(w))
            .height(Length::Fixed(h))
            .into()
    }
}

impl canvas::Program<SettingsMessage> for SizeResizer {
    type State = DragState;

    fn update(
        &self,
        state: &mut Self::State,
        event: &iced::Event,
        bounds: Rectangle,
        cursor: mouse::Cursor,
    ) -> Option<iced::widget::Action<SettingsMessage>> {
        match event {
            iced::Event::Mouse(mouse::Event::ButtonPressed(mouse::Button::Left)) => {
                if let Some(p) = cursor.position_in(bounds) {
                    state.dragging = true;
                    let x_norm = (p.x / bounds.width).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
                    let y_norm = (p.y / bounds.height).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
                    return Some(iced::widget::Action::publish(SettingsMessage::SizeDrag {
                        id: self.id.clone(),
                        x_norm,
                        y_norm,
                    }));
                }
            }
            iced::Event::Mouse(mouse::Event::CursorMoved { .. }) if state.dragging => {
                // Use absolute cursor position (not position_in) so drags
                // that go outside the widget still update clamped to bounds.
                if let Some(p) = cursor.position() {
                    let local_x = p.x - bounds.x;
                    let local_y = p.y - bounds.y;
                    let x_norm = (local_x / bounds.width).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
                    let y_norm = (local_y / bounds.height).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
                    return Some(iced::widget::Action::publish(SettingsMessage::SizeDrag {
                        id: self.id.clone(),
                        x_norm,
                        y_norm,
                    }));
                }
            }
            iced::Event::Mouse(mouse::Event::ButtonReleased(mouse::Button::Left))
                if state.dragging =>
            {
                state.dragging = false;
                return Some(iced::widget::Action::publish(SettingsMessage::SizeCommit {
                    id: self.id.clone(),
                }));
            }
            _ => {}
        }
        None
    }

    fn draw(
        &self,
        state: &Self::State,
        renderer: &iced::Renderer,
        _theme: &Theme,
        bounds: Rectangle,
        _cursor: mouse::Cursor,
    ) -> Vec<Geometry> {
        let mut frame = Frame::new(renderer, bounds.size());
        let w = bounds.width;
        let h = bounds.height;

        // Dim track
        let track_bg = Color { a: 0.10, ..self.bg };
        frame.fill_rectangle(Point::ORIGIN, Size::new(w, h), track_bg);
        frame.stroke(
            &Path::rectangle(Point::ORIGIN, Size::new(w - 1.0, h - 1.0)),
            Stroke::default().with_color(self.border).with_width(1.0),
        );

        // Current fraction of the absolute maximum. Because we map
        // x_norm -> [0, max_w] linearly, the fill ratio directly
        // corresponds to the tooltip's aspect ratio when the track
        // itself matches the aspect ratio of the maximum bounds.
        let w_frac = (self.w as f32 / self.max_w as f32).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
        let h_frac = (self.h as f32 / self.max_h as f32).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
        let handle_x = (w * w_frac).max(8.0).min(w - 8.0);
        let handle_y = (h * h_frac).max(8.0).min(h - 8.0);

        // Filled region from origin to handle
        let fill = Color { a: 0.45, ..self.fg };
        frame.fill_rectangle(Point::ORIGIN, Size::new(handle_x, handle_y), fill);

        // Handle
        let handle_r = 6.0;
        let circle = Path::circle(Point::new(handle_x, handle_y), handle_r);
        frame.fill(&circle, self.fg);
        frame.stroke(
            &circle,
            Stroke::default().with_color(self.bg).with_width(2.0),
        );

        // W × H — center of box, high-contrast
        let label = format!("{} × {}", self.w, self.h);
        frame.fill_text(Text {
            content: label,
            position: Point::new(w / 2.0, h / 2.0),
            color: self.fg,
            size: iced::Pixels(13.0),
            align_x: iced::alignment::Horizontal::Center.into(),
            align_y: iced::alignment::Vertical::Center,
            ..Text::default()
        });

        // Hint label bottom-right
        let hint = if state.dragging {
            "drag…"
        } else {
            "drag to resize"
        };
        frame.fill_text(Text {
            content: hint.to_string(),
            position: Point::new(w - 4.0, h - 2.0),
            color: Color {
                a: 0.55,
                ..self.muted
            },
            size: iced::Pixels(9.0),
            align_x: iced::alignment::Horizontal::Right.into(),
            align_y: iced::alignment::Vertical::Bottom,
            ..Text::default()
        });

        vec![frame.into_geometry()]
    }
}

==> /home/moonburst/projects/moonbeauty/src/overlays/tooltip_engine.rs <==
use iced::widget::canvas::{self, Frame, Geometry, Path, Stroke};
use iced::{Color, Element, Length, Point, Rectangle, Size, Theme};

pub struct Anim {
    pub w: f32,
    pub h: f32,
    pub slant: f32,
    pub cut: f32,
    pub opacity: f32,
}

/// Snapshot of animation state at the moment close was triggered.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]
pub struct ClosingState {
    pub started: std::time::Instant,
    pub from_w: f32,
    pub from_h: f32,
    pub from_opacity: f32,
}

#[inline]
fn smoothstep(t: f32) -> f32 {
    let t = t.clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    t * t * (3.0 - 2.0 * t)
}

pub fn compute(
    elapsed_ms: f32,
    cap_w: f32,
    final_w: f32,
    h_end: f32,
    slant_base: f32,
    bar_h: f32,
    drop_ms: f32,
    expand_ms: f32,
) -> Anim {
    let pause_ms: f32 = std::env::var("MBS_TOOLTIP_PAUSE_MS")
        .ok()
        .and_then(|v| v.parse().ok())
        .unwrap_or(0.0);
    let bar_h = bar_h.max(1.0);
    let slant_at = |h: f32| slant_base * (h / bar_h);
    let cap_core = (cap_w - slant_base).max(1.0);
    let slant_end = slant_at(h_end);
    let final_core = (final_w - slant_end).max(cap_core);
    let h_t = (elapsed_ms / drop_ms.max(1.0)).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    let h = smoothstep(h_t) * h_end;
    let slant_h = slant_at(h);
    let w_start = drop_ms + pause_ms;
    let w_t = ((elapsed_ms - w_start) / expand_ms.max(1.0)).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    let core = cap_core + (final_core - cap_core) * smoothstep(w_t);
    let w = core + slant_h;
    let o_start = w_start + expand_ms;
    let opacity_ms = (drop_ms * 0.6).max(1.0);
    let o_t = ((elapsed_ms - o_start) / opacity_ms).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    let opacity = o_t * (2.0 - o_t);
    let cut = (w.min(h) * 0.15).max(0.0);
    Anim {
        w,
        h,
        slant: slant_h,
        cut,
        opacity,
    }
}

/// Interrupt-safe close: same choreography as `compute_close`, but
/// starts from the captured (from_w, from_h, from_opacity). Duration
/// scales with how much width still needs to shrink, so a tooltip
/// 30%-open closes proportionally faster than one at 100%.
pub fn compute_close_from(
    elapsed_ms: f32,
    from_w: f32,
    from_h: f32,
    from_opacity: f32,
    cap_w: f32,
    final_w: f32,
    slant_base: f32,
    bar_h: f32,
    base_ms: f32,
) -> Anim {
    let bar_h = bar_h.max(1.0);
    let slant_at = |h: f32| slant_base * (h / bar_h);
    let cap_core = (cap_w - slant_base).max(1.0);
    let from_slant = slant_at(from_h);
    let from_core = (from_w - from_slant).max(cap_core);

    let full_width_range = (final_w - cap_w).max(1.0);
    let remaining_width = (from_w - cap_w).max(0.0);
    let frac = (remaining_width / full_width_range).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    // sqrt so a barely-open tooltip still gets a visible ~150ms close.
    let scale = frac.sqrt().max(0.15);

    let fade_ms = (base_ms * 0.4 * scale).max(1.0);
    let width_ms = (base_ms * 0.7 * scale).max(1.0);
    let height_ms = (base_ms * 0.8 * scale).max(1.0);

    let o_t = (elapsed_ms / fade_ms).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    let opacity = from_opacity * (1.0 - o_t * o_t);

    let w_elapsed = (elapsed_ms - fade_ms).max(0.0);
    let w_t = (w_elapsed / width_ms).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    let core = from_core + (cap_core - from_core) * w_t * w_t * w_t;

    let h_elapsed = (elapsed_ms - fade_ms - width_ms).max(0.0);
    let h_t = (h_elapsed / height_ms).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    let h = from_h * (1.0 - h_t * h_t * h_t);

    let slant_h = slant_at(h);
    let w_final = core + slant_h;
    let cut = (w_final.min(h) * 0.15).max(0.0);

    Anim {
        w: w_final,
        h,
        slant: slant_h,
        cut,
        opacity,
    }
}

pub fn compute_close(
    elapsed_ms: f32,
    cap_w: f32,
    final_w: f32,
    h_end: f32,
    slant_base: f32,
    bar_h: f32,
    base_ms: f32,
) -> Anim {
    let bar_h = bar_h.max(1.0);
    let slant_at = |h: f32| slant_base * (h / bar_h);
    let cap_core = (cap_w - slant_base).max(1.0);
    let slant_end = slant_at(h_end);
    let final_core = (final_w - slant_end).max(cap_core);
    let fade_ms = (base_ms * 0.4).max(1.0);
    let width_ms = (base_ms * 0.7).max(1.0);
    let height_ms = (base_ms * 0.8).max(1.0);
    let o_t = (elapsed_ms / fade_ms).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    let opacity = 1.0 - o_t * o_t;
    let w_elapsed = (elapsed_ms - fade_ms).max(0.0);
    let w_t = (w_elapsed / width_ms).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    let core = final_core + (cap_core - final_core) * w_t * w_t * w_t;
    let h_elapsed = (elapsed_ms - fade_ms - width_ms).max(0.0);
    let h_t = (h_elapsed / height_ms).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    let h = h_end * (1.0 - h_t * h_t * h_t);
    let slant_h = slant_at(h);
    let w_final = core + slant_h;
    let cut = (w_final.min(h) * 0.15).max(0.0);
    Anim {
        w: w_final,
        h,
        slant: slant_h,
        cut,
        opacity,
    }
}

pub struct ParallelogramBg {
    pub w: f32,
    pub h: f32,
    pub slant: f32,
    pub slant_right: bool,
    pub background: Color,
    pub border_color: Color,
    pub border_width: f32,
    /// Per-frame counter. Iced 0.14's reactive renderer skips repaints
    /// when the widget tree is identical. Varying a layout widget via this
    /// counter forces the tree to diff and the canvas to redraw at 60fps.
    pub frame: u64,
}

impl ParallelogramBg {
    pub fn view<Message: 'static>(self) -> Element<'static, Message> {
        let w = self.w;
        let h = self.h;
        let inner = TooltipBg {
            w: self.w,
            h: self.h,
            slant: self.slant,
            slant_right: self.slant_right,
            background: self.background,
            border_color: self.border_color,
            border_width: self.border_width,
        };
        let canvas_el: Element<'static, Message> = canvas::Canvas::new(inner)
            .width(Length::Fixed(w))
            .height(Length::Fixed(h))
            .into();
        // Force a tree diff using a zero-height Space widget whose width
        // toggles by frame % 2 so Iced 0.14 redraws the canvas at 60fps
        // without cosmic-text shaping overhead.
        let marker_w = (self.frame % 2) as f32;
        let marker_el: Element<'static, Message> = iced::widget::Space::new()
            .width(Length::Fixed(marker_w))
            .height(Length::Fixed(0.0))
            .into();
        iced::widget::Stack::new()
            .push(canvas_el)
            .push(marker_el)
            .into()
    }
}

pub struct TooltipBg {
    pub w: f32,
    pub h: f32,
    pub slant: f32,
    pub slant_right: bool,
    pub background: Color,
    pub border_color: Color,
    pub border_width: f32,
}

impl<Message> canvas::Program<Message> for TooltipBg {
    // Tracks last-rendered (bounds, w, h, slant). Redraws only when the
    // animation actually produces new geometry — not on every event.
    type State = Option<(Rectangle, f32, f32, f32)>;

    fn update(
        &self,
        state: &mut Self::State,
        _event: &iced::Event,
        bounds: Rectangle,
        _cursor: iced::mouse::Cursor,
    ) -> Option<iced::widget::Action<Message>> {
        let key = (bounds, self.w, self.h, self.slant);
        if *state != Some(key) {
            *state = Some(key);
            return Some(iced::widget::Action::request_redraw());
        }
        None
    }
    fn draw(
        &self,
        _s: &Self::State,
        renderer: &iced::Renderer,
        _t: &Theme,
        bounds: Rectangle,
        _c: iced::mouse::Cursor,
    ) -> Vec<Geometry> {
        let mut frame = Frame::new(renderer, bounds.size());
        if std::env::var_os("MBS_TICK_DIAG").is_some() {
            use std::sync::{Mutex, OnceLock};
            static LAST: OnceLock<Mutex<Option<std::time::Instant>>> = OnceLock::new();
            let m = LAST.get_or_init(|| Mutex::new(None));
            let mut g = m.lock().unwrap();
            let now = std::time::Instant::now();
            if let Some(prev) = *g {
                let us = now.duration_since(prev).as_micros() as f64;
                eprintln!("[tick-diag] dt_ms={:.2}", us / 1000.0);
            }
            *g = Some(now);
        }

        // Use bounds, not self.w/self.h. When the parent clips the canvas
        // (e.g., a fixed-height container), bounds is smaller than self.h
        // and self.w. Drawing at self.w/self.h would overshoot the visible area.
        let bw = self.border_width;
        let half = bw / 2.0;
        let w = bounds.width;
        let h = bounds.height;
        // Scale slant so slope matches when the canvas is clipped shorter.
        let sl = self.slant * (h / self.h.max(1.0));
        // Keep the bottom border + fill safely inside the visible canvas.
        let border_inset = bw.max(4.0);

        // Fill path — bottom at h - border_inset, not self.h.
        let path = if self.slant_right {
            Path::new(|b| {
                b.move_to(Point::new(sl + half, half));
                b.line_to(Point::new(w - half, half));
                b.line_to(Point::new(w - sl - half, h - border_inset));
                b.line_to(Point::new(half, h - border_inset));
                b.close();
            })
        } else {
            Path::new(|b| {
                b.move_to(Point::new(half, half));
                b.line_to(Point::new(w - sl - half, half));
                b.line_to(Point::new(w - half, h - border_inset));
                b.line_to(Point::new(sl + half, h - border_inset));
                b.close();
            })
        };
        if self.background.a > 0.0 {
            frame.fill(&path, self.background);
        }

        if bw > 0.0 && self.border_color.a > 0.0 {
            // Parallelogram corner x-coords:
            //   slant_right=true  (\ \): top-left=sl+half, top-right=w-half, bot-left=half, bot-right=w-sl-half
            //   slant_right=false (/ /): top-left=half, top-right=w-sl-half, bot-left=sl+half, bot-right=w-half
            let (top_left_x, top_right_x, bot_left_x, bot_right_x) = if self.slant_right {
                (sl + half, w - half, half, w - sl - half)
            } else {
                (half, w - sl - half, sl + half, w - half)
            };

            // Top border — spans the parallelogram's top edge exactly
            let top_w = (top_right_x - top_left_x).max(1.0);
            frame.fill_rectangle(
                Point::new(top_left_x, half),
                Size::new(top_w, bw),
                self.border_color,
            );

            // Bottom border — spans the parallelogram's bottom edge exactly
            let bot_w = (bot_right_x - bot_left_x).max(1.0);
            frame.fill_rectangle(
                Point::new(bot_left_x, h - border_inset - bw),
                Size::new(bot_w, bw),
                self.border_color,
            );

            // Diagonal sides — stroked, connecting the corners above
            let stroke = Stroke::default()
                .with_color(self.border_color)
                .with_width(bw);
            if self.slant_right {
                let left_edge = Path::new(|b| {
                    b.move_to(Point::new(sl + half, half));
                    b.line_to(Point::new(half, h - border_inset));
                });
                let right_edge = Path::new(|b| {
                    b.move_to(Point::new(w - half, half));
                    b.line_to(Point::new(w - sl - half, h - border_inset));
                });
                frame.stroke(&left_edge, stroke);
                frame.stroke(&right_edge, stroke);
            } else {
                let left_edge = Path::new(|b| {
                    b.move_to(Point::new(half, half));
                    b.line_to(Point::new(sl + half, h - border_inset));
                });
                let right_edge = Path::new(|b| {
                    b.move_to(Point::new(w - sl - half, half));
                    b.line_to(Point::new(w - half, h - border_inset));
                });
                frame.stroke(&left_edge, stroke);
                frame.stroke(&right_edge, stroke);
            }
        }
        vec![frame.into_geometry()]
    }
}

pub fn clip_content<'a, Message: 'a>(
    content: Element<'a, Message>,
    anim_w: f32,
    anim_h: f32,
    align: iced::alignment::Horizontal,
) -> Element<'a, Message> {
    iced::widget::container(content)
        .width(Length::Fixed(anim_w))
        .height(Length::Fixed(anim_h))
        .align_x(align)
        .align_y(iced::alignment::Vertical::Top)
        .clip(true)
        .into()
}

pub fn align_to_side<'a, Message: 'a>(
    el: Element<'a, Message>,
    align: iced::alignment::Horizontal,
) -> Element<'a, Message> {
    iced::widget::container(el)
        .width(Length::Fill)
        .height(Length::Fill)
        .align_x(align)
        .align_y(iced::alignment::Vertical::Top)
        .into()
}

/// Detect the focused monitor's refresh rate in Hz.
///
/// Reads `swaymsg -t get_outputs -r` once and caches the result via
/// `OnceLock`. Falls back to 60Hz if detection fails. Override via
/// `MBS_REFRESH_HZ` env var if the compositor isn't sway or detection
/// misreads the current mode.
///
/// Used to size the animation tick interval. At 144Hz we want ~5ms
/// ticks (200fps source) to exceed display refresh with margin, not the
/// 16ms (60fps) that's appropriate on a 60Hz panel.
pub fn detect_refresh_hz() -> u32 {
    use std::sync::OnceLock;
    static CACHED: OnceLock<u32> = OnceLock::new();
    *CACHED.get_or_init(|| {
        if let Ok(v) = std::env::var("MBS_REFRESH_HZ") {
            if let Ok(hz) = v.parse::<u32>() {
                if (30..=480).contains(&hz) {
                    eprintln!("[refresh-detect] MBS_REFRESH_HZ override = {}Hz", hz);
                    return hz;
                }
            }
        }
        if let Ok(out) = std::process::Command::new("swaymsg")
            .args(["-t", "get_outputs", "-r"])
            .output()
        {
            if out.status.success() {
                if let Ok(v) = serde_json::from_slice::<serde_json::Value>(&out.stdout) {
                    if let Some(arr) = v.as_array() {
                        for o in arr {
                            if o.get("focused").and_then(|f| f.as_bool()) == Some(true) {
                                if let Some(hz) = o
                                    .get("current_mode")
                                    .and_then(|m| m.get("refresh"))
                                    .and_then(|r| r.as_u64())
                                {
                                    let hz = ((hz as f64) / 1000.0).round() as u32;
                                    if (30..=480).contains(&hz) {
                                        eprintln!("[refresh-detect] focused monitor = {}Hz", hz);
                                        return hz;
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        for o in arr {
                            if let Some(hz) = o
                                .get("current_mode")
                                .and_then(|m| m.get("refresh"))
                                .and_then(|r| r.as_u64())
                            {
                                let hz = ((hz as f64) / 1000.0).round() as u32;
                                if (30..=480).contains(&hz) {
                                    eprintln!("[refresh-detect] first monitor = {}Hz", hz);
                                    return hz;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        eprintln!("[refresh-detect] fallback = 60Hz");
        60
    })
}

// ── OctagonBg: same animation cadence as ParallelogramBg but with 8
// equal corner cuts (diamond-cornered rectangle). Used by the clock
// tooltip — it's the keystone bar module and deserves a distinct shape.

pub struct OctagonBg {
    pub w: f32,
    pub h: f32,
    pub cut: f32,
    pub background: Color,
    pub border_color: Color,
    pub border_width: f32,
    pub frame: u64,
}

impl OctagonBg {
    pub fn view<Message: 'static>(self) -> Element<'static, Message> {
        let w = self.w;
        let h = self.h;
        let inner = OctagonCanvas {
            w: self.w,
            h: self.h,
            cut: self.cut,
            background: self.background,
            border_color: self.border_color,
            border_width: self.border_width,
        };
        let canvas_el: Element<'static, Message> = canvas::Canvas::new(inner)
            .width(Length::Fixed(w))
            .height(Length::Fixed(h))
            .into();
        let marker_w = (self.frame % 2) as f32;
        let marker_el: Element<'static, Message> = iced::widget::Space::new()
            .width(Length::Fixed(marker_w))
            .height(Length::Fixed(0.0))
            .into();
        iced::widget::Stack::new()
            .push(canvas_el)
            .push(marker_el)
            .into()
    }
}

pub struct OctagonCanvas {
    pub w: f32,
    pub h: f32,
    pub cut: f32,
    pub background: Color,
    pub border_color: Color,
    pub border_width: f32,
}

impl<Message> canvas::Program<Message> for OctagonCanvas {
    // (bounds, w, h, cut) — same redraw-on-change pattern as TooltipBg.
    type State = Option<(Rectangle, f32, f32, f32)>;

    fn update(
        &self,
        state: &mut Self::State,
        _event: &iced::Event,
        bounds: Rectangle,
        _cursor: iced::mouse::Cursor,
    ) -> Option<iced::widget::Action<Message>> {
        let key = (bounds, self.w, self.h, self.cut);
        if *state != Some(key) {
            *state = Some(key);
            return Some(iced::widget::Action::request_redraw());
        }
        None
    }

    fn draw(
        &self,
        _s: &Self::State,
        renderer: &iced::Renderer,
        _t: &Theme,
        bounds: Rectangle,
        _c: iced::mouse::Cursor,
    ) -> Vec<Geometry> {
        let mut frame = Frame::new(renderer, bounds.size());
        let w = bounds.width;
        let h = bounds.height;
        let half = self.border_width / 2.0;

        if w <= 2.0 * half || h <= 2.0 * half {
            return vec![frame.into_geometry()];
        }

        // Clamp the cut so the two corner cuts never overlap the opposite
        // sides. 0.35/0.45 matches ShapeBox::Hexagon's own clamps.
        let cut = self.cut.min(w * 0.35).min(h * 0.45);

        let path = Path::new(|b| {
            b.move_to(Point::new(cut + half, half));
            b.line_to(Point::new(w - cut - half, half));
            b.line_to(Point::new(w - half, cut + half));
            b.line_to(Point::new(w - half, h - cut - half));
            b.line_to(Point::new(w - cut - half, h - half));
            b.line_to(Point::new(cut + half, h - half));
            b.line_to(Point::new(half, h - cut - half));
            b.line_to(Point::new(half, cut + half));
            b.close();
        });

        if self.background.a > 0.0 {
            frame.fill(&path, self.background);
        }
        if self.border_width > 0.0 && self.border_color.a > 0.0 {
            frame.stroke(
                &path,
                Stroke::default()
                    .with_color(self.border_color)
                    .with_width(self.border_width),
            );
        }

        vec![frame.into_geometry()]
    }
}

    }
}

use iced::widget::{button, column, container, text, text_input, Stack};
use iced::{Alignment, Element, Length};
use tokio::process::Command;

use crate::libraries::config::theme::ShellTheme;
use crate::libraries::style::shape_box::{ShapeBox, ShapeType};
use crate::libraries::style::TextExt;

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum WebSearchMessage {
    InputChanged(String),
    ExecuteSearch,
    Dismiss,
}

pub struct WebSearchOverlay {
    pub query: String,
}

impl Default for WebSearchOverlay {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

impl WebSearchOverlay {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            query: String::new(),
        }
    }

    pub fn update(&mut self, message: WebSearchMessage) {
        if let WebSearchMessage::InputChanged(q) = message {
            self.query = q;
        }
    }

    pub fn build_url(raw: &str) -> Option<String> {
        let q = raw.trim();
        if q.is_empty() {
            return None;
        }

        let (base, clean_q) = if let Some(stripped) = q.strip_prefix("!g ") {
            ("https://www.google.com/search?q=", stripped)
        } else if let Some(stripped) = q.strip_prefix("!d ").or_else(|| q.strip_prefix("!ddg ")) {
            ("https://duckduckgo.com/?q=", stripped)
        } else if let Some(stripped) = q.strip_prefix("!w ").or_else(|| q.strip_prefix("!wiki ")) {
            (
                "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:Search?search=",
                stripped,
            )
        } else if let Some(stripped) = q.strip_prefix("!gh ") {
            ("https://github.com/search?q=", stripped)
        } else if let Some(stripped) = q.strip_prefix("!nix ") {
            (
                "https://search.nixos.org/packages?channel=unstable&query=",
                stripped,
            )
        } else {
            ("https://www.startpage.com/sp/search?query=", q)
        };

        // RFC 3986 percent-encoding over UTF-8 bytes. The previous version
        // used `c as u32` (Unicode code point) which:
        //   (a) emitted the wrong byte sequence for any non-ASCII input
        //       (é U+00E9 -> "%E9", should be "%C3%A9"); and
        //   (b) emitted 3+ hex digits for code points >= U+0100, producing
        //       malformed escapes like "%100" that parsers split as
        //       "%10" + "0".
        // Iterating bytes fixes both, matching curl --data-urlencode.
        let encoded: String = clean_q
            .bytes()
            .map(|b| match b {
                b' ' => "+".into(),
                b'a'..=b'z' | b'A'..=b'Z' | b'0'..=b'9' | b'-' | b'_' | b'.' | b'~' => {
                    (b as char).to_string()
                }
                _ => format!("%{:02X}", b),
            })
            .collect();

        Some(format!("{}{}", base, encoded))
    }

    pub async fn launch_browser(url: &str) {
        let _ = Command::new("xdg-open").arg(url).spawn();
    }

    pub fn view<'a>(&'a self, theme: &ShellTheme) -> Element<'a, WebSearchMessage> {
        let input = text_input("Type search query [!g, !d, !w, !nix, !gh]...", &self.query)
            .on_input(WebSearchMessage::InputChanged)
            .on_submit(WebSearchMessage::ExecuteSearch)
            .padding(14)
            .size((theme.font_size_overlay) as f32);

        let card_bg = ShapeBox::new()
            .shape(ShapeType::Rounded(12))
            .background(theme.background)
            .border(theme.border, theme.border_width);

        let search_label = if self.query.trim().is_empty() {
            "Search with Startpage".to_string()
        } else {
            format!("Search for \"{}\"", self.query.trim())
        };

        let card_content = container(
            column![
                text("🌐 WEB SEARCH")
                    .size((theme.font_size_overlay) as f32)
                    .color(theme.text)
                    .align_x(Alignment::Center),
                input,
                button(
                    text(search_label)
                        .size((theme.font_size_normal) as f32)
                        .color(theme.text)
                        .bold()
                        .align_x(Alignment::Center),
                )
                .on_press(WebSearchMessage::ExecuteSearch)
                .padding(12)
                .width(Length::Fill)
                .style(|_t, _s| button::Style {
                    background: None,
                    ..Default::default()
                }),
                text("Press [Enter] to open browser  •  ESC to dismiss")
                    .size(11)
                    .color(theme.muted)
                    .align_x(Alignment::Center),
            ]
            .spacing(16)
            .padding(24),
        )
        .width(Length::Fixed(740.0))
        .height(Length::Fixed(300.0));

        let card = Stack::new().push(card_bg.view()).push(card_content);

        container(card)
            .center_x(Length::Fill)
            .center_y(Length::Fill)
            .into()
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::WebSearchOverlay;

    fn encode(query: &str) -> String {
        WebSearchOverlay::build_url(query).expect("non-empty query")
    }

    #[test]
    fn ascii_space_becomes_plus() {
        assert!(encode("hello world").ends_with("hello+world"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn unreserved_ascii_passes_through() {
        assert!(encode("abcXYZ019-_.~").ends_with("abcXYZ019-_.~"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn reserved_ascii_is_percent_encoded() {
        // & = ? # / must be encoded or they break out of the query param.
        let out = encode("a&b=c?d#e/f");
        assert!(out.ends_with("a%26b%3Dc%3Fd%23e%2Ff"), "got {out}");
    }

    #[test]
    fn latin1_non_ascii_uses_utf8_bytes() {
        // é = U+00E9, UTF-8 = C3 A9. Regression: old code emitted %E9.
        let out = encode("café");
        assert!(out.ends_with("caf%C3%A9"), "got {out}");
        assert!(!out.contains("%E9"), "old broken encoding: {out}");
    }

    #[test]
    fn cjk_uses_utf8_bytes() {
        // 日 = U+65E5 (E6 97 A5); 本 = U+672C (E6 9C AC).
        let out = encode("日本");
        assert!(out.ends_with("%E6%97%A5%E6%9C%AC"), "got {out}");
    }

    #[test]
    fn emoji_uses_utf8_bytes() {
        // 🦀 = U+1F980, UTF-8 = F0 9F A6 80. Old code emitted %1F980.
        let out = encode("🦀");
        assert!(out.ends_with("%F0%9F%A6%80"), "got {out}");
    }

    #[test]
    fn no_oversized_hex_escapes() {
        // Ā = U+0100, UTF-8 = C4 80. Old code emitted %100 (malformed).
        let out = encode("Ā");
        assert!(out.ends_with("%C4%80"), "got {out}");
        let bytes = out.as_bytes();
        let mut i = 0;
        while i < bytes.len() {
            if bytes[i] == b'%' {
                assert!(i + 2 < bytes.len(), "truncated escape at {i} in {out}");
                assert!(
                    bytes[i + 1].is_ascii_hexdigit() && bytes[i + 2].is_ascii_hexdigit(),
                    "bad escape at {i} in {out}"
                );
                i += 3;
            } else {
                i += 1;
            }
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn prefix_stripping_still_works() {
        assert!(encode("!g rust").starts_with("https://www.google.com/search?q="));
        assert!(encode("!ddg rust").starts_with("https://duckduckgo.com/?q="));
        assert!(encode("!w rust").contains("wikipedia.org"));
        assert!(encode("!gh rust").starts_with("https://github.com/search?q="));
        assert!(encode("!nix rust").contains("search.nixos.org"));
        assert!(encode("rust").starts_with("https://www.startpage.com/sp/search?query="));
    }

    #[test]
    fn empty_query_returns_none() {
        assert!(WebSearchOverlay::build_url("").is_none());
        assert!(WebSearchOverlay::build_url("   ").is_none());
    }
}

use super::launcher::AppEntry;
use super::*;
use crate::overlays::calc::CalculatorOverlay;

impl AppLauncher {
    pub(super) fn parse_number_unit(query: &str) -> Option<(f64, String)> {
        let q = query.trim();
        // Find longest prefix that parses as f64
        let mut best_end = 0;
        for i in 1..=q.len() {
            if q[..i].parse::<f64>().is_ok() {
                best_end = i;
            }
        }
        if best_end == 0 {
            return None;
        }
        let num: f64 = q[..best_end].parse().ok()?;
        let rest = q[best_end..].trim();
        if rest.is_empty() {
            return None;
        }
        if rest.contains(char::is_whitespace) {
            return None;
        }
        Some((num, rest.to_lowercase()))
    }

    pub(super) fn fmt_num(v: f64) -> String {
        if v.fract().abs() < 0.001 {
            format!("{:.0}", v)
        } else {
            let s = format!("{:.4}", v);
            s.trim_end_matches('0').trim_end_matches('.').to_string()
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn convert_temp(value: f64, from: char) -> Vec<(String, String)> {
        let from_label = match from {
            'C' => "°C",
            'F' => "°F",
            'K' => "K",
            'R' => "°R",
            _ => "?",
        };
        let celsius = match from {
            'C' => value,
            'F' => (value - 32.0) * 5.0 / 9.0,
            'K' => value - 273.15,
            'R' => (value - 491.67) * 5.0 / 9.0,
            _ => value,
        };
        let units = [('C', "°C"), ('F', "°F"), ('K', "K"), ('R', "°R")];
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        for (u, label) in units {
            if u == from {
                continue;
            }
            let converted = match u {
                'C' => celsius,
                'F' => celsius * 9.0 / 5.0 + 32.0,
                'K' => celsius + 273.15,
                'R' => (celsius + 273.15) * 9.0 / 5.0,
                _ => celsius,
            };
            let result = format!("{} {}", Self::fmt_num(converted), label);
            let display = format!("{} {} = {}", Self::fmt_num(value), from_label, result);
            out.push((display, format!("math:{}", result)));
        }
        out
    }

    pub(super) fn convert_linear(
        value: f64,
        unit: &str,
        units: &[(&str, &str, f64)],
    ) -> Option<Vec<(String, String)>> {
        let (_, from_label, from_factor) = units
            .iter()
            .find(|(k, _, _)| k.eq_ignore_ascii_case(unit))?;
        let base = value * from_factor;
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        for (key, label, factor) in units {
            if key.eq_ignore_ascii_case(unit) {
                continue;
            }
            let converted = base / factor;
            let result = format!("{} {}", Self::fmt_num(converted), label);
            let display = format!("{} {} = {}", Self::fmt_num(value), from_label, result);
            out.push((display, format!("math:{}", result)));
        }
        Some(out)
    }

    pub(super) fn convert_currency(value: f64, code: &str) -> Option<Vec<(String, String)>> {
        let rates = Self::get_rates();
        let upper = code.to_uppercase();
        let from_rate = *rates.get(&upper)?;
        let usd = value / from_rate;
        let mut keys: Vec<_> = rates.keys().cloned().collect();
        keys.sort();
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        for to_code in keys {
            if to_code == upper {
                continue;
            }
            let to_rate = rates.get(&to_code)?;
            let converted = usd * to_rate;
            let result = format!("{:.2} {}", converted, to_code);
            let display = format!("{:.2} {} = {}", value, upper, result);
            out.push((display, format!("math:{}", result)));
        }
        Some(out)
    }

    /// Hardcoded fallback rates (USD base). Approximate as of 2025; users
    /// who need accurate rates can wire up an API later via a settings hook.
    pub(super) fn get_rates() -> &'static std::collections::HashMap<String, f64> {
        static RATES: std::sync::OnceLock<std::collections::HashMap<String, f64>> =
            std::sync::OnceLock::new();
        RATES.get_or_init(|| {
            let mut m = std::collections::HashMap::new();
            m.insert("USD".to_string(), 1.00);
            m.insert("EUR".to_string(), 0.92);
            m.insert("GBP".to_string(), 0.79);
            m.insert("JPY".to_string(), 150.2);
            m.insert("CAD".to_string(), 1.37);
            m.insert("AUD".to_string(), 1.52);
            m.insert("CHF".to_string(), 0.88);
            m.insert("CNY".to_string(), 7.24);
            m.insert("INR".to_string(), 83.3);
            m.insert("KRW".to_string(), 1330.0);
            m.insert("MXN".to_string(), 17.1);
            m.insert("BRL".to_string(), 4.97);
            m.insert("ZAR".to_string(), 18.9);
            m.insert("SEK".to_string(), 10.4);
            m.insert("NOK".to_string(), 10.6);
            m.insert("NZD".to_string(), 1.64);
            m.insert("SGD".to_string(), 1.34);
            m.insert("HKD".to_string(), 7.82);
            m.insert("TRY".to_string(), 30.1);
            m.insert("RUB".to_string(), 92.0);
            m
        })
    }

    pub(super) fn try_convert(num: f64, unit: &str) -> Option<Vec<(String, String)>> {
        // Temperature
        match unit {
            "f" | "fahrenheit" => return Some(Self::convert_temp(num, 'F')),
            "c" | "celsius" => return Some(Self::convert_temp(num, 'C')),
            "k" | "kelvin" => return Some(Self::convert_temp(num, 'K')),
            "r" | "rankine" => return Some(Self::convert_temp(num, 'R')),
            _ => {}
        }
        // Distance
        const DISTANCE: &[(&str, &str, f64)] = &[
            ("mm", "mm", 0.001),
            ("cm", "cm", 0.01),
            ("m", "m", 1.0),
            ("km", "km", 1000.0),
            ("in", "in", 0.0254),
            ("ft", "ft", 0.3048),
            ("yd", "yd", 0.9144),
            ("mi", "mi", 1609.344),
            ("nmi", "nmi", 1852.0),
        ];
        if let Some(r) = Self::convert_linear(num, unit, DISTANCE) {
            return Some(r);
        }
        // Weight
        const WEIGHT: &[(&str, &str, f64)] = &[
            ("mg", "mg", 0.000001),
            ("g", "g", 0.001),
            ("kg", "kg", 1.0),
            ("t", "t", 1000.0),
            ("oz", "oz", 0.0283495),
            ("lb", "lb", 0.453592),
            ("st", "st", 6.35029),
        ];
        if let Some(r) = Self::convert_linear(num, unit, WEIGHT) {
            return Some(r);
        }
        // Volume
        const VOLUME: &[(&str, &str, f64)] = &[
            ("ml", "mL", 0.001),
            ("l", "L", 1.0),
            ("cup", "cups", 0.236588),
            ("pt", "pt", 0.473176),
            ("qt", "qt", 0.946353),
            ("gal", "gal", 3.78541),
            ("floz", "fl oz", 0.0295735),
        ];
        if let Some(r) = Self::convert_linear(num, unit, VOLUME) {
            return Some(r);
        }
        // Data
        const DATA: &[(&str, &str, f64)] = &[
            ("b", "B", 1.0),
            ("kb", "KB", 1024.0),
            ("mb", "MB", 1048576.0),
            ("gb", "GB", 1073741824.0),
            ("tb", "TB", 1099511627776.0),
        ];
        if let Some(r) = Self::convert_linear(num, unit, DATA) {
            return Some(r);
        }
        // Time
        const TIME: &[(&str, &str, f64)] = &[
            ("s", "s", 1.0),
            ("min", "min", 60.0),
            ("h", "h", 3600.0),
            ("d", "d", 86400.0),
            ("w", "wk", 604800.0),
            ("y", "yr", 31536000.0),
        ];
        if let Some(r) = Self::convert_linear(num, unit, TIME) {
            return Some(r);
        }
        // Speed
        const SPEED: &[(&str, &str, f64)] = &[
            ("ms", "m/s", 1.0),
            ("kmh", "km/h", 0.277778),
            ("mph", "mph", 0.44704),
            ("kn", "kn", 0.514444),
        ];
        if let Some(r) = Self::convert_linear(num, unit, SPEED) {
            return Some(r);
        }
        // Currency
        if let Some(r) = Self::convert_currency(num, unit) {
            return Some(r);
        }
        None
    }

    pub(super) fn compute_dict_entries(&self, query: &str) -> Option<Vec<AppEntry>> {
        let q = query.trim_start();
        let lower = q.to_lowercase();

        let word_part = if let Some(rest) = lower.strip_prefix("def ") {
            rest
        } else if let Some(rest) = lower.strip_prefix("define ") {
            rest
        } else if let Some(rest) = lower.strip_prefix("dict ") {
            rest
        } else if let Some(rest) = lower.strip_prefix("dictionary ") {
            rest
        } else if lower == "def" || lower == "define" || lower == "dict" || lower == "dictionary" {
            // Show hint
            return Some(vec![AppEntry {
                name: "Dictionary — type a word after 'def '".to_string(),
                exec: "dict:__hint__".to_string(),
                icon: ">".to_string(),
                icon_path: None,
            }]);
        } else {
            return None;
        };

        let word = word_part.split_whitespace().next().unwrap_or("");
        if word.len() < 2 {
            return Some(vec![AppEntry {
                name: "Dictionary — type a word after 'def '".to_string(),
                exec: "dict:__hint__".to_string(),
                icon: ">".to_string(),
                icon_path: None,
            }]);
        }

        if let Some(defs) = self.dict_cache.get(word) {
            return Some(
                defs.iter()
                    .map(|d| {
                        let truncated = if d.definition.chars().count() > 80 {
                            let mut s: String = d.definition.chars().take(77).collect();
                            s.push_str("...");
                            s
                        } else {
                            d.definition.clone()
                        };
                        AppEntry {
                            name: format!("[{}] {}", d.part_of_speech, truncated),
                            exec: format!("dict:{}", d.definition),
                            icon: ">".to_string(),
                            icon_path: None,
                        }
                    })
                    .collect(),
            );
        }

        // Not cached — show pending placeholder
        Some(vec![AppEntry {
            name: format!("Looking up '{}'...", word),
            exec: "dict:__pending__".to_string(),
            icon: ">".to_string(),
            icon_path: None,
        }])
    }

    pub(super) fn dict_word_to_lookup(&self, query: &str) -> Option<String> {
        let q = query.trim_start();
        let lower = q.to_lowercase();
        let word_part = lower
            .strip_prefix("def ")
            .or_else(|| lower.strip_prefix("define "))
            .or_else(|| lower.strip_prefix("dict "))
            .or_else(|| lower.strip_prefix("dictionary "))?;
        let word = word_part.split_whitespace().next().unwrap_or("");
        if word.len() < 2 {
            return None;
        }
        if self.dict_cache.contains_key(word) {
            return None;
        }
        if self.dict_pending.as_deref() == Some(word) {
            return None;
        }
        Some(word.to_string())
    }

    /// Cached pass-store entries — reads the filesystem once per launcher session.
    pub(super) fn get_pass_keys() -> &'static Vec<String> {
        static CACHE: std::sync::OnceLock<Vec<String>> = std::sync::OnceLock::new();
        CACHE.get_or_init(PassOverlay::scan_passwords)
    }

    /// If the query starts with a pass-prefix keyword (`pass`, `passw`, `password`,
    /// `pw`, `passwd`, `cred`, `creds`), return all matching entries.
    /// Query `pass git` → entries containing "git".
    /// Query `pass` alone → all entries (capped at 30).
    pub(super) fn compute_pass_entries(query: &str) -> Option<Vec<(String, String)>> {
        let q = query.trim().to_lowercase();
        let filter_term: &str = if matches!(
            q.as_str(),
            "pass"
                | "passw"
                | "password"
                | "pw"
                | "passwd"
                | "cred"
                | "creds"
                | "credential"
                | "credentials"
                | "secret"
                | "secrets"
        ) {
            ""
        } else if let Some(rest) = q.strip_prefix("pass ") {
            rest.trim()
        } else if let Some(rest) = q.strip_prefix("passw ") {
            rest.trim()
        } else if let Some(rest) = q.strip_prefix("password ") {
            rest.trim()
        } else if let Some(rest) = q.strip_prefix("pw ") {
            rest.trim()
        } else if let Some(rest) = q.strip_prefix("passwd ") {
            rest.trim()
        } else if let Some(rest) = q.strip_prefix("cred ") {
            rest.trim()
        } else if let Some(rest) = q.strip_prefix("creds ") {
            rest.trim()
        } else if let Some(rest) = q.strip_prefix("credential ") {
            rest.trim()
        } else if let Some(rest) = q.strip_prefix("credentials ") {
            rest.trim()
        } else if let Some(rest) = q.strip_prefix("secret ") {
            rest.trim()
        } else {
            let rest = q.strip_prefix("secrets ")?;
            rest.trim()
        };

        let keys = Self::get_pass_keys();
        let results: Vec<(String, String)> = keys
            .iter()
            .filter(|k| filter_term.is_empty() || k.to_lowercase().contains(filter_term))
            .take(30)
            .map(|k| (k.clone(), format!("pass:{}", k)))
            .collect();

        Some(results)
    }

    /// The new multi-result entry point.
    /// - "32f"  → 3 temp conversions
    /// - "10usd"→ 19 currency conversions
    /// - "10+10"→ 1 math result
    /// - "10"   → nothing (no operator, no unit)
    pub(super) fn compute_multi_conversions(query: &str) -> Vec<(String, String)> {
        // 1. Try number+unit syntax first
        if let Some((num, unit)) = Self::parse_number_unit(query) {
            if let Some(results) = Self::try_convert(num, &unit) {
                if !results.is_empty() {
                    return results;
                }
            }
        }
        // 2. Fall back to single math expression
        let q = query.trim();
        if q.is_empty() {
            return vec![];
        }
        let has_operator = q.contains('+')
            || q.contains('-')
            || q.contains('*')
            || q.contains('/')
            || q.contains('(');
        let has_unit_phrase = q.contains(" in ") || q.contains(" to ");
        if !has_operator && !has_unit_phrase {
            return vec![];
        }
        let result = CalculatorOverlay::evaluate(q);
        if result.is_empty() || result == "Syntax Error" {
            return vec![];
        }
        vec![(format!("= {}", result), format!("math:{}", result))]
    }
}

use super::*;

pub(super) fn make_slanted_button(
    label: String,
    msg: Message,
    bg: Color,
    fg: Color,
    border: Color,
    slant: f32,
    fs: u16,
) -> Element<'static, Message> {
    let btn_bg = ShapeBox::new()
        .shape(ShapeType::Slant {
            left: SlantSide::Left,
            right: SlantSide::Left,
        })
        .background(bg)
        .border(border, 1.0)
        .slant_width(slant)
        .size(Length::Fill, Length::Fill);
    Stack::new()
        .push(btn_bg.view())
        .push(
            button(
                container(text(label).size((fs) as f32).bold().color(fg))
                    .width(Length::Fill)
                    .height(Length::Fill)
                    .center_x(Length::Fill)
                    .center_y(Length::Fill),
            )
            .on_press(msg)
            .padding(0)
            .style(|_t, _s| button::Style {
                background: None,
                border: iced::Border::default(),
                ..Default::default()
            }),
        )
        .into()
}

use super::*;
use iced::widget::column;
use crate::overlays::tooltip_common::octagon_row;

impl App {
    pub(super) fn render_clock<'a>(
        &'a self,
        cols: &'a Vec<crate::libraries::backend::WorldZoneColumn>,
        mut col: iced::widget::Column<'a, Message>,
        y_ref: &mut f32,
        t: &ShellTheme,
        settings: &ShellSettings,
        total_h: f32,
        safe: f32,
        w_f: f32,
        alpha: f32,
    ) -> iced::widget::Column<'a, Message> {
        let mut y = *y_ref;
        let a = move |color: Color| Color { a: color.a * alpha, ..color };
        let text_col = a(t.text);
        let muted = a(t.muted);
        let fs = settings.tooltip_font_size;
        let gap = 8.0_f32;
        let mk_close = || -> Element<'a, Message> {
            iced::widget::container(iced::widget::Space::new())
                .width(Length::Fixed(0.0))
                .height(Length::Fixed(0.0))
                .into()
        };
        let success = a(t.success);

        let header_h = fs as f32 + 16.0;
        let header = row![
            text("WORLD CLOCK")
                .size((fs.max(14)) as f32)
                .bold()
                .color(text_col),
            iced::widget::space::horizontal(),
            mk_close(),
        ]
        .align_y(Alignment::Center)
        .width(Length::Fill);
        let cut_f = (w_f.min(total_h) * 0.15).max(0.0);
        col = col.push(octagon_row(
            header.into(),
            y + header_h * 0.5,
            total_h,
            cut_f,
            safe,
            w_f,
            header_h,
        ));
        y += header_h + gap;

        let mut grid_row = row![].spacing(12).width(Length::Fill);
        for c in cols {
            let mut col_widget = column![].spacing(6).width(Length::FillPortion(1));
            col_widget = col_widget.push(
                text(c.title)
                    .size((fs - 1) as f32)
                    .bold()
                    .color(muted)
                    .width(Length::Fill)
                    .align_x(Alignment::Center),
            );
            for (name, code, time, is_me) in &c.zones {
                let t_color = if *is_me { success } else { text_col };
                let is_me_val = *is_me;
                let bg = if is_me_val {
                    Some(iced::Background::Color(a(t.surface_alt)))
                } else {
                    None
                };
                let border_c = if is_me_val {
                    success
                } else {
                    Color::TRANSPARENT
                };

                let item = container(
                    row![
                        column![
                            text(*name)
                                .size((fs - 2) as f32)
                                .bold()
                                .color(t_color)
                                .wrapping(iced::widget::text::Wrapping::None),
                            text(*code)
                                .size((fs - 3) as f32)
                                .color(muted)
                                .wrapping(iced::widget::text::Wrapping::None),
                        ]
                        .spacing(2)
                        .width(Length::Fill),
                        text(time)
                            .size((fs + 1) as f32)
                            .bold()
                            .color(t_color)
                            .wrapping(iced::widget::text::Wrapping::None),
                    ]
                    .align_y(Alignment::Center),
                )
                .padding([4, 8])
                .width(Length::Fill)
                .style(move |_t| container::Style {
                    background: bg,
                    border: iced::Border {
                        color: border_c,
                        width: if is_me_val { 1.0 } else { 0.0 },
                        radius: 4.0.into(),
                    },
                    ..Default::default()
                });
                col_widget = col_widget.push(item);
            }
            grid_row = grid_row.push(col_widget);
        }

        let grid_h = 5.0 * 48.0;
        col = col.push(octagon_row(
            grid_row.into(),
            y + grid_h * 0.5,
            total_h,
            cut_f,
            safe,
            w_f,
            grid_h,
        ));
        *y_ref = y;
        col
    }
}

                    a(t.text),
                    4.0,
                    fs - 3,
                );

                let row_el = row![
                    text(dot).size((fs) as f32).color(dot_color),
                    text(&c.name)
                        .size((fs - 1) as f32)
                        .color(text_col)
                        .width(Length::Fill),
                    text(&c.status).size((fs - 3) as f32).color(muted),
                    container(restart_btn)
                        .width(Length::Fixed(28.0))
                        .height(Length::Fixed(row_h - 2.0)),
                ]
                .spacing(8)
                .align_y(Alignment::Center)
                .width(Length::Fill);

                col = col.push(slanted_row(
                    row_el.into(),
                    y + row_h * 0.5,
                    total_h,
                    slant_h,
                    slant_right,
                    safe,
                    w_f,
                    row_h,
                ));
                y += row_h + gap;
            }
        }

        // Custom items
        if !custom_items.is_empty() {
            let title_h = fs as f32 + 4.0;
            let title_el: Element<'_, Message> = text("Custom Items")
                .size((fs - 2) as f32)
                .bold()
                .color(muted)
                .into();
            col = col.push(slanted_row(
                title_el,
                y + title_h * 0.5,
                total_h,
                slant_h,
                slant_right,
                safe,
                w_f,
                title_h,
            ));
            y += title_h + gap;

            for (idx, item) in custom_items.iter().enumerate() {
                let row_h = fs as f32 + 12.0;
                let dot = if item.is_ok { "●" } else { "○" };
                let dot_color = if item.is_ok { success } else { danger };

                let action_el: Element<'_, Message> = if item.has_toggle {
                    make_slanted_button(
                        "↻".into(),
                        Message::UnifiedToggle(idx),
                        a(t.background),
                        a(t.text),
                        a(t.text),
                        4.0,
                        fs - 3,
                    )
                } else {
                    container(text("")).width(Length::Fixed(28.0)).into()
                };

                let msg_str = if item.message.is_empty() {
                    String::new()
                } else {
                    let truncated: String = item.message.chars().take(18).collect();
                    format!(" ({})", truncated)
                };

                let row_el = row![
                    text(dot).size((fs) as f32).color(dot_color),
                    text(&item.name)
                        .size((fs - 1) as f32)
                        .color(text_col)
                        .width(Length::Fill),
                    text(msg_str).size((fs - 3) as f32).color(muted),
                    container(action_el)
                        .width(Length::Fixed(28.0))
                        .height(Length::Fixed(row_h - 2.0)),
                ]
                .spacing(8)
                .align_y(Alignment::Center)
                .width(Length::Fill);

                col = col.push(slanted_row(
                    row_el.into(),
                    y + row_h * 0.5,
                    total_h,
                    slant_h,
                    slant_right,
                    safe,
                    w_f,
                    row_h,
                ));
                y += row_h + gap;
            }
        }

        if podman.containers.is_empty() && custom_items.is_empty() {
            let msg_h = fs as f32 + 8.0;
            let msg: Element<'_, Message> =
                text("(no containers or custom items — add via Settings)")
                    .size((fs - 2) as f32)
                    .color(muted)
                    .into();
            col = col.push(slanted_row(
                msg,
                y + msg_h * 0.5,
                total_h,
                slant_h,
                slant_right,
                safe,
                w_f,
                msg_h,
            ));
            y += msg_h + gap;
        }

        // Borg — three states: Failed (red) > Running (yellow) > Normal (green)
        let title_h = fs as f32 + 4.0;
        let title_el: Element<'_, Message> = text("Borg")
            .size((fs - 2) as f32)
            .bold()
            .color(muted)
            .into();
        col = col.push(slanted_row(
            title_el,
            y + title_h * 0.5,
            total_h,
            slant_h,
            slant_right,
            safe,
            w_f,
            title_h,
        ));
        y += title_h + gap;

        let borg_h = fs as f32 + 12.0;
        let (borg_dot_color, borg_label) = if borg.is_failed {
            let msg = borg
                .details
                .first()
                .cloned()
                .unwrap_or_else(|| "Failed".to_string());
            (danger, msg)
        } else if borg.is_active {
            let status = if borg.percent > 0 {
                format!("Running ({}%)", borg.percent)
            } else {
                "Running".to_string()
            };
            (warning, status)
        } else if borg.is_mounted {
            (success, "Mounted".to_string())
        } else {
            (success, "Idle (Synced)".to_string())
        };

        let borg_el = row![
            text("●").size((fs) as f32).color(borg_dot_color),
            text(borg_label)
                .size((fs - 1) as f32)
                .color(text_col)
                .width(Length::Fill),
        ]
        .spacing(8)
        .align_y(Alignment::Center)
        .width(Length::Fill)
        .into();
        col = col.push(slanted_row(
            borg_el,
            y + borg_h * 0.5,
            total_h,
            slant_h,
            slant_right,
            safe,
            w_f,
            borg_h,
        ));
        *y_ref = y;
        col
    }
}

use super::*;

impl App {
    pub(super) fn render_custom<'a>(

use super::*;
use super::net_proc::render_net_proc_row;
use iced::widget::column;

impl App {
    pub(super) fn render_net<'a>(
        &'a self,
        net: &'a crate::libraries::backend::NetMetrics,
        mut col: iced::widget::Column<'a, Message>,
        y_ref: &mut f32,
        t: &ShellTheme,
        settings: &ShellSettings,
        total_h: f32,
        slant_h: f32,
        slant_right: bool,
        safe: f32,
        w_f: f32,
        alpha: f32,
        tooltip_slope: f32,
    ) -> iced::widget::Column<'a, Message> {
        let mut y = *y_ref;
        let a = move |color: Color| Color { a: color.a * alpha, ..color };
        let text_col = a(t.text);
        let muted = a(t.muted);
        let fs = settings.tooltip_font_size;
        let gap = 8.0_f32;
        let mk_close = || -> Element<'a, Message> {
            iced::widget::container(iced::widget::Space::new())
                .width(Length::Fixed(0.0))
                .height(Length::Fixed(0.0))
                .into()
        };
        let success = a(t.success);

        let header = row![
            text("NETWORK").size((fs) as f32).bold().color(text_col),
            iced::widget::space::horizontal(),
            mk_close(),
        ]
        .align_y(Alignment::Center)
        .width(Length::Fill);
        col = col.push(slanted_row(
            header.into(),
            y + 16.0,
            total_h,
            slant_h,
            slant_right,
            safe,
            w_f,
            32.0,
        ));
        y += 32.0 + gap;

        let stats_h = fs as f32 + 8.0;
        let stats_el = row![
            text(if net.iface.is_empty() {
                "—"
            } else {
                &net.iface
            })
            .size((fs) as f32)
            .color(text_col),
            text(" ▼ ")
                .size((fs.saturating_sub(2)) as f32)
                .color(success),
            text(&net.down_str).size((fs) as f32).bold().color(text_col),
            text(" ▲ ")
                .size((fs.saturating_sub(2)) as f32)
                .color(success),
            text(&net.up_str).size((fs) as f32).bold().color(text_col),
        ]
        .align_y(Alignment::Center)
        .width(Length::Fill)
        .into();
        col = col.push(slanted_row(
            stats_el,
            y + stats_h * 0.5,
            total_h,
            slant_h,
            slant_right,
            safe,
            w_f,
            stats_h,
        ));
        y += stats_h + gap;

        // Search Bar
        let (search_row, new_y) = crate::overlays::tooltip_common::slanted_search_bar(
            &self.search_query, Message::SearchChanged, t, settings.control_border_width,
            alpha, y, total_h, slant_h, slant_right, safe, w_f, fs, tooltip_slope, gap,
            self.opened.elapsed().as_millis() as u64,
        );
        col = col.push(search_row);
        y = new_y;

        // Process List
        let proc_h = fs as f32 + 10.0;
        let proc_gap = 2.0;
        let mut procs_col = column![].spacing(proc_gap).width(Length::Fill);
        let q = self.search_query.to_lowercase();
        let items: Vec<&ProcessItem> = net
            .top_procs
            .iter()
            .filter(|p| q.is_empty() || p.name.to_lowercase().contains(&q))
            .collect();
        for &p in items.iter().take(10) {
            let inner_w = w_f
                - (slant_h * (1.0 - (y + proc_h * 0.5) / total_h.max(1.0)) + safe)
                - (slant_h * ((y + proc_h * 0.5) / total_h.max(1.0)) + safe);
            let proc_row = render_net_proc_row(
                p,
                t,
                fs,
                alpha,
                inner_w,
                proc_h,
                slant_right,
                tooltip_slope,
            );
            procs_col = procs_col.push(slanted_row(
                proc_row,
                y + proc_h * 0.5,
                total_h,
                slant_h,
                slant_right,
                safe,
                w_f,
                proc_h,
            ));
            y += proc_h + proc_gap;
        }
        if !items.is_empty() {
            col = col.push(procs_col);
        } else {
            let empty_el: Element<'a, Message> = container(
                text(if net.top_procs.is_empty() {
                    "(no active network procs)"
                } else {
                    "(no match)"
                })
                .size((fs.saturating_sub(4).max(9)) as f32)
                .color(muted)
                .wrapping(iced::widget::text::Wrapping::None),
            )
            .into();
            col = col.push(slanted_row(
                empty_el,
                y + 10.0,
                total_h,
                slant_h,
                slant_right,
                safe,
                w_f,
                20.0,
            ));
        }
        *y_ref = y;
        col
    }
}

use super::*;

pub(super) fn render_net_proc_row<'a>(
    p: &'a ProcessItem,
    t: &ShellTheme,
    font_size: u16,
    alpha: f32,
    row_w: f32,
    row_h: f32,
    slant_right: bool,
    tooltip_slope: f32,
) -> Element<'a, Message> {
    crate::overlays::tooltip_common::proc_kill_row(
        crate::overlays::tooltip_common::truncate_proc_name(&p.name),
        p.metric.clone(),
        180.0,
        Message::KillProcess(p.pid),
        t, font_size, alpha, row_w, row_h, slant_right, tooltip_slope,
    )
}

impl App {

        &'a self,
        track_opt: &'a Option<MprisTrack>,
        mut col: iced::widget::Column<'a, Message>,
        y_ref: &mut f32,
        t: &ShellTheme,
        settings: &ShellSettings,
        total_h: f32,
        slant_h: f32,
        slant_right: bool,
        safe: f32,
        w_f: f32,
        alpha: f32,
    ) -> iced::widget::Column<'a, Message> {
        let mut y = *y_ref;
        let a = move |color: Color| Color { a: color.a * alpha, ..color };
        let text_col = a(t.text);
        let _muted = a(t.muted);
        let fs = settings.tooltip_font_size;
        let gap = 8.0_f32;
        let danger = a(t.danger);

        // Extra horizontal padding so widgets don't clip against the diagonal edges
        let safe = safe + 20.0;

                tr.album.clone(),

                tr.position_sec,
                tr.length_sec,
                tr.url.clone(),
                tr.volume_pct,

            None => (
                "No Track".into(),
                "No Artist".into(),
                "".into(),
                false,
                0.0,
                0.0,
                None,
                100,
            ),
        };

        let pos_str = format!("{}:{:02}", (pos as u32) / 60, (pos as u32) % 60);
        let len_str = format!("{}:{:02}", (len as u32) / 60, (len as u32) % 60);

        let header_h = fs as f32 + 16.0;

        ]

        col = col.push(slanted_row(

                placeholder: text_col_l,
                value: text_col_l,
                selection: text_col_l,
            });

        col = col.push(slanted_row(
            search_input.into(),
            y + search_h * 0.5,
            total_h,
            slant_h,
            slant_right,
            safe,
            w_f,
            search_h,
        ));
        y += search_h + gap;

        if !self.music_search_results.is_empty() {
            let mut results_col = column![].spacing(2);
            for (i, (title, url)) in self.music_search_results.iter().enumerate() {
                let url_clone = url.clone();
                let is_sel = i == self.music_selected_idx;
                let bg = if is_sel { text_col_l } else { bg_col_l };
                let fg = if is_sel { bg_col_l } else { text_col_l };

                let btn = button(text(title).size((fs - 3) as f32).color(fg))
                    .on_press(Message::MusicPlaySong(url_clone))
                    .padding(4)
                    .width(Length::Fill)
                    .style(move |_t, _s| button::Style {
                        background: Some(iced::Background::Color(bg)),
                        border: iced::Border {
                            color: text_col_l,
                            width: 1.0,
                            radius: 4.0.into(),
                        },
                        ..Default::default()
                    });
                results_col = results_col.push(btn);
            }
            let scroll_results = scrollable(results_col)
                .id(iced::widget::Id::new("music_scroll"))
                .height(Length::Fixed(100.0));

            col = col.push(slanted_row(
                scroll_results.into(),
                y + 50.0,
                total_h,
                slant_h,
                slant_right,
                safe,
                w_f,
                100.0,
            ));
            y += 100.0 + gap;
        }

        // Sources row
        let src_h = 36.0;
        let src_btn = |label: &'static str, idx: usize| -> Element<'_, Message> {
            let active = match idx {
                0 => self.music_sources.local,
                1 => self.music_sources.spotify,
                2 => self.music_sources.browser,
                _ => false,
            };
            let bg = if active { a(t.text) } else { a(t.background) };
            let fg = if active { a(t.background) } else { a(t.text) };
            let border = a(t.text);
            button(
                container(text(label).size((fs - 1) as f32).bold().color(fg))
                    .center_y(Length::Fill),
            )
            .on_press(Message::MusicToggleSource(idx))
            .padding([0, 16])
            .height(Length::Fill)
            .style(move |_t, _s| button::Style {
                background: Some(iced::Background::Color(bg)),
                border: iced::Border {
                    color: border,
                    width: 1.0,
                    radius: 4.0.into(),
                },
                text_color: fg,
                ..Default::default()
            })
            .into()
        };

        let src_row = row![
            text("Sources:")
                .size((fs - 1) as f32)
                .bold()
                .color(text_col),
            iced::widget::space::horizontal(),
            src_btn("Local", 0),
            src_btn("Spotify", 1),
            src_btn("Browser", 2),
        ]
        .align_y(Alignment::Center)
        .width(Length::Fill);
        col = col.push(slanted_row(
            src_row.into(),
            y + src_h * 0.5,
            total_h,
            slant_h,
            slant_right,
            safe,
            w_f,
            src_h,
        ));
        *y_ref = y;
        col
    }
}

mod buttons;
mod calendar;
mod music;
mod unified;
mod net;
mod clock;
