mod net_proc;
use buttons::*;

use iced::widget::{button, column, container, row, scrollable, text, text_input, Stack};
use iced::{Alignment, Color, Element, Length, Padding, Task};
use std::time::Instant;

use crate::libraries::backend::unified::{borg::{BorgBackend, BorgStatus}, podman::{PodmanBackend, PodmanStatus}, checks::UnifiedItemStatus};
use crate::libraries::backend::system::ProcessItem;
use crate::libraries::backend::{ClockBackend, MprisTrack, SystemCollector};
use crate::libraries::config::theme::ShellTheme;
use crate::libraries::config::ShellSettings;
use crate::libraries::style::shape_box::{ShapeBox, ShapeType, SlantSide};
use crate::libraries::style::TextExt;

use crate::overlays::tooltip_common::{slanted_row, InBarTooltipConfig};

const AUTO_MS: u128 = 15_000;

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum InfoData {
    Calendar(crate::libraries::backend::CalendarViewData),
    Music(Option<MprisTrack>),
    Unified(
        PodmanStatus,
        BorgStatus,
        Vec<UnifiedItemStatus>,
    ),
    Net(crate::libraries::backend::NetMetrics),
    Clock(Vec<crate::libraries::backend::WorldZoneColumn>),
    Custom,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum Message {
    Tick,
    Loaded(InfoData),
    Dismiss,
    MusicPrev,
    MusicNext,
    MusicPlayPause,
    CyclePlayer,
    MusicSeek(f64),
    MusicSetVolume(u8),
    MusicOpenFolder(Option<String>),
    MusicTrashConfirm,
    MusicTrashExecute(Option<String>),
    MusicSearchChanged(String),
    MusicSearchSubmit,
    MusicSearchResults(Vec<(String, String)>),
    MusicPlaySong(String),
    MusicSelectNext,
    MusicSelectPrev,
    MusicPlaySelected,
    MusicToggleSource(usize),
    PodmanRestart(String),
    UnifiedToggle(usize),
    SearchChanged(String),
    KillProcess(u32),
    Noop,
}

pub struct App {
    opened: Instant,
    mode: String,
    data: Option<InfoData>,
    grow_right: bool,
    w: u32,
    h: u32,
    drop_ms: f32,
    expand_ms: f32,
    w_start: f32,
    slant_l: SlantSide,
    #[allow(dead_code)]
    slant_r: SlantSide,
    closing_at: Option<crate::overlays::tooltip_engine::ClosingState>,
    search_query: String,
    trash_confirm: bool,
    anim_frame: u64,
    settings: ShellSettings,
    theme: ShellTheme,
    music_search_query: String,
    music_search_results: Vec<(String, String)>,
    music_selected_idx: usize,
    music_sources: crate::libraries::backend::music::MusicSources,
    pub should_close: bool,
}

impl App {
    pub fn new_in_bar(cfg: &InBarTooltipConfig) -> (Self, Task<Message>) {
        let mode = cfg.id.clone();
        let settings = ShellSettings::load();
        let theme = ShellTheme::from_settings(&settings);
        let app = Self {
            opened: Instant::now(),
            mode: mode.clone(),
            data: None,
            grow_right: cfg.grow_right,
            w: cfg.w,
            w_start: cfg.cap_w,
            slant_l: cfg.slant_l,
            slant_r: cfg.slant_r,
            h: cfg.h,
            drop_ms: cfg.drop_ms,
            expand_ms: cfg.expand_ms,
            closing_at: None,
            search_query: String::new(),
            trash_confirm: false,
            anim_frame: 0,
            settings,
            theme,
            music_search_query: String::new(),
            music_search_results: Vec::new(),
            music_selected_idx: 0,
            music_sources: crate::libraries::backend::music::MusicSources::load(),
            should_close: false,
        };
        let task = Task::perform(fetch_data(mode), Message::Loaded);
        (
            app,
            Task::batch(vec![
                task,
                Task::perform(
                    async { tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(4)).await },
                    |_| Message::Tick,
                ),
            ]),
        )
    }

    fn snapshot_for_close(&self) -> crate::overlays::tooltip_engine::ClosingState {
        let cur = crate::overlays::tooltip_engine::compute(
            self.opened.elapsed().as_millis() as f32,
            self.w_start,
            self.w as f32,
            self.h as f32,
            if self.mode == "clock" { 0.0 } else { self.theme.slant_width },
            self.settings.bar_height.max(1) as f32,
            self.drop_ms,
            self.expand_ms,
        );
        crate::overlays::tooltip_engine::ClosingState {
            started: Instant::now(),
            from_w: cur.w,
            from_h: cur.h,
            from_opacity: cur.opacity,
        }
    }

    pub fn is_music_search_nav(&self) -> bool {
        self.mode == "music" && !self.music_search_results.is_empty()
    }

    pub fn update(&mut self, m: Message) -> Task<Message> {
        match m {
            Message::Tick => {
                self.anim_frame = self.anim_frame.wrapping_add(1);

                let mut tasks = Vec::new();

                // Keep the tooltip live if it's the music player (~1 sec)
                // ONLY do this if we aren't currently closing!
                if self.mode == "music" && self.anim_frame % 250 == 0 && self.closing_at.is_none() {
                    tasks.push(Task::perform(fetch_data("music".to_string()), Message::Loaded));
                }

                let elapsed_ms = self.opened.elapsed().as_millis() as u64;
                if std::env::var_os("MBS_TICK_DIAG").is_some() {
                    eprintln!("[tick] frame={} elapsed={}ms", self.anim_frame, elapsed_ms);
                }

                if let Some(t) = &self.closing_at {
                    if t.started.elapsed().as_millis() > (self.drop_ms * 3.0) as u128 {
                        self.should_close = true;
                        return Task::none();
                    }
                } else if self.opened.elapsed().as_millis() > AUTO_MS {
                    self.should_close = true;
                    return Task::none();
                }

                let next_ms: u64 = if elapsed_ms < 2000 || self.closing_at.is_some() {
                    std::env::var("MBS_TICK_MS")
                        .ok()
                        .and_then(|s| s.parse().ok())
                        .filter(|n| *n >= 1 && *n <= 100)
                        .unwrap_or(4)
                } else {
                    100
                };

                tasks.push(Task::perform(
                    async move { tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(next_ms)).await },
                    |_| Message::Tick,
                ));

                return Task::batch(tasks);
            }
            Message::SearchChanged(q) => {
                self.search_query = q;
            }
            Message::KillProcess(pid) => {
                let target = self.mode.clone();
                return Task::batch([
                    Task::perform(SystemCollector::kill_process(pid), |_| Message::Noop),
                    Task::perform(
                        async move {
                            tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(250)).await;
                            match target.as_str() {
                                "net" => {
                                    let mut sc = SystemCollector::new();
                                    let _ = sc.update_net();
                                    tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(500)).await;
                                    InfoData::Net(sc.update_net())
                                }
                                _ => InfoData::Custom,
                            }
                        },
                        Message::Loaded,
                    ),
                ]);
            }
            Message::Noop => {}
            Message::Loaded(d) => {
                self.data = Some(d);
            }
            Message::Dismiss => {
                if self.closing_at.is_none() {
                    let snap = self.snapshot_for_close();
                    self.closing_at = Some(snap);
                }
            }
            Message::MusicPrev => {
                return Task::perform(
                    async {
                        if let Ok(exe) = std::env::current_exe() {
                            let _ = tokio::process::Command::new(exe)
                                .arg("--music-previous")
                                .status()
                                .await;
                        }
                        tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(300)).await;
                        fetch_data("music".to_string()).await
                    },
                    Message::Loaded,
                );
            }
            Message::MusicNext => {
                return Task::perform(
                    async {
                        if let Ok(exe) = std::env::current_exe() {
                            let _ = tokio::process::Command::new(exe)
                                .arg("--music-next")
                                .status()
                                .await;
                        }
                        tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(300)).await;
                        fetch_data("music".to_string()).await
                    },
                    Message::Loaded,
                );
            }
            Message::MusicPlayPause => {
                return Task::perform(
                    async {
                        if let Ok(exe) = std::env::current_exe() {
                            let _ = tokio::process::Command::new(exe)
                                .arg("--music-play-pause")
                                .status()
                                .await;
                        }
                        tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(300)).await;
                        fetch_data("music".to_string()).await
                    },
                    Message::Loaded,
                );
            }
            Message::CyclePlayer => {
                // Cycle to next player (or pause current), then re-fetch
                // so the tooltip shows the new state. 500ms gives the
                // bar time to complete the async cycle.
                return Task::perform(
                    async {
                        if let Ok(exe) = std::env::current_exe() {
                            let _ = tokio::process::Command::new(exe)
                                .arg("--music-cycle")
                                .status()
                                .await;
                        }
                        tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(500)).await;
                        fetch_data("music".to_string()).await
                    },
                    Message::Loaded,
                );
            }
            Message::MusicSeek(secs) => {
                return Task::perform(
                    async move {
                        let _ = crate::libraries::backend::MprisBackend::set_position(secs).await;
                        let _ = crate::libraries::backend::LocalMusicBackend::seek(secs).await;
                        tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(250)).await;
                        crate::libraries::backend::MprisBackend::clear_cache();
                        crate::libraries::backend::LocalMusicBackend::clear_cache();
                        fetch_data("music".to_string()).await
                    },
                    Message::Loaded,
                );
            }
            Message::MusicSetVolume(vol) => {
                return Task::perform(
                    async move {
                        let _ = crate::libraries::backend::MprisBackend::set_volume(vol).await;
                        let _ = crate::libraries::backend::LocalMusicBackend::set_volume(vol).await;
                        tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(250)).await;
                        crate::libraries::backend::MprisBackend::clear_cache();
                        crate::libraries::backend::LocalMusicBackend::clear_cache();
                        fetch_data("music".to_string()).await
                    },
                    Message::Loaded,
                );
            }
            Message::MusicOpenFolder(url) => {
                return Task::perform(
                    async move {
                        crate::libraries::backend::MprisBackend::open_track_folder(url.as_deref())
                            .await;
                    },
                    |_| Message::Noop,
                );
            }
            Message::PodmanRestart(cname) => {
                return Task::perform(
                    async move {
                        crate::libraries::backend::unified::podman::PodmanBackend::restart(&cname).await;
                    },
                    |_| Message::Dismiss,
                );
            }
            Message::UnifiedToggle(idx) => {
                let s = ShellSettings::load();
                if let Some(item) = s.unified_items.get(idx).cloned() {
                    let mode = self.mode.clone();
                    return Task::perform(
                        async move {
                            if let Err(e) = crate::libraries::backend::unified::checks::toggle_item(&item).await {
                                eprintln!("[unified] toggle '{}' failed: {}", item.name, e);
                            }
                            tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(500)).await;
                            fetch_data(mode).await
                        },
                        Message::Loaded,
                    );
                }
            }
            Message::MusicToggleSource(idx) => {
                match idx {
                    0 => self.music_sources.local = !self.music_sources.local,
                    1 => self.music_sources.spotify = !self.music_sources.spotify,
                    2 => self.music_sources.browser = !self.music_sources.browser,
                    _ => {}
                }
                self.music_sources.save();
            }
            Message::MusicSearchChanged(q) => {
                self.music_search_query = q.clone();
                self.music_selected_idx = 0;
                if q.is_empty() {
                    self.music_search_results.clear();
                    return Task::none();
                }
                return Task::perform(
                    async move { crate::libraries::backend::LocalMusicBackend::search_songs(&q).await },
                    Message::MusicSearchResults,
                );
            }
            Message::MusicSearchSubmit => {
                return Task::done(Message::MusicPlaySelected);
            }
            Message::MusicSearchResults(res) => {
                self.music_search_results = res;
                self.music_selected_idx = 0;
            }
            Message::MusicSelectNext => {
                if !self.music_search_results.is_empty() {
                    self.music_selected_idx =
                        (self.music_selected_idx + 1).min(self.music_search_results.len() - 1);
                    return iced::widget::operation::scroll_to(
                        iced::widget::Id::new("music_scroll"),
                        iced::widget::scrollable::AbsoluteOffset {
                            x: 0.0,
                            y: (self.music_selected_idx as f32 * 32.0 - 60.0).max(0.0),
                        },
                    )
                    .map(|_: ()| Message::Tick);
                }
            }
            Message::MusicSelectPrev => {
                if !self.music_search_results.is_empty() {
                    self.music_selected_idx = self.music_selected_idx.saturating_sub(1);
                    return iced::widget::operation::scroll_to(
                        iced::widget::Id::new("music_scroll"),
                        iced::widget::scrollable::AbsoluteOffset {
                            x: 0.0,
                            y: (self.music_selected_idx as f32 * 24.0 - 40.0).max(0.0),
                        },
                    )
                    .map(|_: ()| Message::Tick);
                }
            }
            Message::MusicPlaySelected => {
                if self
                    .music_search_results
                    .get(self.music_selected_idx)
                    .is_some()
                {
                    let urls: Vec<String> = self
                        .music_search_results
                        .iter()
                        .map(|(_, u)| u.clone())
                        .collect();
                    let idx = self.music_selected_idx;
                    return Task::perform(
                        async move {
                            crate::libraries::backend::LocalMusicBackend::play_queue(&urls, idx).await;
                            tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(100)).await;
                            fetch_data("music".to_string()).await
                        },
                        |info| Message::Loaded(info),
                    );
                }
            }
            Message::MusicPlaySong(url) => {
                if let Some(idx) = self
                    .music_search_results
                    .iter()
                    .position(|(_, u)| u == &url)
                {
                    let urls: Vec<String> = self
                        .music_search_results
                        .iter()
                        .map(|(_, u)| u.clone())
                        .collect();
                    return Task::perform(
                        async move {
                            crate::libraries::backend::LocalMusicBackend::play_queue(&urls, idx).await;
                            tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(100)).await;
                            fetch_data("music".to_string()).await
                        },
                        |info| Message::Loaded(info),
                    );
                }
            }
            Message::MusicTrashConfirm => {
                self.trash_confirm = true;
            }
            Message::MusicTrashExecute(url) => {
                self.trash_confirm = false;
                return Task::perform(
                    async move {
                        crate::libraries::backend::MprisBackend::trash_current_track(
                            url.as_deref(),
                        )
                        .await;
                    },
                    |_| Message::Noop,
                );
            }
        }
        Task::none()
    }

    pub fn view(&self) -> Element<'_, Message> {
        let settings = &self.settings;
        let theme = &self.theme;
        let effective_h = self.h as f32;

        let is_clock = self.mode == "clock";
        // For the keystone (clock) we pass slant_base=0. The octagon draw path
        // doesn't use `slant` at all — it uses `cut`. Passing 0 forces
        // compute() to lock width at the capsule's width during the drop phase,
        // then expand symmetrically during the expand phase (instead of growing
        // width by slant-coupling during drop like the parallelogram does).
        let slant_base = if is_clock { 0.0 } else { theme.slant_width };

        let anim = if let Some(t) = &self.closing_at {
            crate::overlays::tooltip_engine::compute_close_from(
                t.started.elapsed().as_millis() as f32,
                t.from_w,
                t.from_h,
                t.from_opacity,
                self.w_start,
                self.w as f32,
                slant_base,
                settings.bar_height as f32,
                self.drop_ms,
            )
        } else {
            crate::overlays::tooltip_engine::compute(
                self.opened.elapsed().as_millis() as f32,
                self.w_start,
                self.w as f32,
                effective_h,
                slant_base,
                settings.bar_height as f32,
                self.drop_ms,
                self.expand_ms,
            )
        };

        // Clock gets an octagon; every other info tooltip gets the parallelogram.
        let bg_view: Element<'_, Message> = if is_clock {
            let oct = crate::overlays::tooltip_engine::OctagonBg {
                w: anim.w,
                h: anim.h,
                cut: anim.cut,
                background: theme.background,
                border_color: theme.text,
                border_width: theme.control_border_width,
                frame: self.opened.elapsed().as_millis() as u64,
            };
            oct.view()
        } else {
            let slant_h = theme.slant_width * (anim.h / settings.bar_height.max(1) as f32);
            let para = crate::overlays::tooltip_engine::ParallelogramBg {
                w: anim.w,
                h: anim.h,
                slant: slant_h,
                slant_right: self.slant_l == SlantSide::Right,
                background: theme.background,
                border_color: theme.text,
                border_width: theme.control_border_width,
                frame: self.opened.elapsed().as_millis() as u64,
            };
            para.view()
        };

        // Clock: content and outer box both centered. Other modes preserve
        // the existing left/right grow behavior.
        let align = if is_clock {
            iced::alignment::Horizontal::Center
        } else if self.grow_right {
            iced::alignment::Horizontal::Left
        } else {
            iced::alignment::Horizontal::Right
        };
        let content: Element<'_, Message> =
            self.build_content(theme, settings, anim.opacity, effective_h);
        let clipped = crate::overlays::tooltip_engine::clip_content(content, anim.w, anim.h, align);
        let stacked = iced::widget::container(Stack::new().push(bg_view).push(clipped))
            .width(Length::Fixed(anim.w))
            .height(Length::Fixed(anim.h))
            .clip(true);
        crate::overlays::tooltip_engine::align_to_side(stacked.into(), align)
    }

    fn build_content<'a>(
        &'a self,
        t: &ShellTheme,
        settings: &ShellSettings,
        alpha: f32,
        total_h: f32,
    ) -> Element<'a, Message> {
        let a = move |c: Color| Color {
            a: c.a * alpha,
            ..c
        };
        let muted = a(t.muted);
        let half_tt = settings.control_border_width * 0.5;

        let fs = settings.tooltip_font_size;
        let bar_h = settings.bar_height.max(1) as f32;
        let slant_h = t.slant_width * (total_h / bar_h);
        let slant_right = self.slant_l == SlantSide::Right;
        let tooltip_slope = slant_h / (total_h - 2.0 * half_tt);
        let safe = 16.0;
        let vpad = 14.0;
        let gap = 8.0;
        let w_f = self.w as f32;

        let mut y = vpad;
        let mut col = column![].spacing(gap).width(Length::Fill);

        let mk_close = || -> Element<'a, Message> {
            iced::widget::container(iced::widget::Space::new())
                .width(Length::Fixed(0.0))
                .height(Length::Fixed(0.0))
                .into()
        };

        if let Some(d) = &self.data {
            match d {
                InfoData::Calendar(c) => {
                    col = self.render_calendar(c, col, &mut y, t, settings, total_h, slant_h, slant_right, safe, w_f, alpha);
                }
                InfoData::Music(track_opt) => {
                    col = self.render_music(track_opt, col, &mut y, t, settings, total_h, slant_h, slant_right, safe, w_f, alpha);
                }
                InfoData::Unified(podman, borg, custom_items) => {
                    col = self.render_unified(podman, borg, custom_items, col, &mut y, t, settings, total_h, slant_h, slant_right, safe, w_f, alpha);
                }
                InfoData::Net(net) => {
                    col = self.render_net(net, col, &mut y, t, settings, total_h, slant_h, slant_right, safe, w_f, alpha, tooltip_slope);
                }
                InfoData::Clock(cols) => {
                    col = self.render_clock(cols, col, &mut y, t, settings, total_h, safe, w_f, alpha);
                }
                InfoData::Custom => {
                    col = self.render_custom(col, &mut y, t, settings, total_h, slant_h, slant_right, safe, w_f, alpha);
                }
            }
        } else {
            let header = row![
                text("LOADING...").size((fs) as f32).color(muted),
                iced::widget::space::horizontal(),
                mk_close(),
            ]
            .align_y(Alignment::Center)
            .width(Length::Fill);
            col = col.push(slanted_row(
                header.into(),
                y + 16.0,
                total_h,
                slant_h,
                slant_right,
                safe,
                w_f,
                32.0,
            ));
        }

        container(col)
            .padding(Padding {
                top: vpad,
                right: 0.0,
                bottom: vpad,
                left: 0.0,
            })
            .width(Length::Fixed(self.w as f32))
            .height(Length::Fixed(self.h as f32))
            .clip(true)
            .into()
    }
}

async fn fetch_data(mode: String) -> InfoData {
    match mode.as_str() {
        "calendar" => InfoData::Calendar(ClockBackend::compute_calendar(0, 0)),
        "music" => InfoData::Music(crate::libraries::backend::poll_track().await.0),
        "unified" => {
            let p = PodmanBackend::poll().await;
            let b = BorgBackend::poll().await;
            let s = ShellSettings::load();
            let items = crate::libraries::backend::unified::checks::check_unified_items(&s.unified_items).await;
            InfoData::Unified(p, b, items)
        }
        "net" => {
            let mut sc = SystemCollector::new();
            let _ = sc.update_net(); // Prime global rate
            let _ = sc.get_top_net_procs_bandwidth(); // Prime process bandwidth
            tokio::time::sleep(tokio::time::Duration::from_millis(1000)).await;
            let mut net = sc.update_net();
            net.top_procs = sc.get_top_net_procs_bandwidth(); // Calculate delta
            InfoData::Net(net)
        }
        "clock" => InfoData::Clock(ClockBackend::get_world_matrix()),
        _ => InfoData::Custom,
    }
}

use super::*;

impl App {
    pub(super) fn render_calendar<'a>(
        &'a self,
        c: &'a crate::libraries::backend::CalendarViewData,
        mut col: iced::widget::Column<'a, Message>,
        y_ref: &mut f32,
        t: &ShellTheme,
        settings: &ShellSettings,
        total_h: f32,
        slant_h: f32,
        slant_right: bool,
        safe: f32,
        w_f: f32,
        alpha: f32,
    ) -> iced::widget::Column<'a, Message> {
        let mut y = *y_ref;
        let a = move |color: Color| Color { a: color.a * alpha, ..color };
        let text_col = a(t.text);
        let muted = a(t.muted);
        let fs = settings.tooltip_font_size;
        let gap = 8.0_f32;

        let header_h = fs as f32 + 16.0;
        let header = row![
            text("CALENDAR")
                .size((fs.max(14)) as f32)
                .bold()
                .color(text_col)
                .wrapping(iced::widget::text::Wrapping::None),
            iced::widget::space::horizontal(),
        ]
        .align_y(Alignment::Center)
        .width(Length::Fill);
        col = col.push(slanted_row(
            header.into(),
            y + header_h * 0.5,
            total_h,
            slant_h,
            slant_right,
            safe,
            w_f,
            header_h,
        ));
        y += header_h + gap;

        // Month Label
        let month_h = fs as f32 + 12.0;
        let month_el = row![text(&c.month_label)
            .size((fs + 2) as f32)
            .bold()
            .color(text_col)
            .width(Length::Fill)
            .align_x(Alignment::Center),]
        .width(Length::Fill)
        .into();
        col = col.push(slanted_row(
            month_el,
            y + month_h * 0.5,
            total_h,
            slant_h,
            slant_right,
            safe,
            w_f,
            month_h,
        ));
        y += month_h + gap;

        // Grid setup
        let cell_h = fs as f32 + 8.0;
        // Fixed width for each of the 7 days so they don't collapse
        let cell_w = (w_f - (slant_h * 2.0) - safe * 2.0) / 7.0;

        // Days of week
        let dow_h = fs as f32 + 4.0;
        let mut dow_row = row![].spacing(0);
        for day_name in ["S", "M", "T", "W", "T", "F", "S"] {
            dow_row = dow_row.push(
                container(text(day_name).size(fs as f32).color(muted))
                    .width(Length::Fixed(cell_w))
                    .align_x(Alignment::Center),
            );
        }
        col = col.push(slanted_row(
            dow_row.into(),
            y + dow_h * 0.5,
            total_h,
            slant_h,
            slant_right,
            safe,
            w_f,
            dow_h,
        ));
        y += dow_h + gap;

        let mut day = 1;
        for _row in 0..6 {
            let mut row_widgets = row![].spacing(0);
            for col_idx in 0..7 {
                if _row == 0 && col_idx < c.first_day_offset {
                    row_widgets = row_widgets
                        .push(container(text("")).width(Length::Fixed(cell_w)));
                } else if day <= c.days_in_month {
                    let is_today = day == c.today_day;
                    let color = if is_today { a(t.danger) } else { text_col };
                    let bg_col = if is_today {
                        Some(iced::Background::Color(a(t.surface_alt)))
                    } else {
                        None
                    };
                    let border_col = if is_today {
                        a(t.danger)
                    } else {
                        Color::TRANSPARENT
                    };

                    let cell = container(
                        text(format!("{:2}", day)).size(fs as f32).color(color),
                    )
                    .width(Length::Fixed(cell_w))
                    .height(Length::Fixed(cell_h))
                    .center_x(Length::Fill)
                    .center_y(Length::Fill)
                    .style(move |_t| {
                        container::Style {
                            background: bg_col,
                            border: iced::Border {
                                color: border_col,
                                width: if is_today { 1.5 } else { 0.0 },
                                radius: 4.0.into(),
                            },
                            ..Default::default()
                        }
                    });

                    row_widgets = row_widgets.push(cell);
                    day += 1;
                } else {
                    row_widgets = row_widgets
                        .push(container(text("")).width(Length::Fixed(cell_w)));
                }
            }
            col = col.push(slanted_row(
                row_widgets.into(),
                y + cell_h * 0.5,
                total_h,
                slant_h,
                slant_right,
                safe,
                w_f,
                cell_h,
            ));
            y += cell_h + 2.0;
            if day > c.days_in_month {
                break;
            }
        }
        *y_ref = y;
        col
    }
}

impl SettingsOverlay {
    pub(super) fn view_bar_layout<'a>(
        &'a self,

    ) -> Element<'a, SettingsMessage> {
        let base_sz = theme.font_size_overlay;
        let scale_sz = |factor: f32| -> u16 { ((base_sz as f32) * factor).round().max(9.0) as u16 };
        let all_capsules = [
            "calendar", "music", "alarm", "weather", "unified", "notify", "audio", "clock", "mic",
            "custom", "net", "cpu", "gpu", "ram", "battery", "tray",
        ];

        let mk_toggle = move |label: &'static str, active: bool, msg: SettingsMessage| {
            let bg = if active {
                theme.success
            } else {
                theme.background
            };
            let fg = if active { Color::BLACK } else { theme.text };
            let border = if active { theme.success } else { theme.text };
            button(text(label).size((scale_sz(0.7)) as f32).bold().color(fg))
                .on_press(msg)
                .padding([4, 10])
                .style(move |_t, _s| button::Style {
                    background: Some(iced::Background::Color(bg)),
                    border: iced::Border {
                        color: border,
                        width: 1.0,
                        radius: 4.0.into(),
                    },
                    ..Default::default()
                })
        };

        // ── Monitor picker ────────────────────────────────
        let monitors = ["All", "DP-1", "DP-2", "HDMI-A-1", "HDMI-A-2"];
        let mut mon_row: iced::widget::Row<'a, SettingsMessage> = iced::widget::Row::new()
            .spacing(8)
            .align_y(Alignment::Center)
            .push(
                text("Bar Monitor:")
                    .size((scale_sz(0.85)) as f32)
                    .bold()
                    .color(theme.text),
            );
        for m in monitors {
            let is_sel = settings.bar_monitor == m;
            let m_str = m.to_string();
            let btn = button(
                text(m)
                    .size((scale_sz(0.65)) as f32)
                    .bold()
                    .color(if is_sel { Color::BLACK } else { theme.text }),
            )
            .on_press(SettingsMessage::SelectBarMonitor(m_str))
            .padding([3, 10])
            .style(move |_t, _s| button::Style {
                background: Some(iced::Background::Color(if is_sel {
                    theme.text
                } else {
                    Color::TRANSPARENT
                })),
                border: iced::Border {
                    color: if is_sel { theme.text } else { theme.border },
                    width: 1.0,
                    radius: 4.0.into(),
                },
                ..Default::default()
            });
            mon_row = mon_row.push(btn);
        }

        let bg_bar_row: Element<'a, SettingsMessage> = row![
            text("Background Bar Shape:")
                .size((scale_sz(0.85)) as f32)
                .bold()
                .color(theme.text),
            mk_toggle(
                "SLANT",
                settings.bar_shape == "slant",
                SettingsMessage::SelectBarShape("slant".into())
            ),
            mk_toggle(
                "HEXAGON",
                settings.bar_shape == "hexagon",
                SettingsMessage::SelectBarShape("hexagon".into())
            ),
            mk_toggle(
                "ROUNDED",
                settings.bar_shape == "rounded",
                SettingsMessage::SelectBarShape("rounded".into())
            ),
            mk_toggle(
                "FLAT",
                settings.bar_shape == "flat",
                SettingsMessage::SelectBarShape("flat".into())
            ),
        ]
        .spacing(8)
        .align_y(Alignment::Center)
        .width(Length::Fill)
        .into();

        let module_slants_row: Element<'a, SettingsMessage> = row![
            text("Module Slants:")
                .size((scale_sz(0.85)) as f32)
                .bold()
                .color(theme.text),
            mk_toggle(
                "LEFT",
                settings.slant_mode == "left",
                SettingsMessage::SelectSlantMode("left".into())
            ),
            mk_toggle(
                "CENTER",
                settings.slant_mode == "center"
                    || settings.slant_mode == "symmetric"
                    || settings.slant_mode == "sym",
                SettingsMessage::SelectSlantMode("center".into())
            ),
            mk_toggle(
                "RIGHT",
                settings.slant_mode == "right",
                SettingsMessage::SelectSlantMode("right".into())
            ),
        ]
        .spacing(8)
        .align_y(Alignment::Center)
        .width(Length::Fill)
        .into();

        let module_shape_row: Element<'a, SettingsMessage> = row![
            text("Module Shape:")
                .size((scale_sz(0.85)) as f32)
                .bold()
                .color(theme.text),
            mk_toggle(
                "SLANT",
                settings.module_shape == "slant",
                SettingsMessage::SelectModuleShape("slant".into())
            ),
            mk_toggle(
                "HEXAGON",
                settings.module_shape == "hexagon",
                SettingsMessage::SelectModuleShape("hexagon".into())
            ),
            mk_toggle(
                "ROUNDED",
                settings.module_shape == "rounded",
                SettingsMessage::SelectModuleShape("rounded".into())
            ),
            mk_toggle(
                "FLAT",
                settings.module_shape == "flat",
                SettingsMessage::SelectModuleShape("flat".into())
            ),
        ]
        .spacing(8)
        .align_y(Alignment::Center)
        .width(Length::Fill)
        .into();

        let top_sliders: Element<'a, SettingsMessage> = column![
            row![
                column![
                    row![
                        text("Top Bar Height")
                            .size((scale_sz(0.8)) as f32)
                            .bold()
                            .color(theme.text),
                        row![].width(Length::Fill),
                        text(format!("{}px", settings.bar_height))
                            .size((scale_sz(0.8)) as f32)
                            .bold()
                            .color(theme.text)
                    ],
                    slider(28..=90, settings.bar_height, SettingsMessage::BarHeight)
                        .width(Length::Fill),
                ]
                .spacing(3)
                .width(Length::FillPortion(1)),
                column![
                    row![
                        text("Global Font Size")
                            .size((scale_sz(0.8)) as f32)
                            .bold()
                            .color(theme.text),
                        row![].width(Length::Fill),
                        text(format!("{}px", settings.global_font_size))
                            .size((scale_sz(0.8)) as f32)
                            .bold()
                            .color(theme.text)
                    ],
                    slider(
                        8..=32,
                        settings.global_font_size,
                        SettingsMessage::GlobalFontSize
                    )
                    .width(Length::Fill),
                ]
                .spacing(3)
                .width(Length::FillPortion(1)),
            ]
            .spacing(20)
            .width(Length::Fill),
            row![
                column![
                    row![
                        text("Capsule Spacing")
                            .size((scale_sz(0.8)) as f32)
                            .bold()
                            .color(theme.text),
                        row![].width(Length::Fill),
                        text(format!("{}px", settings.capsule_spacing))
                            .size((scale_sz(0.8)) as f32)
                            .bold()
                            .color(theme.text)
                    ],
                    slider(
                        -50..=40,
                        settings.capsule_spacing,
                        SettingsMessage::CapsuleSpacing
                    )
                    .width(Length::Fill),
                ]
                .spacing(3)
                .width(Length::FillPortion(1)),
                column![
                    row![
                        text("Capsule Slant Width")
                            .size((scale_sz(0.8)) as f32)
                            .bold()
                            .color(theme.text),
                        row![].width(Length::Fill),
                        text(format!("{}px", settings.slant_width as u32))
                            .size((scale_sz(0.8)) as f32)
                            .bold()
                            .color(theme.text)
                    ],
                    slider(
                        0..=40,
                        settings.slant_width as u32,
                        SettingsMessage::SlantWidth
                    )
                    .width(Length::Fill),
                ]
                .spacing(3)
                .width(Length::FillPortion(1)),
                column![
                    row![
                        text("Capsule Internal Padding")
                            .size((scale_sz(0.8)) as f32)
                            .bold()
                            .color(theme.text),
                        row![].width(Length::Fill),
                        text(format!("{}px", settings.capsule_internal_padding))
                            .size((scale_sz(0.8)) as f32)
                            .bold()
                            .color(theme.text)
                    ],
                    slider(
                        0..=60,
                        settings.capsule_internal_padding,
                        SettingsMessage::CapsuleInternalPadding
                    )
                    .width(Length::Fill),
                ]
                .spacing(3)
                .width(Length::FillPortion(1)),
            ]
            .spacing(20)
            .width(Length::Fill),
        ]
        .spacing(12)
        .width(Length::Fill)
        .into();

        // Per-slot offset columns: slider shows the effective value (auto or override),
        // marks "(auto)" when None, and the reset button clears the override.
        let offset_left_col: Element<'a, SettingsMessage> = {
            let is_auto = settings.tooltip_offset_left.is_none();
            let eff = settings.effective_tooltip_offset_left();
            column![
                row![
                    text("Tooltip Left Offset")
                        .size((scale_sz(0.8)) as f32)
                        .bold()
                        .color(theme.text),
                    row![].width(Length::Fill),
                    text(if is_auto {
                        format!("{}px (auto)", eff)
                    } else {
                        format!("{}px", eff)
                    })
                    .size((scale_sz(0.8)) as f32)
                    .bold()
                    .color(theme.text),
                    button(text(if is_auto { " " } else { "↺" }).size(11))
                        .on_press_maybe(if is_auto {
                            None
                        } else {
                            Some(SettingsMessage::TooltipOffsetLeftReset)
                        })
                        .padding([2, 6])
                        .style(move |_t, _s| button::Style {
                            background: if is_auto {
                                None
                            } else {
                                Some(iced::Background::Color(theme.surface_alt))
                            },
                            border: if is_auto {
                                iced::Border::default()
                            } else {
                                iced::Border {
                                    color: theme.warning,
                                    width: 1.0,
                                    radius: 3.0.into(),
                                }
                            },
                            text_color: if is_auto { theme.text } else { theme.warning },
                            ..Default::default()
                        }),
                ]
                .spacing(4)
                .align_y(Alignment::Center),
                slider(-50..=100, eff, SettingsMessage::TooltipOffsetLeft).width(Length::Fill),
            ]
            .spacing(3)
            .width(Length::FillPortion(1))
            .into()
        };
        let offset_right_col: Element<'a, SettingsMessage> = {
            let is_auto = settings.tooltip_offset_right.is_none();
            let eff = settings.effective_tooltip_offset_right();
            column![
                row![
                    text("Tooltip Right Offset")
                        .size((scale_sz(0.8)) as f32)
                        .bold()
                        .color(theme.text),
                    row![].width(Length::Fill),
                    text(if is_auto {
                        format!("{}px (auto)", eff)
                    } else {
                        format!("{}px", eff)
                    })
                    .size((scale_sz(0.8)) as f32)
                    .bold()
                    .color(theme.text),
                    button(text(if is_auto { " " } else { "↺" }).size(11))
                        .on_press_maybe(if is_auto {
                            None
                        } else {
                            Some(SettingsMessage::TooltipOffsetRightReset)
                        })
                        .padding([2, 6])
                        .style(move |_t, _s| button::Style {
                            background: if is_auto {
                                None
                            } else {
                                Some(iced::Background::Color(theme.surface_alt))
                            },
                            border: if is_auto {
                                iced::Border::default()
                            } else {
                                iced::Border {
                                    color: theme.warning,
                                    width: 1.0,
                                    radius: 3.0.into(),
                                }
                            },
                            text_color: if is_auto { theme.text } else { theme.warning },
                            ..Default::default()
                        }),
                ]
                .spacing(4)
                .align_y(Alignment::Center),
                slider(-50..=100, eff, SettingsMessage::TooltipOffsetRight).width(Length::Fill),
            ]
            .spacing(3)
            .width(Length::FillPortion(1))
            .into()
        };
        let anim_sliders: Element<'a, SettingsMessage> = column![
            row![
                column![
                    row![
                        text("Tooltip Drop Speed")
                            .size((scale_sz(0.8)) as f32)
                            .bold()
                            .color(theme.text),
                        row![].width(Length::Fill),
                        text(format!("{}ms", settings.tooltip_drop_ms))
                            .size((scale_sz(0.8)) as f32)
                            .bold()
                            .color(theme.text)
                    ],
                    slider(
                        5..=100,
                        (settings.tooltip_drop_ms / 10).clamp(5, 100),
                        |v: u32| SettingsMessage::TooltipDropMs(v * 10)
                    )
                    .width(Length::Fill),
                ]
                .spacing(3)
                .width(Length::FillPortion(1)),
                column![
                    row![
                        text("Tooltip Expand Speed")
                            .size((scale_sz(0.8)) as f32)
                            .bold()
                            .color(theme.text),
                        row![].width(Length::Fill),
                        text(format!("{}ms", settings.tooltip_expand_ms))
                            .size((scale_sz(0.8)) as f32)
                            .bold()
                            .color(theme.text)
                    ],
                    slider(
                        5..=100,
                        (settings.tooltip_expand_ms / 10).clamp(5, 100),
                        |v: u32| SettingsMessage::TooltipExpandMs(v * 10)
                    )
                    .width(Length::Fill),
                ]
                .spacing(3)
                .width(Length::FillPortion(1)),
            ]
            .spacing(20)
            .width(Length::Fill),
            row![
                column![
                    row![
                        text("Tooltip Pause Time")
                            .size((scale_sz(0.8)) as f32)
                            .bold()
                            .color(theme.text),
                        row![].width(Length::Fill),
                        text(format!("{}ms", settings.tooltip_pause_ms))
                            .size((scale_sz(0.8)) as f32)
                            .bold()
                            .color(theme.text)
                    ],
                    slider(
                        0..=100,
                        (settings.tooltip_pause_ms / 10).min(100),
                        |v: u32| SettingsMessage::TooltipPauseMs(v * 10)
                    )
                    .width(Length::Fill),
                ]
                .spacing(3)
                .width(Length::FillPortion(1)),
                column![
                    row![
                        text("Tooltip Text Size")
                            .size((scale_sz(0.8)) as f32)
                            .bold()
                            .color(theme.text),
                        row![].width(Length::Fill),
                        text(format!("{}px", settings.tooltip_font_size))
                            .size((scale_sz(0.8)) as f32)
                            .bold()
                            .color(theme.text)
                    ],
                    slider(
                        8..=28,
                        settings.tooltip_font_size,
                        SettingsMessage::TooltipFontSize
                    )
                    .width(Length::Fill),
                ]
                .spacing(3)
                .width(Length::FillPortion(1)),
                offset_left_col,
                offset_right_col,
            ]
            .spacing(20)
            .width(Length::Fill),
        ]
        .spacing(12)
        .width(Length::Fill)
        .into();

        let render_row = |id_str: &str, is_visible: bool| -> Element<'a, SettingsMessage> {
            let id = id_str.to_string();
            let (w_val, h_val) = settings.tooltip_size(id_str);
            let _id_w = id_str.to_string();
            let _id_h = id_str.to_string();
            let id_reset = id_str.to_string();
            let has_override = settings.tooltip_sizes.contains_key(id_str);

            let up = button(text("▲").size((scale_sz(0.6)) as f32).color(theme.text))
                .on_press(SettingsMessage::MoveCapsuleUp(id.clone()))
                .padding([2, 6])
                .style(move |_t, _s| button::Style {
                    background: None,
                    border: iced::Border::default(),
                    ..Default::default()
                });
            let down = button(text("▼").size((scale_sz(0.6)) as f32).color(theme.text))
                .on_press(SettingsMessage::MoveCapsuleDown(id.clone()))
                .padding([2, 6])
                .style(move |_t, _s| button::Style {
                    background: None,
                    border: iced::Border::default(),
                    ..Default::default()
                });

            let (min_w, min_h): (u32, u32) = min_size_for(id_str);

            let size_controls = if id_str == "tray" {
                row![
                    text("W:").size((scale_sz(0.6)) as f32).color(theme.text),
                    slider(30..=400, settings.tray_width, SettingsMessage::TrayWidth)
                        .width(Length::Fixed(80.0)),
                    text(format!("{}", settings.tray_width))
                        .size((scale_sz(0.6)) as f32)
                        .color(theme.text)
                        .width(Length::Fixed(25.0)),
                    text("I:").size((scale_sz(0.6)) as f32).color(theme.text),
                    slider(
                        12..=48,
                        settings.tray_icon_size,
                        SettingsMessage::TrayIconSize
                    )
                    .width(Length::Fixed(80.0)),
                    text(format!("{}px", settings.tray_icon_size))
                        .size((scale_sz(0.6)) as f32)
                        .color(theme.text)
                        .width(Length::Fixed(25.0)),
                    text("T:").size((scale_sz(0.6)) as f32).color(theme.text),
                    slider(
                        0..=30,
                        settings.tray_timeout_sec,
                        SettingsMessage::TrayTimeout
                    )
                    .width(Length::Fixed(80.0)),
                    text(format!("{}s", settings.tray_timeout_sec))
                        .size((scale_sz(0.6)) as f32)
                        .color(theme.text)
                        .width(Length::Fixed(25.0)),
                ]
                .spacing(4)
                .align_y(Alignment::Center)
            } else {
                let resizer = crate::overlays::size_resizer::SizeResizer {
                    id: id_str.to_string(),
                    w: w_val,
                    h: h_val,
                    min_w,
                    min_h,
                    max_w: 1200,
                    max_h: 1000,
                    bg: theme.background,
                    fg: theme.text,
                    border: theme.border,
                    muted: theme.text,
                    display_w: 180.0,
                    display_h: 150.0,
                };
                row![
                    resizer.view(),
                    button(
                        text(if has_override { "×" } else { "·" })
                            .size((scale_sz(0.7)) as f32)
                            .color(if has_override {
                                theme.danger
                            } else {
                                theme.text
                            })
                    )
                    .on_press(SettingsMessage::ResetTooltipSize(id_reset))
                    .padding([2, 6])
                    .style(move |_t, _s| button::Style {
                        background: Some(iced::Background::Color(theme.background)),
                        border: iced::Border {
                            color: if has_override {
                                theme.danger
                            } else {
                                theme.border
                            },
                            width: 1.0,
                            radius: 3.0.into()
                        },
                        ..Default::default()
                    }),
                ]
                .spacing(6)
                .align_y(Alignment::Center)
            };

            let btn_text = if is_visible { "HIDE" } else { "SHOW" };
            let btn_bg = if is_visible {
                theme.danger
            } else {
                theme.success
            };
            let toggle_btn = button(
                text(btn_text)
                    .size((scale_sz(0.65)) as f32)
                    .bold()
                    .color(Color::BLACK),
            )
            .on_press(SettingsMessage::ToggleCapsuleVisible(id.clone()))
            .padding([4, 8])
            .style(move |_t, _s| button::Style {
                background: Some(iced::Background::Color(btn_bg)),
                border: iced::Border {
                    color: btn_bg,
                    width: 1.0,
                    radius: 4.0.into(),
                },
                ..Default::default()
            });
            let mk_move = |lbl: &'static str, target: &'static str| {
                button(text(lbl).size((scale_sz(0.55)) as f32).color(theme.text))
                    .on_press(SettingsMessage::MoveCapsuleTo(id.clone(), target.into()))
                    .padding([2, 4])
                    .style(move |_t, _s| button::Style {
                        background: Some(iced::Background::Color(theme.background)),
                        border: iced::Border {
                            color: theme.text,
                            width: 1.0,
                            radius: 3.0.into(),
                        },
                        ..Default::default()
                    })
            };
            let controls = row![
                mk_move("L", "left"),
                mk_move("C", "center"),
                mk_move("R", "right"),
                toggle_btn
            ]
            .spacing(4)
            .align_y(Alignment::Center);

            let base_row = row![
                row![up, down].spacing(4),
                text(id_str.to_uppercase())
                    .size((scale_sz(0.7)) as f32)
                    .bold()
                    .color(theme.text)
                    .width(Length::Fixed(110.0)),
                size_controls,
                row![].width(Length::Fill),
                controls
            ]
            .spacing(8)
            .align_y(Alignment::Center);

            let mut content_col = column![base_row].spacing(8).width(Length::Fill);

            if id_str == "alarm" {
                let audio_ui = column![
                    row![
                        text("Sound:")
                            .size((scale_sz(0.7)) as f32)
                            .color(theme.text)
                            .width(Length::Fixed(55.0)),
                        text_input(
                            "filename.mp3",
                            settings.alarm_sound.as_deref().unwrap_or("")
                        )
                        .on_input(SettingsMessage::AlarmSoundChanged)
                        .padding(4)
                        .size((scale_sz(0.7)) as f32)
                        .width(Length::Fill),
                        button(
                            text("Import")
                                .size((scale_sz(0.65)) as f32)
                                .bold()
                                .color(theme.text)
                        )
                        .on_press(SettingsMessage::ImportAlarmSound)
                        .padding([4, 8])
                        .style(move |_t, _s| button::Style {
                            background: Some(iced::Background::Color(theme.background)),
                            border: iced::Border {
                                color: theme.text,
                                width: 1.0,
                                radius: 4.0.into()
                            },
                            ..Default::default()
                        }),
                        button(
                            text("Test")
                                .size((scale_sz(0.65)) as f32)
                                .bold()
                                .color(theme.text)
                        )
                        .on_press(SettingsMessage::TestAlarmSound)
                        .padding([4, 8])
                        .style(move |_t, _s| button::Style {
                            background: Some(iced::Background::Color(theme.background)),
                            border: iced::Border {
                                color: theme.text,
                                width: 1.0,
                                radius: 4.0.into()
                            },
                            ..Default::default()
                        }),
                    ]
                    .spacing(8)
                    .align_y(Alignment::Center),
                    row![
                        text("Duration:")
                            .size((scale_sz(0.7)) as f32)
                            .color(theme.text)
                            .width(Length::Fixed(55.0)),
                        slider(
                            1..=60,
                            settings.alarm_sound_duration_sec,
                            SettingsMessage::AlarmSoundDurationChanged
                        )
                        .width(Length::Fill),
                        text(format!("{}s", settings.alarm_sound_duration_sec))
                            .size((scale_sz(0.7)) as f32)
                            .color(theme.text)
                            .width(Length::Fixed(25.0)),
                    ]
                    .spacing(8)
                    .align_y(Alignment::Center),
                    row![
                        text("Volume:")
                            .size((scale_sz(0.7)) as f32)
                            .color(theme.text)
                            .width(Length::Fixed(55.0)),
                        slider(
                            0..=100,
                            settings.alarm_sound_volume,
                            SettingsMessage::AlarmSoundVolumeChanged
                        )
                        .width(Length::Fill),
                        text(format!("{}%", settings.alarm_sound_volume))
                            .size((scale_sz(0.7)) as f32)
                            .color(theme.text)
                            .width(Length::Fixed(25.0)),
                    ]
                    .spacing(8)
                    .align_y(Alignment::Center),
                ]
                .spacing(6)
                .width(Length::Fill);

                content_col = content_col.push(audio_ui);
            }

            container(content_col)
                .padding([8, 10])
                .width(Length::Fill)
                .style(move |_t| container::Style {
                    border: iced::Border {
                        color: theme.text,
                        width: 1.0,
                        radius: 6.0.into(),
                    },
                    ..Default::default()
                })
                .into()
        };

        let section_header = |title: &'static str, color: Color| {
            container(row![
                text(title)
                    .size((scale_sz(0.85)) as f32)
                    .bold()
                    .color(color),
                row![].width(Length::Fill),
            ])
            .padding([4, 12])
            .style(move |_t| container::Style {
                border: iced::Border {
                    color,
                    width: 1.5,
                    radius: 6.0.into(),
                },
                ..Default::default()
            })
            .width(Length::Fill)
        };

        let mut sections: iced::widget::Column<'a, SettingsMessage> =
            iced::widget::Column::new().spacing(16).width(Length::Fill);

        sections = sections.push(section_header("LEFT BAR SECTION", theme.success));
        for id in &settings.bar_left {
            if settings.visible_capsules.get(id).copied().unwrap_or(true) {
                sections = sections.push(render_row(id, true));
            }
        }
        sections = sections.push(section_header("CENTER BAR SECTION", theme.success));
        for id in &settings.bar_center {
            if settings.visible_capsules.get(id).copied().unwrap_or(true) {
                sections = sections.push(render_row(id, true));
            }
        }
        sections = sections.push(section_header("RIGHT BAR SECTION", theme.success));
        for id in &settings.bar_right {
            if settings.visible_capsules.get(id).copied().unwrap_or(true) {
                sections = sections.push(render_row(id, true));
            }
        }
        sections = sections.push(section_header("HIDDEN MODULES", theme.danger));
        for id_str in all_capsules {
            let id = id_str.to_string();
            let is_vis = settings.visible_capsules.get(&id).copied().unwrap_or(true);
            let in_left = settings.bar_left.contains(&id);
            let in_center = settings.bar_center.contains(&id);
            let in_right = settings.bar_right.contains(&id);
            if !is_vis || (!in_left && !in_center && !in_right) {
                sections = sections.push(render_row(id_str, false));
            }
        }

        container(
            scrollable(
                column![
                    text("BAR GEOMETRY, CAPSULE SHAPES & LAYOUT")
                        .size((scale_sz(1.0)) as f32)
                        .bold()
                        .color(theme.success),
                    mon_row,
                    bg_bar_row,
                    module_slants_row,
                    module_shape_row,
                    top_sliders,
                    anim_sliders,
                    sections,
                ]
                .spacing(16)
                .width(Length::Fill),
            )
            .height(Length::Fill)
            .width(Length::Fill),
        )
        .padding(iced::Padding {
            top: 0.0,
            right: (settings.overlay_cut as f32) + 16.0,
            bottom: (settings.overlay_cut as f32) + 16.0,
            left: (settings.overlay_cut as f32) + 16.0,
        })
        .width(Length::Fill)
        .height(Length::Fill)
        .clip(true)
        .into()
    }
}

use iced::widget::{button, column, container, row, scrollable, slider, text, text_input, Stack};

/// Minimum tooltip size per module id, shared with the drag handler so
/// the mapping `x_norm → w` matches the slider range.
fn min_size_for(id: &str) -> (u32, u32) {
    match id {
        "alarm" => (400, 280),
        "calendar" => (380, 260),
        "music" => (380, 280),
        "unified" => (380, 260),
        "net" => (380, 260),
        _ => (280, 200),
    }
}

/// Debug log gated on MBS_DEBUG or MBS_SETTINGS_DEBUG.
fn mbs_dbg(msg: &str) {
    use std::io::Write;
    use std::sync::{Mutex, OnceLock};

    if std::env::var_os("MBS_DEBUG").is_none() && std::env::var_os("MBS_SETTINGS_DEBUG").is_none() {
        return;
    }

    static LOG: OnceLock<Mutex<std::fs::File>> = OnceLock::new();
    let file = LOG.get_or_init(|| {
        let f = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()
            .create(true)
            .append(true)
            .open("/tmp/mbs-settings-dbg.log")
            .expect("open /tmp/mbs-settings-dbg.log");
        Mutex::new(f)
    });
    if let Ok(mut f) = file.lock() {
        let _ = writeln!(*f, "{}", msg);
    }
}
