pub struct SettingsOverlay {
    pub active_tab: SettingsTab,
    pub selected_screen: String,
    pub selected_profile: usize,
    last_save: std::time::Instant,
    pub detected_gpus: Vec<GpuInfo>,
    pub browsing_music_dir: Option<std::path::PathBuf>,
    pub browse_entries: Vec<std::path::PathBuf>,
    pub browse_mode: Option<BrowseMode>,
    pub browse_files: Vec<std::path::PathBuf>,
}

impl SettingsOverlay {
    pub fn new(_settings: &ShellSettings) -> Self {
        Self {
            active_tab: SettingsTab::Notifications,
            selected_screen: "Auto (Primary)".into(),
            selected_profile: 0,
            last_save: std::time::Instant::now(),
            detected_gpus: SystemCollector::list_gpus_sync(),
            browsing_music_dir: None,
            browse_entries: Vec::new(),
            browse_mode: None,
            browse_files: Vec::new(),
        }
    }

    pub fn empty() -> Self {
        Self {
            active_tab: SettingsTab::Notifications,
            selected_screen: "Auto (Primary)".into(),
            selected_profile: 0,
            last_save: std::time::Instant::now(),
            detected_gpus: Vec::new(),
            browsing_music_dir: None,
            browse_entries: Vec::new(),
            browse_mode: None,
            browse_files: Vec::new(),
        }
    }

    pub fn update(&mut self, message: SettingsMessage, settings: &mut ShellSettings) {
        mbs_dbg(&format!(
            "[dbg-update-entry] {:?}",
            std::mem::discriminant(&message)
        ));
        let should_persist = matches!(
            &message,
            SettingsMessage::Dismiss
                | SettingsMessage::SaveSettings
                | SettingsMessage::SelectTab(_)
                | SettingsMessage::ToggleNotifications
                | SettingsMessage::ToggleNotifReadBody
                | SettingsMessage::SelectNotifCorner(_)
                | SettingsMessage::SelectNotifShape(_)
                | SettingsMessage::SelectNotifScreen(_)
                | SettingsMessage::SelectBarShape(_)
                | SettingsMessage::SelectModuleShape(_)
                | SettingsMessage::SelectSlantMode(_)
                | SettingsMessage::AddNewProfile
                | SettingsMessage::DeleteProfile(_)
                | SettingsMessage::ToggleProfileSound(_)
                | SettingsMessage::ToggleProfileTts(_)
                | SettingsMessage::ToggleProfileReadBody(_)
                | SettingsMessage::ProfileSummaryChanged(_, _)
                | SettingsMessage::ProfileColorChanged(_, _)
                | SettingsMessage::ProfileSoundPathChanged(_, _)
                | SettingsMessage::ProfileTtsTemplateChanged(_, _)
                | SettingsMessage::AddContentRule(_)
                | SettingsMessage::DeleteContentRule(_, _)
                | SettingsMessage::RulePatternChanged(_, _, _)
                | SettingsMessage::RuleReadoutChanged(_, _, _)
                | SettingsMessage::ToggleCapsuleVisible(_)
                | SettingsMessage::MoveCapsuleTo(_, _)
                | SettingsMessage::MoveCapsuleUp(_)
                | SettingsMessage::MoveCapsuleDown(_)
                | SettingsMessage::ColorChanged(_, _)
                | SettingsMessage::SelectGpuId(_)
                | SettingsMessage::TrayIconSize(_)
                | SettingsMessage::LauncherIconSize(_)
                | SettingsMessage::ClipboardThumbnailSize(_)
                | SettingsMessage::ScreenshotSaveFormat(_)
                | SettingsMessage::SizeCommit { .. }
                | SettingsMessage::AlarmSoundImported(_)
                | SettingsMessage::AddMusicDir
                | SettingsMessage::MusicDirPicked(_)
                | SettingsMessage::MusicDirChanged(_, _)
                | SettingsMessage::RemoveMusicDir(_)
                | SettingsMessage::BrowseSelectCurrent
        );
        match message {
            SettingsMessage::TrayIconSize(v) => settings.tray_icon_size = v.clamp(12, 48),
            SettingsMessage::LauncherIconSize(v) => settings.launcher_icon_size = v.clamp(48, 160),
            SettingsMessage::ClipboardThumbnailSize(v) => {
                settings.clipboard_thumbnail_size = v.clamp(32, 160)
            }
            SettingsMessage::SelectGpuId(id) => {
                settings.gpu_selected_id = id;
            }
            SettingsMessage::ScreenshotSaveFormat(fmt) => {
                settings.screenshot_save_format = fmt;
            }
            SettingsMessage::Gpu1TempWarn(v) => settings.gpu1.temp_warn = v,
            SettingsMessage::Gpu1TempDanger(v) => settings.gpu1.temp_danger = v,
            SettingsMessage::Gpu1VramWarn(v) => settings.gpu1.vram_warn = v,
            SettingsMessage::Gpu1VramDanger(v) => settings.gpu1.vram_danger = v,

            SettingsMessage::SelectBarMonitor(s) => {
                settings.bar_monitor = s.clone();
                let _ = settings.save();
                if let Ok(exe) = std::env::current_exe() {
                    let _ = std::process::Command::new(exe).arg("--restart-bar").spawn();
                }
            }
            SettingsMessage::SizeDrag { id, x_norm, y_norm } => {
                let (min_w, min_h) = min_size_for(&id);
                let max_w: u32 = 1200;
                let max_h: u32 = 1000;
                // Map x_norm linearly into [0, max], then clamp to [min, max].
                // This makes the fill's aspect ratio exactly w/h when the
                // track has the aspect ratio of (max_w, max_h).
                let new_w = ((x_norm * max_w as f32).round() as u32).clamp(min_w, max_w);
                let new_h = ((y_norm * max_h as f32).round() as u32).clamp(min_h, max_h);
                settings.tooltip_sizes.insert(id, (new_w, new_h));
            }
            SettingsMessage::SizeCommit { .. } => {}
            SettingsMessage::ResetTooltipSize(id) => {
                settings.tooltip_sizes.remove(&id);
            }
            SettingsMessage::SelectTab(t) => {
                self.browsing_music_dir = None;
                self.browse_mode = None;
                self.browse_entries.clear();
                self.browse_files.clear();
                self.active_tab = t;
                if t == SettingsTab::Hardware {
                    self.detected_gpus = SystemCollector::list_gpus_sync();
                }
            }

            SettingsMessage::BarHeight(v) => settings.bar_height = v.clamp(28, 90),
            SettingsMessage::GlobalFontSize(v) => settings.global_font_size = v.clamp(8, 32),
            SettingsMessage::OverlayFontSize(v) => settings.overlay_font_size = v.clamp(10, 36),
            SettingsMessage::TooltipFontSize(v) => settings.tooltip_font_size = v.clamp(8, 28),
            SettingsMessage::SlantWidth(v) => settings.slant_width = (v as f32).clamp(0.0, 40.0),
            SettingsMessage::TooltipDropMs(v) => settings.tooltip_drop_ms = v.clamp(50, 1000),
            SettingsMessage::TooltipExpandMs(v) => settings.tooltip_expand_ms = v.clamp(50, 1000),
            SettingsMessage::TooltipWidthPx(v) => settings.tooltip_width_px = v.clamp(200, 1000),
            SettingsMessage::TooltipHeightPx(v) => settings.tooltip_height_px = v.clamp(100, 1000),
            SettingsMessage::TooltipPauseMs(v) => settings.tooltip_pause_ms = v.clamp(0, 1000),
            SettingsMessage::TooltipOffsetLeft(v) => {
                settings.tooltip_offset_left = Some(v.clamp(-100, 200))
            }
            SettingsMessage::TooltipOffsetRight(v) => {
                settings.tooltip_offset_right = Some(v.clamp(-100, 200))
            }
            SettingsMessage::TooltipOffsetLeftReset => settings.tooltip_offset_left = None,
            SettingsMessage::TooltipOffsetRightReset => settings.tooltip_offset_right = None,
            SettingsMessage::BorderWidth(v) => {
                settings.global_border_width = (v as f32).clamp(1.0, 12.0)
            }
            SettingsMessage::ControlBorderWidth(v) => {
                settings.control_border_width = (v as f32).clamp(1.0, 8.0)
            }
            SettingsMessage::CapsuleSpacing(v) => settings.capsule_spacing = v.clamp(-50, 40),
            SettingsMessage::CapsuleInternalPadding(v) => {
                settings.capsule_internal_padding = v.clamp(0, 60)
            }
            SettingsMessage::TrayWidth(v) => settings.tray_width = v.clamp(50, 400),
            SettingsMessage::TrayTimeout(v) => settings.tray_timeout_sec = v.clamp(0, 30),
            SettingsMessage::HardwarePollInterval(v) => {
                settings.hardware_poll_interval_ms = v.clamp(500, 10000)
            }

            SettingsMessage::SelectBarShape(s) => settings.bar_shape = s,
            SettingsMessage::SelectModuleShape(s) => settings.module_shape = s,
            SettingsMessage::SelectSlantMode(m) => settings.slant_mode = m,

            SettingsMessage::ToggleNotifications => {
                settings.notifications_enabled = !settings.notifications_enabled
            }
            SettingsMessage::ToggleNotifReadBody => {
                settings.notif_tts_read_body = !settings.notif_tts_read_body
            }
            SettingsMessage::SelectNotifCorner(c) => settings.notif_corner = c,
            SettingsMessage::SelectNotifShape(s) => settings.notif_shape = s,
            SettingsMessage::SelectNotifScreen(s) => {
                self.selected_screen = s.clone();
                settings.notif_screen_name = s;
            }
            SettingsMessage::NotifHoldDuration(v) => {
                settings.notif_hold_duration_sec = v.clamp(1, 30)
            }
            SettingsMessage::NotifVolume(v) => settings.notif_volume = v.clamp(0, 100),
            SettingsMessage::NotifBaselineY(v) => settings.notif_baseline_y = v.clamp(20, 1200),
            SettingsMessage::NotifMarginX(v) => settings.notif_margin_x = v.clamp(0, 200),
            SettingsMessage::NotifStackOverlap(v) => {
                settings.notif_stack_overlap = v.clamp(-100, 100)
            }
            SettingsMessage::NotifCardWidth(v) => settings.notif_card_width = v.clamp(250, 800),
            SettingsMessage::NotifCardHeight(v) => settings.notif_card_height = v.clamp(80, 300),
            SettingsMessage::NotifSlideIn(v) => settings.notif_slide_in_ms = v.clamp(20, 1000),
            SettingsMessage::NotifDropPause(v) => settings.notif_drop_pause_ms = v.clamp(0, 500),
            SettingsMessage::NotifDropDistance(v) => {
                settings.notif_drop_distance_px = v.clamp(10, 500)
            }
            SettingsMessage::NotifSummarySize(v) => settings.notif_summary_size = v.clamp(10, 36),
            SettingsMessage::NotifBodySize(v) => settings.notif_body_size = v.clamp(8, 32),
            SettingsMessage::NotifIconSize(v) => settings.notif_icon_size = v.clamp(24, 96),
            SettingsMessage::NotifExcludedChanged(v) => settings.notif_excluded = v,
            SettingsMessage::CpuTempWarn(v) => settings.cpu_temp_warn = v,
            SettingsMessage::CpuTempDanger(v) => settings.cpu_temp_danger = v,
            SettingsMessage::CpuUsageWarn(v) => settings.cpu_usage_warn = v,
            SettingsMessage::CpuUsageDanger(v) => settings.cpu_usage_danger = v,
            SettingsMessage::RamWarnGib(v) => settings.ram_warn_gib = v,
            SettingsMessage::RamDangerGib(v) => settings.ram_danger_gib = v,

            SettingsMessage::SelectProfile(idx) => self.selected_profile = idx,
            SettingsMessage::TestProfileSound(_) | SettingsMessage::TestProfileTts(_) => {}
            SettingsMessage::ToggleProfileSound(idx) => {
                if let Some(p) = settings.friend_profiles.get_mut(idx) {
                    p.sound = !p.sound;
                    let _ = crate::libraries::config::settings::save_friend_profiles(
                        &settings.friend_profiles,
                    );
                }
            }
            SettingsMessage::ToggleProfileTts(idx) => {
                if let Some(p) = settings.friend_profiles.get_mut(idx) {
                    p.tts = !p.tts;
                    let _ = crate::libraries::config::settings::save_friend_profiles(
                        &settings.friend_profiles,
                    );
                }
            }
            SettingsMessage::ToggleProfileReadBody(idx) => {
                if let Some(p) = settings.friend_profiles.get_mut(idx) {
                    p.read_body = !p.read_body;
                    let _ = crate::libraries::config::settings::save_friend_profiles(
                        &settings.friend_profiles,
                    );
                }
            }
            SettingsMessage::ProfileSummaryChanged(idx, val) => {
                if let Some(p) = settings.friend_profiles.get_mut(idx) {
                    p.summary = val.clone();
                    p.name = val.to_lowercase().replace(' ', "_");
                    let _ = crate::libraries::config::settings::save_friend_profiles(
                        &settings.friend_profiles,
                    );
                }
            }
            SettingsMessage::ProfileColorChanged(idx, col) => {
                if let Some(p) = settings.friend_profiles.get_mut(idx) {
                    p.color = col;
                    let _ = crate::libraries::config::settings::save_friend_profiles(
                        &settings.friend_profiles,
                    );
                }
            }
            SettingsMessage::ProfileSoundPathChanged(idx, path) => {
                if let Some(p) = settings.friend_profiles.get_mut(idx) {
                    p.sound_path = if path.trim().is_empty() {
                        None
                    } else {
                        Some(path.trim().to_string())
                    };
                    let _ = crate::libraries::config::settings::save_friend_profiles(
                        &settings.friend_profiles,
                    );
                }
            }
            SettingsMessage::ProfileTtsTemplateChanged(idx, tpl) => {
                if let Some(p) = settings.friend_profiles.get_mut(idx) {
                    p.default_readout = if tpl.trim().is_empty() {
                        None
                    } else {
                        Some(tpl.trim().to_string())
                    };
                    let _ = crate::libraries::config::settings::save_friend_profiles(
                        &settings.friend_profiles,
                    );
                }
            }
            SettingsMessage::DeleteProfile(idx) => {
                if idx < settings.friend_profiles.len() {
                    settings.friend_profiles.remove(idx);
                    if self.selected_profile >= settings.friend_profiles.len() {
                        self.selected_profile = settings.friend_profiles.len().saturating_sub(1);
                    }
                    let _ = crate::libraries::config::settings::save_friend_profiles(
                        &settings.friend_profiles,
                    );
                }
            }
            SettingsMessage::PickAvatar(idx) => {
                self.browse_mode = Some(BrowseMode::AvatarImage(idx));
                let start = dirs::picture_dir()
                    .or_else(dirs::home_dir)
                    .unwrap_or_else(|| std::path::PathBuf::from("/"));
                self.refresh_browse_dir(start);
            }
            SettingsMessage::AvatarUpdated | SettingsMessage::AvatarFilePicked(_, _) => {}
            SettingsMessage::AddNewProfile => {
                settings.friend_profiles.push(FriendProfile {
                    name: "new_ping".into(),
                    summary: "New Ping".into(),
                    color: "#38FEDC".into(),
                    sound: true,
                    sound_path: None,
                    tts: true,
                    read_body: false,
                    default_readout: Some("Message from {name}".into()),
                    content_rules: vec![crate::libraries::config::settings::ContentRule {
                        pattern: "logged in".into(),
                        readout: "{name} has logged in".into(),
                        sound_path: None,
                    }],
                });
                self.selected_profile = settings.friend_profiles.len().saturating_sub(1);
                let _ = crate::libraries::config::settings::save_friend_profiles(
                    &settings.friend_profiles,
                );
            }

            SettingsMessage::AddContentRule(p_idx) => {
                if let Some(p) = settings.friend_profiles.get_mut(p_idx) {
                    p.content_rules.push(ContentRule {
                        pattern: "logged in".into(),
                        readout: "{name} has logged in".into(),
                        sound_path: None,
                    });
                    let _ = crate::libraries::config::settings::save_friend_profiles(
                        &settings.friend_profiles,
                    );
                }
            }
            SettingsMessage::DeleteContentRule(p_idx, r_idx) => {
                if let Some(p) = settings.friend_profiles.get_mut(p_idx) {
                    if r_idx < p.content_rules.len() {
                        p.content_rules.remove(r_idx);
                        let _ = crate::libraries::config::settings::save_friend_profiles(
                            &settings.friend_profiles,
                        );
                    }
                }
            }
            SettingsMessage::RulePatternChanged(p_idx, r_idx, val) => {
                if let Some(p) = settings.friend_profiles.get_mut(p_idx) {
                    if let Some(r) = p.content_rules.get_mut(r_idx) {
                        r.pattern = val;
                        let _ = crate::libraries::config::settings::save_friend_profiles(
                            &settings.friend_profiles,
                        );
                    }
                }
            }
            SettingsMessage::RuleReadoutChanged(p_idx, r_idx, val) => {
                if let Some(p) = settings.friend_profiles.get_mut(p_idx) {
                    if let Some(r) = p.content_rules.get_mut(r_idx) {
                        r.readout = val;
                        let _ = crate::libraries::config::settings::save_friend_profiles(
                            &settings.friend_profiles,
                        );
                    }
                }
            }

            SettingsMessage::ColorChanged(slot, hex) => match slot.as_str() {
                "base00" => settings.palette.base00 = hex,
                "base01" => settings.palette.base01 = hex,
                "base02" => settings.palette.base02 = hex,
                "base03" => settings.palette.base03 = hex,
                "base05" => settings.palette.base05 = hex,
                "base08" => settings.palette.base08 = hex,
                "base09" => settings.palette.base09 = hex,
                "base0c" => settings.palette.base0c = hex,
                "base0d" => settings.palette.base0d = hex,
                _ => {}
            },

            SettingsMessage::GpuTempWarn(v) => settings.gpu0.temp_warn = v,
            SettingsMessage::GpuTempDanger(v) => settings.gpu0.temp_danger = v,
            SettingsMessage::GpuVramWarn(v) => settings.gpu0.vram_warn = v,
            SettingsMessage::GpuVramDanger(v) => settings.gpu0.vram_danger = v,

            SettingsMessage::ToggleCapsuleVisible(id) => {
                let cur = settings.visible_capsules.get(&id).copied().unwrap_or(true);
                settings.visible_capsules.insert(id, !cur);
            }
            SettingsMessage::MoveCapsuleTo(id, target) => {
                settings.bar_left.retain(|x| x != &id);
                settings.bar_center.retain(|x| x != &id);
                settings.bar_right.retain(|x| x != &id);
                match target.as_str() {
                    "left" => {
                        settings.bar_left.push(id.clone());
                        settings.visible_capsules.insert(id, true);
                    }
                    "center" => {
                        settings.bar_center.push(id.clone());
                        settings.visible_capsules.insert(id, true);
                    }
                    "right" => {
                        settings.bar_right.push(id.clone());
                        settings.visible_capsules.insert(id, true);
                    }
                    "hidden" => {
                        settings.visible_capsules.insert(id, false);
                    }
                    _ => {}
                }
            }
            SettingsMessage::MoveCapsuleUp(id) => {
                let lists = [
                    &mut settings.bar_left,
                    &mut settings.bar_center,
                    &mut settings.bar_right,
                ];
                for list in lists {
                    if let Some(pos) = list.iter().position(|x| x == &id) {
                        if pos > 0 {
                            list.swap(pos, pos - 1);
                        }
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            SettingsMessage::MoveCapsuleDown(id) => {
                let lists = [
                    &mut settings.bar_left,
                    &mut settings.bar_center,
                    &mut settings.bar_right,
                ];
                for list in lists {
                    if let Some(pos) = list.iter().position(|x| x == &id) {
                        if pos < list.len() - 1 {
                            list.swap(pos, pos + 1);
                        }
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }

            SettingsMessage::OverlayWidth(v) => settings.overlay_width = v.clamp(400, 3000),
            SettingsMessage::OverlayHeight(v) => settings.overlay_height = v.clamp(250, 2000),
            SettingsMessage::WindowWidth(id, w) => {
                let entry = settings.standalone_windows.entry(id).or_insert(
                    crate::libraries::config::settings::WindowDim {
                        width: w,
                        height: 650,
                        field_height: None,
                        dismiss_on_blur: Some(true),
                        escape_closes: Some(true),
                    },
                );
                entry.width = w;
            }
            SettingsMessage::WindowHeight(id, h) => {
                let entry = settings.standalone_windows.entry(id).or_insert(
                    crate::libraries::config::settings::WindowDim {
                        width: 840,
                        height: h,
                        field_height: None,
                        dismiss_on_blur: Some(true),
                        escape_closes: Some(true),
                    },
                );
                entry.height = h;
            }
            SettingsMessage::AttachmentDownloadDirChanged(v) => {
                settings.attachment_download_dir = v
            }
            SettingsMessage::AddMusicDir => {
                settings.music_dirs.push(String::new());
            }
            SettingsMessage::RescanMusicLibrary => {}
            SettingsMessage::PickMusicDir => {
                self.browse_mode = Some(BrowseMode::MusicDir);
                let start = dirs::home_dir().unwrap_or_else(|| std::path::PathBuf::from("/"));
                self.refresh_browse_dir(start);
            }
            SettingsMessage::BrowseNavigate(dir) => {
                self.refresh_browse_dir(dir);
            }
            SettingsMessage::BrowseSelectCurrent => {
                if let Some(dir) = self.browsing_music_dir.take() {
                    let dir_str = dir.to_string_lossy().into_owned();
                    if !settings.music_dirs.contains(&dir_str) {
                        settings.music_dirs.push(dir_str);
                    }
                }
                self.browse_mode = None;
                self.browse_entries.clear();
                self.browse_files.clear();
            }
            SettingsMessage::BrowseCancel => {
                self.browsing_music_dir = None;
                self.browse_mode = None;
                self.browse_entries.clear();
                self.browse_files.clear();
            }
            SettingsMessage::MusicDirPicked(Some(dir)) => {
                if !settings.music_dirs.contains(&dir) {
                    settings.music_dirs.push(dir);
                }
            }
            SettingsMessage::MusicDirPicked(None) => {}
            SettingsMessage::MusicDirChanged(idx, v) => {
                if let Some(entry) = settings.music_dirs.get_mut(idx) {
                    *entry = v;
                }
            }
            SettingsMessage::RemoveMusicDir(idx) => {
                if idx < settings.music_dirs.len() {
                    settings.music_dirs.remove(idx);
                }
            }
            SettingsMessage::OverlayCut(v) => {
                settings.overlay_cut = v.clamp(0, 200);
            }
            SettingsMessage::OverlayAngle(v) => {
                settings.overlay_angle = v.clamp(5, 85);
            }
            SettingsMessage::TestNotification => {
                settings.friend_profiles =
                    crate::libraries::config::settings::load_friend_profiles();
            }
            SettingsMessage::AlarmSoundChanged(v) => {
                settings.alarm_sound = if v.trim().is_empty() { None } else { Some(v) };
            }
            SettingsMessage::AlarmSoundDurationChanged(v) => {
                settings.alarm_sound_duration_sec = v.clamp(1, 60);
            }
            SettingsMessage::TestAlarmSound => {
                if let Some(sound) = &settings.alarm_sound {
                    crate::libraries::backend::play_alarm_sound(
                        sound,
                        settings.alarm_sound_volume,
                        settings.alarm_sound_duration_sec,
                    );
                }
            }
            SettingsMessage::SaveSettings => {}
            SettingsMessage::AlarmSoundVolumeChanged(v) => {
                settings.alarm_sound_volume = v.clamp(0, 100);
            }

            SettingsMessage::ImportAlarmSound => {
                // Handled in app/update/settings.rs via async rfd::AsyncFileDialog.
            }
            SettingsMessage::AlarmSoundImported(Some(filename)) => {
                settings.alarm_sound = Some(filename);
            }
            SettingsMessage::AlarmSoundImported(None) => {}
            // CopyIpc is handled in app/update.rs (returns
            // iced::clipboard::write early). This arm only exists for
            // enum exhaustiveness when SettingsOverlay::update is
            // called directly.
            SettingsMessage::CopyIpc(_) => {}
            SettingsMessage::Dismiss => {}
        }

        // Commit to disk: immediately on explicit save-worthy events, or
        // 300ms after the last slider tick (rate-limited so a full slider
        // drag writes at most ~3×/sec instead of 60×/sec).
        let rate_limited = self.last_save.elapsed() >= std::time::Duration::from_millis(300);
        if should_persist || rate_limited {
            let _ = settings.save();
            self.last_save = std::time::Instant::now();
        }
    }

    fn refresh_browse_dir(&mut self, dir: std::path::PathBuf) {
        let mut dirs_found = Vec::new();
        let mut files_found = Vec::new();
        let want_images = matches!(self.browse_mode, Some(BrowseMode::AvatarImage(_)));
        const IMG_EXTS: &[&str] = &["png", "jpg", "jpeg", "webp", "gif"];

        if let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(&dir) {
            for entry in entries.flatten() {
                let p = entry.path();
                let hidden = p
                    .file_name()
                    .and_then(|n| n.to_str())
                    .is_some_and(|n| n.starts_with('.'));
                if hidden {
                    continue;
                }
                if p.is_dir() {
                    dirs_found.push(p);
                } else if want_images
                    && p.is_file()
                    && p.extension()
                        .and_then(|e| e.to_str())
                        .is_some_and(|ext| IMG_EXTS.iter().any(|k| ext.eq_ignore_ascii_case(k)))
                {
                    files_found.push(p);
                }
            }
        }
        let sort_by_name = |v: &mut Vec<std::path::PathBuf>| {
            v.sort_by(|a, b| {
                a.file_name()
                    .and_then(|s| s.to_str())
                    .unwrap_or("")
                    .to_lowercase()
                    .cmp(
                        &b.file_name()
                            .and_then(|s| s.to_str())
                            .unwrap_or("")
                            .to_lowercase(),
                    )
            });
        };
        sort_by_name(&mut dirs_found);
        sort_by_name(&mut files_found);

        self.browsing_music_dir = Some(dir);
        self.browse_entries = dirs_found;
        self.browse_files = files_found;
    }

    pub(super) fn view_in_app_browser<'a>(
        &'a self,
        settings: &'a ShellSettings,
        theme: &'a ShellTheme,
    ) -> Option<Element<'a, SettingsMessage>> {
        let current_dir = self.browsing_music_dir.as_ref()?;
        let mode = self.browse_mode?;

        let base_sz = theme.font_size_overlay;
        let scale_sz = |factor: f32| -> u16 { ((base_sz as f32) * factor).round().max(9.0) as u16 };
        let fs_lbl = scale_sz(0.85) as f32;

        let text_col = theme.text;
        let bg_col = theme.background;
        let surf_col = theme.surface_alt;
        let border_col = theme.border;
        let success_col = theme.success;
        let danger_col = theme.danger;

        let mut nav_row = row![].spacing(8).align_y(Alignment::Center);

        if let Some(parent) = current_dir.parent() {
            let p_buf = parent.to_path_buf();
            nav_row = nav_row.push(
                button(text("⬆ Up").size(fs_lbl).bold().color(text_col))
                    .on_press(SettingsMessage::BrowseNavigate(p_buf))
                    .padding([4, 10])
                    .style(move |_t, _s| button::Style {
                        background: Some(iced::Background::Color(surf_col)),
                        border: iced::Border { color: border_col, width: 1.0, radius: 4.0.into() },
                        ..Default::default()
                    }),
            );
        }

        if let Some(home) = dirs::home_dir() {
            nav_row = nav_row.push(
                button(text("🏠 Home").size(fs_lbl).bold().color(text_col))
                    .on_press(SettingsMessage::BrowseNavigate(home))
                    .padding([4, 10])
                    .style(move |_t, _s| button::Style {
                        background: Some(iced::Background::Color(surf_col)),
                        border: iced::Border { color: border_col, width: 1.0, radius: 4.0.into() },
                        ..Default::default()
                    }),
            );
        }

        if matches!(mode, BrowseMode::AvatarImage(_)) {
            if let Some(pics) = dirs::picture_dir() {
                if pics.exists() {
                    nav_row = nav_row.push(
                        button(text("🖼 Pictures").size(fs_lbl).bold().color(text_col))
                            .on_press(SettingsMessage::BrowseNavigate(pics))
                            .padding([4, 10])
                            .style(move |_t, _s| button::Style {
                                background: Some(iced::Background::Color(surf_col)),
                                border: iced::Border { color: border_col, width: 1.0, radius: 4.0.into() },
                                ..Default::default()
                            }),
                    );
                }
            }
            if let Some(dl) = dirs::download_dir() {
                if dl.exists() {
                    nav_row = nav_row.push(
                        button(text("📥 Downloads").size(fs_lbl).bold().color(text_col))
                            .on_press(SettingsMessage::BrowseNavigate(dl))
                            .padding([4, 10])
                            .style(move |_t, _s| button::Style {
                                background: Some(iced::Background::Color(surf_col)),
                                border: iced::Border { color: border_col, width: 1.0, radius: 4.0.into() },
                                ..Default::default()
                            }),
                    );
                }
            }
        }

        for quick in ["/", "/mnt", "/run/media"] {
            let qp = std::path::PathBuf::from(quick);
            if qp.exists() {
                nav_row = nav_row.push(
                    button(text(quick).size(fs_lbl).bold().color(text_col))
                        .on_press(SettingsMessage::BrowseNavigate(qp))
                        .padding([4, 10])
                        .style(move |_t, _s| button::Style {
                            background: Some(iced::Background::Color(surf_col)),
                            border: iced::Border { color: border_col, width: 1.0, radius: 4.0.into() },
                            ..Default::default()
                        }),
                );
            }
        }

        nav_row = nav_row.push(row![].width(Length::Fill));

        if matches!(mode, BrowseMode::MusicDir) {
            nav_row = nav_row.push(
                button(text("✓ Add This Folder").size(fs_lbl).bold().color(bg_col))
                    .on_press(SettingsMessage::BrowseSelectCurrent)
                    .padding([5, 12])
                    .style(move |_t, _s| button::Style {
                        background: Some(iced::Background::Color(success_col)),
                        border: iced::Border { color: success_col, width: 1.0, radius: 4.0.into() },
                        ..Default::default()
                    }),
            );
        }

        nav_row = nav_row.push(
            button(text("✕ Cancel").size(fs_lbl).bold().color(danger_col))
                .on_press(SettingsMessage::BrowseCancel)
                .padding([5, 12])
                .style(move |_t, _s| button::Style {
                    background: Some(iced::Background::Color(surf_col)),
                    border: iced::Border { color: danger_col, width: 1.0, radius: 4.0.into() },
                    ..Default::default()
                }),
        );

        let mut list_col = column![].spacing(6);

        for entry in &self.browse_entries {
            let name = entry
                .file_name()
                .and_then(|n| n.to_str())
                .unwrap_or("")
                .to_string();
            let nav_target = entry.clone();
            let mut row_item = row![
                button(text(format!("📁 {}", name)).size(fs_lbl).color(text_col))
                    .on_press(SettingsMessage::BrowseNavigate(nav_target))
                    .padding([6, 10])
                    .width(Length::Fill)
                    .style(move |_t, status| button::Style {
                        background: Some(iced::Background::Color(match status {
                            button::Status::Hovered => surf_col,
                            _ => Color::from_rgb8(18, 20, 26),
                        })),
                        border: iced::Border { color: border_col, width: 1.0, radius: 4.0.into() },
                        ..Default::default()
                    }),
            ]
            .spacing(8)
            .align_y(Alignment::Center);

            if matches!(mode, BrowseMode::MusicDir) {
                let add_str = entry.to_string_lossy().into_owned();
                row_item = row_item.push(
                    button(text("+ Add").size(fs_lbl).bold().color(success_col))
                        .on_press(SettingsMessage::MusicDirPicked(Some(add_str)))
                        .padding([6, 10])
                        .style(move |_t, _s| button::Style {
                            background: Some(iced::Background::Color(surf_col)),
                            border: iced::Border { color: success_col, width: 1.0, radius: 4.0.into() },
                            ..Default::default()
                        }),
                );
            }
            list_col = list_col.push(row_item);
        }

        if let BrowseMode::AvatarImage(profile_idx) = mode {
            for img in &self.browse_files {
                let name = img
                    .file_name()
                    .and_then(|n| n.to_str())
                    .unwrap_or("")
                    .to_string();
                let img_path = img.clone();
                list_col = list_col.push(
                    button(
                        row![
                            text(format!("🖼 {}", name)).size(fs_lbl).color(success_col),
                            row![].width(Length::Fill),
                            text("Click to Pick & Auto-Crop").size(fs_lbl).color(text_col),
                        ]
                        .align_y(Alignment::Center),
                    )
                    .on_press(SettingsMessage::AvatarFilePicked(profile_idx, img_path))
                    .padding([6, 10])
                    .width(Length::Fill)
                    .style(move |_t, status| button::Style {
                        background: Some(iced::Background::Color(match status {
                            button::Status::Hovered => surf_col,
                            _ => Color::from_rgb8(18, 20, 26),
                        })),
                        border: iced::Border { color: success_col, width: 1.0, radius: 4.0.into() },
                        ..Default::default()
                    }),
                );
            }
            if self.browse_entries.is_empty() && self.browse_files.is_empty() {
                list_col = list_col.push(
                    text("(No folders or PNG/JPG/WEBP/GIF images in this directory)")
                        .size(fs_lbl)
                        .color(text_col),
                );
            }
        } else if self.browse_entries.is_empty() {
            list_col = list_col.push(
                text("(No subdirectories — click 'Add This Folder' to add this directory)")
                    .size(fs_lbl)
                    .color(text_col),
            );
        }

        let heading = match mode {
            BrowseMode::MusicDir => "📁 SELECT MUSIC FOLDER",
            BrowseMode::AvatarImage(_) => "🖼 SELECT AVATAR IMAGE",
        };

        Some(

                right: (settings.overlay_cut as f32) + 16.0,

    pub fn view<'a>(
        &'a self,
        settings: &'a ShellSettings,
        theme: &'a ShellTheme,
    ) -> Element<'a, SettingsMessage> {
        let (card_w, card_h) = settings.get_window_size("settings", 1260, 840);

        let cut_f = settings.overlay_cut as f32;
        let angle_deg = settings.overlay_angle as f32;
        let hex = AngledHexGeometry::new(card_w, card_h, cut_f, angle_deg);
        let header_inset = hex.inset_at(22.0, 18.0);
        let tab_inset = hex.inset_at(55.0, 14.0);
        let footer_inset = hex.inset_at(24.0, 18.0);

        let base_sz = theme.font_size_overlay;
        let scale_sz = |factor: f32| -> u16 { ((base_sz as f32) * factor).round().max(9.0) as u16 };

        let tabs = [
            (SettingsTab::Notifications, "Notifications"),
            (SettingsTab::ColorsStyles, "Colors & Styles"),
            (SettingsTab::Hardware, "Hardware"),
            (SettingsTab::BarLayout, "Bar Layout & Slants"),
            (SettingsTab::OverlaysWindows, "Overlays & Windows"),
            (SettingsTab::IpcCommands, "Commands & Keybinds"),
        ];

        let mut tab_row = row![].spacing(6).align_y(Alignment::Center);
        for (tab, label) in tabs {
            let is_sel = self.active_tab == tab;
            let col = if is_sel { theme.background } else { theme.text };
            let bg_col = if is_sel {
                theme.text
            } else {
                Color::TRANSPARENT
            };

            let btn_item = button(
                text(label)
                    .size((scale_sz(0.82)) as f32)
                    .bold()
                    .color(col)
                    .align_x(Alignment::Center),
            )
            .on_press(SettingsMessage::SelectTab(tab))
            .padding([8, 14])
            .style(move |_t, _s| button::Style {
                background: Some(iced::Background::Color(bg_col)),
                border: iced::Border {
                    color: theme.text,
                    width: 1.5,
                    radius: 4.0.into(),
                },
                ..Default::default()
            });

            tab_row = tab_row.push(btn_item);
        }

        let body_content: Element<'a, SettingsMessage> = match self.active_tab {
            SettingsTab::Notifications => self.view_notifications(settings, theme),
            SettingsTab::ColorsStyles => self.view_colors_styles(settings, theme),
            SettingsTab::Hardware => self.view_hardware(settings, theme),
            SettingsTab::BarLayout => self.view_bar_layout(settings, theme),
            SettingsTab::OverlaysWindows => self.view_overlays_windows(settings, theme),
            SettingsTab::IpcCommands => self.view_ipc_commands(settings, theme),
        };

        let card_bg = ShapeBox::new()
            .shape(ShapeType::AngledHexagon {
                cut: cut_f,
                angle_deg,
            })
            .background(theme.background)
            .border(theme.border, theme.border_width)
            .size(Length::Fixed(card_w), Length::Fixed(card_h));

        let header_row = container(
            row![
                text("⚙ SYSTEM SETTINGS & PREFERENCES")
                    .size((scale_sz(1.15)) as f32)
                    .bold()
                    .color(theme.text),
                row![].width(Length::Fill),
                button(
                    text("✕")
                        .size((scale_sz(0.85)) as f32)
                        .bold()
                        .color(theme.danger)
                )
                .on_press(SettingsMessage::Dismiss)
                .padding([4, 10])
                .style(|_t, _s| button::Style {
                    background: None,
                    ..Default::default()
                }),
            ]
            .align_y(Alignment::Center),
        )
        .width(Length::Fill)
        .padding(Padding {
            top: 0.0,
            right: header_inset,
            bottom: 0.0,
            left: header_inset,
        });

        let tab_container = container(tab_row).width(Length::Fill).padding(Padding {
            top: 0.0,
            right: tab_inset,
            bottom: 0.0,
            left: tab_inset,
        });

        let footer_container = container(
            text("ESC or [✕] to dismiss  •  Changes update and save live in real time")
                .size((scale_sz(0.78)) as f32)
                .color(theme.text)
                .align_x(Alignment::Center),
        )
        .width(Length::Fill)
        .padding(Padding {
            top: 0.0,
            right: footer_inset,
            bottom: 0.0,
            left: footer_inset,
        });

        let card_content = container(
            column![
                header_row,
                tab_container,
                container(body_content)
                    .width(Length::Fill)
                    .height(Length::Fill)
                    .padding(8),
                footer_container,
            ]
            .spacing(12)
            .padding(20),
        )
        .width(Length::Fixed(card_w))
        .height(Length::Fixed(card_h));

        let card = Stack::new().push(card_bg.view()).push(card_content);

        container(card)
            .center_x(Length::Fill)
            .center_y(Length::Fill)
            .into()
    }
}

pub fn import_alarm_sound_file_to(
    src: &std::path::Path,
    dest_dir: &std::path::Path,
) -> Result<String, String> {
    if !src.is_file() {
        return Err(format!("sound file does not exist: {}", src.display()));
    }
    let filename = src
        .file_name()
        .and_then(|f| f.to_str())
        .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())
        .ok_or_else(|| "invalid sound filename".to_string())?;
    std::fs::create_dir_all(dest_dir).map_err(|e| format!("mkdir {}: {e}", dest_dir.display()))?;
    let dest = dest_dir.join(filename);
    std::fs::copy(src, &dest).map_err(|e| format!("copy to {}: {e}", dest.display()))?;
    eprintln!("[alarm-sound] imported {} -> {}", filename, dest.display());
    Ok(filename.to_string())
}

pub fn import_alarm_sound_file(src: &std::path::Path) -> Result<String, String> {
    let dest_dir = dirs::data_dir()
        .map(|d| d.join("moonbeauty").join("sounds"))
        .unwrap_or_else(|| std::path::PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("resources"));
    import_alarm_sound_file_to(src, &dest_dir)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::{import_alarm_sound_file_to, SettingsMessage, SettingsOverlay};
    use crate::libraries::config::settings::ShellSettings;

    #[test]
    fn import_alarm_sound_copies_file_and_updates_setting() {
        let dir = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
            "mbs-sound-test-{}",
            crate::libraries::process::random_token()
        ));
        let src_dir = dir.join("src");
        let dest_dir = dir.join("dest");
        std::fs::create_dir_all(&src_dir).unwrap();

        let missing = src_dir.join("missing.ogg");
        assert!(import_alarm_sound_file_to(&missing, &dest_dir).is_err());

        let src_file = src_dir.join("chime.ogg");
        std::fs::write(&src_file, b"OggS-test").unwrap();
        let name = import_alarm_sound_file_to(&src_file, &dest_dir).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(name, "chime.ogg");
        assert_eq!(std::fs::read(dest_dir.join("chime.ogg")).unwrap(), b"OggS-test");

        let mut settings = ShellSettings::default();
        let mut ov = SettingsOverlay::empty();
        ov.update(SettingsMessage::AlarmSoundImported(Some(name)), &mut settings);
        assert_eq!(settings.alarm_sound.as_deref(), Some("chime.ogg"));

        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir);
    }
}

/// Restrict URI-list ingestion to known-safe roots. Any same-user
/// process can `wl-copy file:///home/user/.ssh/id_rsa`, and the
/// clipboard cache would persist a 0600 copy. This confines ingestion
/// to content dirs (Pictures/Downloads/Documents/Desktop/Videos/Music)
/// and the shell's own mbs-tmp scratch. Symlinks are resolved via
/// canonicalize before the check; a symlink inside a safe root that
/// points outside is rejected.
fn is_safe_ingest_root(path: &std::path::Path) -> bool {
    let Ok(canon) = std::fs::canonicalize(path) else {
        return false;
    };
    let mut roots: Vec<std::path::PathBuf> = Vec::new();
    if let Some(home) = dirs::home_dir() {
        for sub in ["Pictures", "Downloads", "Documents", "Desktop", "Videos", "Music"] {
            roots.push(home.join(sub));
        }
    }
    if let Ok(rt) = std::env::var("XDG_RUNTIME_DIR") {
        roots.push(std::path::PathBuf::from(rt).join("mbs-tmp"));
    }
    roots.iter().any(|root| {
        std::fs::canonicalize(root)
            .ok()
            .is_some_and(|cr| canon.starts_with(&cr))
    })
}

pub fn run(args: &[String]) {
    if args.iter().any(|a| a == "--clipboard-ingest") {
        use std::io::Read;
        // 100 MB cap. stdin is untrusted (any same-user process can
        // pipe to wl-copy). Without this, `yes | wl-copy` buffers GB
        // into memory before we can react. Truncate silently — the
        // head of the paste is what the user wants.
        const MAX_INGEST: u64 = 100 * 1024 * 1024;
        let mut bytes = Vec::new();
        let mut limited = std::io::Read::take(std::io::stdin(), MAX_INGEST + 1);
        if limited.read_to_end(&mut bytes).is_ok() && !bytes.is_empty() {
            if bytes.len() as u64 > MAX_INGEST {
                bytes.truncate(MAX_INGEST as usize);
                eprintln!(
                    "[clipboard-ingest] truncated to {} MB",
                    MAX_INGEST / (1024 * 1024)
                );
            }
            let dir = dirs::data_dir()
                .unwrap_or_else(std::env::temp_dir)
                .join("moonbeauty")
                .join("clipboard");
            let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir);
            let index_path = dir.join("index.json");

            let id = std::time::SystemTime::now()
                .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
                .unwrap()
                .as_millis() as u64;

            // Detect images by Magic Bytes (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP)
            // JPEG XL: either the 12-byte container signature or a bare
            // codestream (starts with 0xFF 0x0A).
            let is_jxl = bytes.starts_with(&[0xFF, 0x0A])
                || bytes.starts_with(&[
                    0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x0C, 0x4A, 0x58, 0x4C, 0x20, 0x0D, 0x0A, 0x87, 0x0A,
                ]);
            let is_image = is_jxl
                || bytes.starts_with(&[0x89, 0x50, 0x4E, 0x47])
                || bytes.starts_with(&[0xFF, 0xD8, 0xFF])
                || bytes.starts_with(b"GIF89a")
                || bytes.starts_with(b"GIF87a")
                || (bytes.len() > 12 && bytes.starts_with(b"RIFF") && &bytes[8..12] == b"WEBP");

            let ext = if is_jxl {
                "jxl"
            } else if bytes.starts_with(&[0x89, 0x50, 0x4E, 0x47]) {
                "png"
            } else if bytes.starts_with(&[0xFF, 0xD8, 0xFF]) {
                "jpg"
            } else if bytes.starts_with(b"GIF89a") || bytes.starts_with(b"GIF87a") {
                "gif"
            } else if bytes.len() > 12 && bytes.starts_with(b"RIFF") && &bytes[8..12] == b"WEBP" {
                "webp"
            } else {
                "txt"
            };
            let path = dir.join(format!("{}.{}", id, ext));
            let _ = crate::libraries::process::private_write_file(&path, &bytes);

            // Pre-generate the 512x512 preview so the long-running UI
            // process never has to decode the full 4K image later.
            if is_image {
                let _ = crate::overlays::clipboard::ensure_image_preview(&path);
            }

            // URI-list ingest (annotator saves, file-manager copies).
            if bytes.starts_with(b"file:") {
                let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&bytes);
                let mut ingested = 0usize;
                for line in text.lines() {
                    let line = line.trim();
                    if line.is_empty() || line.starts_with('#') {
                        continue;
                    }
                    let path_str = line.strip_prefix("file://").unwrap_or(line);
                    let path = std::path::PathBuf::from(path_str);
                    if !path.is_file() {
                        continue;
                    }
                    if !is_safe_ingest_root(&path) {
                        eprintln!(
                            "[clipboard-ingest] reject URI outside safe roots: {}",
                            path.display()
                        );
                        continue;
                    }
                    if crate::overlays::clipboard::ClipboardOverlay::add_entry(&path, None)
                        .is_some()
                    {
                        ingested += 1;
                        eprintln!("[clipboard-ingest] URI: {}", path.display());
                    }
                }
                eprintln!("[clipboard-ingest] URI batch: {} new", ingested);
                std::process::exit(0);
            }

            let mut items: Vec<crate::overlays::clipboard::ClipItem> = Vec::new();
            if let Ok(content) = std::fs::read_to_string(&index_path) {
                if let Ok(parsed) = serde_json::from_str(&content) {
                    items = parsed;
                }
            }
            let mut text_preview = if is_image {
                String::new()
            } else {
                String::from_utf8_lossy(&bytes[..bytes.len().min(100)]).to_string()
            };

            if is_image {
                let name_file = crate::libraries::process::mbs_runtime_dir()
                    .join("mbs-last-clip-name.txt");
                if let Ok(txt) = std::fs::read_to_string(&name_file) {
                    text_preview = txt.trim().to_string();
                    let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&name_file);
                }
            }

            // Dedupe by content hash. `wl-paste --watch` can fire more
            // than once per wl-copy (fork-mode ownership change), which
            // previously produced N identical rows for one clipboard
            // write. Compare against the TOP entry only — inserting a
            // genuinely-new occurrence of the same content later still
            // works because it lands at items[0] and pushes the old one
            // down.
            let incoming_hash: String = {
                use sha2::Digest as _;
                format!("{:x}", sha2::Sha256::digest(&bytes))
            };

            // Backfill top entry's hash if missing (one-shot migration
            // for rows written before this patch).
            if let Some(top) = items.first_mut() {
                if top.content_hash.is_none() {
                    if let Some(p) =
                        crate::overlays::clipboard::ClipboardOverlay::get_file_path(
                            &dir, top.id,
                        )
                    {
                        if let Ok(b) = std::fs::read(&p) {
                            use sha2::Digest as _;
                            top.content_hash = Some(format!("{:x}", sha2::Sha256::digest(&b)));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            if items.first().and_then(|t| t.content_hash.as_deref()) == Some(incoming_hash.as_str())
            {
                eprintln!("[clipboard-ingest] duplicate content, skipping insert");
                // The mbs-last-clip-name.txt we may have read from the
                // first fire is already consumed; nothing left to do.
                std::process::exit(0);
            }

            items.insert(
                0,
                crate::overlays::clipboard::ClipItem {
                    id,
                    text: text_preview,
                    is_image,
                    content_hash: Some(incoming_hash),
                    source_path: None,
                    ext: Some(ext.to_string()),
                },
            );
            items.truncate(2000);

            if let Ok(json) = serde_json::to_string(&items) {
                let tmp = dir.join("index.json.tmp");
                if crate::libraries::process::private_write_file(&tmp, json.as_bytes()).is_ok()
                {
                    let _ = std::fs::rename(&tmp, &index_path);
                    // Purge AFTER successful write: if the write fails,
                    // the old index still references files we would
                    // have deleted.
                    crate::overlays::clipboard::ClipboardOverlay::purge_orphans(&dir, &items);
                    eprintln!(
                        "[clipboard-ingest] Saved {} items, is_image={}",
                        items.len(),
                        is_image
                    );
                }
            }
        }
        std::process::exit(0);
    }
}
