use iced::widget::{button, column, container, row, scrollable, text, text_input, Row, Stack};
use iced::{Alignment, Color, Element, Length, Padding};

use crate::libraries::config::settings::ShellSettings;
use crate::libraries::config::theme::ShellTheme;
use crate::libraries::style::shape_box::{AngledHexGeometry, ShapeBox, ShapeType};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize)]
pub struct ClipItem {
    pub id: u64,
    pub text: String,
    pub is_image: bool,
    /// SHA-256 of the raw ingested bytes. Used to skip duplicate inserts
    /// when `wl-paste --watch` fires more than once per wl-copy (fork-mode
    /// ownership change produces two events for the same payload).
    #[serde(default)]
    pub content_hash: Option<String>,
    /// Durable source file (archive for annotator saves,
    /// origin for external URI ingests). Re-paste prefers this.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub source_path: Option<std::path::PathBuf>,
    /// File extension (without dot) for the clipboard-dir copy.
    /// Set on new entries; absent on pre-patch entries. When present,
    /// `get_file_path_with_ext` uses it for a single stat instead of
    /// the 7-stat fallback loop — relevant at 1000+ entries where the
    /// list view would otherwise storm the filesystem.
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub ext: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum ClipboardMessage {
    SearchChanged(String),
    SelectEntry(u64),
    SelectNext,
    SelectPrev,
    CopySelected,
    CopyEntry(u64),
    DeleteEntry(u64),
    DeleteSelected,
    WipeAll,
    RunOcr(u64),
    SetFilter(ClipFilter),
    RevealImage(u64),
    Reloaded(Vec<ClipItem>),
    PreviewLoaded {
        id: u64,
        text: String,
        image_data: Option<(u32, u32, Vec<u8>)>,
    },
    Dismiss,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum ClipFilter {
    All,
    Text,
    Images,
}

// ── Payload dispatch ───────────────────────────────────────────────
// Firefox requests image/png for raw image bytes; JPEG/WebP/GIF/JXL
// blobs are silently ignored on paste. text/uri-list is universally
// accepted — the target loads the file via its own decoders
// (image.jxl.enabled covers JXL). Non-PNG is served as text/uri-list.

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Payload {
    UriList,
    Bytes(&'static str),
}

impl Payload {
    pub fn for_extension(ext: &str) -> Self {
        match ext.to_ascii_lowercase().as_str() {
            "jxl" | "webp" | "gif" | "bmp" => Self::UriList,
            "png" => Self::Bytes("image/png"),
            "jpg" | "jpeg" => Self::Bytes("image/jpeg"),
            // Text content: serve actual bytes as text/plain so
            // pasting a text entry yields the text, not a file:// URI.
            "txt" => Self::Bytes("text/plain;charset=utf-8"),
            _ => Self::UriList,
        }
    }
}

pub fn serve_uri_list(paths: &[std::path::PathBuf]) {
    if paths.is_empty() {
        return;
    }
    use std::io::Write;
    let body: String = paths
        .iter()
        .map(|p| format!("file://{}\n", p.display()))
        .collect();
    if let Ok(mut child) = std::process::Command::new("wl-copy")
        .args(["--type", "text/uri-list"])
        .stdin(std::process::Stdio::piped())
        .spawn()
    {
        if let Some(mut stdin) = child.stdin.take() {
            let _ = stdin.write_all(body.as_bytes());
        }
        let _ = child.wait();
    }
}

/// Ensure a persistent PNG companion exists for an image file,
/// resized to max 512px and saved as `{stem}.preview.png`.
pub fn ensure_image_preview(path: &std::path::Path) -> Option<std::path::PathBuf> {
    let ext = path
        .extension()
        .and_then(|e| e.to_str())
        .unwrap_or("")
        .to_ascii_lowercase();
    let png_path = path.with_extension("preview.png");
    if png_path.exists() {
        return Some(png_path);
    }

    const MAX_DIM: u32 = 512;

    let magick = crate::overlays::screenshot::magick_or_convert();

    if let Some(bin) = magick {
        // Write to a unique temp file IN THE SAME DIRECTORY as the final
        // output. Renaming across different filesystems (like /tmp to ~)
        // fails with EXDEV on Linux.
        let token = crate::libraries::process::random_token();
        let tmp_path = png_path.with_file_name(format!(".preview-{}.tmp.png", token));

        let status = std::process::Command::new(bin)
            .arg(path)
            .args(["-resize", "512x512>"])
            .arg(&tmp_path)
            .stdout(std::process::Stdio::null())
            .stderr(std::process::Stdio::null())
            .status();

        if status.map(|s| s.success()).unwrap_or(false) {
            if std::fs::rename(&tmp_path, &png_path).is_ok() {
                return Some(png_path);
            }
        }
        let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&tmp_path);
    }

    if ext == "jxl" {
        let token = crate::libraries::process::random_token();
        let tmp = png_path.with_file_name(format!(".preview-{}.tmp.png", token));
        let djxl_paths = ["djxl", "/run/current-system/sw/bin/djxl", "/usr/bin/djxl"];
        for djxl in djxl_paths {
            if std::process::Command::new(djxl)
                .arg(path)
                .arg(&tmp)
                .stdout(std::process::Stdio::null())
                .stderr(std::process::Stdio::null())
                .status()
                .map(|s| s.success())
                .unwrap_or(false)
            {
                if let Ok(img) = image::open(&tmp) {
                    let final_img = img.thumbnail(MAX_DIM, MAX_DIM);
                    let _ = final_img.save(&png_path);
                    let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&tmp);
                    return Some(png_path);
                }
            }
        }
        crate::overlays::screenshot::annotator::register_jxl_decoder();
    }

    let img = image::open(path).ok()?;
    let final_img = img.thumbnail(MAX_DIM, MAX_DIM);
    final_img.save(&png_path).ok()?;
    Some(png_path)
}

pub struct ClipboardOverlay {
    pub search_query: String,
    pub entries: Vec<ClipItem>,
    pub selected_id: Option<u64>,
    pub preview_text: String,
    pub preview_image_data: Option<(u32, u32, Vec<u8>)>,
    pub filter: ClipFilter,
}

impl Default for ClipboardOverlay {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

impl ClipboardOverlay {
    pub fn filtered_ids(&self) -> Vec<u64> {
        let q = self.search_query.to_lowercase();
        self.entries
            .iter()
            .filter(|e| match self.filter {
                ClipFilter::All => true,
                ClipFilter::Text => !e.is_image,
                ClipFilter::Images => e.is_image,
            })
            .filter(|e| q.is_empty() || e.text.to_lowercase().contains(&q))
            .map(|e| e.id)
            .collect()
    }

    /// Remove `selected_id` from `entries` and advance selection within `filtered_ids()`.
    /// Returns `Some((next_id, next_filtered_pos))` when another visible entry remains.
    pub fn delete_selected_in_memory(&mut self) -> Option<(u64, usize)> {
        let id = self.selected_id?;
        let vis_before = self.filtered_ids();
        let vis_pos = vis_before.iter().position(|&x| x == id);
        let pos = self.entries.iter().position(|e| e.id == id)?;
        self.entries.remove(pos);

        let vis_after = self.filtered_ids();
        if vis_after.is_empty() {
            self.selected_id = None;
            self.preview_text.clear();
            self.preview_image_data = None;
            None
        } else {
            let next_pos = vis_pos.map(|p| p.min(vis_after.len() - 1)).unwrap_or(0);
            let next_id = vis_after[next_pos];
            self.selected_id = Some(next_id);
            Some((next_id, next_pos))
        }
    }

    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            search_query: String::new(),
            entries: Vec::new(),
            selected_id: None,
            preview_text: String::new(),
            preview_image_data: None,
            filter: ClipFilter::All,
        }
    }

    /// Ingest a file into the index by reference. Used by annotator
    /// save and URI-list ingest. Sync — no tokio runtime needed.
    pub fn add_entry(source: &std::path::Path, display_name: Option<String>) -> Option<u64> {
        if !source.is_file() {
            return None;
        }
        // 100 MB cap. Annotation saves and URI-list ingests otherwise
        // load an arbitrarily large file into memory. Skip (do not
        // truncate) to preserve file integrity.
        const MAX_SOURCE_BYTES: u64 = 100 * 1024 * 1024;
        let file_size = source.metadata().map(|m| m.len()).unwrap_or(0);
        if file_size > MAX_SOURCE_BYTES {
            eprintln!(
                "[clipboard-add] skipping {} ({} MB exceeds {} MB cap)",
                source.display(),
                file_size / (1024 * 1024),
                MAX_SOURCE_BYTES / (1024 * 1024),
            );
            return None;
        }
        let bytes = std::fs::read(source).ok()?;
        if bytes.is_empty() {
            return None;
        }
        let hash = {
            use sha2::Digest as _;
            format!("{:x}", sha2::Sha256::digest(&bytes))
        };
        let dir = dirs::data_dir()
            .unwrap_or_else(std::env::temp_dir)
            .join("moonbeauty")
            .join("clipboard");
        std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).ok()?;
        let index_path = dir.join("index.json");
        let mut items: Vec<ClipItem> = std::fs::read_to_string(&index_path)
            .ok()
            .and_then(|s| serde_json::from_str(&s).ok())
            .unwrap_or_default();
        // Dedup: check the last 5 items. If the same hash exists and was
        // inserted within the last 5 seconds, it's a race condition duplicate.
        let now = std::time::SystemTime::now()
            .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
            .map(|d| d.as_millis() as u64)
            .unwrap_or(0);
        if items.iter().take(5).any(|t| {
            t.content_hash.as_deref() == Some(hash.as_str()) && (now.saturating_sub(t.id)) < 5000
        }) {
            return None;
        }
        let id = std::time::SystemTime::now()
            .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
            .map(|d| d.as_millis() as u64)
            .unwrap_or(0);
        let ext = source.extension().and_then(|e| e.to_str()).unwrap_or("bin");
        let is_image = matches!(
            ext.to_ascii_lowercase().as_str(),
            "jxl" | "png" | "jpg" | "jpeg" | "gif" | "webp" | "bmp"
        );
        let text = if is_image {
            display_name
                .or_else(|| source.file_name().map(|n| n.to_string_lossy().into_owned()))
                .unwrap_or_else(|| format!("Image {}", id))
        } else {
            String::from_utf8_lossy(&bytes[..bytes.len().min(100)]).to_string()
        };
        let ext_owned = ext.to_string();

        // Copy the file into the clipboard cache so it's self-contained.
        // std::fs::copy inherits the source file's mode, so chmod explicitly to 0600.
        let dest_path = dir.join(format!("{}.{}", id, ext));
        if std::fs::copy(source, &dest_path).is_err() {
            return None;
        }
        {
            use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt as _;
            if let Ok(meta) = std::fs::metadata(&dest_path) {
                let mut perms = meta.permissions();
                if perms.mode() & 0o777 != 0o600 {
                    perms.set_mode(0o600);
                    let _ = std::fs::set_permissions(&dest_path, perms);
                }
            }
        }

        // Pre-generate the 512x512 preview using the cached copy
        if is_image {
            let _ = ensure_image_preview(&dest_path);
        }

        items.insert(
            0,
            ClipItem {
                id,
                text,
                is_image,
                content_hash: Some(hash),
                source_path: Some(source.to_path_buf()),
                ext: Some(ext_owned),
            },
        );
        items.truncate(2000);
        let tmp = dir.join("index.json.tmp");
        crate::libraries::process::private_write_file(
            &tmp,
            serde_json::to_string(&items).ok()?.as_bytes(),
        )
        .ok()?;
        std::fs::rename(&tmp, &index_path).ok()?;
        // Purge AFTER successful write: if the write fails, the old
        // index still references files we would have deleted.
        Self::purge_orphans(&dir, &items);
        Some(id)
    }

    /// Resolve the preferred paste path: cache copy if present, else source_path.
    pub fn resolve_path(id: u64) -> Option<std::path::PathBuf> {
        let dir = dirs::data_dir()
            .unwrap_or_else(std::env::temp_dir)
            .join("moonbeauty")
            .join("clipboard");
        let index = std::fs::read_to_string(dir.join("index.json")).ok()?;
        let items: Vec<ClipItem> = serde_json::from_str(&index).ok()?;
        let item = items.into_iter().find(|i| i.id == id)?;
        // Prefer the self-contained clipboard copy
        if let Some(p) = Self::get_file_path_with_ext(&dir, id, item.ext.as_deref()) {
            return Some(p);
        }
        // Fallback to source_path if the cache was deleted
        if let Some(sp) = item.source_path {
            if sp.is_file() {
                return Some(sp);
            }
        }
        None
    }

    pub fn get_file_path(dir: &std::path::Path, id: u64) -> Option<std::path::PathBuf> {
        for ext in &["jxl", "png", "jpg", "gif", "webp", "txt", "bin"] {
            let p = dir.join(format!("{}.{}", id, ext));
            if p.exists() {
                return Some(p);
            }
        }
        None
    }

    /// Like `get_file_path` but uses a known extension for a single
    /// stat instead of walking the ext list. Falls back to the stat
    /// loop when `ext` is None or the ext-named file is missing.
    pub fn get_file_path_with_ext(
        dir: &std::path::Path,
        id: u64,
        ext: Option<&str>,
    ) -> Option<std::path::PathBuf> {
        if let Some(e) = ext {
            let p = dir.join(format!("{}.{}", id, e));
            if p.exists() {
                return Some(p);
            }
        }
        Self::get_file_path(dir, id)
    }

    /// Delete files whose numeric id is not referenced by any item in
    /// `items`. Called after successful index write. Skips non-numeric
    /// filenames (index.json, index.json.tmp, etc.).
    pub fn purge_orphans(dir: &std::path::Path, items: &[ClipItem]) {
        let live: std::collections::HashSet<u64> = items.iter().map(|i| i.id).collect();
        let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(dir) else {
            return;
        };
        let mut purged = 0u32;
        for entry in entries.flatten() {
            let name = entry.file_name();
            let Some(name_str) = name.to_str() else {
                continue;
            };
            let Some(dot) = name_str.find(".") else {
                continue;
            };
            let Ok(id) = name_str[..dot].parse::<u64>() else {
                continue;
            };
            if !live.contains(&id) && std::fs::remove_file(entry.path()).is_ok() {
                purged += 1;
            }
        }
        if purged > 0 {
            crate::dbg_log!("[clipboard] purged {} orphan file(s)", purged);
        }
    }

    pub async fn reload() -> Vec<ClipItem> {
        let dir = dirs::data_dir()
            .unwrap_or_else(std::env::temp_dir)
            .join("moonbeauty")
            .join("clipboard");
        let index_path = dir.join("index.json");

        let mut list = Vec::new();
        if let Ok(content) = std::fs::read_to_string(&index_path) {
            if let Ok(items) = serde_json::from_str::<Vec<ClipItem>>(&content) {
                for mut item in items {
                    if item.is_image {
                        if let Some(path) =
                            Self::get_file_path_with_ext(&dir, item.id, item.ext.as_deref())
                        {
                            if item.text.is_empty()
                                || item.text == "📸 Image"
                                || item.text.starts_with("📸 Image 1")
                            {
                                crate::overlays::screenshot::annotator::register_jxl_decoder();
                                if let Ok((w, h)) = ::image::image_dimensions(&path) {
                                    item.text = format!("📸 Image {}x{}", w, h);
                                } else {
                                    item.text = format!("📸 Image {}", item.id);
                                }
                            }
                        } else {
                            if item.text.is_empty() {
                                item.text = format!("📸 Image {}", item.id);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    list.push(item);
                }
            }
        }
        list
    }

    pub async fn load_preview(id: u64) -> (String, Option<(u32, u32, Vec<u8>)>) {
        let Some(path) = Self::resolve_path(id) else {
            return (String::new(), None);
        };
        let ext = path
            .extension()
            .and_then(|e| e.to_str())
            .unwrap_or("")
            .to_ascii_lowercase();
        if ext == "txt" || ext == "bin" {
            if let Ok(bytes) = std::fs::read(&path) {
                if let Ok(text) = String::from_utf8(bytes) {
                    return (text, None);
                }
            }
        }

        // Decode to RGBA bytes on a background thread so the UI thread
        // never has to load anything asynchronously.
        let path_clone = path.clone();
        let image_data = tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || {
            let preview_path = ensure_image_preview(&path_clone).unwrap_or(path_clone);
            let img = image::open(&preview_path).ok()?;
            let rgba = img.to_rgba8();
            let (w, h) = rgba.dimensions();
            Some((w, h, rgba.into_raw()))
        })
        .await
        .unwrap_or(None);

        (String::new(), image_data)
    }

    pub async fn copy(id: u64) {
        let Some(paste_path) = Self::resolve_path(id) else {
            return;
        };
        let ext = paste_path
            .extension()
            .and_then(|e| e.to_str())
            .unwrap_or("");
        let payload = Payload::for_extension(ext);
        use tokio::io::AsyncWriteExt;
        let (mime, body) = match payload {
            Payload::UriList => (
                "text/uri-list",
                format!("file://{}\n", paste_path.display()).into_bytes(),
            ),
            Payload::Bytes(m) => {
                let Ok(data) = std::fs::read(&paste_path) else {
                    return;
                };
                (m, data)
            }
        };
        let Ok(mut child) = tokio::process::Command::new("wl-copy")
            .args(["--type", mime])
            .stdin(std::process::Stdio::piped())
            .spawn()
        else {
            return;
        };
        if let Some(mut stdin) = child.stdin.take() {
            let _ = stdin.write_all(&body).await;
        }
        let _ = child.wait().await;
    }

    pub fn delete(id: u64) {
        let dir = dirs::data_dir()
            .unwrap_or_else(std::env::temp_dir)
            .join("moonbeauty")
            .join("clipboard");
        let index_path = dir.join("index.json");

        let mut ext_opt: Option<String> = None;
        if let Ok(content) = std::fs::read_to_string(&index_path) {
            if let Ok(mut items) = serde_json::from_str::<Vec<ClipItem>>(&content) {
                ext_opt = items.iter().find(|i| i.id == id).and_then(|i| i.ext.clone());
                items.retain(|i| i.id != id);
                if let Ok(new_json) = serde_json::to_string(&items) {
                    let tmp = dir.join("index.json.tmp");
                    if crate::libraries::process::private_write_file(&tmp, new_json.as_bytes())
                        .is_ok()
                    {
                        let _ = std::fs::rename(&tmp, &index_path);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if let Some(path) = Self::get_file_path_with_ext(&dir, id, ext_opt.as_deref()) {
            let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&path);
        }
        let _ = std::fs::remove_file(dir.join(format!("{}.preview.png", id)));
    }

    pub async fn wipe() {
        let dir = dirs::data_dir()
            .unwrap_or_else(std::env::temp_dir)
            .join("moonbeauty")
            .join("clipboard");
        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir);
    }

    pub async fn ocr(_id: u64) -> String {
        String::new() // OCR can be re-added via external tool if needed
    }

    pub fn view<'a>(
        &'a self,
        theme: &'a ShellTheme,
        settings: &ShellSettings,
    ) -> Element<'a, ClipboardMessage> {
        let is_image_selected = self
            .selected_id
            .and_then(|id| self.entries.iter().find(|e| e.id == id))
            .map(|e| e.is_image)
            .unwrap_or(false);

        let (win_w, win_h) = settings.get_window_size("clipboard", 1000, 700);
        let cut = theme.overlay_cut as u16;

        let cut_f = theme.overlay_cut;
        let angle_deg = theme.overlay_angle;
        let pad_top = 18.0_f32;
        let pad_bottom = 16.0_f32;
        let (search_inward, list_top_inset, list_bottom_inset, list_side_inset) =
            AngledHexGeometry::new(win_w, win_h, cut_f, angle_deg).search_list_insets();

        // Top Row
        let search_input = text_input("Search clipboard...", &self.search_query)
            .on_input(ClipboardMessage::SearchChanged)
            .padding(Padding {
                top: 12.0,
                right: 24.0,
                bottom: 12.0,
                left: 24.0,
            })
            .size((theme.font_size_overlay) as f32)
            .width(Length::Fill)
            .style(move |_t, _s| text_input::Style {
                background: iced::Background::Color(Color::TRANSPARENT),
                border: iced::Border::default(),
                icon: theme.muted,
                placeholder: theme.muted,
                value: theme.text,
                selection: theme.surface_alt,
            });

        let search_bg = ShapeBox::new()
            .shape(ShapeType::Hexagon { cut })
            .background(theme.background)
            .border(theme.border, theme.control_border_width)
            .size(Length::Fill, Length::Fixed(48.0));

        let search_bar = container(Stack::new().push(search_bg.view()).push(search_input))
            .height(Length::Fixed(48.0));

        let wipe_btn = button(
            container(
                text("Wipe")
                    .size((theme.font_size_overlay) as f32)
                    .color(theme.danger),
            )
            .center_y(Length::Fill)
            .center_x(Length::Fill),
        )
        .on_press(ClipboardMessage::WipeAll)
        .height(Length::Fixed(48.0))
        .width(Length::Fixed(100.0))
        .style(move |_t, _s| button::Style {
            background: Some(iced::Background::Color(Color::TRANSPARENT)),
            border: iced::Border::default(),
            ..Default::default()
        });

        let wipe_bg = ShapeBox::new()
            .shape(ShapeType::Hexagon { cut })
            .background(theme.background)
            .border(theme.danger, theme.control_border_width)
            .size(Length::Fixed(100.0), Length::Fixed(48.0));

        let wipe_bar = container(Stack::new().push(wipe_bg.view()).push(wipe_btn))
            .height(Length::Fixed(48.0))
            .width(Length::Fixed(100.0));

        let ocr_btn = button(
            container(text("OCR").size((theme.font_size_overlay) as f32).color(
                if is_image_selected {
                    theme.text
                } else {
                    theme.muted
                },
            ))
            .center_y(Length::Fill)
            .center_x(Length::Fill),
        )
        .on_press_maybe(Some(ClipboardMessage::RunOcr(
            self.selected_id.unwrap_or(0),
        )))
        .height(Length::Fixed(48.0))
        .width(Length::Fixed(80.0))
        .style(move |_t, _s| button::Style {
            background: Some(iced::Background::Color(Color::TRANSPARENT)),
            border: iced::Border::default(),
            ..Default::default()
        });

        let ocr_bg = ShapeBox::new()
            .shape(ShapeType::Hexagon { cut })
            .background(theme.background)
            .border(
                if is_image_selected {
                    theme.text
                } else {
                    theme.border
                },
                theme.control_border_width,
            )
            .size(Length::Fixed(80.0), Length::Fixed(48.0));

        let ocr_bar = container(Stack::new().push(ocr_bg.view()).push(ocr_btn))
            .height(Length::Fixed(48.0))
            .width(Length::Fixed(80.0));

        let mut top_row = Row::new().spacing(12).align_y(Alignment::Center);
        top_row = top_row.push(search_bar);
        top_row = top_row.push(ocr_bar);
        top_row = top_row.push(wipe_bar);

        let input_row = container(top_row).width(Length::Fill).padding(Padding {
            top: 0.0,
            right: search_inward,
            bottom: 0.0,
            left: search_inward,
        });

        // Bottom Row
        let mk_tab = |label: &'static str, filter: ClipFilter| -> Element<'a, ClipboardMessage> {
            let is_active = self.filter == filter;
            let bg = if is_active {
                theme.surface_alt
            } else {
                theme.background
            };
            let border = if is_active { theme.text } else { theme.border };
            let text_w = label.chars().count() as f32 * (theme.font_size_overlay as f32) * 0.6;
            let w = (text_w + (cut as f32 * 2.0) + 24.0).max(80.0);
            let shape = ShapeBox::new()
                .shape(ShapeType::Hexagon { cut })
                .background(bg)
                .border(border, theme.control_border_width)
                .size(Length::Fixed(w), Length::Fixed(48.0));
            button(
                Stack::new().push(shape.view()).push(
                    container(
                        text(label)
                            .size((theme.font_size_overlay) as f32)
                            .color(theme.text),
                    )
                    .center_x(Length::Fill)
                    .center_y(Length::Fill)
                    .width(Length::Fixed(w))
                    .height(Length::Fixed(48.0)),
                ),
            )
            .on_press(ClipboardMessage::SetFilter(filter))
            .padding(0)
            .style(|_t, _s| button::Style {
                background: None,
                ..Default::default()
            })
            .into()
        };

        let reveal_bg_col = if is_image_selected {
            theme.surface_alt
        } else {
            theme.background
        };
        let reveal_border_col = if is_image_selected {
            theme.text
        } else {
            theme.border
        };

        let reveal_text_w =
            "Reveal".chars().count() as f32 * (theme.font_size_overlay as f32) * 0.6;
        let reveal_w = (reveal_text_w + (cut as f32 * 2.0) + 24.0).max(80.0);

        let reveal_shape = ShapeBox::new()
            .shape(ShapeType::Hexagon { cut })
            .background(reveal_bg_col)
            .border(reveal_border_col, theme.control_border_width)
            .size(Length::Fixed(reveal_w), Length::Fixed(48.0));

        let reveal_btn = button(
            Stack::new().push(reveal_shape.view()).push(
                container(
                    text("Reveal")
                        .size((theme.font_size_overlay) as f32)
                        .color(theme.text),
                )
                .center_x(Length::Fill)
                .center_y(Length::Fill)
                .width(Length::Fixed(reveal_w))
                .height(Length::Fixed(48.0)),
            ),
        )
        .on_press_maybe(if is_image_selected {
            Some(ClipboardMessage::RevealImage(self.selected_id.unwrap_or(0)))
        } else {
            None
        })
        .padding(0)
        .style(|_t, _s| button::Style {
            background: None,
            ..Default::default()
        });

        let reveal_bar = container(reveal_btn)
            .height(Length::Fixed(48.0))
            .width(Length::Fixed(reveal_w));

        let mut bot_row = Row::new().spacing(12).align_y(Alignment::Center);
        bot_row = bot_row.push(mk_tab("Text", ClipFilter::Text));
        bot_row = bot_row.push(mk_tab("Images", ClipFilter::Images));
        bot_row = bot_row.push(reveal_bar);

        let filter_row = container(bot_row).width(Length::Fill).padding(Padding {
            top: 12.0,
            right: search_inward,
            bottom: 0.0,
            left: search_inward,
        });

        // Left Pane (List)
        let mut list_col = column![].spacing(8);
        for item in &self.entries {
            if let ClipFilter::Text = self.filter {
                if item.is_image {
                    continue;
                }
            } else if let ClipFilter::Images = self.filter {
                if !item.is_image {
                    continue;
                }
            }

            if !self.search_query.is_empty()
                && !item
                    .text
                    .to_lowercase()
                    .contains(&self.search_query.to_lowercase())
            {
                continue;
            }

            let is_sel = self.selected_id == Some(item.id);
            let border_color = if is_sel { theme.danger } else { theme.border };
            let text_color = if is_sel { theme.text } else { theme.text };

            let raw_text = item.text.lines().next().unwrap_or("").to_string();
            let display_text = if raw_text.chars().count() > 45 {
                let truncated: String = raw_text.chars().take(42).collect();
                format!("{}...", truncated)
            } else {
                raw_text
            };

            let mut item_row = row![].spacing(12).align_y(Alignment::Center);
            if item.is_image {
                item_row = item_row.push(
                    container(text("📸").size(16).color(theme.muted))
                        .width(Length::Fixed(40.0))
                        .height(Length::Fixed(40.0))
                        .center_x(Length::Fill)
                        .center_y(Length::Fill),
                );
            } else {
                item_row = item_row.push(text("■").size(10).color(theme.muted));
            }

            let text_container = container(
                text(display_text)
                    .size((theme.font_size_overlay) as f32)
                    .color(text_color),
            )
            .width(Length::Fill)
            .clip(true);
            item_row = item_row.push(text_container);

            let btn_content = container(item_row)
                .padding(Padding {
                    top: 0.0,
                    right: 24.0,
                    bottom: 0.0,
                    left: 24.0,
                })
                .width(Length::Fill)
                .height(Length::Fixed(56.0))
                .align_y(Alignment::Center);

            let item_bg = ShapeBox::new()
                .shape(ShapeType::Hexagon { cut })
                .background(theme.background)
                .border(border_color, theme.control_border_width)
                .size(Length::Fill, Length::Fixed(56.0));

            let item_btn = button(Stack::new().push(item_bg.view()).push(btn_content))
                .on_press(ClipboardMessage::SelectEntry(item.id))
                .width(Length::Fill)
                .height(Length::Fixed(56.0))
                .style(move |_t, _s| button::Style {
                    background: Some(iced::Background::Color(Color::TRANSPARENT)),
                    border: iced::Border::default(),
                    ..Default::default()
                });

            list_col = list_col.push(item_btn);
        }

        let left_pane = container(
            scrollable(list_col)
                .id(iced::widget::Id::new("clip_list"))
                .width(Length::Fill)
                .height(Length::Fill),
        )
        .width(Length::FillPortion(1))
        .height(Length::Fill)
        .clip(true)
        .padding(Padding {
            top: list_top_inset,
            right: 24.0,
            bottom: list_bottom_inset,
            left: list_side_inset,
        });

        // Right Pane (Preview)
        let inner_pad = cut_f + 4.0;
        let inner_padding = Padding {
            top: inner_pad,
            right: inner_pad,
            bottom: inner_pad,
            left: inner_pad,
        };

        let preview_content: Element<'a, ClipboardMessage> =
            if let Some((w, h, data)) = &self.preview_image_data {
                let handle = iced::widget::image::Handle::from_rgba(*w, *h, data.clone());
                container(
                    container(
                        iced::widget::image(handle)
                            .width(Length::Fill)
                            .content_fit(iced::ContentFit::Contain),
                    )
                    .padding(inner_padding)
                    .center_x(Length::Fill)
                    .center_y(Length::Fill)
                    .width(Length::Fill)
                    .height(Length::Fill),
                )
                .into()
            } else if !self.preview_text.is_empty() {
                container(
                    scrollable(
                        container(
                            text(&self.preview_text)
                                .size((theme.font_size_overlay) as f32)
                                .font(iced::Font::MONOSPACE)
                                .color(theme.text)
                                .wrapping(iced::widget::text::Wrapping::WordOrGlyph),
                        )
                        .width(Length::Fill),
                    )
                    .width(Length::Fill)
                    .height(Length::Fill),
                )
                .padding(inner_padding)
                .width(Length::Fill)
                .height(Length::Fill)
                .into()
            } else {
                container(
                    text("Select an entry to preview")
                        .size((theme.font_size_overlay) as f32)
                        .color(theme.muted),
                )
                .center_x(Length::Fill)
                .center_y(Length::Fill)
                .width(Length::Fill)
                .height(Length::Fill)
                .into()
            };

        let right_bg = ShapeBox::new()
            .shape(ShapeType::Hexagon { cut })
            .background(theme.background)
            .border(theme.border, theme.control_border_width)
            .size(Length::Fill, Length::Fill);

        let right_pane = container(Stack::new().push(right_bg.view()).push(preview_content))
            .width(Length::FillPortion(2))
            .clip(true)
            .height(Length::Fill)
            .clip(true);

        let content = column![
            input_row,
            filter_row,
            row![left_pane, right_pane]
                .spacing(16)
                .height(Length::Fill)
                .width(Length::Fill)
        ]
        .spacing(16)
        .padding(Padding {
            top: pad_top,
            right: 0.0,
            bottom: pad_bottom,
            left: 0.0,
        })
        .width(Length::Fixed(win_w))
        .height(Length::Fixed(win_h));

        let bg_shape = ShapeBox::new()
            .shape(ShapeType::Hexagon { cut })
            .background(theme.background)
            .border(theme.border, theme.control_border_width)
            .size(Length::Fixed(win_w), Length::Fixed(win_h));

        container(Stack::new().push(bg_shape.view()).push(content))
            .width(Length::Fill)
            .height(Length::Fill)
            .center_x(Length::Fill)
            .center_y(Length::Fill)
            .into()
    }
}

pub mod cli;

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::{ClipFilter, ClipItem, ClipboardOverlay, Payload};

    fn item(id: u64, text: &str, is_image: bool) -> ClipItem {
        ClipItem {
            id,
            text: text.into(),
            is_image,
            content_hash: None,
            source_path: None,
            ext: None,
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn delete_selected_stays_within_filtered_entries() {
        let mut ov = ClipboardOverlay::new();
        ov.entries = vec![
            item(1, "plain text one", false),
            item(2, "img alpha", true),
            item(3, "plain text two", false),
            item(4, "img beta", true),
            item(5, "img gamma", true),
        ];
        ov.filter = ClipFilter::Images;
        ov.selected_id = Some(4); // middle image (filtered pos 1)

        // Delete middle image -> moves to next image (5), NOT text item (3)
        assert_eq!(ov.delete_selected_in_memory(), Some((5, 1)));
        assert_eq!(ov.selected_id, Some(5));

        // Delete last image -> clamps to previous image (2)
        assert_eq!(ov.delete_selected_in_memory(), Some((2, 0)));
        assert_eq!(ov.selected_id, Some(2));

        // Delete only remaining image -> clears selection & preview
        ov.preview_text = "stale".into();
        assert_eq!(ov.delete_selected_in_memory(), None);
        assert_eq!(ov.selected_id, None);
        assert!(ov.preview_text.is_empty());
        // Text items remain untouched
        assert_eq!(ov.entries.len(), 2);
    }

    #[test]
    fn payload_dispatch_matches_extension() {
        assert_eq!(Payload::for_extension("png"), Payload::Bytes("image/png"));
        assert_eq!(Payload::for_extension("PNG"), Payload::Bytes("image/png"));
        assert_eq!(Payload::for_extension("jpg"), Payload::Bytes("image/jpeg"));
        assert_eq!(Payload::for_extension("txt"), Payload::Bytes("text/plain;charset=utf-8"));
        assert_eq!(Payload::for_extension("jxl"), Payload::UriList);
        assert_eq!(Payload::for_extension("webp"), Payload::UriList);
    }
}

/// Reject auto-opening attachments whose extension could yield code execution on double-click.
pub fn is_safe_to_auto_open(path: &std::path::Path) -> bool {
    // Default-deny allowlist: only known-safe media/doc formats auto-open.
    const ALLOW_EXT: &[&str] = &[
        "png", "jpg", "jpeg", "gif", "webp", "svg",
        "pdf", "txt", "md", "csv",
        "mp3", "mp4", "ogg", "webm", "flac",
    ];
    match path.extension().and_then(|s| s.to_str()) {
        Some(ext) => ALLOW_EXT.iter().any(|a| ext.eq_ignore_ascii_case(a)),
        None => false,
    }
}

    pub fn new() -> Self {
