use chrono::Local;
use iced::widget::{button, column, container, row, scrollable, text, text_input, Stack};
use iced::{Alignment, Element, Length, Padding};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::fs;
use std::path::PathBuf;

use crate::libraries::config::settings::ShellSettings;
use crate::libraries::config::theme::ShellTheme;
use crate::libraries::style::shape_box::{AngledHexGeometry, ShapeBox, ShapeType};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct NoteItem {
    pub id: u64,
    pub content: String,
    pub ts: String,
}

pub const NOTES_INPUT_ID: &str = "notes_input";

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum SortMode {
    Alphabetical,
    Newest,
    Oldest,
}

impl SortMode {
    fn next(self) -> Self {
        match self {
            SortMode::Alphabetical => SortMode::Newest,
            SortMode::Newest => SortMode::Oldest,
            SortMode::Oldest => SortMode::Alphabetical,
        }
    }
    fn label(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            SortMode::Alphabetical => "A-Z",
            SortMode::Newest => "Newest",
            SortMode::Oldest => "Oldest",
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum NotesMessage {
    SearchOrNewChanged(String),
    AddNote,
    DeleteNote(u64),
    CopyNote(String),
    SelectNext,
    SelectPrev,
    DeleteSelected,
    CycleSortMode,
    Refocus,
    Dismiss,
}

pub struct NotesOverlay {
    pub input_text: String,
    pub notes: Vec<NoteItem>,
    pub selected_id: Option<u64>,
    pub sort_mode: SortMode,
}

impl Default for NotesOverlay {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

impl NotesOverlay {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            input_text: String::new(),
            notes: Self::load(),
            selected_id: None,
            sort_mode: SortMode::Newest,
        }
    }

    pub fn empty() -> Self {
        Self {
            input_text: String::new(),
            notes: Vec::new(),
            selected_id: None,
            sort_mode: SortMode::Newest,
        }
    }

    fn visible_notes(&self) -> Vec<u64> {
        let query = self.input_text.trim().to_lowercase();
        let mut notes: Vec<&NoteItem> = self
            .notes
            .iter()
            .filter(|n| {
                query.is_empty()
                    || n.content.to_lowercase().contains(&query)
                    || n.ts.contains(&query)
            })
            .collect();
        match self.sort_mode {
            SortMode::Alphabetical => notes.sort_by_key(|a| a.content.to_lowercase()),
            SortMode::Newest => notes.sort_by_key(|x| std::cmp::Reverse(x.id)),
            SortMode::Oldest => notes.sort_by_key(|a| a.id),
        }
        notes.into_iter().map(|n| n.id).collect()
    }

    fn delete_note_advance(&mut self, id: u64) {
        let was_selected = self.selected_id == Some(id);
        let visible_before = self.visible_notes();
        let pos = visible_before.iter().position(|v| *v == id);

        self.notes.retain(|n| n.id != id);
        self.save();

        if !was_selected {
            return;
        }

        let visible_after = self.visible_notes();
        if visible_after.is_empty() {
            self.selected_id = None;
        } else {
            let new_pos = pos.map(|p| p.min(visible_after.len() - 1)).unwrap_or(0);
            self.selected_id = Some(visible_after[new_pos]);
        }
    }

    fn storage_path() -> PathBuf {
        let base = dirs::data_dir().unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from("/tmp"));
        base.join("moonbeauty").join("notes.json")
    }

    pub fn load() -> Vec<NoteItem> {
        let path = Self::storage_path();
        if path.exists() {
            if let Ok(raw) = fs::read_to_string(&path) {
                if let Ok(items) = serde_json::from_str::<Vec<NoteItem>>(&raw) {
                    return items;
                }
            }
        }
        Vec::new()
    }

    pub fn save(&self) {
        let path = Self::storage_path();
        if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
            let _ = fs::create_dir_all(parent);
        }
        if let Ok(data) = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&self.notes) {
            let tmp = path.with_extension("tmp");
            if crate::libraries::process::private_write_file(&tmp, data.as_bytes()).is_ok() {
                let _ = fs::rename(tmp, path);
            }
        }
    }

    pub fn update(&mut self, message: NotesMessage) {
        match message {
            NotesMessage::SearchOrNewChanged(val) => {
                self.input_text = val;
            }
            NotesMessage::AddNote => {
                let clean = self.input_text.trim();
                if !clean.is_empty() {
                    let max_id = self.notes.iter().map(|n| n.id).max().unwrap_or(0);
                    let ts = Local::now().format("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M").to_string();
                    self.notes.insert(
                        0,
                        NoteItem {
                            id: max_id + 1,
                            content: clean.to_string(),
                            ts,
                        },
                    );
                    self.input_text.clear();
                    self.save();
                }
            }
            NotesMessage::DeleteNote(id) => {
                self.delete_note_advance(id);
            }
            NotesMessage::CopyNote(_) => {}
            NotesMessage::SelectNext => {
                let visible = self.visible_notes();
                if visible.is_empty() {
                    return;
                }
                let cur = self
                    .selected_id
                    .and_then(|id| visible.iter().position(|v| *v == id));
                self.selected_id = Some(match cur {
                    None => visible[0],
                    Some(i) => visible[(i + 1) % visible.len()],
                });
            }
            NotesMessage::SelectPrev => {
                let visible = self.visible_notes();
                if visible.is_empty() {
                    return;
                }
                let cur = self
                    .selected_id
                    .and_then(|id| visible.iter().position(|v| *v == id));
                self.selected_id = Some(match cur {
                    Some(0) | None => visible[visible.len() - 1],
                    Some(i) => visible[i - 1],
                });
            }
            NotesMessage::DeleteSelected => {
                if !self.input_text.is_empty() {
                    return;
                }
                if let Some(id) = self.selected_id {
                    self.delete_note_advance(id);
                }
            }
            NotesMessage::CycleSortMode => {
                self.sort_mode = self.sort_mode.next();
            }
            NotesMessage::Refocus => {}
            NotesMessage::Dismiss => {}
        }
    }

    pub fn view<'a>(
        &'a self,
        theme: &'a ShellTheme,
        settings: &ShellSettings,
    ) -> Element<'a, NotesMessage> {
        let (win_w, win_h) = settings.get_window_size("notes", 840, 650);

        let cut_f = theme.overlay_cut;
        let angle_deg = theme.overlay_angle;
        let pad_top = 20.0_f32;
        let pad_bottom = 20.0_f32;
        let (header_inset, body_inset, footer_inset) =
            AngledHexGeometry::new(win_w, win_h, cut_f, angle_deg).standard_insets();

        let input = text_input("Type note to save [Enter to add]...", &self.input_text)
            .id(NOTES_INPUT_ID)
            .on_input(NotesMessage::SearchOrNewChanged)
            .on_submit(NotesMessage::AddNote)
            .padding(Padding {
                top: 18.0,
                bottom: 18.0,
                left: 20.0,
                right: 20.0,
            })
            .size(theme.font_size_overlay as f32);

        let visible_ids = self.visible_notes();
        let mut list_col = column![].spacing(8);

        for id in &visible_ids {

use crate::libraries::config::settings::ShellSettings;

use crate::libraries::style::shape_box::{AngledHexGeometry, ShapeBox, ShapeType, SlantSide};

pub const DICT_SEARCH_ID: &str = "dict_search";

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct MeaningEntry {
    pub part_of_speech: String,
    pub definition: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum DictMessage {
    InputChanged(String),
    SearchWord,
    DefinitionsLoaded(String, Vec<MeaningEntry>),
    CopyDefinition(String),
    Dismiss,
    Refocus,
}

pub struct DictionaryOverlay {
    pub word_query: String,
    pub active_definitions: Vec<MeaningEntry>,
    pub cache: HashMap<String, Vec<MeaningEntry>>,
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
struct ApiResponse {
    meanings: Option<Vec<ApiMeaning>>,
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
struct ApiMeaning {
    #[serde(rename = "partOfSpeech")]
    part_of_speech: Option<String>,
    definitions: Option<Vec<ApiDef>>,
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
struct ApiDef {
    definition: Option<String>,
}

impl Default for DictionaryOverlay {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

impl DictionaryOverlay {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            word_query: String::new(),
            active_definitions: Vec::new(),
            cache: Self::load_cache(),
        }
    }

    pub fn empty() -> Self {
        Self {
            word_query: String::new(),
            active_definitions: Vec::new(),
            cache: HashMap::new(),
        }
    }

    fn cache_path() -> PathBuf {
        // Keep dictionary cache out of world-readable /tmp.
        dirs::cache_dir()
            .expect(
                "XDG_CACHE_HOME or HOME must be set; refusing to persist dictionary cache to /tmp",
            )
            .join("moonbeauty_dict_cache.json")
    }

    pub fn load_cache() -> HashMap<String, Vec<MeaningEntry>> {
        // 8 MB cap.
        crate::libraries::process::read_json_capped::<HashMap<String, Vec<MeaningEntry>>>(
            &Self::cache_path(),
            8 * 1024 * 1024,
        )
        .unwrap_or_default()
    }

    fn save_cache(&self) {
        let path = Self::cache_path();
        if let Ok(data) = serde_json::to_string(&self.cache) {
            let _ = fs::write(path, data);
        }
    }

    pub fn update(&mut self, message: DictMessage) {
        match message {
            DictMessage::InputChanged(w) => {
                self.word_query = w;
            }
            DictMessage::DefinitionsLoaded(word, defs) => {
                self.active_definitions = defs.clone();
                self.cache.insert(word.to_lowercase(), defs);
                self.save_cache();
            }
            DictMessage::CopyDefinition(def) => {
                tokio::spawn(async move {
                    let _ = Command::new("wl-copy").arg(&def).status().await;
                    let _ = Command::new("notify-send")
                        .args(["-a", "Dictionary", "Definition Copied", &def])
                        .spawn();
                });
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }

    pub async fn lookup_word(word: &str) -> Vec<MeaningEntry> {
        let clean = word.trim().to_lowercase();
        if clean.is_empty() {
            return Vec::new();
        }

        let url = format!("https://api.dictionaryapi.dev/api/v2/entries/en/{}", clean);
        let Ok(out) = Command::new("curl")
            .args(["-s", "--max-time", "5", &url])
            .output()
            .await
        else {
            return Vec::new();
        };

        let mut results = Vec::new();
        if let Ok(api_list) = serde_json::from_slice::<Vec<ApiResponse>>(&out.stdout) {
            for entry in api_list {
                if let Some(meanings) = entry.meanings {
                    for m in meanings {
                        let pos = m.part_of_speech.unwrap_or_else(|| "word".into());
                        if let Some(defs) = m.definitions {
                            for d in defs {
                                if let Some(def_text) = d.definition {
                                    results.push(MeaningEntry {
                                        part_of_speech: pos.clone(),
                                        definition: def_text,
                                    });
                                    if results.len() >= 12 {
                                        return results;
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        results
    }

    pub fn view<'a>(
        &'a self,
        theme: &'a ShellTheme,
        settings: &ShellSettings,
    ) -> Element<'a, DictMessage> {
        let (win_w, win_h) = settings.get_window_size("dictionary", 820, 600);

        let cut_f = theme.overlay_cut;
        let angle_deg = theme.overlay_angle;
        let pad_top = 18.0_f32;
        let pad_bottom = 16.0_f32;
        let (search_inward, list_top_inset, list_bottom_inset, list_side_inset) =
            AngledHexGeometry::new(win_w, win_h, cut_f, angle_deg).search_list_insets();

        let input = text_input("Type a word and press Enter...", &self.word_query)
            .id(DICT_SEARCH_ID)
            .on_input(DictMessage::InputChanged)
            .on_submit(DictMessage::SearchWord)
            .padding(Padding {
                top: 12.0,
                right: 24.0,
                bottom: 12.0,
                left: 24.0,
            })
            .size((theme.font_size_overlay) as f32)
            .width(Length::Fill)
            .style(move |_t, status| text_input::Style {
                background: iced::Background::Color(theme.surface_alt),
                border: iced::Border {
                    color: match status {
                        text_input::Status::Focused { .. } => theme.focus,
                        text_input::Status::Hovered => theme.border,
                        _ => theme.border,
                    },
                    width: theme.control_border_width,
                    radius: 8.0.into(),
                },
                icon: theme.muted,
                placeholder: theme.muted,
                value: theme.text,
                selection: theme.focus,
            });

        let input_row = container(input).width(Length::Fill).padding(Padding {

            bottom: 0.0,
            left: search_inward,
        });

        // Slanted definition rows
        let mut list_col = column![].spacing(6).width(Length::Fill);

pub const PASS_SEARCH_ID: &str = "pass_search";

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum PassMessage {
    SearchChanged(String),
    CopyKey(String),
    Dismiss,
    Refocus,
}

pub struct PassOverlay {
    pub search_query: String,
    pub all_keys: Vec<String>,
    pub filtered_keys: Vec<String>,
}

impl Default for PassOverlay {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

impl PassOverlay {
    /// Cheap constructor — no filesystem walk. Used when the pass
    /// overlay is not the target (spawning for another overlay).
    pub fn empty() -> Self {
        Self {
            search_query: String::new(),
            filtered_keys: Vec::new(),
            all_keys: Vec::new(),
        }
    }

    pub fn new() -> Self {
        let all_keys = Self::scan_passwords();
        Self {
            search_query: String::new(),
            filtered_keys: all_keys.clone(),
            all_keys,
        }
    }

    pub fn scan_passwords() -> Vec<String> {
        let store_dir = std::env::var("PASSWORD_STORE_DIR")
            .map(PathBuf::from)
            .unwrap_or_else(|_| {
                dirs::home_dir()
                    .unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from("/tmp"))
                    .join(".password-store")
            });

        let mut keys = Vec::new();
        if !store_dir.exists() {
            return keys;
        }

        for entry in WalkDir::new(&store_dir).into_iter().flatten() {
            let path = entry.path();
            if path.is_file() && path.extension().and_then(|s| s.to_str()) == Some("gpg") {
                if let Ok(rel) = path.strip_prefix(&store_dir) {
                    let mut s = rel.to_string_lossy().to_string();
                    if s.ends_with(".gpg") {
                        s.truncate(s.len() - 4);
                        if !s.starts_with(".git") {
                            keys.push(s);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        keys.sort();
        keys
    }

    pub fn update(&mut self, message: PassMessage) {
        if let PassMessage::SearchChanged(q) = message {
            self.search_query = q.clone();
            let lower = q.trim().to_lowercase();
            if lower.is_empty() {
                self.filtered_keys = self.all_keys.clone();
            } else {
                self.filtered_keys = self
                    .all_keys
                    .iter()
                    .filter(|k| k.to_lowercase().contains(&lower))
                    .cloned()
                    .collect();
            }
        }
    }

    pub fn view<'a>(
        &'a self,
        theme: &'a ShellTheme,
        settings: &ShellSettings,
    ) -> Element<'a, PassMessage> {
        let (win_w, win_h) = settings.get_window_size("pass", 820, 600);

        let cut_f = theme.overlay_cut;
        let angle_deg = theme.overlay_angle;
        let pad_top = 18.0_f32;
        let pad_bottom = 16.0_f32;
        let (search_inward, list_top_inset, list_bottom_inset, list_side_inset) =
            AngledHexGeometry::new(win_w, win_h, cut_f, angle_deg).search_list_insets();

        // Themed search input
        let input = text_input("Search password store...", &self.search_query)
            .id(PASS_SEARCH_ID)
            .on_input(PassMessage::SearchChanged)
            .on_submit(if let Some(first) = self.filtered_keys.first() {
                PassMessage::CopyKey(first.clone())
            } else {
                PassMessage::Dismiss
            })
            .padding(Padding {
                top: 12.0,
                right: 24.0,
                bottom: 12.0,
                left: 24.0,
            })
            .size((theme.font_size_overlay) as f32)
            .width(Length::Fill)
            .style(move |_t, status| text_input::Style {
                background: iced::Background::Color(theme.surface_alt),
                border: iced::Border {
                    color: match status {
                        text_input::Status::Focused { .. } => theme.focus,
                        text_input::Status::Hovered => theme.border,
                        _ => theme.border,
                    },
                    width: theme.control_border_width,
                    radius: 8.0.into(),
                },
                icon: theme.muted,
                placeholder: theme.muted,
                value: theme.text,
                selection: theme.focus,
            });

        let input_row = container(input).width(Length::Fill).padding(Padding {
            top: 0.0,
            right: search_inward,
            bottom: 0.0,
            left: search_inward,
        });

        // Slanted list of pass entries
        let mut list_col = column![].spacing(6).width(Length::Fill);
        for key in self.filtered_keys.iter().take(50) {
            let k_clone = key.clone();

            let item_bg = ShapeBox::new()
                .shape(ShapeType::Slant {
                    left: SlantSide::Left,

                })

                .padding(0)

            top: list_top_inset,
            right: list_side_inset,
            bottom: list_bottom_inset,

use iced::widget::{column, container, text, text_input, Stack};
use iced::{Alignment, Element, Length, Padding};
use tokio::process::Command;

use crate::libraries::config::settings::ShellSettings;
use crate::libraries::config::theme::ShellTheme;
use crate::libraries::style::shape_box::{AngledHexGeometry, ShapeBox, ShapeType};

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum CalcMessage {
    InputChanged(String),
    CopyResult(String),
    Dismiss,
    Refocus,
}

pub const CALC_INPUT_ID: &str = "calc_input";

pub struct CalculatorOverlay {
    pub input_text: String,
    pub result_text: String,
}

impl Default for CalculatorOverlay {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

impl CalculatorOverlay {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            input_text: String::new(),
            result_text: String::new(),
        }
    }

    pub fn new_with_input(expr: &str) -> Self {
        let expr = expr.to_string();
        let result = Self::evaluate(&expr);
        Self {
            input_text: expr,
            result_text: result,
        }
    }

    pub fn update(&mut self, message: CalcMessage) {
        if let CalcMessage::InputChanged(val) = message {
            self.input_text = val.clone();
            self.result_text = Self::evaluate(&val);
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate(expr: &str) -> String {
        let clean = expr.trim().trim_start_matches('=').trim();
        if clean.is_empty() {
            return String::new();
        }

        if let Some(res) = Self::eval_units(clean) {
            return res;
        }

        match Self::eval_math(clean) {
            Ok(v) => format!("{:.6}", v)
                .trim_end_matches('0')
                .trim_end_matches('.')
                .to_string(),
            Err(_) => "Syntax Error".to_string(),
        }
    }

    fn eval_math(expr: &str) -> Result<f64, ()> {
        let mut tokens = Vec::new();
        let mut num_buf = String::new();

        for c in expr.chars() {
            if c.is_ascii_digit() || c == '.' {
                num_buf.push(c);
            } else {
                if !num_buf.is_empty() {
                    tokens.push(num_buf.clone());
                    num_buf.clear();
                }
                if !c.is_whitespace() {
                    tokens.push(c.to_string());
                }
            }
        }
        if !num_buf.is_empty() {
            tokens.push(num_buf);
        }

        let mut it = tokens.iter().peekable();
        Self::parse_expr(&mut it)
    }

    fn parse_expr<'a>(
        it: &mut std::iter::Peekable<std::slice::Iter<'a, String>>,
    ) -> Result<f64, ()> {
        let mut left = Self::parse_term(it)?;
        while let Some(&op) = it.peek() {
            if op == "+" {
                it.next();
                left += Self::parse_term(it)?;
            } else if op == "-" {
                it.next();
                left -= Self::parse_term(it)?;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
        Ok(left)
    }

    fn parse_term<'a>(
        it: &mut std::iter::Peekable<std::slice::Iter<'a, String>>,
    ) -> Result<f64, ()> {
        let mut left = Self::parse_factor(it)?;
        while let Some(&op) = it.peek() {
            if op == "*" {
                it.next();
                left *= Self::parse_factor(it)?;
            } else if op == "/" {
                it.next();
                let denom = Self::parse_factor(it)?;
                if denom == 0.0 {
                    return Err(());
                }
                left /= denom;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
        Ok(left)
    }

    fn parse_factor<'a>(
        it: &mut std::iter::Peekable<std::slice::Iter<'a, String>>,
    ) -> Result<f64, ()> {
        let token = it.next().ok_or(())?;
        if token == "(" {
            let val = Self::parse_expr(it)?;
            if it.next().map(|s| s.as_str()) != Some(")") {
                return Err(());
            }
            Ok(val)
        } else if token == "-" {
            Ok(-Self::parse_factor(it)?)
        } else {
            token.parse::<f64>().map_err(|_| ())
        }
    }

    fn eval_units(expr: &str) -> Option<String> {
        let parts: Vec<&str> = expr.split_whitespace().collect();
        if parts.len() == 4
            && (parts[2].eq_ignore_ascii_case("in") || parts[2].eq_ignore_ascii_case("to"))
        {
            let val = parts[0].parse::<f64>().ok()?;
            let from = parts[1].to_lowercase();
            let to = parts[3].to_lowercase();

            if from == "c" && to == "f" {
                return Some(format!("{:.2} °F", val * 9.0 / 5.0 + 32.0));
            } else if from == "f" && to == "c" {
                return Some(format!("{:.2} °C", (val - 32.0) * 5.0 / 9.0));
            } else if from == "kg" && to == "lbs" {
                return Some(format!("{:.2} lbs", val * 2.20462));
            } else if from == "lbs" && to == "kg" {
                return Some(format!("{:.2} kg", val / 2.20462));
            } else if from == "km" && to == "mi" {
                return Some(format!("{:.2} mi", val * 0.621371));
            } else if from == "mi" && to == "km" {
                return Some(format!("{:.2} km", val / 0.621371));
            }
        }
        None
    }

    pub async fn copy_to_clipboard(val: &str) {
        if val.is_empty() {
            return;
        }
        let _ = Command::new("wl-copy").arg(val).status().await;
        let _ = Command::new("notify-send")
            .args(["-a", "Calculator", "Copied to Clipboard", val])
            .spawn();
    }

    }

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]

pub struct ReminderEntry {
    pub id: u64,
    pub target_epoch: i64,
    pub text: String,
    pub target_str: String,
    pub alerted: bool,
    #[serde(default = "default_true")]
    pub play_sound: bool,
}

fn default_true() -> bool {
    true
}

pub const REMINDER_TASK_ID: &str = "rem_task";
pub const REMINDER_WHEN_ID: &str = "rem_when";

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum ReminderMessage {
    TaskInputChanged(String),
    WhenInputChanged(String),
    QuickWhen(String),
    ScrollUp,
    ScrollDown,
    SelectFirst,
    SelectLast,
    FocusNextField,
    FocusPrevField,
    DeleteSelected,
    Tick,
    InitialFocus,
    Refocus,
    AddReminder,
    DeleteReminder(u64),
    ToggleSound(u64),
    ToggleSoundSelected,
    Dismiss,
}

pub struct RemindersOverlay {
    pub task_text: String,
    pub when_text: String,
    pub entries: Vec<ReminderEntry>,
    pub scroll_y: f32,
    pub active_field: usize, // 0 = task, 1 = when
    pub selected_idx: Option<usize>,
}

impl Default for RemindersOverlay {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

impl RemindersOverlay {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            task_text: String::new(),
            when_text: String::new(),
            entries: Self::load(),
            scroll_y: 0.0,
            active_field: 0,
            selected_idx: None,
        }
    }

    pub fn empty() -> Self {
        Self {
            task_text: String::new(),
            when_text: String::new(),
            entries: Vec::new(),
            scroll_y: 0.0,
            active_field: 0,
            selected_idx: None,
        }
    }

    pub fn storage_path() -> PathBuf {
        let base = crate::libraries::process::mbs_runtime_dir();
        let mbs = base.join("moon_reminders.json");
        let qs = base.join("quickshell_reminders.json");
        // One-time migration from Quickshell. The QML backend wrote to
        // XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/quickshell_reminders.json; if that exists but
        // our file doesn't, copy it over so users don't lose their timers.
        if !mbs.exists() && qs.exists() {
            match fs::copy(&qs, &mbs) {
                Ok(n) => eprintln!("[reminders] migrated {} bytes from quickshell", n),
                Err(e) => eprintln!("[reminders] migration failed: {e}"),
            }
        }
        mbs
    }

    pub fn load() -> Vec<ReminderEntry> {
        // 4 MB cap.
        crate::libraries::process::read_json_capped::<Vec<ReminderEntry>>(
            &Self::storage_path(),
            4 * 1024 * 1024,
        )
        .unwrap_or_default()
    }

    pub fn save(&self) {
        let path = Self::storage_path();
        if let Ok(data) = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&self.entries) {
            let tmp = path.with_extension("tmp");
            if crate::libraries::process::private_write_file(&tmp, data.as_bytes()).is_ok() {
                let _ = fs::rename(tmp, path);
            }
        }
    }

    pub fn parse_when(when_expr: &str) -> (i64, String) {
        let now = Local::now();
        let expr = when_expr.trim().to_lowercase();

        let mut minutes: i64 = 0;
        let mut is_relative = false;

        if !expr.contains("am") && !expr.contains("pm") {
            let compact = expr.replace(' ', "");

            if let Some(h_pos) = compact.find('h') {
                if let Ok(h) = compact[..h_pos].parse::<i64>() {
                    minutes += h * 60;
                    is_relative = true;
                }
            }

            let start = if let Some(h_pos) = compact.find('h') {
                h_pos + 1
            } else {
                0
            };
            if let Some(m_pos) = compact[start..].find('m') {
                let abs_m_pos = start + m_pos;
                if let Ok(m) = compact[start..abs_m_pos].parse::<i64>() {
                    minutes += m;
                    is_relative = true;
                }
            }
        }

        if is_relative && minutes > 0 {
            let target = now + Duration::minutes(minutes);
            return (
                target.timestamp(),
                target.format("%a, %b %d %I:%M %p").to_string(),
            );
        }

        let is_tomorrow = expr.contains("tomorrow");
        let target_date = if is_tomorrow {
            now.date_naive() + Duration::days(1)
        } else {
            now.date_naive()
        };

        if let Some(time_part) = expr
            .split_whitespace()
            .find(|s| s.contains(':') || s.ends_with("am") || s.ends_with("pm"))
        {
            let mut hour = 9;
            let mut min = 0;

            if let Some((h_str, m_str)) = time_part.split_once(':') {
                let is_pm = m_str.ends_with("pm");
                let is_am = m_str.ends_with("am");
                let clean_m = m_str.trim_end_matches("am").trim_end_matches("pm");
                hour = h_str.parse().unwrap_or(9);
                min = clean_m.parse().unwrap_or(0);
                if is_pm && hour < 12 {
                    hour += 12;
                }
                if is_am && hour == 12 {
                    hour = 0;
                }
            } else if time_part.ends_with("pm") {
                hour = time_part.trim_end_matches("pm").parse().unwrap_or(9);
                if hour < 12 {
                    hour += 12;
                }
            } else if time_part.ends_with("am") {
                hour = time_part.trim_end_matches("am").parse().unwrap_or(9);
                if hour == 12 {
                    hour = 0;
                }
            }

            if let Some(target) = target_date.and_hms_opt(hour, min, 0) {
                let local_target = target.and_local_timezone(Local).unwrap();
                return (
                    local_target.timestamp(),
                    local_target.format("%a, %b %d %I:%M %p").to_string(),
                );
            }
        }

        let fallback = now + Duration::minutes(30);
        (
            fallback.timestamp(),
            fallback.format("%a, %b %d %I:%M %p").to_string(),
        )
    }

    pub fn cycle_focus_forward(&mut self) {
        self.active_field = (self.active_field + 1) % 2;
    }

    pub fn cycle_focus_backward(&mut self) {
        self.active_field = if self.active_field == 0 { 1 } else { 0 };
    }

    pub fn update(&mut self, message: ReminderMessage) {
        match message {
            ReminderMessage::TaskInputChanged(txt) => {
                self.task_text = txt;
            }
            ReminderMessage::WhenInputChanged(w) => {
                self.when_text = w;
            }
            ReminderMessage::QuickWhen(w) => {
                self.when_text = w;
            }
            ReminderMessage::AddReminder => {
                let t = self.task_text.trim();
                let w = self.when_text.trim();
                if t.is_empty() && w.is_empty() {
                    // Both inputs empty → Enter means "toggle sound on the
                    // selected reminder", matching the footer hint.
                    self.update(ReminderMessage::ToggleSoundSelected);
                    return;
                }
                if !t.is_empty() && !w.is_empty() {
                    let (epoch, str_repr) = Self::parse_when(w);
                    let max_id = self.entries.iter().map(|e| e.id).max().unwrap_or(0);
                    self.entries.push(ReminderEntry {
                        id: max_id + 1,
                        target_epoch: epoch,
                        text: t.to_string(),
                        target_str: str_repr,
                        alerted: false,
                        play_sound: true,
                    });
                    self.task_text.clear();
                    self.when_text.clear();
                    self.save();
                }
            }
            ReminderMessage::DeleteReminder(id) => {
                self.entries.retain(|e| e.id != id);
                self.save();
            }
            ReminderMessage::ToggleSound(id) => {
                if let Some(e) = self.entries.iter_mut().find(|e| e.id == id) {
                    e.play_sound = !e.play_sound;
                    self.save();
                }
            }
            ReminderMessage::ToggleSoundSelected => {
                // Guard: only when the input fields are empty, so typing
                // 's' or pressing Enter while composing doesn't toggle the
                // selected reminder's sound.
                if !self.task_text.is_empty() || !self.when_text.is_empty() {
                    return;
                }
                if let Some(idx) = self.selected_idx {
                    if idx < self.entries.len() {
                        let id = self.entries[idx].id;
                        if let Some(e) = self.entries.iter_mut().find(|e| e.id == id) {
                            e.play_sound = !e.play_sound;
                            self.save();
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            ReminderMessage::FocusNextField => {
                self.cycle_focus_forward();
            }
            ReminderMessage::FocusPrevField => {
                self.cycle_focus_backward();
            }
            ReminderMessage::InitialFocus => {}
            ReminderMessage::Tick => {}
            ReminderMessage::ScrollDown => {
                // Only navigate the list if the input fields are empty.
                // Otherwise arrows should go to text_input for cursor work.
                if !self.task_text.is_empty() || !self.when_text.is_empty() {
                    return;
                }
                if self.entries.is_empty() {
                    self.selected_idx = None;
                    return;
                }
                self.selected_idx = Some(match self.selected_idx {
                    None => 0,
                    Some(i) => (i + 1) % self.entries.len(),
                });
                // Approximate row step: row height (~60) + gap (8)
                let idx = self.selected_idx.unwrap_or(0) as f32;
                self.scroll_y = (idx * 68.0 - 40.0).max(0.0);
            }
            ReminderMessage::SelectFirst => {
                if !self.task_text.is_empty() || !self.when_text.is_empty() {
                    return;
                }
                if self.entries.is_empty() {
                    self.selected_idx = None;
                    return;
                }
                self.selected_idx = Some(0);
                self.scroll_y = 0.0;
            }
            ReminderMessage::SelectLast => {
                if !self.task_text.is_empty() || !self.when_text.is_empty() {
                    return;
                }
                if self.entries.is_empty() {
                    self.selected_idx = None;
                    return;
                }
                self.selected_idx = Some(self.entries.len() - 1);
                self.scroll_y = ((self.entries.len() - 1) as f32 * 68.0 - 40.0).max(0.0);
            }
            ReminderMessage::ScrollUp => {
                if !self.task_text.is_empty() || !self.when_text.is_empty() {
                    return;
                }
                if self.entries.is_empty() {
                    self.selected_idx = None;
                    return;
                }
                self.selected_idx = Some(match self.selected_idx {
                    None => 0,
                    Some(0) => self.entries.len() - 1,
                    Some(i) => i - 1,
                });
                let idx = self.selected_idx.unwrap_or(0) as f32;
                self.scroll_y = (idx * 68.0 - 40.0).max(0.0);
            }
            ReminderMessage::DeleteSelected => {
                eprintln!(
                    "[reminders-delete] fired: task_empty={} when_empty={} sel={:?} count={}",
                    self.task_text.is_empty(),
                    self.when_text.is_empty(),
                    self.selected_idx,
                    self.entries.len()
                );
                if !self.task_text.is_empty() || !self.when_text.is_empty() {
                    return;
                }
                if let Some(idx) = self.selected_idx {
                    if idx < self.entries.len() {
                        let id = self.entries[idx].id;
                        self.entries.retain(|e| e.id != id);
                        self.save();
                        if self.entries.is_empty() {
                            self.selected_idx = None;
                        } else {
                            self.selected_idx = Some(idx.min(self.entries.len() - 1));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            ReminderMessage::Refocus => {}
            ReminderMessage::Dismiss => {}
        }
    }

    pub fn view<'a>(
        &'a self,
        theme: &'a ShellTheme,
        settings: &ShellSettings,
    ) -> Element<'a, ReminderMessage> {
        let (win_w, win_h) = settings.get_window_size("reminders", 780, 600);

        let cut_f = theme.overlay_cut;
        let angle_deg = theme.overlay_angle;

            AngledHexGeometry::new(win_w, win_h, cut_f, angle_deg).standard_insets();

        let fs = theme.font_size_overlay as f32;
        let fs_sm = fs * 0.85;

            .padding(14)
            .size(fs);

        let when_input = text_input(
            "When (e.g. 15m, 1h 30m, 5pm, tomorrow 9am)...",
            &self.when_text,
        )
        .id(REMINDER_WHEN_ID)
        .on_input(ReminderMessage::WhenInputChanged)
        .on_submit(ReminderMessage::AddReminder)
        .padding(14)
        .size(fs);

        let sched_btn = button(
            container(text("+ Schedule").size(fs_sm).bold().color(theme.success)).padding([14, 20]),
        )
        .on_press(ReminderMessage::AddReminder)
        .style(move |_t, _s| button::Style {
            background: Some(iced::Background::Color(theme.surface_alt)),
            border: iced::Border {
                color: theme.success,
                width: 1.5,
                radius: 6.0.into(),
            },
            ..Default::default()
        });

        let mut list_col = column![].spacing(8);
        for (idx, item) in self.entries.iter().enumerate() {
            let is_sel = self.selected_idx == Some(idx);

            // Match Quickshell's formatRemaining: due now / Xd Yh / Xh Ym / Xm Ys / Xs

                let m = (remaining_s % 3600) / 60;
                let sec = remaining_s % 60;
                if d > 0 {
                    format!("{}d {}h", d, h)
                } else if h > 0 {
                    format!("{}h {}m", h, m)
                } else if m > 0 {
                    format!("{}m {}s", m, sec)
                } else {
                    format!("{}s", sec)
                }
            };

            let row_item = row![
                text("⏰").size(fs),
                column![
                    text(&item.text).size(fs).bold().color(theme.text),

                        background: None,

        .padding(Padding {
            top: 0.0,
            right: body_inset,
            bottom: 0.0,
            left: body_inset,
        });

        let card_bg = ShapeBox::new()
            .shape(ShapeType::AngledHexagon {
                cut: cut_f,
                angle_deg,
            })
            .background(theme.background)
            .border(theme.border, theme.border_width)
            .size(Length::Fixed(win_w), Length::Fixed(win_h));

        let footer = container(
            text("Tab: Next field  •  ↑↓/Home/End: Select  •  Enter/Ctrl+S: Toggle sound  •  Del: Delete  •  Esc: Clear/Dismiss")
                .size(fs_sm * 0.9)
                .color(theme.muted)
                .align_x(Alignment::Center)
        )
        .width(Length::Fill)
        .padding(Padding { top: 8.0, right: header_inset, bottom: 0.0, left: header_inset });

        let card_content = container(
            column![header_row, input_area, list_container, footer].padding(Padding {
                top: pad_top,
                right: 0.0,
                bottom: pad_bottom,
                left: 0.0,
            }),
        )
        .width(Length::Fixed(win_w))
        .height(Length::Fixed(win_h))
        .style(|_t| iced::widget::container::Style::default());

        let card = Stack::new().push(card_bg.view()).push(card_content);

        container(card)
            .center_x(Length::Fill)
            .center_y(Length::Fill)
            .style(|_t| iced::widget::container::Style::default())
            .into()
    }
}

pub fn save_reminders(entries: &[ReminderEntry]) {
    let path = RemindersOverlay::storage_path();
    if let Ok(data) = serde_json::to_string_pretty(entries) {
        let tmp = path.with_extension("tmp");
        if crate::libraries::process::private_write_file(&tmp, data.as_bytes()).is_ok() {
            let _ = std::fs::rename(tmp, path);
        }
    }
}

use chrono::Local;
use iced::widget::{button, column, container, row, scrollable, text, Stack};
use iced::{Alignment, Element, Length, Padding};
use std::fs::File;
use std::io::Read;

use crate::libraries::config::settings::ShellSettings;
use crate::libraries::config::theme::ShellTheme;
use crate::libraries::style::shape_box::{AngledHexGeometry, ShapeBox, ShapeType};
use crate::libraries::style::TextExt;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum KeepMode {
    All,
    Highest,
    Lowest,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct RollHistoryItem {
    pub time_str: String,
    pub type_str: String,
    pub total: i32,
    pub avg: f32,
    pub summary: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum RngMessage {
    SetDiceCount(u32),
    SetStrength(i32),
    SetFlatMod(i32),
    SetKeepMode(KeepMode),
    SetKeepN(u32),
    SelectSides(u32),
    ExecuteRoll,
    ToggleHistory,
    CycleFieldPrev,
    CycleFieldNext,
    AdjustField(bool), // true = up, false = down
    Dismiss,
}

pub struct RngOverlay {
    pub dice_count: u32,
    pub selected_sides: u32,
    pub strength: i32,
    pub flat_mod: i32,
    pub keep_mode: KeepMode,
    pub keep_n: u32,
    pub show_history: bool,
    pub active_field: usize, // 0=Qty, 1=Str, 2=Mod, 3=KeepN
    pub last_total: i32,
    pub last_rolls: Vec<(String, bool)>, // (value, is_kept)
    pub last_type_str: String,
    pub last_avg: f32,
    pub history: Vec<RollHistoryItem>,
}

impl Default for RngOverlay {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

impl RngOverlay {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            dice_count: 1,
            selected_sides: 6,
            strength: 0,
            flat_mod: 0,
            keep_mode: KeepMode::All,
            keep_n: 1,
            show_history: false,
            active_field: 0,
            last_total: 0,
            last_rolls: Vec::new(),
            last_type_str: "None".into(),
            last_avg: 0.0,
            history: Vec::new(),
        }
    }

    fn random_u32() -> u32 {
        let mut buf = [0u8; 4];
        if let Ok(mut f) = File::open("/dev/urandom") {
            if f.read_exact(&mut buf).is_ok() {
                return u32::from_ne_bytes(buf);
            }
        }
        std::time::SystemTime::now()
            .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
            .unwrap()
            .subsec_nanos()
    }

    pub fn roll(&mut self) {
        let count = self.dice_count.clamp(1, 100);
        let sides = self.selected_sides.clamp(2, 1000);

        if sides == 2 {
            let mut heads = 0;
            let mut rolls = Vec::new();
            for _ in 0..count {
                if Self::random_u32().is_multiple_of(2) {
                    heads += 1;
                    rolls.push(("Heads".to_string(), true));
                } else {
                    rolls.push(("Tails".to_string(), true));
                }
            }
            self.last_total = heads;
            self.last_avg = (heads as f32) / (count as f32);
            self.last_rolls = rolls;
            self.last_type_str =
                format!("{} Coin Flip{}", count, if count == 1 { "" } else { "s" });
        } else {
            let mut rolls: Vec<(i32, bool)> = (0..count)
                .map(|_| {
                    let raw = (Self::random_u32() % sides) as i32 + 1;
                    let adjusted = (raw + self.strength).clamp(1, sides as i32);
                    (adjusted, true)
                })
                .collect();

            let keep_n = (self.keep_n.min(count)).max(1) as usize;
            match self.keep_mode {
                KeepMode::All => {}
                KeepMode::Highest => {
                    rolls.sort_by_key(|r| std::cmp::Reverse(r.0));
                    for r in rolls.iter_mut().skip(keep_n) {
                        r.1 = false;
                    }
                }
                KeepMode::Lowest => {
                    rolls.sort_by_key(|r| r.0);
                    for r in rolls.iter_mut().skip(keep_n) {
                        r.1 = false;
                    }
                }
            }

            // Sort naturally for display
            rolls.sort_by_key(|r| r.0);

            let kept_sum: i32 = rolls.iter().filter(|r| r.1).map(|r| r.0).sum();
            let kept_num = rolls.iter().filter(|r| r.1).count();

            self.last_total = kept_sum + self.flat_mod;
            self.last_avg = if kept_num > 0 {
                (kept_sum as f32) / (kept_num as f32)
            } else {
                0.0
            };
            self.last_type_str = format!(
                "{}d{}{}",
                count,
                sides,
                match self.keep_mode {
                    KeepMode::All => "".to_string(),
                    KeepMode::Highest => format!(" (kh{})", keep_n),
                    KeepMode::Lowest => format!(" (kl{})", keep_n),
                }
            );
            self.last_rolls = rolls.into_iter().map(|(v, k)| (v.to_string(), k)).collect();
        }

        let summary: Vec<String> = self
            .last_rolls
            .iter()
            .map(|(v, k)| if *k { v.clone() } else { format!("({})", v) })
            .collect();

        self.history.insert(
            0,
            RollHistoryItem {
                time_str: Local::now().format("%H:%M:%S").to_string(),
                type_str: self.last_type_str.clone(),
                total: self.last_total,
                avg: self.last_avg,
                summary: summary.join(", "),
            },
        );
        if self.history.len() > 50 {
            self.history.truncate(50);
        }
    }

    pub fn update(&mut self, message: RngMessage) {
        match message {
            RngMessage::SetDiceCount(n) => {
                self.dice_count = n.clamp(1, 100);
                if self.keep_n > self.dice_count {
                    self.keep_n = self.dice_count;
                }
            }
            RngMessage::SetStrength(n) => self.strength = n.clamp(-100, 100),
            RngMessage::SetFlatMod(n) => self.flat_mod = n.clamp(-100, 100),
            RngMessage::SetKeepMode(m) => {
                self.keep_mode = m;
                if m == KeepMode::All && self.active_field >= 3 {
                    self.active_field = 2;
                }
            }
            RngMessage::SetKeepN(n) => self.keep_n = n.clamp(1, self.dice_count.max(1)),
            RngMessage::SelectSides(s) => self.selected_sides = s,
            RngMessage::ExecuteRoll => self.roll(),
            RngMessage::ToggleHistory => self.show_history = !self.show_history,
            RngMessage::CycleFieldPrev => {
                let max = if self.keep_mode == KeepMode::All {
                    3
                } else {
                    4
                };
                self.active_field = if self.active_field == 0 {
                    max - 1
                } else {
                    self.active_field - 1
                };
            }
            RngMessage::CycleFieldNext => {
                let max = if self.keep_mode == KeepMode::All {
                    3
                } else {
                    4
                };
                self.active_field = (self.active_field + 1) % max;
            }
            RngMessage::AdjustField(up) => {
                let delta = if up { 1 } else { -1 };
                match self.active_field {
                    0 => self.update(RngMessage::SetDiceCount(
                        (self.dice_count as i32 + delta).max(1) as u32,
                    )),
                    1 => self.update(RngMessage::SetStrength(self.strength + delta)),
                    2 => self.update(RngMessage::SetFlatMod(self.flat_mod + delta)),
                    3 => self.update(RngMessage::SetKeepN(
                        (self.keep_n as i32 + delta).max(1) as u32
                    )),
                    _ => {}
                }
            }
            RngMessage::Dismiss => {}
        }
    }

        let card_content = container(

        let card = Stack::new().push(card_bg.view()).push(card_content);
        container(card)

    }
}

pub fn resolve_rng_key(
    key: &iced::keyboard::Key,
    modifiers: iced::keyboard::Modifiers,
) -> Option<RngMessage> {
    use iced::keyboard::{key::Named, Key};
    match key {
        Key::Named(Named::Enter) => Some(RngMessage::ExecuteRoll),
        Key::Named(Named::ArrowLeft) => Some(RngMessage::CycleFieldPrev),
        Key::Named(Named::ArrowRight) => Some(RngMessage::CycleFieldNext),
        Key::Named(Named::Tab) if modifiers.shift() => Some(RngMessage::CycleFieldPrev),
        Key::Named(Named::Tab) => Some(RngMessage::CycleFieldNext),
        Key::Named(Named::ArrowUp) => Some(RngMessage::AdjustField(true)),
        Key::Named(Named::ArrowDown) => Some(RngMessage::AdjustField(false)),
        _ => None,
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::{resolve_rng_key, KeepMode, RngMessage, RngOverlay};
    use iced::keyboard::{key::Named, Key, Modifiers};

    #[test]
    fn tab_advances_forward_and_shift_tab_goes_backward() {
        assert!(matches!(
            resolve_rng_key(&Key::Named(Named::Tab), Modifiers::default()),
            Some(RngMessage::CycleFieldNext)
        ));
        assert!(matches!(
            resolve_rng_key(&Key::Named(Named::Tab), Modifiers::SHIFT),
            Some(RngMessage::CycleFieldPrev)
        ));
        assert!(matches!(
            resolve_rng_key(&Key::Named(Named::ArrowLeft), Modifiers::default()),
            Some(RngMessage::CycleFieldPrev)
        ));
        assert!(matches!(
            resolve_rng_key(&Key::Named(Named::ArrowRight), Modifiers::default()),
            Some(RngMessage::CycleFieldNext)
        ));
        assert!(matches!(
            resolve_rng_key(&Key::Named(Named::ArrowUp), Modifiers::default()),
            Some(RngMessage::AdjustField(true))
        ));
        assert!(matches!(
            resolve_rng_key(&Key::Named(Named::ArrowDown), Modifiers::default()),
            Some(RngMessage::AdjustField(false))
        ));
        assert!(matches!(
            resolve_rng_key(&Key::Named(Named::Enter), Modifiers::default()),
            Some(RngMessage::ExecuteRoll)
        ));
    }

    #[test]
    fn switching_to_keep_all_clamps_active_field() {
        let mut rng = RngOverlay::new();
        rng.update(RngMessage::SetKeepMode(KeepMode::Highest));
        rng.active_field = 3;
        rng.update(RngMessage::SetKeepMode(KeepMode::All));
        assert_eq!(rng.active_field, 2);
    }

    #[test]
    fn cycle_fields_wraps_for_all_and_keep_modes() {
        let mut rng = RngOverlay::new();
        rng.update(RngMessage::CycleFieldPrev);
        assert_eq!(rng.active_field, 2);
        rng.update(RngMessage::CycleFieldNext);
        assert_eq!(rng.active_field, 0);

        rng.update(RngMessage::SetKeepMode(KeepMode::Highest));
        rng.update(RngMessage::CycleFieldPrev);
        assert_eq!(rng.active_field, 3);
        rng.update(RngMessage::CycleFieldNext);
        assert_eq!(rng.active_field, 0);
    }

    #[test]
    fn advantage_roll_keeps_highest_n_plus_flat_mod() {
        let mut rng = RngOverlay::new();
        rng.update(RngMessage::SelectSides(20));
        rng.update(RngMessage::SetDiceCount(4));
        rng.update(RngMessage::SetKeepMode(KeepMode::Highest));
        rng.update(RngMessage::SetKeepN(2));
        rng.update(RngMessage::SetFlatMod(3));
        rng.update(RngMessage::ExecuteRoll);

        assert_eq!(rng.last_rolls.len(), 4);
        let kept: Vec<i32> = rng
            .last_rolls
            .iter()
            .filter(|(_, k)| *k)
            .map(|(v, _)| v.parse::<i32>().unwrap())
            .collect();
        assert_eq!(kept.len(), 2);
        assert_eq!(rng.last_total, kept.iter().sum::<i32>() + 3);
    }
}
