use iced::widget::{button, checkbox, column, container, row, scrollable, text, text_input, Stack};
use iced::{Alignment, Element, Length, Padding};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::fs;
use std::path::PathBuf;

use crate::libraries::config::theme::ShellTheme;
use crate::libraries::style::shape_box::{AngledHexGeometry, ShapeBox, ShapeType};
use crate::libraries::style::TextExt;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct TodoItem {
    pub id: u64,
    pub task: String,
    pub completed: bool,
    pub category: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, Default)]
pub struct TodoDb {
    pub categories: Vec<String>,
    pub todos: Vec<TodoItem>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum TodoFilter {
    All,
    Active,
    Completed,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum TodoMessage {
    SelectCategory(String),
    AddCategory(String),
    DeleteCategory(String),
    FilterChanged(TodoFilter),
    NewTaskInputChanged(String),
    AddTask,
    ToggleTask(u64),
    DeleteTask(u64),
    CategoryPrev,
    CategoryNext,
    FilterPrev,
    FilterNext,
    TaskSelectPrev,
    TaskSelectNext,
    ToggleSelected,
    DeleteSelected,
    EditSelected,
    EditTask(u64),
    CancelEdit,
    Refocus,
    Dismiss,
}

pub const TODO_INPUT_ID: &str = "todo_input";

pub struct TodoOverlay {
    pub db: TodoDb,
    pub active_category: String,
    pub filter: TodoFilter,
    pub new_task_text: String,
    /// Which task (by id) is keyboard-highlighted. Cleared when the task
    /// disappears (deleted, toggled off a filter, category switch).
    pub selected_task_id: Option<u64>,
    /// Which task (by id) is currently being edited. When Some, the input
    /// field contains that task's text and Enter saves back to it (instead
    /// of adding a new task). Cleared on Enter-save, Escape-cancel, or when
    /// the underlying task is deleted.
    pub editing_task_id: Option<u64>,
}

impl Default for TodoOverlay {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

impl TodoOverlay {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        let mut db = Self::load();
        if db.categories.is_empty() {
            db.categories.push("Inbox".into());
        }
        let active_category = db
            .categories
            .first()
            .cloned()
            .unwrap_or_else(|| "Inbox".into());

        Self {
            db,
            active_category,
            filter: TodoFilter::All,
            new_task_text: String::new(),
            selected_task_id: None,
            editing_task_id: None,
        }
    }

    pub fn empty() -> Self {
        Self {
            db: TodoDb {
                categories: vec!["Inbox".into()],
                todos: Vec::new(),
            },
            active_category: "Inbox".into(),
            filter: TodoFilter::All,
            new_task_text: String::new(),
            selected_task_id: None,
            editing_task_id: None,
        }
    }

    pub fn visible_task_ids(&self) -> Vec<u64> {
        self.db
            .todos
            .iter()
            .filter(|t| t.category == self.active_category)
            .filter(|t| match self.filter {
                TodoFilter::All => true,
                TodoFilter::Active => !t.completed,
                TodoFilter::Completed => t.completed,
            })
            .map(|t| t.id)
            .collect()
    }

    fn storage_path() -> PathBuf {
        let base = dirs::data_dir().unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from("/tmp"));
        let mbs = base.join("moonbeauty").join("todos.json");
        let qs = base.join("quickshell").join("todos.json");
        // One-time migration: user's pre-migration todos lived at
        // ~/.local/share/quickshell/todos.json (Quickshell convention).
        // Copy them to the moon-beauty path on first launch so existing
        // tasks aren't invisible.
        if !mbs.exists() && qs.exists() {
            if let Some(parent) = mbs.parent() {
                let _ = fs::create_dir_all(parent);
            }
            match fs::copy(&qs, &mbs) {
                Ok(n) => eprintln!("[todo] migrated {} bytes from quickshell → moon-beauty", n),
                Err(e) => eprintln!("[todo] quickshell migration failed: {e}"),
            }
        }
        mbs
    }

    pub fn load() -> TodoDb {
        // 8 MB cap.
        crate::libraries::process::read_json_capped::<TodoDb>(
            &Self::storage_path(),
            8 * 1024 * 1024,
        )
        .unwrap_or_else(|| TodoDb {
            categories: vec!["Inbox".into()],
            todos: Vec::new(),
        })
    }

    pub fn save(&self) {
        if cfg!(test) {
            return;
        }
        let path = Self::storage_path();
        if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
            let _ = fs::create_dir_all(parent);
        }
        if let Ok(data) = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&self.db) {
            let tmp = path.with_extension("tmp");
            if crate::libraries::process::private_write_file(&tmp, data.as_bytes()).is_ok() {
                let _ = fs::rename(tmp, path);
            }
        }
    }

    pub fn update(&mut self, message: TodoMessage) {
        match message {
            TodoMessage::SelectCategory(cat) => {
                self.active_category = cat;
                self.selected_task_id = None;
                if self.editing_task_id.is_some() {
                    self.editing_task_id = None;
                    self.new_task_text.clear();
                }
            }
            TodoMessage::AddCategory(name) => {
                let clean = name.trim();
                if !clean.is_empty()
                    && !self
                        .db
                        .categories
                        .iter()
                        .any(|c| c.eq_ignore_ascii_case(clean))
                {
                    self.db.categories.push(clean.to_string());
                    self.active_category = clean.to_string();
                    self.selected_task_id = None;
                    if self.editing_task_id.is_some() {
                        self.editing_task_id = None;
                        self.new_task_text.clear();
                    }
                    self.save();
                }
            }
            TodoMessage::DeleteCategory(name) => {
                if name != "Inbox" {
                    self.db.categories.retain(|c| c != &name);
                    self.db.todos.retain(|t| t.category != name);
                    if self.active_category == name {
                        self.active_category = "Inbox".into();
                        self.selected_task_id = None;
                        if self.editing_task_id.is_some() {
                            self.editing_task_id = None;
                            self.new_task_text.clear();
                        }
                    } else {
                        if let Some(id) = self.selected_task_id {
                            if !self.visible_task_ids().contains(&id) {
                                self.selected_task_id = None;
                            }
                        }
                        if let Some(id) = self.editing_task_id {
                            if !self.db.todos.iter().any(|t| t.id == id) {
                                self.editing_task_id = None;
                                self.new_task_text.clear();
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    self.save();
                }
            }
            TodoMessage::FilterChanged(f) => {
                self.filter = f;
                self.selected_task_id = None;
                if self.editing_task_id.is_some() {
                    self.editing_task_id = None;
                    self.new_task_text.clear();
                }
            }
            TodoMessage::NewTaskInputChanged(txt) => {
                // 'e' / 'E' as an edit shortcut. text_input captures every
                // character key so the subscription never sees this — the
                // only hook is here, on the resulting text change. Gate on:
                //   (a) input was empty before this keystroke
                //   (b) new value is exactly "e" or "E"
                //   (c) a task is selected
                //   (d) not already editing
                // Trade-off: cannot start a new task whose first letter is
                // 'e' while a task is selected. Deselect first (Escape or
                // click another category) to type 'e' as normal.
                let first_char_e = self.new_task_text.is_empty()
                    && txt.chars().count() == 1
                    && txt
                        .chars()
                        .next()
                        .map(|c| c.eq_ignore_ascii_case(&'e'))
                        .unwrap_or(false);
                if first_char_e && self.selected_task_id.is_some() && self.editing_task_id.is_none()
                {
                    if let Some(id) = self.selected_task_id {
                        if let Some(t) = self.db.todos.iter().find(|t| t.id == id) {
                            self.editing_task_id = Some(id);
                            self.new_task_text = t.task.clone();
                            eprintln!("[todo] 'e' intercepted → edit mode (id={})", id);
                            return;
                        }
                    }
                }
                self.new_task_text = txt;
            }
            TodoMessage::AddTask => {
                // 3-way dispatch on Enter (fires via text_input::on_submit):
                //   non-empty input + editing -> save edit
                //   non-empty input + not editing -> add new task
                //   empty input + selection -> toggle complete
                let clean = self.new_task_text.trim().to_string();
                if !clean.is_empty() {
                    if let Some(edit_id) = self.editing_task_id {
                        if let Some(t) = self.db.todos.iter_mut().find(|t| t.id == edit_id) {
                            t.task = clean;
                            self.save();
                        }
                        self.editing_task_id = None;
                        self.new_task_text.clear();
                        self.selected_task_id = Some(edit_id);
                    } else {
                        let max_id = self.db.todos.iter().map(|t| t.id).max().unwrap_or(0);
                        let new_id = max_id + 1;
                        self.db.todos.push(TodoItem {
                            id: new_id,
                            task: clean,
                            completed: false,
                            category: self.active_category.clone(),
                        });
                        self.new_task_text.clear();
                        self.save();
                        self.selected_task_id = Some(new_id);
                    }
                } else if let Some(id) = self.selected_task_id {
                    // Empty input: treat Enter as "toggle selected"
                    if let Some(t) = self.db.todos.iter_mut().find(|t| t.id == id) {
                        t.completed = !t.completed;
                        self.save();
                        if !self.visible_task_ids().contains(&id) {
                            self.selected_task_id = None;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            TodoMessage::ToggleTask(id) => {
                if let Some(t) = self.db.todos.iter_mut().find(|t| t.id == id) {
                    t.completed = !t.completed;
                    self.save();
                    if !self.visible_task_ids().contains(&id) {
                        self.selected_task_id = None;
                    }
                }
            }
            TodoMessage::DeleteTask(id) => {
                self.db.todos.retain(|t| t.id != id);
                if self.selected_task_id == Some(id) {
                    self.selected_task_id = None;
                }
                if self.editing_task_id == Some(id) {
                    self.editing_task_id = None;
                    self.new_task_text.clear();
                }
                self.save();
            }
            TodoMessage::CategoryPrev => {
                if !self.new_task_text.is_empty() || self.editing_task_id.is_some() {
                    return;
                }
                let n = self.db.categories.len();
                if n > 0 {
                    if let Some(idx) = self
                        .db
                        .categories
                        .iter()
                        .position(|c| c == &self.active_category)
                    {
                        self.active_category = self.db.categories[(idx + n - 1) % n].clone();
                        self.selected_task_id = None;
                    }
                }
            }
            TodoMessage::CategoryNext => {
                if !self.new_task_text.is_empty() || self.editing_task_id.is_some() {
                    return;
                }
                let n = self.db.categories.len();
                if n > 0 {
                    if let Some(idx) = self
                        .db
                        .categories
                        .iter()
                        .position(|c| c == &self.active_category)
                    {
                        self.active_category = self.db.categories[(idx + 1) % n].clone();
                        self.selected_task_id = None;
                    }
                }
            }
            TodoMessage::FilterPrev => {
                self.filter = match self.filter {
                    TodoFilter::All => TodoFilter::Completed,
                    TodoFilter::Active => TodoFilter::All,
                    TodoFilter::Completed => TodoFilter::Active,
                };
                if let Some(id) = self.selected_task_id {
                    if !self.visible_task_ids().contains(&id) {
                        self.selected_task_id = None;
                    }
                }
            }
            TodoMessage::FilterNext => {
                self.filter = match self.filter {
                    TodoFilter::All => TodoFilter::Active,
                    TodoFilter::Active => TodoFilter::Completed,
                    TodoFilter::Completed => TodoFilter::All,
                };
                if let Some(id) = self.selected_task_id {
                    if !self.visible_task_ids().contains(&id) {
                        self.selected_task_id = None;
                    }
                }
            }
            TodoMessage::TaskSelectPrev => {
                if !self.new_task_text.is_empty() || self.editing_task_id.is_some() {
                    return;
                }
                let visible = self.visible_task_ids();
                if visible.is_empty() {
                    return;
                }
                let cur = self
                    .selected_task_id
                    .and_then(|id| visible.iter().position(|v| *v == id));
                self.selected_task_id = Some(match cur {
                    Some(0) | None => visible[visible.len() - 1],
                    Some(i) => visible[i - 1],
                });
            }
            TodoMessage::TaskSelectNext => {
                if !self.new_task_text.is_empty() {
                    return;
                }
                if self.editing_task_id.is_some() {
                    return;
                }
                let visible = self.visible_task_ids();
                if visible.is_empty() {
                    return;
                }
                let cur = self
                    .selected_task_id
                    .and_then(|id| visible.iter().position(|v| *v == id));
                self.selected_task_id = Some(match cur {
                    None => visible[0],
                    Some(i) => visible[(i + 1) % visible.len()],
                });
            }
            TodoMessage::ToggleSelected => {
                if !self.new_task_text.is_empty() {
                    return;
                }
                if let Some(id) = self.selected_task_id {
                    if let Some(t) = self.db.todos.iter_mut().find(|t| t.id == id) {
                        t.completed = !t.completed;
                        self.save();
                        if !self.visible_task_ids().contains(&id) {
                            self.selected_task_id = None;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            TodoMessage::DeleteSelected => {
                // Guard: if input has text, Delete means "delete char
                // before/after cursor", NOT "delete selected task".
                // text_input handles the char; we no-op.
                if !self.new_task_text.is_empty() {
                    return;
                }
                eprintln!(
                    "[todo] DeleteSelected fired (sel={:?})",
                    self.selected_task_id
                );
                if let Some(id) = self.selected_task_id {
                    self.db.todos.retain(|t| t.id != id);
                    if self.editing_task_id == Some(id) {
                        self.editing_task_id = None;
                        self.new_task_text.clear();
                    }
                    self.selected_task_id = None;
                    self.save();
                }
            }
            TodoMessage::EditSelected => {
                if let Some(id) = self.selected_task_id {
                    if let Some(t) = self.db.todos.iter().find(|t| t.id == id) {
                        self.editing_task_id = Some(id);
                        self.new_task_text = t.task.clone();
                    }
                }
            }
            TodoMessage::EditTask(id) => {
                if let Some(t) = self.db.todos.iter().find(|t| t.id == id) {
                    self.selected_task_id = Some(id);
                    self.editing_task_id = Some(id);
                    self.new_task_text = t.task.clone();
                }
            }
            TodoMessage::CancelEdit => {
                self.editing_task_id = None;
                self.new_task_text.clear();
            }
            TodoMessage::Refocus => {}
            TodoMessage::Dismiss => {}
        }
    }

    pub fn view<'a>(
        &'a self,
        theme: &'a ShellTheme,
        settings: &crate::libraries::config::settings::ShellSettings,
    ) -> Element<'a, TodoMessage> {
        {
            use std::sync::OnceLock;
            static ONCE: OnceLock<()> = OnceLock::new();
            ONCE.get_or_init(|| {
                eprintln!(
                    "[todo-view] overlay_font_size={} normal_font_size={}",
                    theme.font_size_overlay, theme.font_size_normal
                );
            });
        }

        let (win_w, win_h) = settings.get_window_size("todo", 840, 650);
        let mut cat_row = row![].spacing(8).align_y(Alignment::Center);
        for cat in &self.db.categories {
            let is_sel = cat == &self.active_category;
            let col = if is_sel { theme.success } else { theme.text };
            let cat_clone = cat.clone();

            let cat_btn = button(
                text(cat)
                    .size((theme.font_size_normal) as f32)
                    .color(col)
                    .bold(),
            )
            .on_press(TodoMessage::SelectCategory(cat_clone))
            .padding([6, 12])
            .style(|_t, _s| button::Style {
                background: None,
                ..Default::default()
            });

            cat_row = cat_row.push(cat_btn);
        }

        let input = text_input("Add a task and press [Enter]...", &self.new_task_text)
            .id(TODO_INPUT_ID)
            .on_input(TodoMessage::NewTaskInputChanged)
            .on_submit(TodoMessage::AddTask)
            .padding(14)
            .size(theme.font_size_overlay as f32);

        let mut list_col = column![].spacing(6);
        for item in self.db.todos.iter().filter(|t| {
            t.category == self.active_category
                && match self.filter {
                    TodoFilter::All => true,
                    TodoFilter::Active => !t.completed,
                    TodoFilter::Completed => t.completed,
                }
        }) {
            let id = item.id;
            let is_done = item.completed;

            let is_editing = self.editing_task_id == Some(id);
            let row_item = row![
                checkbox(is_done).on_toggle(move |_| TodoMessage::ToggleTask(id)),
                text(&item.task)
                    .size(theme.font_size_overlay as f32)
                    .color(if is_done { theme.muted } else { theme.text })
                    .width(Length::Fill),
                button(
                    text("✎")
                        .size(theme.font_size_overlay as f32)
                        .color(if is_editing {
                            theme.success
                        } else {
                            theme.text
                        })
                )
                .on_press(TodoMessage::EditTask(id))
                .padding(4)
                .style(|_t, _s| button::Style {
                    background: None,
                    ..Default::default()
                }),
                button(
                    text("✕")
                        .size(theme.font_size_overlay as f32)
                        .color(theme.danger)
                )
                .on_press(TodoMessage::DeleteTask(id))
                .padding(4)
                .style(|_t, _s| button::Style {
                    background: None,
                    ..Default::default()
                }),
            ]
            .spacing(16)
            .align_y(Alignment::Center);

            let is_sel = self.selected_task_id == Some(id);
            // Row bg is applied to a narrower wrapper than the row
            // content itself (below), so at the top of the list the
            // highlight can't touch the octagon corners.
            let bg: Option<iced::Background> = if is_editing {
                Some(iced::Background::Color(theme.background))
            } else if is_sel {
                Some(iced::Background::Color(theme.surface_alt))
            } else {
                None
            };
            let border_col = if is_editing {
                theme.success
            } else if is_sel {
                theme.text
            } else {
                theme.border
            };
            let border_w = if is_editing {
                theme.control_border_width * 1.5
            } else if is_sel {
                theme.control_border_width
            } else {
                0.0
            };
            // Wrap the styled row in an outer container with horizontal
            // margin, so the highlight never touches the octagon edges.
            list_col = list_col.push(
                container(
                    container(row_item)
                        .padding([10, 14])
                        .width(Length::Fill)
                        .style(move |_t| container::Style {
                            background: bg,
                            border: iced::Border {
                                color: border_col,
                                width: border_w,
                                radius: 4.0.into(),
                            },
                            ..Default::default()
                        }),
                )
                .width(Length::Fill)
                .padding(Padding {
                    top: 0.0,
                    bottom: 0.0,
                    left: 8.0,
                    right: 8.0,
                }),
            );
        }

        let filter_row = row![
            text("Filter:")
                .size((theme.font_size_normal) as f32)
                .bold()
                .color(theme.text),
            button(
                text("All")
                    .size((theme.font_size_overlay as f32) * 0.85)
                    .color(if self.filter == TodoFilter::All {
                        theme.success
                    } else {
                        theme.text
                    })
            )
            .on_press(TodoMessage::FilterChanged(TodoFilter::All))
            .style(|_t, _s| button::Style {
                background: None,
                ..Default::default()
            }),
            button(
                text("Active")
                    .size((theme.font_size_overlay as f32) * 0.85)
                    .color(if self.filter == TodoFilter::Active {
                        theme.success
                    } else {
                        theme.text
                    })
            )
            .on_press(TodoMessage::FilterChanged(TodoFilter::Active))
            .style(|_t, _s| button::Style {
                background: None,
                ..Default::default()
            }),
            button(
                text("Completed")
                    .size((theme.font_size_overlay as f32) * 0.85)
                    .color(if self.filter == TodoFilter::Completed {
                        theme.success
                    } else {
                        theme.text
                    })
            )
            .on_press(TodoMessage::FilterChanged(TodoFilter::Completed))
            .style(|_t, _s| button::Style {
                background: None,
                ..Default::default()
            }),
        ]
        .spacing(12)
        .align_y(Alignment::Center);

        // Angled hexagon matches the rest of the shell (launcher, calc,
        // lockscreen, dictionary). The shape needs an explicit size —
        // without it, ShapeBox fills the parent and gets squeezed when
        // rendered inside the bar's 42px-tall window.
        let cut_f = theme.overlay_cut;
        let angle_deg = theme.overlay_angle;
        // Per-row horizontal insets so content clears the angled-hexagon
        // corner cuts.
        let pad_top = 20.0_f32;
        let pad_bottom = 20.0_f32;
        let (header_inset, body_inset, footer_inset) =
            AngledHexGeometry::new(win_w, win_h, cut_f, angle_deg).standard_insets();
        eprintln!(
            "[todo-size] win={}x{} cut={} angle={} header_inset={:.1} body_inset={:.1} footer_inset={:.1}",
            win_w, win_h, cut_f, angle_deg, header_inset, body_inset, footer_inset
        );
        let card_bg = ShapeBox::new()
            .shape(ShapeType::AngledHexagon {
                cut: cut_f,
                angle_deg,
            })
            .background(theme.background)
            .border(theme.border, theme.border_width)
            .size(Length::Fixed(win_w), Length::Fixed(win_h));

        // Per-row containers get independent horizontal insets so content
        // clears the octagon diagonals at top and bottom.
        let header_row = container(
            row![
                text("✅ TASK BOARD")
                    .size(theme.font_size_overlay as f32)
                    .color(theme.text),
                scrollable(cat_row).width(Length::Fill),
            ]
            .spacing(16)
            .align_y(Alignment::Center),
        )
        .width(Length::Fill)
        .padding(Padding {
            top: 0.0,
            right: header_inset,
            bottom: 0.0,
            left: header_inset,
        });

        let input_row = container(input).width(Length::Fill).padding(Padding {
            top: 0.0,
            right: body_inset,
            bottom: 0.0,
            left: body_inset,
        });

        let list_container = container(
            scrollable(list_col)
                .id(iced::widget::Id::new("todo_list"))
                .height(Length::Fill),
        )
        .width(Length::Fill)
        .height(Length::Fill)
        .padding(Padding {
            top: 0.0,
            right: body_inset,
            bottom: 0.0,
            left: body_inset,
        });

        let filter_container = container(filter_row).width(Length::Fill).padding(Padding {
            top: 0.0,
            right: footer_inset,
            bottom: 0.0,
            left: footer_inset,
        });

        let card_content = container(
            column![header_row, input_row, list_container, filter_container]
                .spacing(14)
                .padding(Padding {
                    top: pad_top,
                    right: 0.0,
                    bottom: pad_bottom,
                    left: 0.0,
                }),
        )
        .width(Length::Fixed(win_w))
        .height(Length::Fixed(win_h));

        let card = Stack::new().push(card_bg.view()).push(card_content);

        container(card)
            .center_x(Length::Fill)
            .center_y(Length::Fill)
            .into()
    }

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::{TodoFilter, TodoItem, TodoMessage, TodoOverlay};

    fn seeded_todo() -> TodoOverlay {
        let mut ov = TodoOverlay::empty();
        ov.db.categories = vec!["Inbox".into(), "Work".into()];
        ov.db.todos = vec![
            TodoItem { id: 1, task: "Inbox A".into(), completed: false, category: "Inbox".into() },
            TodoItem { id: 2, task: "Inbox B".into(), completed: true, category: "Inbox".into() },
            TodoItem { id: 3, task: "Work A".into(), completed: false, category: "Work".into() },
        ];
        ov
    }

    #[test]
    fn task_select_prev_respects_typing_and_edit_guards() {
        let mut ov = seeded_todo();
        ov.selected_task_id = Some(2);

        ov.new_task_text = "draft".into();
        ov.update(TodoMessage::TaskSelectPrev);
        assert_eq!(ov.selected_task_id, Some(2));

        ov.new_task_text.clear();
        ov.editing_task_id = Some(2);
        ov.update(TodoMessage::TaskSelectPrev);
        assert_eq!(ov.selected_task_id, Some(2));

        ov.editing_task_id = None;
        ov.update(TodoMessage::TaskSelectPrev);
        assert_eq!(ov.selected_task_id, Some(1));
    }

    #[test]
    fn category_prev_next_clears_selection_and_respects_edit_guard() {
        let mut ov = seeded_todo();
        ov.selected_task_id = Some(1);
        ov.update(TodoMessage::CategoryNext);
        assert_eq!(ov.active_category, "Work");
        assert_eq!(ov.selected_task_id, None);

        ov.selected_task_id = Some(3);
        ov.editing_task_id = Some(3);
        ov.update(TodoMessage::CategoryPrev);
        assert_eq!(ov.active_category, "Work");

        ov.editing_task_id = None;
        ov.update(TodoMessage::CategoryPrev);
        assert_eq!(ov.active_category, "Inbox");
        assert_eq!(ov.selected_task_id, None);
    }

    #[test]
    fn filter_prev_next_clears_hidden_selection() {
        let mut ov = seeded_todo();
        ov.selected_task_id = Some(1); // active task
        ov.update(TodoMessage::FilterPrev); // All -> Completed
        assert_eq!(ov.filter, TodoFilter::Completed);
        assert_eq!(ov.selected_task_id, None);

        ov.selected_task_id = Some(2); // completed task
        ov.update(TodoMessage::FilterPrev); // Completed -> Active
        assert_eq!(ov.filter, TodoFilter::Active);
        assert_eq!(ov.selected_task_id, None);
    }

    #[test]
    fn delete_category_clears_stale_selection_and_edit() {
        let mut ov = seeded_todo();
        ov.update(TodoMessage::SelectCategory("Work".into()));
        ov.update(TodoMessage::EditTask(3));
        ov.update(TodoMessage::DeleteCategory("Work".into()));
        assert_eq!(ov.active_category, "Inbox");
        assert_eq!(ov.selected_task_id, None);
        assert_eq!(ov.editing_task_id, None);
        assert!(ov.new_task_text.is_empty());
    }
}

    fn filtered(&self) -> Vec<&UnicodeEntry> {
        let q = self.search_query.trim().to_lowercase();
        self.catalog
            .iter()
            .filter(|e| q.is_empty() || e.symbol == q || e.name.contains(&q))
            .collect()
    }

    pub fn selected_symbol(&self) -> Option<&'static str> {
        let idx = self.selected_idx?;
        self.filtered().get(idx).map(|e| e.symbol)
    }

    pub fn update(&mut self, message: UnicodeMessage) {
        match message {
            UnicodeMessage::SearchChanged(q) => {
                self.search_query = q;
                self.selected_idx = None;
            }
            UnicodeMessage::SelectNext => {
                if !self.search_query.is_empty() {
                    return;
                }
                let n = self.filtered().len();
                if n == 0 {
                    return;
                }
                let cur = self.selected_idx.unwrap_or(usize::MAX);
                self.selected_idx = Some(if cur == usize::MAX { 0 } else { (cur + 1) % n });
            }
            UnicodeMessage::SelectPrev => {
                if !self.search_query.is_empty() {
                    return;
                }
                let n = self.filtered().len();
                if n == 0 {
                    return;
                }
                let cur = self.selected_idx.unwrap_or(usize::MAX);
                self.selected_idx = Some(if cur == usize::MAX {
                    n.saturating_sub(1)
                } else {
                    (cur + n - 1) % n
                });
            }
            UnicodeMessage::SelectNextRow => {
                let n = self.filtered().len();
                if n == 0 {
                    return;
                }
                self.selected_idx = Some(match self.selected_idx {
                    None => 0,
                    Some(cur) => (cur + 5).min(n - 1),
                });
            }
            UnicodeMessage::SelectPrevRow => {
                let n = self.filtered().len();
                if n == 0 {
                    return;
                }
                self.selected_idx = Some(match self.selected_idx {
                    None => n.saturating_sub(1),
                    Some(cur) => cur.saturating_sub(5),
                });
            }
            UnicodeMessage::CopySelected => {}
            UnicodeMessage::Refocus => {}
            UnicodeMessage::Dismiss => {}
            UnicodeMessage::CopySymbol(_) => {}
        }
    }

    pub async fn copy(symbol: &str) {
        let _ = Command::new("wl-copy").arg(symbol).status().await;
        let _ = Command::new("notify-send")
            .args(["-a", "Unicode", "Glyph Copied", symbol])
            .spawn();
    }

    pub fn view<'a>(
        &'a self,
        theme: &'a ShellTheme,
        settings: &ShellSettings,
    ) -> Element<'a, UnicodeMessage> {
        let (win_w, win_h) = settings.get_window_size("unicode", 780, 620);

        let cut_f = theme.overlay_cut;
        let angle_deg = theme.overlay_angle;
        let pad_top = 20.0_f32;
        let pad_bottom = 20.0_f32;
        let (header_inset, body_inset, footer_inset) =
            AngledHexGeometry::new(win_w, win_h, cut_f, angle_deg).standard_insets();

        let input = text_input("Search unicode glyphs and symbols...", &self.search_query)
            .id(UNICODE_INPUT_ID)
            .on_input(UnicodeMessage::SearchChanged)
            .padding(Padding {
                top: 18.0,
                bottom: 18.0,
                left: 20.0,
                right: 20.0,
            })
            .size(theme.font_size_overlay as f32);

        let filtered = self.filtered();
        let item_gap = 8.0;
        let per_row = 5;
        let grid_usable = win_w - body_inset * 2.0;
        let item_w = (grid_usable - (per_row as f32 - 1.0) * item_gap) / per_row as f32;
        let sym_size = (theme.font_size_overlay as f32) * 1.6;
        let label_size = (theme.font_size_overlay as f32) * 0.65;

        let mut grid_col = column![].spacing(item_gap);

        for (row_idx, chunk) in filtered.chunks(per_row).enumerate() {
            let mut grid_row = row![].spacing(item_gap).align_y(Alignment::Center);
            for (col_idx, entry) in chunk.iter().enumerate() {
                let global_idx = row_idx * per_row + col_idx;
                let is_sel = self.selected_idx == Some(global_idx);
                let sym = entry.symbol;

                let bg = if is_sel {
                    Some(iced::Background::Color(theme.surface_alt))
                } else {
                    None
                };
                let border_col = if is_sel { theme.text } else { theme.border };
                let border_w = if is_sel {
                    theme.control_border_width
                } else {
                    0.0
                };

                let item_content = column![
                    text(entry.symbol)
                        .size(sym_size)
                        .color(theme.text)
                        .align_x(Alignment::Center),
                    text(entry.name.split_whitespace().next().unwrap_or(""))

            // Pad incomplete last row so items don't stretch

        let list_container = container(scrollable(grid_col).id(iced::widget::Id::new("unicode_grid")).height(Length::Fill))
            .width(Length::Fill)

//! Shared tooltip rendering primitives.

use iced::widget::canvas::{self, Frame, Geometry, Path, Stroke};
use iced::widget::{container, row};
use iced::{Color, Element, Length, Point, Rectangle, Theme};

pub fn slanted_row<'a, M: 'a>(
    inner: Element<'a, M>,
    y_mid: f32,
    total_h: f32,
    slant: f32,
    slant_right: bool,
    safe: f32,
    total_w: f32,
    row_h: f32,
) -> Element<'a, M> {
    let frac = (y_mid / total_h.max(1.0)).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    let (lp, rp) = if slant_right {
        (slant * (1.0 - frac) + safe, slant * frac + safe)
    } else {
        (slant * frac + safe, slant * (1.0 - frac) + safe)
    };
    let inner_w = (total_w - lp - rp).max(10.0);

    let inner_clipped = container(inner)
        .width(Length::Fixed(inner_w))
        .height(Length::Fixed(row_h))
        .clip(true);

    row![
        iced::widget::container(iced::widget::Space::new()).width(Length::Fixed(lp)),
        inner_clipped,
        iced::widget::container(iced::widget::Space::new()).width(Length::Fixed(rp)),
    ]
    .height(Length::Fixed(row_h))
    .width(Length::Fixed(total_w))
    .into()
}

pub fn octagon_row<'a, M: 'a>(
    inner: Element<'a, M>,
    y_mid: f32,
    total_h: f32,
    cut: f32,
    safe: f32,
    total_w: f32,
    row_h: f32,
) -> Element<'a, M> {
    let half_row = row_h * 0.5;
    let y_top = (y_mid - half_row).max(0.0);
    let y_bot = (y_mid + half_row).min(total_h);

    // Inset at row boundary: 0 in the middle band, rises linearly from 0
    // to `cut` as you approach the top or bottom edge.
    let inset_at = |y: f32| -> f32 {
        if cut <= 0.0 {
            return 0.0;
        }
        if y < cut {
            cut - y
        } else if y > total_h - cut {
            y - (total_h - cut)
        } else {
            0.0
        }
    };

    // Take the max of top/bottom insets so a row that straddles the
    // diagonal doesn't poke out on one corner.
    let inset = inset_at(y_top).max(inset_at(y_bot));
    let lp = inset + safe;
    let rp = inset + safe;
    let inner_w = (total_w - lp - rp).max(10.0);

    let inner_clipped = container(inner)
        .width(Length::Fixed(inner_w))
        .height(Length::Fixed(row_h))
        .clip(true);

    row![
        iced::widget::container(iced::widget::Space::new()).width(Length::Fixed(lp)),
        inner_clipped,
        iced::widget::container(iced::widget::Space::new()).width(Length::Fixed(rp)),
    ]
    .height(Length::Fixed(row_h))
    .width(Length::Fixed(total_w))
    .into()
}

pub struct KillButtonShape {
    pub w: f32,
    pub h: f32,
    pub slant: f32,
    pub slant_right: bool,
    pub background: Color,
    pub border_color: Color,
    pub border_width: f32,
    pub x_color: Color,
}

impl<Message> canvas::Program<Message> for KillButtonShape {
    type State = ();
    fn draw(
        &self,
        _state: &Self::State,
        renderer: &iced::Renderer,
        _theme: &Theme,
        bounds: Rectangle,
        _cursor: iced::mouse::Cursor,
    ) -> Vec<Geometry> {
        let mut frame = Frame::new(renderer, bounds.size());
        let half = self.border_width / 2.0;
        let w = self.w;
        let h = self.h;
        let sl = self.slant;

        let path = if self.slant_right {
            Path::new(|b| {
                b.move_to(Point::new(sl + half, half));
                b.line_to(Point::new(w - half, half));
                b.line_to(Point::new(w - sl - half, h - half));
                b.line_to(Point::new(half, h - half));
                b.close();
            })
        } else {
            Path::new(|b| {
                b.move_to(Point::new(half, half));
                b.line_to(Point::new(w - sl - half, half));
                b.line_to(Point::new(w - half, h - half));
                b.line_to(Point::new(sl + half, h - half));
                b.close();
            })
        };

        if self.background.a > 0.0 {
            frame.fill(&path, self.background);
        }
        if self.border_width > 0.0 && self.border_color.a > 0.0 {
            frame.stroke(
                &path,
                Stroke::default()
                    .with_color(self.border_color)
                    .with_width(self.border_width),
            );
        }

        let cx = w / 2.0;
        let cy = h / 2.0;
        let r_x = (w * 0.26).max(3.0);
        let r_y = (h * 0.26).max(3.0);
        let stroke_w = (h * 0.09).max(1.5);

        let inner_h = (h - 2.0 * half).max(1.0);
        let sl_sign = if self.slant_right { 1.0 } else { -1.0 };
        let delta = sl_sign * sl * r_y / inner_h;

        let tl = Point::new(cx - r_x + delta, cy - r_y);
        let tr = Point::new(cx + r_x + delta, cy - r_y);
        let bl = Point::new(cx - r_x - delta, cy + r_y);
        let br = Point::new(cx + r_x - delta, cy + r_y);

        let x_stroke = Stroke::default()
            .with_color(self.x_color)
            .with_width(stroke_w)
            .with_line_cap(canvas::LineCap::Round);
        let diag_a = Path::new(|b| {
            b.move_to(tl);
            b.line_to(br);
        });
        let diag_b = Path::new(|b| {
            b.move_to(bl);
            b.line_to(tr);
        });
        frame.stroke(&diag_a, x_stroke);
        frame.stroke(&diag_b, x_stroke);

        vec![frame.into_geometry()]
    }
}

pub struct InBarTooltipConfig {

    pub w: u32,
    pub h: u32,
    pub cx: i32,
    pub sw: u32,
    pub cap_w: f32,
    pub grow_right: bool,
    pub slant_l: crate::libraries::style::shape_box::SlantSide,
    pub slant_r: crate::libraries::style::shape_box::SlantSide,
    pub drop_ms: f32,
    pub expand_ms: f32,
}

pub fn layer_anchor_and_margin_for(
    s: &crate::libraries::config::ShellSettings,
    w: u32,
    center_on_capsule: bool,
    cx: i32,
    sw: i32,
    cap_w: f32,
    bias_l: i32,
    bias_r: i32,
) -> (iced_layershell::reexport::Anchor, (i32, i32, i32, i32)) {
    use iced_layershell::reexport::Anchor;
    let grow_right = cx < sw / 2;

    let bar_h = s.bar_height as i32;
    let margin_top = (bar_h - s.control_border_width as i32 - 1).max(0);
    let half_cap = (cap_w / 2.0) as i32;

    let adjust_left = s.effective_tooltip_offset_left() + bias_l;
    let adjust_right = s.effective_tooltip_offset_right() + bias_r;

    if center_on_capsule {
        let margin_left = (cx - (w as i32) / 2).max(0);
        (Anchor::Top | Anchor::Left, (margin_top, 0, 0, margin_left))
    } else if grow_right {
        (
            Anchor::Top | Anchor::Left,
            (margin_top, 0, 0, (cx - half_cap + adjust_left).max(0)),
        )
    } else {
        (
            Anchor::Top | Anchor::Right,
            (margin_top, (sw - cx - half_cap + adjust_right).max(0), 0, 0),
        )
    }
}

pub fn truncate_proc_name(name: &str) -> String {
    let max = 22;
    if name.chars().count() > max {
        let mut s: String = name.chars().take(max - 3).collect();
        s.push_str("...");
        s
    } else {
        name.to_string()
    }
}

#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
pub fn proc_kill_row<'a, M: Clone + 'a>(
    name: String,
    metric_str: String,
    metric_w: f32,
    on_kill: M,
    t: &crate::libraries::config::theme::ShellTheme,
    font_size: u16,
    alpha: f32,
    row_w: f32,
    row_h: f32,
    slant_right: bool,
    tooltip_slope: f32,
) -> Element<'a, M> {
    let apply = |c: Color| Color {
        a: c.a * alpha,
        ..c
    };
    let muted = apply(t.muted);
    let danger = apply(t.danger);
    let text_col = apply(t.text);
    let surface_alt = apply(t.surface_alt);

    let kill_w = 32.0;
    let kill_h = 24.0;
    let kill_border = t.control_border_width;
    let half_k = kill_border * 0.5;
    let x_slant = tooltip_slope * (kill_h - 2.0 * half_k);

    let kill_shape = KillButtonShape {
        w: kill_w,
        h: kill_h,
        slant: x_slant,
        slant_right,
        background: surface_alt,
        border_color: danger,
        border_width: kill_border,
        x_color: danger,
    };

    let kill_canvas: Element<'a, M> = canvas::Canvas::new(kill_shape)
        .width(Length::Fixed(kill_w))
        .height(Length::Fixed(kill_h))
        .into();

    let kill_btn = iced::widget::button(kill_canvas)
        .on_press(on_kill)
        .padding(0)
        .width(Length::Fixed(kill_w))
        .height(Length::Fixed(row_h))
        .style(|_t, _s| iced::widget::button::Style {
            background: None,
            ..Default::default()
        });

    let name_clip = container(
        iced::widget::text(name)
            .size((font_size.saturating_sub(4).max(9)) as f32)
            .color(text_col)
            .wrapping(iced::widget::text::Wrapping::None),
    )
    .width(Length::Fill)
    .height(Length::Fixed(row_h))
    .align_y(iced::Alignment::Center)
    .clip(true);

    let metric_container = container(
        iced::widget::text(metric_str)
            .size((font_size.saturating_sub(4).max(9)) as f32)
            .color(muted)
            .wrapping(iced::widget::text::Wrapping::None),
    )
    .width(Length::Fixed(metric_w))
    .height(Length::Fixed(row_h))
    .align_y(iced::Alignment::Center)
    .padding([0.0, 6.0])
    .clip(true);

    row![name_clip, metric_container, kill_btn]
        .spacing(8.0)
        .align_y(iced::Alignment::Center)
        .width(Length::Fixed(row_w))
        .into()
}

#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
pub fn slanted_search_bar<'a, M: Clone + 'static>(
    query: &str,
    on_input: fn(String) -> M,
    t: &crate::libraries::config::theme::ShellTheme,
    control_border_width: f32,
    alpha: f32,
    y: f32,
    total_h: f32,
    slant_h: f32,
    slant_right: bool,
    safe: f32,
    w_f: f32,
    fs: u16,
    tooltip_slope: f32,
    gap: f32,
    frame_ms: u64,
) -> (Element<'a, M>, f32) {
    let search_h = 40.0;
    let y_mid_search = y + search_h * 0.5;
    let frac_s = (y_mid_search / total_h.max(1.0)).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    let (lp_s, rp_s) = if slant_right {
        (slant_h * (1.0 - frac_s) + safe, slant_h * frac_s + safe)
    } else {
        (slant_h * frac_s + safe, slant_h * (1.0 - frac_s) + safe)
    };
    let search_w = (w_f - lp_s - rp_s).max(100.0);
    let half_s = control_border_width * 0.5;
    let search_slant = tooltip_slope * (search_h - 2.0 * half_s);

    let search_bg = crate::overlays::tooltip_engine::ParallelogramBg {
        w: search_w,
        h: search_h,
        slant: search_slant,
        slant_right,
        background: Color {
            a: t.surface_alt.a * alpha,
            ..t.surface_alt
        },
        border_color: Color {
            a: t.text.a * alpha,
            ..t.text
        },
        border_width: control_border_width,
        frame: frame_ms,
    };

    let input_text_col = Color { a: 1.0, ..t.text };
    let input_muted = Color { a: 1.0, ..t.muted };
    let selection_col = Color { a: 1.0, ..t.focus };

    let search_input = iced::widget::text_input("Search programs...", query)
        .on_input(on_input)
        .padding(iced::Padding {
            top: 8.0,
            bottom: 8.0,
            left: search_slant + 8.0,
            right: search_slant + 8.0,
        })
        .size(fs as f32)
        .width(Length::Fill)
        .style(move |_t, _s| iced::widget::text_input::Style {
            background: iced::Background::Color(Color::TRANSPARENT),
            border: iced::Border::default(),
            icon: input_muted,
            placeholder: input_muted,
            value: input_text_col,
            selection: selection_col,
        });

    let search_layer: Element<'a, M> = iced::widget::Stack::new()
        .push(search_bg.view())
        .push(
            container(search_input)
                .width(Length::Fixed(search_w))
                .height(Length::Fixed(search_h))
                .center_x(Length::Fill)
                .center_y(Length::Fill),
        )
        .width(Length::Fixed(search_w))
        .height(Length::Fixed(search_h))
        .into();

    let row_el = slanted_row(
        search_layer,
        y_mid_search,
        total_h,
        slant_h,
        slant_right,
        safe,
        w_f,
        search_h,
    );

    (row_el, y + search_h + gap)
}

pub struct AppLauncher {

    pub fn scan_desktop_files() -> Vec<AppEntry> {
        let mut apps = Vec::new();
        let home = dirs::home_dir().unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from("/tmp"));
        let user = std::env::var("USER").unwrap_or_else(|_| "user".into());

        let mut dirs: Vec<PathBuf> = vec![
            PathBuf::from("/usr/share/applications"),
            PathBuf::from("/usr/local/share/applications"),
            PathBuf::from("/run/current-system/sw/share/applications"),
            PathBuf::from("/etc/profiles/per-user").join(&user).join("share/applications"),
            home.join(".nix-profile/share/applications"),
            PathBuf::from("/var/lib/flatpak/exports/share/applications"),
            home.join(".local/share/flatpak/exports/share/applications"),
            PathBuf::from("/run/flatpak/exports/share/applications"),
            PathBuf::from("/var/lib/snapd/desktop/applications"),
            home.join(".local/share/applications"),
        ];

        if let Ok(xdg) = std::env::var("XDG_DATA_DIRS") {
            for d in xdg.split(':') {
                if !d.is_empty() { dirs.push(PathBuf::from(d).join("applications")); }
            }
        }

        let mut seen = std::collections::HashSet::new();
        for dir in &dirs {
            if !dir.exists() { continue; }
            let entries = match fs::read_dir(dir) { Ok(e) => e, Err(_) => continue };
            for entry in entries.flatten() {
                let path = entry.path();
                if path.extension().and_then(|s| s.to_str()) != Some("desktop") { continue; }
                let Ok(content) = fs::read_to_string(&path) else { continue; };
                let mut name: Option<String> = None;
                let mut exec: Option<String> = None;
                let mut icon_name: Option<String> = None;
                let mut nodisplay = false;
                let mut hidden_flag = false;
                let mut in_main_section = false;

                for line in content.lines() {
                    let line = line.trim();
                    if line.starts_with('[') {
                        in_main_section = line.eq_ignore_ascii_case("[Desktop Entry]");
                        continue;
                    }
                    if !in_main_section { continue; }
                    if let Some(v) = line.strip_prefix("Name=") {
                        if name.is_none() { name = Some(v.trim().chars().take(256).collect::<String>()); }
                    } else if let Some(v) = line.strip_prefix("Exec=") {
                        if exec.is_none() { exec = Some(Self::strip_field_codes(v.trim()).trim().chars().take(4096).collect::<String>()); }
                    } else if let Some(v) = line.strip_prefix("Icon=") {
                        if icon_name.is_none() { icon_name = Some(v.trim().chars().take(128).collect::<String>()); }
                    } else if line.eq_ignore_ascii_case("NoDisplay=true") {
                        nodisplay = true;
                    } else if line.eq_ignore_ascii_case("Hidden=true") {
                        hidden_flag = true;
                    }
                }

                if nodisplay || hidden_flag { continue; }
                if let (Some(n), Some(e)) = (name.clone(), exec.clone()) {
                    if e.is_empty() { continue; }
                    let key = format!("{}|{}", n.to_lowercase(), e.to_lowercase());
                    if !seen.contains(&key) {
                        seen.insert(key);
                        let icon_path = icon_name.as_deref().and_then(Self::resolve_icon);
                        apps.push(AppEntry { name: n, exec: e, icon: "🚀".to_string(), icon_path });
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        apps.sort_by_key(|a| a.name.to_lowercase());
        apps
    }

    fn resolve_icon(name: &str) -> Option<String> {
        crate::libraries::process::resolve_icon_path(name).map(|p| p.to_string_lossy().into_owned())
    }

    pub fn update(&mut self, message: LauncherMessage) -> iced::Task<LauncherMessage> {
        match message {
            LauncherMessage::Refocus => return iced::widget::operation::focus(LAUNCHER_SEARCH_ID),
            LauncherMessage::EnterPressed => {
                if self.search_query.trim().to_lowercase() == "music" {
                    if self.music_focus_idx == 0 {
                        return self.update(LauncherMessage::MusicPlaySelected);
                    } else {
                        return self.update(LauncherMessage::MusicTriggerAction);
                    }
                } else if let Some(selected) = self.filtered_apps.get(self.selected_index) {
                    return self.update(LauncherMessage::ExecuteApp(selected.exec.clone()));
                }
                return iced::Task::none();
            }
            LauncherMessage::MusicTriggerAction => {
                match self.music_focus_idx {
                    3 => return self.update(LauncherMessage::MusicPrev),
                    4 => return self.update(LauncherMessage::MusicPlayPause),
                    5 => return self.update(LauncherMessage::MusicNext),
                    6 => return self.update(LauncherMessage::MusicCycle),
                    7 => {
                        if let Some(m) = &self.music_state {
                            return self.update(LauncherMessage::MusicOpenFolder(m.url.clone()));
                        }
                    }
                    8 => {
                        if self.trash_confirm {
                            if let Some(m) = &self.music_state {
                                return self.update(LauncherMessage::MusicTrashExecute(m.url.clone()));
                            }
                        } else {
                            return self.update(LauncherMessage::MusicTrashConfirm);
                        }
                    }
                    9 => return self.update(LauncherMessage::MusicToggleSource(0)),
                    10 => return self.update(LauncherMessage::MusicToggleSource(1)),
                    11 => return self.update(LauncherMessage::MusicToggleSource(2)),
                    12 => return self.update(LauncherMessage::MusicPlaySelected),
                    _ => {}
                }
                return iced::Task::none();
            }
            LauncherMessage::SelectNext => {
                if self.search_query.trim().to_lowercase() == "music" {
                    if self.music_focus_idx == 0 {
                        return iced::Task::none(); // Let text_input handle Right arrow
                    } else if self.music_focus_idx == 1 {
                        if let Some(m) = &self.music_state {
                            return self.update(LauncherMessage::MusicSeek((m.position_sec + 5.0).min(m.length_sec)));
                        }
                    } else if self.music_focus_idx == 2 {
                        if let Some(m) = &self.music_state {
                            return self.update(LauncherMessage::MusicSetVolume((m.volume_pct + 5).min(100)));
                        }
                    } else {
                        self.music_focus_idx = match self.music_focus_idx {
                            3 | 4 | 5 | 6 => (self.music_focus_idx + 1).min(6),
                            7 | 8 => (self.music_focus_idx + 1).min(8),
                            9 | 10 | 11 => (self.music_focus_idx + 1).min(11),
                            _ => self.music_focus_idx,
                        };
                        return iced::widget::operation::focus(FOCUS_DUMMY_ID);
                    }
                } else if !self.filtered_apps.is_empty() {
                    self.selected_index = (self.selected_index + 1) % self.filtered_apps.len();
                }
                return iced::Task::none();
            }
            LauncherMessage::SelectPrev => {
                if self.search_query.trim().to_lowercase() == "music" {
                    if self.music_focus_idx == 0 {
                        return iced::Task::none(); // Let text_input handle Left arrow
                    } else if self.music_focus_idx == 1 {
                        if let Some(m) = &self.music_state {
                            return self.update(LauncherMessage::MusicSeek((m.position_sec - 5.0).max(0.0)));
                        }
                    } else if self.music_focus_idx == 2 {
                        if let Some(m) = &self.music_state {
                            return self.update(LauncherMessage::MusicSetVolume(m.volume_pct.saturating_sub(5)));
                        }
                    } else {
                        self.music_focus_idx = match self.music_focus_idx {
                            3 | 4 | 5 | 6 => (self.music_focus_idx - 1).max(3),
                            7 | 8 => (self.music_focus_idx - 1).max(7),
                            9 | 10 | 11 => (self.music_focus_idx - 1).max(9),
                            _ => self.music_focus_idx,
                        };
                        return iced::widget::operation::focus(FOCUS_DUMMY_ID);
                    }
                } else if !self.filtered_apps.is_empty() {
                    self.selected_index = (self.selected_index + self.filtered_apps.len() - 1) % self.filtered_apps.len();
                }
                return iced::Task::none();
            }
            LauncherMessage::SelectDown => {
                if self.search_query.trim().to_lowercase() == "music" {
                    if self.music_focus_idx == 12 && self.music_selected_idx < self.music_search_results.len().saturating_sub(1) {
                        self.music_selected_idx += 1;
                        return iced::widget::operation::scroll_to(
                            iced::widget::Id::new("music_scroll"),
                            iced::widget::scrollable::AbsoluteOffset { x: 0.0, y: (self.music_selected_idx as f32 * 28.0 - 50.0).max(0.0) },
                        );
                    } else if self.music_focus_idx < 12 {
                        self.music_focus_idx = match self.music_focus_idx {
                            0 => 1,
                            1 => 2,
                            2 => 4, // Volume -> Play
                            3 | 4 | 5 | 6 => 7, // Controls -> Folder
                            7 | 8 => 9, // Act -> Local
                            9 | 10 | 11 => 12, // Sources -> Results
                            _ => 12,
                        };
                        if self.music_focus_idx == 0 { return iced::widget::operation::focus(MUSIC_SEARCH_ID); }
                        return iced::widget::operation::focus(FOCUS_DUMMY_ID);
                    }
                    return iced::Task::none();
                } else if !self.filtered_apps.is_empty() {
                    let math_count = self.filtered_apps.iter().filter(|a| a.exec.starts_with("math:")).count();
                    let step = if math_count > 0 && self.selected_index < math_count { 3 } else { 1 };
                    self.selected_index = (self.selected_index + step).min(self.filtered_apps.len() - 1);
                }
                return iced::Task::none();
            }
            LauncherMessage::SelectUp => {
                if self.search_query.trim().to_lowercase() == "music" {
                    if self.music_focus_idx == 12 && self.music_selected_idx > 0 {
                        self.music_selected_idx -= 1;
                        return iced::widget::operation::scroll_to(
                            iced::widget::Id::new("music_scroll"),
                            iced::widget::scrollable::AbsoluteOffset { x: 0.0, y: (self.music_selected_idx as f32 * 28.0 - 50.0).max(0.0) },
                        );
                    } else if self.music_focus_idx > 0 {
                        self.music_focus_idx = match self.music_focus_idx {
                            0 => 0,
                            1 => 0,
                            2 => 1,
                            3 | 4 | 5 | 6 => 2, // Controls -> Volume
                            7 | 8 => 4, // Act -> Play
                            9 | 10 | 11 => 7, // Sources -> Folder
                            12 => 11, // Results -> Browser
                            _ => 0,
                        };
                        if self.music_focus_idx == 0 { return iced::widget::operation::focus(MUSIC_SEARCH_ID); }
                        return iced::widget::operation::focus(FOCUS_DUMMY_ID);
                    }
                    return iced::Task::none();
                } else if !self.filtered_apps.is_empty() {
                    let math_count = self.filtered_apps.iter().filter(|a| a.exec.starts_with("math:")).count();
                    let step = if math_count > 0 && self.selected_index < math_count { 3 } else { 1 };
                    self.selected_index = self.selected_index.saturating_sub(step);
                }
                return iced::Task::none();
            }
            LauncherMessage::DictLookupReady(word, defs) => {
                self.dict_cache.insert(word.clone(), defs);
                if self.dict_pending.as_deref() == Some(&word) { self.dict_pending = None; }
                let q = self.search_query.clone();
                return self.update(LauncherMessage::SearchChanged(q));
            }
            LauncherMessage::SearchChanged(q) => {
                self.search_query = q.clone();
                self.selected_index = 0;
                let lower = q.trim().to_lowercase();
                
                if lower == "music" {
                    self.music_focus_idx = 0;
                    let mut tasks = vec![iced::widget::operation::focus(MUSIC_SEARCH_ID)];
                    if self.music_state.is_none() {
                        tasks.push(iced::Task::perform(async { poll_track().await.0 }, LauncherMessage::MusicLoaded));
                    }
                    return iced::Task::batch(tasks);
                }

                let mut filtered: Vec<AppEntry> = if lower.is_empty() {
                    self.all_apps.clone()
                } else {
                    let mut f: Vec<AppEntry> = self.all_apps.iter()
                        .filter(|a| a.name.to_lowercase().contains(&lower) || a.exec.to_lowercase().contains(&lower))
                        .cloned().collect();
                    if let Some(alias) = Self::routing_alias(&lower) {
                        if !f.iter().any(|a| a.exec == alias.exec) { f.insert(0, alias); }
                    }
                    f
                };

                if let Some(dict_entries) = self.compute_dict_entries(&q) {
                    let mut dict_items = dict_entries;
                    dict_items.append(&mut filtered);
                    filtered = dict_items;
                    if let Some(word) = self.dict_word_to_lookup(&q) {
                        self.dict_pending = Some(word.clone());
                        self.filtered_apps = filtered;
                        let w1 = word.clone();
                        return iced::Task::perform(async move { DictionaryOverlay::lookup_word(&w1).await }, move |defs| LauncherMessage::DictLookupReady(word.clone(), defs));
                    }
                }

                if let Some(pass_entries) = Self::compute_pass_entries(&q) {
                    let mut pass_items: Vec<AppEntry> = pass_entries.into_iter().map(|(name, exec)| AppEntry { name, exec, icon: ">".to_string(), icon_path: None }).collect();
                    pass_items.append(&mut filtered);
                    filtered = pass_items;
                }

                let conversions = Self::compute_multi_conversions(&q);
                if !conversions.is_empty() {
                    let mut math_entries: Vec<AppEntry> = conversions.into_iter().map(|(label, exec)| AppEntry { name: label, exec, icon: "=".to_string(), icon_path: None }).collect();
                    math_entries.append(&mut filtered);
                    filtered = math_entries;
                }

                self.filtered_apps = filtered;
                return iced::Task::none();
            }
            LauncherMessage::MusicLoaded(state) => {
                self.music_state = state;
                return iced::Task::none();
            }
            LauncherMessage::MusicTick => {
                if self.search_query.trim().to_lowercase() == "music" {
                    return iced::Task::perform(async { poll_track().await.0 }, LauncherMessage::MusicLoaded);
                }
                return iced::Task::none();
            }
            LauncherMessage::MusicPlayPause => {
                return iced::Task::perform(async {
                    if let Ok(exe) = std::env::current_exe() { let _ = tokio::process::Command::new(exe).arg("--music-play-pause").status().await; }
                    tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(300)).await;
                    poll_track().await.0
                }, LauncherMessage::MusicLoaded);
            }
            LauncherMessage::MusicNext => {
                return iced::Task::perform(async {
                    if let Ok(exe) = std::env::current_exe() { let _ = tokio::process::Command::new(exe).arg("--music-next").status().await; }
                    tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(300)).await;
                    poll_track().await.0
                }, LauncherMessage::MusicLoaded);
            }
            LauncherMessage::MusicPrev => {
                return iced::Task::perform(async {
                    if let Ok(exe) = std::env::current_exe() { let _ = tokio::process::Command::new(exe).arg("--music-previous").status().await; }
                    tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(300)).await;
                    poll_track().await.0
                }, LauncherMessage::MusicLoaded);
            }
            LauncherMessage::MusicCycle => {
                return iced::Task::perform(async {
                    if let Ok(exe) = std::env::current_exe() { let _ = tokio::process::Command::new(exe).arg("--music-cycle").status().await; }
                    tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(500)).await;
                    poll_track().await.0
                }, LauncherMessage::MusicLoaded);
            }
            LauncherMessage::MusicSeek(secs) => {
                if let Some(m) = &mut self.music_state {
                    m.position_sec = secs;
                }
                return iced::Task::perform(async move { 
                    let _ = MprisBackend::set_position(secs).await; 
                    let _ = LocalMusicBackend::seek(secs).await;
                    tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(250)).await;
                    MprisBackend::clear_cache();
                    LocalMusicBackend::clear_cache();
                    poll_track().await.0
                }, LauncherMessage::MusicLoaded);
            }
            LauncherMessage::MusicSetVolume(vol) => {
                if let Some(m) = &mut self.music_state {
                    m.volume_pct = vol;
                }
                return iced::Task::perform(async move { 
                    let _ = MprisBackend::set_volume(vol).await; 
                    let _ = LocalMusicBackend::set_volume(vol).await;
                    tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(250)).await;
                    MprisBackend::clear_cache();
                    LocalMusicBackend::clear_cache();
                    poll_track().await.0
                }, LauncherMessage::MusicLoaded);
            }
            LauncherMessage::MusicOpenFolder(url) => return iced::Task::perform(async move { crate::libraries::backend::MprisBackend::open_track_folder(url.as_deref()).await; }, |_| LauncherMessage::MusicTick),
            LauncherMessage::MusicTrashConfirm => self.trash_confirm = true,
            LauncherMessage::MusicTrashExecute(url) => {
                self.trash_confirm = false;
                return iced::Task::perform(async move { crate::libraries::backend::MprisBackend::trash_current_track(url.as_deref()).await; }, |_| LauncherMessage::MusicTick);
            }
            LauncherMessage::MusicToggleSource(idx) => {
                match idx {
                    0 => self.music_sources.local = !self.music_sources.local,
                    1 => self.music_sources.spotify = !self.music_sources.spotify,
                    2 => self.music_sources.browser = !self.music_sources.browser,
                    _ => {}
                }
                self.music_sources.save();
            }
            LauncherMessage::MusicSearchChanged(q) => {
                self.music_search_query = q.clone();
                self.music_selected_idx = 0;
                if q.is_empty() { self.music_search_results.clear(); return iced::Task::none(); }
                return iced::Task::perform(async move { LocalMusicBackend::search_songs(&q).await }, LauncherMessage::MusicSearchResults);
            }
            LauncherMessage::MusicSearchSubmit => return iced::Task::done(LauncherMessage::MusicPlaySelected),
            LauncherMessage::MusicSearchResults(res) => { self.music_search_results = res; self.music_selected_idx = 0; }
            LauncherMessage::MusicSelectNext => { if !self.music_search_results.is_empty() { self.music_selected_idx = (self.music_selected_idx + 1).min(self.music_search_results.len() - 1); } }
            LauncherMessage::MusicSelectPrev => { if !self.music_search_results.is_empty() { self.music_selected_idx = self.music_selected_idx.saturating_sub(1); } }
            LauncherMessage::MusicPlaySelected => {
                if self.music_search_results.get(self.music_selected_idx).is_some() {
                    let urls: Vec<String> = self.music_search_results.iter().map(|(_, u)| u.clone()).collect();
                    let idx = self.music_selected_idx;
                    return iced::Task::perform(async move {
                        LocalMusicBackend::play_queue(&urls, idx).await;
                        tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(300)).await;
                        poll_track().await.0
                    }, LauncherMessage::MusicLoaded);
                }
            }
            LauncherMessage::MusicPlaySong(url) => {
                if let Some(idx) = self.music_search_results.iter().position(|(_, u)| u == &url) {
                    let urls: Vec<String> = self.music_search_results.iter().map(|(_, u)| u.clone()).collect();
                    return iced::Task::perform(async move {
                        LocalMusicBackend::play_queue(&urls, idx).await;
                        tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(300)).await;
                        poll_track().await.0
                    }, LauncherMessage::MusicLoaded);
                }
            }
            _ => {}
        }
        iced::Task::none()
    }

    fn routing_alias(query: &str) -> Option<AppEntry> {
        let (name, exec) = match query {
            "cfg" | "set" | "settings" | "config" | "prefs" | "preferences" | "options" | "settings & options" | "preference" | "configuration" => ("Settings & Options", "internal:settings"),
            "clip" | "clipboard" | "clipboard manager" | "clipboard history" | "paste" | "pastebin" => ("Clipboard Manager", "internal:clip"),
            "todo" | "td" | "task" | "tasks" | "tasks & todos" | "task list" => ("Tasks & Todos", "internal:todo"),
            "note" | "notes" | "quick notes" | "quicknote" => ("Quick Notes", "internal:notes"),
            "power" | "pwr" | "session" | "power & session" | "logout" | "reboot" | "shutdown" | "lock" | "lockscreen" => ("Power & Session", "internal:power"),
            "remind" | "reminder" | "reminders" | "alarm" | "alarms" | "reminders & alarms" | "timer" | "timers" => ("Reminders & Alarms", "internal:reminders"),
            "." | "unicode" | "glyph" | "glyphs" | "symbol" | "symbols" | "emoji" | "emojis" | "unicode glyphs" => ("Unicode", "internal:unicode"),
            "email" | "mail" | "em" | "mail client" | "inbox" => ("Email", "internal:email"),
            "rng" | "dice" | "roll" | "random" | "rand" | "d20" => ("RNG / Dice", "internal:rng"),
            "web" | "search" | "web search" | "google" | "ddg" | "duckduckgo" => ("Web Search", "internal:web"),
            "amogus" | "amongus" | "among us" | "sus" => ("Among Us", "internal:amogus"),
            "shot" | "screenshot" | "capture" => ("Screenshot", "moonbeauty --screenshot"),
            _ => return None,
        };
        Some(AppEntry { name: name.into(), exec: exec.into(), icon: ">".into(), icon_path: None })
    }

    #[cfg(test)]
    pub(crate) fn parse_exec_for_test(exec: &str) -> Option<(String, Vec<String>)> { Self::parse_exec(exec) }
    #[cfg(test)]
    pub(crate) fn strip_field_codes_for_test(raw: &str) -> String { Self::strip_field_codes(raw) }

    fn strip_field_codes(raw: &str) -> String {
        let mut out = String::with_capacity(raw.len());
        let mut it = raw.chars().peekable();
        while let Some(c) = it.next() {
            if c == '%' {
                match it.next() {
                    Some('%') => out.push('%'),
                    Some(_) => {} 
                    None => out.push('%'),
                }
            } else { out.push(c); }
        }
        out
    }

    fn parse_exec(exec: &str) -> Option<(String, Vec<String>)> {
        let mut tokens: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
        let mut cur = String::new();
        let mut in_single = false;
        let mut in_double = false;
        let mut it = exec.chars().peekable();
        while let Some(c) = it.next() {
            match (c, in_single, in_double) {
                ('\\', false, false) => {
                    if let Some(&n) = it.peek() { cur.push(n); it.next(); } else { cur.push('\\'); }
                }
                ('\'', false, false) => in_single = true,
                ('\'', true, _) => in_single = false,
                ('"', false, false) => in_double = true,
                ('"', _, true) => in_double = false,
                (' ', false, false) | ('\t', false, false) => {
                    if !cur.is_empty() { tokens.push(std::mem::take(&mut cur)); }
                }
                _ => cur.push(c),
            }
        }
        if in_single || in_double { return None; }
        if !cur.is_empty() { tokens.push(cur); }
        let mut tok_it = tokens.into_iter();
        let prog = tok_it.next()?;
        Some((prog, tok_it.collect()))
    }

    pub async fn launch(exec: &str) {
        if exec.is_empty() { return; }
        let Some((prog, args)) = Self::parse_exec(exec) else {
            crate::dbg_log!("[launcher] refusing to launch: unparseable Exec {:?}", exec);
            return;
        };
        let _ = Command::new("systemd-run").args(["--user", "--collect", "--quiet", "--slice=app.slice", "--"]).arg(&prog).args(&args).spawn();
    }

    pub fn view<'a>(
        &'a self,
        theme: &'a ShellTheme,
        settings: &ShellSettings,
    ) -> Element<'a, LauncherMessage> {
        let (win_w, win_h) = settings.get_window_size("launcher", 840, 650);

        let cut_f = theme.overlay_cut;
        let angle_deg = theme.overlay_angle;
        let pad_top = 18.0_f32;
        let pad_bottom = 16.0_f32;
        let hex = AngledHexGeometry::new(win_w, win_h, cut_f, angle_deg);
        let (search_inward, _list_top_inset, _list_bottom_inset, list_side_inset) =
            hex.search_list_insets();
        let footer_inward = hex.inset_at(pad_bottom + 8.0, 16.0);

        let input = text_input("Search applications or settings...", &self.search_query)
            .id(LAUNCHER_SEARCH_ID)
            .font(shell_font(iced::font::Weight::Normal))
            .on_input(LauncherMessage::SearchChanged)
            .on_submit(LauncherMessage::EnterPressed)
            .padding(14)
            .size((theme.font_size_overlay) as f32)
            .width(Length::Fill)
            .style(move |_t, status| {
                let border_color = match status {
                    text_input::Status::Focused { .. } => theme.focus,
                    text_input::Status::Hovered => theme.border,
                    _ => theme.border,
                };
                let border_width = match status {
                    text_input::Status::Focused { .. } => theme.control_border_width + 0.5,
                    _ => theme.control_border_width,
                };
                text_input::Style {
                    background: iced::Background::Color(theme.surface_alt),
                    border: iced::Border { color: border_color, width: border_width, radius: 8.0.into() },
                    icon: theme.muted, placeholder: theme.muted, value: theme.text, selection: theme.focus,
                }
            });

        let input_row = container(input).width(Length::Fill).padding(Padding { top: 0.0, right: search_inward, bottom: 0.0, left: search_inward });

        let bottom_footer = container(
            text("↑↓ Select  •  Tab Focus  •  Enter Activate  •  ESC Dismiss")
                .size(11).shell().color(theme.muted).align_x(Alignment::Center),
        ).width(Length::Fill).padding(Padding { top: 0.0, right: footer_inward, bottom: 0.0, left: footer_inward });

        let card_bg = ShapeBox::new()
            .shape(ShapeType::AngledHexagon { cut: cut_f, angle_deg })
            .background(theme.background)
            .border(theme.border, theme.border_width)
            .size(Length::Fixed(win_w), Length::Fixed(win_h));

        if self.search_query.trim().to_lowercase() == "music" {
            let music_ui: Element<'_, LauncherMessage> = if let Some(m) = &self.music_state {
                let title = if m.title.is_empty() { "No Track" } else { &m.title };
                let artist = if m.artist.is_empty() { "No Artist" } else { &m.artist };
                let playing_btn = if m.is_playing { "Pause" } else { "Play" };

                let focus_border = |idx: usize| {
                    if self.music_focus_idx == idx { theme.focus } else { theme.border }
                };
                let focus_bg = |idx: usize| {
