                    if self.music_focus_idx == idx { theme.surface_alt } else { theme.background }
                };

                let seek_bar = iced::widget::slider(0.0..=m.length_sec.max(1.0), m.position_sec, LauncherMessage::MusicSeek)
                    .style(move |_t, _s| iced::widget::slider::Style {
                        rail: iced::widget::slider::Rail { backgrounds: (iced::Background::Color(theme.text), iced::Background::Color(theme.surface_alt)), width: 2.0, border: iced::Border { color: focus_border(1), width: 2.0, radius: 2.0.into() } },
                        handle: iced::widget::slider::Handle { shape: iced::widget::slider::HandleShape::Rectangle { width: 10, border_radius: 0.0.into() }, background: iced::Background::Color(theme.text), border_color: focus_border(1), border_width: 2.0 },
                    });

                let vol_bar = iced::widget::slider(0..=100, m.volume_pct, LauncherMessage::MusicSetVolume)
                    .style(move |_t, _s| iced::widget::slider::Style {
                        rail: iced::widget::slider::Rail { backgrounds: (iced::Background::Color(theme.text), iced::Background::Color(theme.surface_alt)), width: 2.0, border: iced::Border { color: focus_border(2), width: 2.0, radius: 2.0.into() } },
                        handle: iced::widget::slider::Handle { shape: iced::widget::slider::HandleShape::Rectangle { width: 10, border_radius: 0.0.into() }, background: iced::Background::Color(theme.text), border_color: focus_border(2), border_width: 2.0 },
                    });

                let btn_style = move |idx: usize| {
                    move |_t: &iced::Theme, _s: button::Status| button::Style {
                        background: Some(iced::Background::Color(focus_bg(idx))),
                        border: iced::Border { color: focus_border(idx), width: 2.0, radius: 4.0.into() },
                        text_color: theme.text, ..Default::default()
                    }
                };

                let controls = row![
                    button(text("< Prev").size(14)).on_press(LauncherMessage::MusicPrev).padding([6, 12]).width(Length::Fill).style(btn_style(3)),
                    button(text(playing_btn).size(14)).on_press(LauncherMessage::MusicPlayPause).padding([6, 12]).width(Length::Fill).style(btn_style(4)),
                    button(text("Next >").size(14)).on_press(LauncherMessage::MusicNext).padding([6, 12]).width(Length::Fill).style(btn_style(5)),
                    button(text("Cycle").size(14)).on_press(LauncherMessage::MusicCycle).padding([6, 12]).width(Length::Fill).style(btn_style(6)),
                ].spacing(10).width(Length::Fill);

                let act_row = row![
                    button(text("Folder").size(14)).on_press(LauncherMessage::MusicOpenFolder(m.url.clone())).padding([6, 12]).width(Length::Fill).style(btn_style(7)),
                    button(text(if self.trash_confirm { "Confirm?" } else { "Trash" }).size(14).color(if self.trash_confirm { theme.danger } else { theme.text }))
                        .on_press(if self.trash_confirm { LauncherMessage::MusicTrashExecute(m.url.clone()) } else { LauncherMessage::MusicTrashConfirm })
                        .padding([6, 12]).width(Length::Fill).style(btn_style(8)),
                ].spacing(10).width(Length::Fill);

                let src_btn = |label: &'static str, idx: usize| -> Element<'_, LauncherMessage> {
                    let active = match idx { 0 => self.music_sources.local, 1 => self.music_sources.spotify, 2 => self.music_sources.browser, _ => false };
                    let focused = self.music_focus_idx == 9 + idx;
                    
                    let bg = if focused {
                        theme.surface_alt // Focused background overrides active state
                    } else if active {
                        theme.text // Active background
                    } else {
                        theme.background // Inactive background
                    };
                    let fg = if focused {
                        theme.text
                    } else if active {
                        theme.background
                    } else {
                        theme.text
                    };
                    
                    button(text(label).size(12).bold().color(fg))
                        .on_press(LauncherMessage::MusicToggleSource(idx)).padding([4, 10]).width(Length::Fill)
                        .style(move |_t, _s| button::Style { 
                            background: Some(iced::Background::Color(bg)), 
                            border: iced::Border { color: if focused { theme.focus } else { theme.border }, width: if focused { 3.0 } else { 1.0 }, radius: 4.0.into() }, 
                            text_color: fg, 
                            ..Default::default() 
                        }).into()
                };

                let src_row = row![
                    text("Sources:").size(12).bold().color(theme.text),
                    iced::widget::space::horizontal(),
                    src_btn("Local", 0), src_btn("Spotify", 1), src_btn("Browser", 2)
                ].spacing(10).align_y(Alignment::Center).width(Length::Fill);

                let search_input = text_input("Search local music...", &self.music_search_query)
                    .id(MUSIC_SEARCH_ID)
                    .on_input(LauncherMessage::MusicSearchChanged)
                    .on_submit(LauncherMessage::MusicSearchSubmit)
                    .padding(8).size(14)
                    .style(move |_t, _s| text_input::Style {
                        background: iced::Background::Color(focus_bg(0)),
                        border: iced::Border { color: focus_border(0), width: 2.0, radius: 4.0.into() },
                        icon: theme.text, placeholder: theme.text, value: theme.text, selection: theme.text,
                    });

                let mut results_col = column![].spacing(2);
                for (i, (title, url)) in self.music_search_results.iter().enumerate() {
                    let url_clone = url.clone();
                    let is_sel = i == self.music_selected_idx;
                    let bg = if is_sel { theme.text } else { theme.background };
                    let fg = if is_sel { theme.background } else { theme.text };
                    
                    let btn = button(text(title).size(12).color(fg)).on_press(LauncherMessage::MusicPlaySong(url_clone)).padding(6).width(Length::Fill)
                        .style(move |_t, _s| button::Style { 
                            background: Some(iced::Background::Color(bg)), 
                            border: iced::Border { color: if is_sel && self.music_focus_idx == 12 { theme.focus } else { theme.text }, width: if is_sel && self.music_focus_idx == 12 { 2.0 } else { 1.0 }, radius: 4.0.into() }, 
                            ..Default::default() 
                        });
                    results_col = results_col.push(btn);
                }
                
                let scroll_results = scrollable(results_col).id(iced::widget::Id::new("music_scroll")).height(Length::Fill);

                container(
                    column![
                        search_input,
                        scroll_results,
                        text(format!("{} - {}", title, artist)).size(18).bold().color(theme.text).align_x(Alignment::Center),
                        column![
                            row![text("0:00").size(12).color(theme.text), seek_bar, text(format!("{}:{:02}", (m.length_sec as u32)/60, (m.length_sec as u32)%60)).size(12).color(theme.text)].spacing(10).align_y(Alignment::Center),
                            row![text("VOL").size(12).bold().color(theme.text), vol_bar, text(format!("{}%", m.volume_pct)).size(12).color(theme.text)].spacing(10).align_y(Alignment::Center),
                        ].spacing(10),
                        controls,
                        act_row,
                        src_row,
                        text_input("", "").id(FOCUS_DUMMY_ID).width(Length::Fixed(0.0)),
                    ].spacing(14).align_x(Alignment::Center).width(Length::Fill).height(Length::Fill)
                ).padding(20).width(Length::Fill).height(Length::Fill).into()
            } else {
                container(text("Loading music...").size(20).color(theme.muted)).center_x(Length::Fill).padding(40).into()
            };

            let music_list = container(music_ui).width(Length::Fill).height(Length::Fill).padding(Padding { top: 10.0, right: list_side_inset, bottom: 0.0, left: list_side_inset });

            let card_content = container(
                column![input_row, music_list, bottom_footer].spacing(12).width(Length::Fill).height(Length::Fill),
            )
            .padding(Padding { top: pad_top, right: 0.0, bottom: pad_bottom, left: 0.0 })
            .width(Length::Fixed(win_w)).height(Length::Fixed(win_h));

            let card = Stack::new().push(card_bg.view()).push(card_content);
            return container(card).center_x(Length::Fill).center_y(Length::Fill).into();
        }

        let math_count = self.filtered_apps.iter().filter(|a| a.exec.starts_with("math:")).count();
        let math_items: Vec<&AppEntry> = self.filtered_apps.iter().filter(|a| a.exec.starts_with("math:")).take(40).collect();
        let app_items: Vec<&AppEntry> = self.filtered_apps.iter().filter(|a| !a.exec.starts_with("math:")).take(40).collect();

        let mut content_col = column![].spacing(10).width(Length::Fill);

        if !math_items.is_empty() {
            let tile_h = 76.0_f32;
            let content_w = win_w - list_side_inset * 2.0;
            let tile_w = ((content_w - 12.0) / 3.0).max(60.0);
            let mut grid_col = column![].spacing(6).width(Length::Fill);
            for (chunk_idx, chunk) in math_items.chunks(3).enumerate() {
                let mut grid_row = Row::new().spacing(6).width(Length::Fill);
                for (rel_i, item) in chunk.iter().enumerate() {
                    let global_idx = chunk_idx * 3 + rel_i;
                    let is_selected = global_idx == self.selected_index;
                    let exec_cmd = item.exec.clone();
                    let copy_val = item.exec.strip_prefix("math:").unwrap_or("").to_string();
                    let input_part = if item.name.starts_with("= ") {
                        let q = self.search_query.clone();
                        if q.chars().count() > 20 { q.chars().take(17).collect::<String>() + "..." } else { q }
                    } else { item.name.split(" = ").next().unwrap_or("").to_string() };

                    let bg = if is_selected { theme.surface_alt } else { theme.background };
                    let border_c = if is_selected { theme.text } else { theme.border };

                    let tile_bg = ShapeBox::new().shape(ShapeType::Hexagon { cut: 8 }).background(bg).border(border_c, theme.control_border_width).size(Length::Fixed(tile_w), Length::Fixed(tile_h));
                    let tile_content = container(
                        column![
                            text(copy_val).size((theme.font_size_overlay + 1) as f32).bold().color(theme.text).align_x(Alignment::Center).wrapping(iced::widget::text::Wrapping::None),
                            text(input_part).size((theme.font_size_normal.saturating_sub(2)) as f32).color(theme.muted).align_x(Alignment::Center).wrapping(iced::widget::text::Wrapping::None),
                        ].spacing(2).align_x(Alignment::Center),
                    ).width(Length::Fill).height(Length::Fill).center_x(Length::Fill).center_y(Length::Fill).padding([0, 20]);

                    let tile_inner = container(Stack::new().push(tile_bg.view()).push(tile_content)).width(Length::Fixed(tile_w)).height(Length::Fixed(tile_h)).clip(true);
                    let tile = button(tile_inner).on_press(LauncherMessage::ExecuteApp(exec_cmd)).padding(0).width(Length::Fixed(tile_w)).height(Length::Fixed(tile_h))
                        .style(|_t, _s| button::Style { background: None, ..Default::default() });
                    grid_row = grid_row.push(tile);
                }
                for _ in chunk.len()..3 { grid_row = grid_row.push(container("").width(Length::Fixed(tile_w)).height(Length::Fixed(tile_h))); }
                grid_col = grid_col.push(grid_row);
            }
            content_col = content_col.push(grid_col);
        }

        if !app_items.is_empty() {
            let gap = 12.0;
            let inner_pad_x = 20.0;
            let inner_pad_y = 10.0;
            let icon_size = settings.launcher_icon_size as f32;
            let icon_hex_size = icon_size * 1.40;
            let icon_hex_cut: u16 = ((icon_hex_size * 0.10) as u16).max(8);
            let row_h = icon_hex_size + inner_pad_y * 2.0;
            let row_w = win_w - list_side_inset * 2.0;
            let mut grid_col = column![].spacing(gap);

            for (idx_offset, app) in app_items.iter().enumerate() {
                let idx = math_count + idx_offset;
                let exec_cmd = app.exec.clone();
                let is_selected = idx == self.selected_index;

                let row_bg = ShapeBox::new()
                    .shape(ShapeType::Hexagon { cut: 18 })
                    .background(if is_selected { theme.surface_alt } else { theme.background })
                    .border(if is_selected { theme.text } else { theme.border }, theme.control_border_width)
                    .size(Length::Fixed(row_w), Length::Fixed(row_h));

                let icon_elem: Element<'_, LauncherMessage> = if let Some(ref path) = app.icon_path {
                    if path.ends_with(".svg") {
                        iced::widget::svg(iced::widget::svg::Handle::from_path(path.clone())).width(Length::Fixed(icon_size)).height(Length::Fixed(icon_size)).into()
                    } else {
                        iced::widget::image(iced::widget::image::Handle::from_path(path.clone())).width(Length::Fixed(icon_size)).height(Length::Fixed(icon_size)).content_fit(iced::ContentFit::Contain).into()
                    }
                } else {
                    container(text(&app.icon).size(64).color(theme.text)).width(Length::Fixed(icon_size)).height(Length::Fixed(icon_size)).center_x(Length::Fill).center_y(Length::Fill).into()
                };

                let icon_bg = ShapeBox::new().shape(ShapeType::Hexagon { cut: icon_hex_cut }).background(theme.background)
                    .border(if is_selected { theme.text } else { theme.border }, theme.control_border_width).size(Length::Fixed(icon_hex_size), Length::Fixed(icon_hex_size));
                let icon_stack = Stack::new().push(icon_bg.view()).push(container(icon_elem).width(Length::Fixed(icon_hex_size)).height(Length::Fixed(icon_hex_size)).center_x(Length::Fill).center_y(Length::Fill));

                let name_txt = text(&app.name).size(18.0).bold().color(if is_selected { theme.text_strong } else { theme.text });
                let exec_txt = text(&app.exec).size(12.0).font(iced::Font::MONOSPACE).color(theme.muted);
                let info_col = column![name_txt, exec_txt].spacing(4).align_x(Alignment::Start).width(Length::Fill);
                let row_inner = row![icon_stack, container(info_col).width(Length::Fill).padding(iced::Padding { top: 0.0, right: 20.0, bottom: 0.0, left: 20.0 })].spacing(0).align_y(iced::alignment::Vertical::Center).width(Length::Fill);
                let row_content = container(row_inner).width(Length::Fixed(row_w)).height(Length::Fixed(row_h)).padding(iced::Padding { top: inner_pad_y, right: inner_pad_x, bottom: inner_pad_y, left: inner_pad_x });
                let row_stack = Stack::new().push(row_bg.view()).push(row_content);
                let row_btn = button(row_stack).on_press(LauncherMessage::ExecuteApp(exec_cmd)).padding(0).width(Length::Fixed(row_w)).height(Length::Fixed(row_h))
                    .style(|_t, _s| button::Style { background: None, ..Default::default() });
                grid_col = grid_col.push(row_btn);
            }
            content_col = content_col.push(grid_col);
        }

        if math_items.is_empty() && app_items.is_empty() {
            content_col = content_col.push(container(text("No results").size((theme.font_size_overlay) as f32).color(theme.muted)).width(Length::Fill).center_x(Length::Fill).padding(20));
        }

        let list_container = container(scrollable(content_col).id(iced::widget::Id::new("launcher_scroll")).height(Length::Fill).width(Length::Fill))
            .width(Length::Fill).height(Length::Fill).padding(Padding { top: 0.0, right: list_side_inset, bottom: 0.0, left: list_side_inset });

        let card_content = container(
            column![input_row, list_container, bottom_footer,].spacing(12).width(Length::Fill).height(Length::Fill),
        ).padding(Padding { top: pad_top, right: 0.0, bottom: pad_bottom, left: 0.0 }).width(Length::Fixed(win_w)).height(Length::Fixed(win_h));

        let card = Stack::new().push(card_bg.view()).push(card_content);
        container(card).center_x(Length::Fill).center_y(Length::Fill).into()
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod parse_exec_tests {
    use super::{AppLauncher, LauncherMessage};
    #[test]
    fn simple_command() { let (prog, args) = AppLauncher::parse_exec_for_test("firefox").unwrap(); assert_eq!(prog, "firefox"); assert!(args.is_empty()); }
    #[test]
    fn command_with_args() { let (prog, args) = AppLauncher::parse_exec_for_test("firefox --new-window").unwrap(); assert_eq!(prog, "firefox"); assert_eq!(args, vec!["--new-window"]); }
    #[test]
    fn double_quoted_argument() { let (prog, args) = AppLauncher::parse_exec_for_test(r#"foo "bar baz""#).unwrap(); assert_eq!(prog, "foo"); assert_eq!(args, vec!["bar baz"]); }
    #[test]
    fn single_quoted_argument() { let (prog, args) = AppLauncher::parse_exec_for_test("foo 'bar baz'").unwrap(); assert_eq!(prog, "foo"); assert_eq!(args, vec!["bar baz"]); }
    #[test]
    fn shell_metachars_are_literal_args() { let (prog, args) = AppLauncher::parse_exec_for_test("foo; rm -rf ~").unwrap(); assert_eq!(prog, "foo;"); assert_eq!(args, vec!["rm", "-rf", "~"]); }
    #[test]
    fn dollar_command_substitution_literal() { let (prog, args) = AppLauncher::parse_exec_for_test("firefox $(id)").unwrap(); assert_eq!(prog, "firefox"); assert_eq!(args, vec!["$(id)"]); }
    #[test]
    fn unbalanced_quote_rejected() { assert!(AppLauncher::parse_exec_for_test(r#"foo "bar"#).is_none()); assert!(AppLauncher::parse_exec_for_test("foo 'bar").is_none()); }
    #[test]
    fn empty_returns_none() { assert!(AppLauncher::parse_exec_for_test("").is_none()); assert!(AppLauncher::parse_exec_for_test("   ").is_none()); }
    #[test]
    fn backslash_escape() { let (prog, args) = AppLauncher::parse_exec_for_test(r"foo\\bar").unwrap(); assert_eq!(prog, "foo\\bar"); assert!(args.is_empty()); }
    #[test]
    fn percent_codes_stripped() { assert_eq!(AppLauncher::strip_field_codes_for_test("firefox %u"), "firefox "); assert_eq!(AppLauncher::strip_field_codes_for_test("app %f --flag"), "app  --flag"); assert_eq!(AppLauncher::strip_field_codes_for_test("echo 100%%"), "echo 100%"); }

    #[test]
    fn dot_routes_to_unicode_without_breaking_decimals() {
        let mut l = AppLauncher::new_empty();
        let _ = l.update(LauncherMessage::SearchChanged(".".into()));
        assert_eq!(l.selected_index, 0);
        assert_eq!(
            l.filtered_apps.first().map(|a| a.exec.as_str()),
            Some("internal:unicode")
        );

        let _ = l.update(LauncherMessage::SearchChanged(".5km".into()));
        assert!(l.filtered_apps.iter().any(|a| a.exec.starts_with("math:")));
    }
}


==> /home/moonburst/projects/moonbeauty/src/overlays/system_tooltip.rs <==
use crate::libraries::style::TextExt;
use iced::widget::{button, column, container, row, text, Stack};
use iced::{Alignment, Color, Element, Length, Padding, Task, Theme};
use std::time::Instant;

use crate::libraries::backend::system::{GpuInfo, ProcessItem, SystemCollector};
use crate::libraries::config::theme::ShellTheme;
use crate::libraries::config::ShellSettings;
use crate::libraries::style::shape_box::SlantSide;

use crate::overlays::tooltip_common::{
    proc_kill_row, slanted_row, slanted_search_bar, truncate_proc_name, InBarTooltipConfig,
};

const AUTO_MS: u128 = 10_000;

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum Data {
    Cpu(crate::libraries::backend::system::CpuMetrics),
    Gpu(crate::libraries::backend::system::GpuMetrics),
    Ram(crate::libraries::backend::system::RamMetrics),
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum Message {
    Tick,
    Loaded(Data),
    Dismiss,
    KillProcess(u32),
    Noop,
    SearchChanged(String),
    Scrolled(f32),
    ScrollToFraction(f32),
    CycleGpu,
}

pub struct App {
    opened: Instant,
    target: String,
    data: Option<Data>,
    grow_right: bool,
    w: u32,
    h: u32,
    drop_ms: f32,
    expand_ms: f32,
    w_start: f32,
    slant_l: SlantSide,
    #[allow(dead_code)]
    slant_r: SlantSide,
    closing_at: Option<crate::overlays::tooltip_engine::ClosingState>,
    search_query: String,
    scroll_y: f32,
    gpu_list: Vec<GpuInfo>,
    selected_gpu: usize,
    anim_frame: u64,
    settings: ShellSettings,
    theme: ShellTheme,
    pub should_close: bool,
}

impl App {
    pub fn new_in_bar(cfg: &InBarTooltipConfig) -> (Self, Task<Message>) {
        let target = cfg.id.clone();
        let s = ShellSettings::load();
        let mut w = cfg.w;
        let mut h = cfg.h;
        if target == "ram" {
            w = w.max(540);
            h = h.max(480);
        }
        let gpu_list = if target == "gpu" {
            SystemCollector::list_gpus_sync()
        } else {
            Vec::new()
        };
        let selected_gpu = if target == "gpu" {
            select_gpu_index(&gpu_list, &s.gpu_selected_id)
        } else {
            0
        };
        let settings = s;
        let theme = ShellTheme::from_settings(&settings);
        let app = Self {
            opened: Instant::now(),
            target: target.clone(),
            data: None,
            grow_right: cfg.grow_right,
            w,
            h,
            drop_ms: cfg.drop_ms,
            expand_ms: cfg.expand_ms,
            w_start: cfg.cap_w,
            slant_l: cfg.slant_l,
            slant_r: cfg.slant_r,
            closing_at: None,
            search_query: String::new(),
            scroll_y: 0.0,
            gpu_list,
            selected_gpu,
            anim_frame: 0,
            settings,
            theme,
            should_close: false,
        };
        Self::boot_with_app(app, target)
    }

    fn boot_with_app(app: Self, target: String) -> (Self, Task<Message>) {
        let task = if target == "cpu" {
            Task::perform(async { SystemCollector::collect_all().await.0 }, |d| {
                Message::Loaded(Data::Cpu(d))
            })
        } else if target == "gpu" {
            let info = app.gpu_list.get(app.selected_gpu).cloned().unwrap_or_default();
            Task::perform(
                async move {
                    // Run the blocking file I/O on a background thread so it
                    // doesn't freeze the iced event loop during animation.
                    tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || {
                        tokio::runtime::Handle::current()
                            .block_on(SystemCollector::collect_gpu_by_info(&info))
                    })
                    .await
                    .unwrap_or_default()
                },
                |d| Message::Loaded(Data::Gpu(d)),
            )
        } else if target == "ram" {
            Task::perform(async { SystemCollector::collect_all_pss().await.1 }, |d| {
                Message::Loaded(Data::Ram(d))
            })
        } else {
            eprintln!(
                "[sys-tooltip] FATAL: unknown target={:?}; expected cpu|gpu|ram",
                target
            );
            std::process::exit(2);
        };
        (
            app,
            Task::batch(vec![
                task,
                Task::perform(
                    async { tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(4)).await },
                    |_| Message::Tick,
                ),
            ]),
        )
    }

    fn snapshot_for_close(&self) -> crate::overlays::tooltip_engine::ClosingState {
        let cur = crate::overlays::tooltip_engine::compute(
            self.opened.elapsed().as_millis() as f32,
            self.w_start,
            self.w as f32,
            self.h as f32,
            self.theme.slant_width,
            self.settings.bar_height.max(1) as f32,
            self.drop_ms,
            self.expand_ms,
        );
        crate::overlays::tooltip_engine::ClosingState {
            started: Instant::now(),
            from_w: cur.w,
            from_h: cur.h,
            from_opacity: cur.opacity,
        }
    }

    pub fn update(&mut self, m: Message) -> Task<Message> {
        match m {
            Message::Tick => {
                self.anim_frame = self.anim_frame.wrapping_add(1);
                let elapsed_ms = self.opened.elapsed().as_millis() as u64;
                if std::env::var_os("MBS_TICK_DIAG").is_some() {
                    eprintln!("[tick] frame={} elapsed={}ms", self.anim_frame, elapsed_ms);
                }

                if let Some(t) = &self.closing_at {
                    if t.started.elapsed().as_millis() > (self.drop_ms * 3.0) as u128 {
                        self.should_close = true;
                        return Task::none();
                    }
                } else if self.opened.elapsed().as_millis() > AUTO_MS {
                    self.should_close = true;
                    return Task::none();
                }

                let next_ms: u64 = if elapsed_ms < 2000 || self.closing_at.is_some() {
                    std::env::var("MBS_TICK_MS")
                        .ok()
                        .and_then(|s| s.parse().ok())
                        .filter(|n| *n >= 1 && *n <= 100)
                        .unwrap_or(4)
                } else {
                    100
                };

                let mut tasks = Vec::new();

                if self.anim_frame % 250 == 0 && self.closing_at.is_none() {
                    let target = self.target.clone();
                    let gpu_info = self.gpu_list.get(self.selected_gpu).cloned().unwrap_or_default();
                    tasks.push(Task::perform(
                        async move {
                            match target.as_str() {
                                "cpu" => Data::Cpu(async { SystemCollector::collect_all().await.0 }.await),
                                "gpu" => Data::Gpu(SystemCollector::collect_gpu_by_info(&gpu_info).await),
                                _ => Data::Ram(async { SystemCollector::collect_all_pss().await.1 }.await),
                            }
                        },
                        Message::Loaded,
                    ));
                }

                tasks.push(Task::perform(
                    async move { tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(next_ms)).await },
                    |_| Message::Tick,
                ));

                return Task::batch(tasks);
            }
            Message::SearchChanged(q) => {
                self.search_query = q;
                self.scroll_y = 0.0;
                return iced::widget::operation::scroll_to(
                    iced::widget::Id::new("sys_proc_scroll"),
                    iced::widget::scrollable::AbsoluteOffset { x: 0.0, y: 0.0 },
                );
            }
            Message::Scrolled(y) => {
                self.scroll_y = y.max(0.0);
            }
            Message::ScrollToFraction(frac) => {
                let target_y = frac.clamp(0.0, 1.0) * self.max_scroll();
                self.scroll_y = target_y;
                return iced::widget::operation::scroll_to(
                    iced::widget::Id::new("sys_proc_scroll"),
                    iced::widget::scrollable::AbsoluteOffset { x: 0.0, y: target_y },
                );
            }
            Message::Loaded(d) => {
                self.data = Some(d);
            }
            Message::Dismiss => {
                if self.closing_at.is_none() {
                    let snap = self.snapshot_for_close();
                    self.closing_at = Some(snap);
                }
            }
            Message::KillProcess(pid) => {
                let target = self.target.clone();
                let gpu_info = self
                    .gpu_list
                    .get(self.selected_gpu)
                    .cloned()
                    .unwrap_or_default();
                return Task::batch([
                    Task::perform(SystemCollector::kill_process(pid), |_| Message::Noop),
                    Task::perform(
                        async move {
                            tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(250)).await;
                            match target.as_str() {
                                "cpu" => Data::Cpu(
                                    async { SystemCollector::collect_all().await.0 }.await,
                                ),
                                "gpu" => {
                                    Data::Gpu(SystemCollector::collect_gpu_by_info(&gpu_info).await)
                                }
                                _ => Data::Ram(
                                    async { SystemCollector::collect_all_pss().await.1 }.await,
                                ),
                            }
                        },
                        Message::Loaded,
                    ),
                ]);
            }
            Message::CycleGpu => {
                if !self.gpu_list.is_empty() {
                    self.scroll_y = 0.0;
                    self.selected_gpu = (self.selected_gpu + 1) % self.gpu_list.len();
                    let info = self.gpu_list[self.selected_gpu].clone();
                    eprintln!("[gpu-cycle] now {}", info.name);
                    return Task::perform(
                        async move { SystemCollector::collect_gpu_by_info(&info).await },
                        |d| Message::Loaded(Data::Gpu(d)),
                    );
                }
            }
            Message::Noop => {}
        }
        Task::none()
    }

    pub fn view(&self) -> Element<'_, Message> {
        let settings = &self.settings;
        let theme = &self.theme;
        let effective_h = self.h as f32;

        let anim = if let Some(t) = &self.closing_at {
            crate::overlays::tooltip_engine::compute_close_from(
                t.started.elapsed().as_millis() as f32,
                t.from_w,
                t.from_h,
                t.from_opacity,
                self.w_start,
                self.w as f32,
                theme.slant_width,
                settings.bar_height as f32,
                self.drop_ms,
            )
        } else {
            crate::overlays::tooltip_engine::compute(
                self.opened.elapsed().as_millis() as f32,
                self.w_start,
                self.w as f32,
                effective_h,
                theme.slant_width,
                settings.bar_height as f32,
                self.drop_ms,
                self.expand_ms,
            )
        };
        let slant_h = theme.slant_width * (anim.h / settings.bar_height.max(1) as f32);
        let bg = crate::overlays::tooltip_engine::ParallelogramBg {
            w: anim.w,
            h: anim.h,
            slant: slant_h,
            slant_right: self.slant_l == SlantSide::Right,
            background: theme.background,
            border_color: theme.text,
            border_width: theme.control_border_width,
            frame: self.opened.elapsed().as_millis() as u64,
        };
        let content: Element<'_, Message> = self.build_content(theme, settings, anim.opacity);
        let clipped = crate::overlays::tooltip_engine::clip_content(
            content,
            anim.w,
            anim.h,
            if self.grow_right {
                iced::alignment::Horizontal::Left
            } else {
                iced::alignment::Horizontal::Right
            },
        );
        let stacked = iced::widget::container(Stack::new().push(bg.view()).push(clipped))
            .width(Length::Fixed(anim.w))
            .height(Length::Fixed(anim.h))
            .clip(true);
        crate::overlays::tooltip_engine::align_to_side(
            stacked.into(),
            if self.grow_right {
                iced::alignment::Horizontal::Left
            } else {
                iced::alignment::Horizontal::Right
            },
        )
    }
}

fn render_proc_row(
    p: &ProcessItem,
    t: &ShellTheme,
    total_ram_gib: Option<f32>,
    is_gpu: bool,
    font_size: u16,
    alpha: f32,
    row_w: f32,
    row_h: f32,
    slant_right: bool,
    tooltip_slope: f32,
) -> Element<'static, Message> {
    let metric_str = if is_gpu {
        p.metric.clone()
    } else if let Some(total) = total_ram_gib {
        let rss_mib = leading_number(&p.metric);
        let total_mib = (total.max(0.01) as f64) * 1024.0;
        let pct = (rss_mib / total_mib * 100.0).clamp(0.0, 100.0);
        if rss_mib >= 1024.0 {
            format!("{:.1}% · {:.1}G", pct, rss_mib / 1024.0)
        } else {
            format!("{:.1}% · {:.0}M", pct, rss_mib)
        }
    } else {
        p.metric.clone()
    };
    proc_kill_row(
        truncate_proc_name(&p.name), metric_str, 140.0, Message::KillProcess(p.pid),
        t, font_size, alpha, row_w, row_h, slant_right, tooltip_slope,
    )
}

fn leading_number(s: &str) -> f64 {
    let first = s.split_whitespace().next().unwrap_or("");
    first.trim_end_matches('%').parse().unwrap_or(0.0)
}

struct DiagonalScrollbar {
    y_top: f32,
    list_h: f32,
    content_h: f32,
    scroll_y: f32,
    total_h: f32,
    w_f: f32,
    slant_h: f32,
    slant_right: bool,
    half_tt: f32,
    rail_color: Color,
    thumb_color: Color,
}

impl DiagonalScrollbar {
    fn track_cx(&self, local_y: f32) -> f32 {
        let global_y = self.y_top + local_y;
        let frac = (global_y / self.total_h.max(1.0)).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
        let border_x = if self.slant_right {
            self.w_f - self.slant_h * frac - self.half_tt
        } else {
            self.w_f - self.slant_h * (1.0 - frac) - self.half_tt
        };
        border_x - 8.0
    }
}

impl iced::widget::canvas::Program<Message> for DiagonalScrollbar {
    type State = bool;

    fn update(
        &self,
        dragging: &mut Self::State,
        event: &iced::Event,
        bounds: iced::Rectangle,
        cursor: iced::mouse::Cursor,
    ) -> Option<iced::widget::Action<Message>> {
        use iced::mouse;
        if self.content_h <= self.list_h + 1.0 {
            *dragging = false;
            return None;
        }
        match event {
            iced::Event::Mouse(mouse::Event::ButtonPressed(mouse::Button::Left)) => {
                if let Some(pt) = cursor.position_in(bounds) {
                    if (pt.x - self.track_cx(pt.y)).abs() <= 10.0 {
                        *dragging = true;
                        let frac = (pt.y / bounds.height.max(1.0)).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
                        return Some(iced::widget::Action::publish(Message::ScrollToFraction(
                            frac,
                        )));
                    }
                }
            }
            iced::Event::Mouse(mouse::Event::CursorMoved { .. }) if *dragging => {
                if let Some(pt) = cursor.position() {
                    let frac = ((pt.y - bounds.y) / bounds.height.max(1.0)).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
                    return Some(iced::widget::Action::publish(Message::ScrollToFraction(
                        frac,
                    )));
                }
            }
            iced::Event::Mouse(mouse::Event::ButtonReleased(mouse::Button::Left))
                if *dragging =>
            {
                *dragging = false;
                return Some(iced::widget::Action::publish(Message::Noop));
            }
            _ => {}
        }
        None
    }

    fn draw(
        &self,
        _state: &Self::State,
        renderer: &iced::Renderer,
        _theme: &Theme,
        bounds: iced::Rectangle,
        _cursor: iced::mouse::Cursor,
    ) -> Vec<iced::widget::canvas::Geometry> {
        let mut frame = iced::widget::canvas::Frame::new(renderer, bounds.size());
        if self.content_h <= self.list_h + 1.0 {
            return vec![frame.into_geometry()];
        }
        let h = bounds.height.max(1.0);
        if !h.is_finite() || h <= 8.0 {
            return vec![frame.into_geometry()];
        }

        let rail_hw = 1.5;
        let (rx0, rx1) = (self.track_cx(2.0), self.track_cx(h - 2.0));
        let rail_path = iced::widget::canvas::Path::new(|b| {
            b.move_to(iced::Point::new(rx0 - rail_hw, 2.0));
            b.line_to(iced::Point::new(rx0 + rail_hw, 2.0));
            b.line_to(iced::Point::new(rx1 + rail_hw, h - 2.0));
            b.line_to(iced::Point::new(rx1 - rail_hw, h - 2.0));
            b.close();
        });
        frame.fill(&rail_path, self.rail_color);

        let track_span = (h - 4.0).max(1.0);
        let min_thumb = 24.0_f32.min(track_span);
        let thumb_h = ((self.list_h / self.content_h) * track_span).clamp(min_thumb, track_span);
        let max_scroll = (self.content_h - self.list_h).max(1.0);
        let scroll_frac = (self.scroll_y / max_scroll).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
        let ty0 = 2.0 + scroll_frac * (track_span - thumb_h);
        let ty1 = ty0 + thumb_h;
        let (tx0, tx1) = (self.track_cx(ty0), self.track_cx(ty1));
        let thumb_hw = 2.5;
        let thumb_path = iced::widget::canvas::Path::new(|b| {
            b.move_to(iced::Point::new(tx0 - thumb_hw, ty0));
            b.line_to(iced::Point::new(tx0 + thumb_hw, ty0));
            b.line_to(iced::Point::new(tx1 + thumb_hw, ty1));
            b.line_to(iced::Point::new(tx1 - thumb_hw, ty1));
            b.close();
        });
        frame.fill(&thumb_path, self.thumb_color);

        vec![frame.into_geometry()]
    }
}

impl App {
    fn max_scroll(&self) -> f32 {
        let Some(d) = &self.data else {
            return 0.0;
        };
        let raw = match d {
            Data::Cpu(c) => &c.top_procs,
            Data::Gpu(g) => &g.top_procs,
            Data::Ram(r) => &r.top_procs,
        };
        let q = self.search_query.to_lowercase();
        let count = raw
            .iter()
            .filter(|p| q.is_empty() || p.name.to_lowercase().contains(&q))
            .count();
        let fs = self.settings.tooltip_font_size;
        let proc_h = fs as f32 + 10.0;
        let proc_gap = 2.0;
        let vpad = 14.0;
        let gap = 8.0;
        let header_h = fs as f32 + 16.0;
        let search_h = 40.0;
        let y = vpad + header_h + gap + search_h + gap;
        let list_h = (self.h as f32 - vpad - y).max(60.0);
        let content_h = (count as f32) * proc_h + (count.saturating_sub(1) as f32) * proc_gap;
        (content_h - list_h).max(0.0)
    }

    fn render_search_bar<'a>(
        &'a self,
        t: &ShellTheme,
        settings: &ShellSettings,
        alpha: f32,
        y: f32,
        total_h: f32,
        slant_h: f32,
        slant_right: bool,
        safe: f32,
        w_f: f32,
        fs: u16,
        tooltip_slope: f32,
        gap: f32,
    ) -> (Element<'a, Message>, f32) {
        slanted_search_bar(
            &self.search_query, Message::SearchChanged, t, settings.control_border_width,
            alpha, y, total_h, slant_h, slant_right, safe, w_f, fs, tooltip_slope, gap,
            self.opened.elapsed().as_millis() as u64,
        )
    }

    fn render_proc_list<'a>(
        &'a self,
        raw_procs: &'a [ProcessItem],
        total_ram_gib: Option<f32>,
        is_gpu: bool,
        empty_msg: &'static str,
        no_match_msg: &'static str,
        t: &ShellTheme,
        fs: u16,
        alpha: f32,
        y: f32,
        total_h: f32,
        vpad: f32,
        slant_h: f32,
        slant_right: bool,
        safe: f32,
        w_f: f32,
        tooltip_slope: f32,
    ) -> Element<'a, Message> {
        let muted = Color {
            a: t.muted.a * alpha,
            ..t.muted
        };
        let proc_h = fs as f32 + 10.0;
        let proc_gap = 2.0;
        let q = self.search_query.to_lowercase();
        let mut items: Vec<&ProcessItem> = raw_procs
            .iter()
            .filter(|p| q.is_empty() || p.name.to_lowercase().contains(&q))
            .collect();
        items.sort_by(|a, b| {
            leading_number(&b.metric)
                .partial_cmp(&leading_number(&a.metric))
                .unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal)
        });

        if items.is_empty() {
            let msg = if raw_procs.is_empty() {
                empty_msg
            } else {
                no_match_msg
            };
            let empty_el: Element<'a, Message> = container(
                text(msg)
                    .size((fs.saturating_sub(4).max(9)) as f32)
                    .color(muted)
                    .wrapping(iced::widget::text::Wrapping::None),
            )
            .into();
            return slanted_row(
                empty_el,
                y + 10.0,
                total_h,
                slant_h,
                slant_right,
                safe,
                w_f,
                20.0,
            );
        }

        let list_h = (total_h - vpad - y).max(60.0);
        let mut procs_col = column![].spacing(proc_gap).width(Length::Fixed(w_f));
        for (i, &p) in items.iter().enumerate() {
            let screen_y = (y + (i as f32) * (proc_h + proc_gap) - self.scroll_y + proc_h * 0.5)
                .clamp(0.0, total_h);
            let frac = (screen_y / total_h.max(1.0)).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
            let (lp, rp) = if slant_right {
                (slant_h * (1.0 - frac) + safe, slant_h * frac + safe)
            } else {
                (slant_h * frac + safe, slant_h * (1.0 - frac) + safe)
            };
            let inner_w = (w_f - lp - rp).max(10.0);
            let proc_row = render_proc_row(
                p,
                t,
                total_ram_gib,
                is_gpu,
                fs,
                alpha,
                inner_w,
                proc_h,
                slant_right,
                tooltip_slope,
            );
            procs_col = procs_col.push(slanted_row(
                proc_row,
                screen_y,
                total_h,
                slant_h,
                slant_right,
                safe,
                w_f,
                proc_h,
            ));
        }

        let content_h =
            (items.len() as f32) * proc_h + (items.len().saturating_sub(1) as f32) * proc_gap;
        let scroll_el: Element<'a, Message> = iced::widget::scrollable(procs_col)
            .id(iced::widget::Id::new("sys_proc_scroll"))
            .direction(iced::widget::scrollable::Direction::Vertical(
                iced::widget::scrollable::Scrollbar::hidden(),
            ))
            .width(Length::Fixed(w_f))
            .height(Length::Fixed(list_h))
            .on_scroll(|vp| Message::Scrolled(vp.absolute_offset().y))
            .into();

        let half_tt = self.settings.control_border_width * 0.5;
        let diag_bar: Element<'a, Message> = iced::widget::canvas::Canvas::new(DiagonalScrollbar {
            y_top: y,
            list_h,
            content_h,
            scroll_y: self.scroll_y,
            total_h,
            w_f,
            slant_h,
            slant_right,
            half_tt,
            rail_color: Color {
                a: t.muted.a * alpha * 0.35,
                ..t.muted
            },
            thumb_color: Color {
                a: t.text.a * alpha,
                ..t.text
            },
        })
        .width(Length::Fixed(w_f))
        .height(Length::Fixed(list_h))
        .into();

        Stack::new()
            .push(scroll_el)
            .push(diag_bar)
            .width(Length::Fixed(w_f))
            .height(Length::Fixed(list_h))
            .into()
    }
    fn build_content<'a>(
        &'a self,
        t: &ShellTheme,
        settings: &ShellSettings,
        alpha: f32,
    ) -> Element<'a, Message> {
        let a = move |c: Color| Color {
            a: c.a * alpha,
            ..c
        };
        let text_col = a(t.text);
        let muted = a(t.muted);

        let fs = settings.tooltip_font_size;
        let total_h = self.h as f32;
        let bar_h = settings.bar_height.max(1) as f32;
        let slant_h = t.slant_width * (total_h / bar_h);
        let half_tt = settings.control_border_width * 0.5;
        // The tooltip's actual edge slope: slant measured over the path height (h - 2 * half_border)
        let tooltip_slope = slant_h / (total_h - 2.0 * half_tt);
        // One-time diagnostic
        {
            use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};
            static SHOWN: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
            if !SHOWN.swap(true, Ordering::Relaxed) {
                eprintln!(
                    "[slope-diag] tooltip h={:.1} slant={:.2} slope={:.4}",
                    total_h, slant_h, tooltip_slope
                );
            }
        }
        let slant_right = self.slant_l == SlantSide::Right;
        let safe = 16.0;
        let vpad = 14.0;
        let gap = 8.0;
        let w_f = self.w as f32;

        let mut y = vpad;
        let mut col = column![].spacing(gap).width(Length::Fill);

        if let Some(d) = &self.data {
            match d {
                Data::Cpu(c) => {
                    let q = self.search_query.to_lowercase();
                    let header_title = if q.is_empty() {
                        format!("CPU METRICS · {}%", c.usage_pct)
                    } else {
                        let sum_pct: f64 = c
                            .top_procs
                            .iter()
                            .filter(|p| p.name.to_lowercase().contains(&q))
                            .map(|p| leading_number(&p.metric))
                            .sum();
                        format!("CPU METRICS · {:.1}%", sum_pct)
                    };

                    let header_h = fs as f32 + 16.0;
                    let header: Element<'_, Message> = row![
                        text(header_title)
                            .size((fs.max(12)) as f32)
                            .bold()
                            .color(text_col)
                            .wrapping(iced::widget::text::Wrapping::None),
                        iced::widget::space::horizontal(),
                    ]
                    .align_y(Alignment::Center)
                    .width(Length::Fill)
                    .into();
                    col = col.push(slanted_row(
                        header,
                        y + header_h * 0.5,
                        total_h,
                        slant_h,
                        slant_right,
                        safe,
                        w_f,
                        header_h,
                    ));
                    y += header_h + gap;

                    let (search_el, new_y) = self.render_search_bar(
                        t,
                        settings,
                        alpha,
                        y,
                        total_h,
                        slant_h,
                        slant_right,
                        safe,
                        w_f,
                        fs,
                        tooltip_slope,
                        gap,
                    );
                    col = col.push(search_el);
                    y = new_y;

                    col = col.push(self.render_proc_list(
                        &c.top_procs,
                        None,
                        false,
                        "(no CPU processes tracked)",
                        "(no match)",
                        t,
                        fs,
                        alpha,
                        y,
                        total_h,
                        vpad,
                        slant_h,
                        slant_right,
                        safe,
                        w_f,
                        tooltip_slope,
                    ));
                }
                Data::Gpu(g) => {
                    let header_h = fs as f32 + 16.0;
                    let multi = self.gpu_list.len() > 1;
                    let q = self.search_query.to_lowercase();
                    let usage_label = if q.is_empty() {
                        format!("{}%", g.usage_pct)
                    } else {
                        let matching: Vec<&ProcessItem> = g
                            .top_procs
                            .iter()
                            .filter(|p| p.name.to_lowercase().contains(&q))
                            .collect();
                        let has_pct = matching.iter().any(|p| p.metric.contains('%'));
                        let has_mib = matching.iter().any(|p| p.metric.contains("MiB"));
                        if has_pct || !has_mib {
                            let sum_pct: f64 = matching
                                .iter()
                                .filter(|p| p.metric.contains('%'))
                                .map(|p| leading_number(&p.metric))
                                .sum();
                            format!("{:.1}%", sum_pct)
                        } else {
                            let sum_mib: f64 =
                                matching.iter().map(|p| leading_number(&p.metric)).sum();
                            format!("{:.0}M", sum_mib)
                        }
                    };
                    let header_label = if multi {
                        format!("GPU: {} ({})  ▼", g.name, usage_label)
                    } else {
                        format!("GPU: {} ({})", g.name, usage_label)
                    };

                    let header_el: Element<'_, Message> = if multi {
                        button(
                            row![
                                text(header_label)
                                    .size((fs.max(12)) as f32)
                                    .bold()
                                    .color(text_col)
                                    .wrapping(iced::widget::text::Wrapping::None),
                                iced::widget::space::horizontal(),
                            ]
                            .align_y(Alignment::Center)
                            .width(Length::Fill),
                        )
                        .on_press(Message::CycleGpu)
                        .padding(0)
                        .width(Length::Fill)
                        .style(|_t, _s| button::Style {
                            background: None,
                            ..Default::default()
                        })
                        .into()
                    } else {
                        row![
                            text(header_label)
                                .size((fs.max(12)) as f32)
                                .bold()
                                .color(text_col)
                                .wrapping(iced::widget::text::Wrapping::None),
                            iced::widget::space::horizontal(),
                        ]
                        .align_y(Alignment::Center)
                        .width(Length::Fill)
                        .into()
                    };
                    col = col.push(slanted_row(
                        header_el,
                        y + header_h * 0.5,
                        total_h,
                        slant_h,
                        slant_right,
                        safe,
                        w_f,
                        header_h,
                    ));
                    y += header_h + gap;

                    let (search_el, new_y) = self.render_search_bar(
                        t,
                        settings,
                        alpha,
                        y,
                        total_h,
                        slant_h,
                        slant_right,
                        safe,
                        w_f,
                        fs,
                        tooltip_slope,
                        gap,
                    );
                    col = col.push(search_el);
                    y = new_y;

                    col = col.push(self.render_proc_list(
                        &g.top_procs,
                        Some(g.vram_total_gib as f32),
                        true,
                        "(no GPU processes tracked)",
                        "(no match)",
                        t,
                        fs,
                        alpha,
                        y,
                        total_h,
                        vpad,
                        slant_h,
                        slant_right,
                        safe,
                        w_f,
                        tooltip_slope,
                    ));
                }
                Data::Ram(r) => {
                    let total = r.total_gib.max(0.01);
                    let q = self.search_query.to_lowercase();
                    let header_title = if q.is_empty() {
                        let used_gib = (r.total_gib - r.available_gib).max(0.0);
                        format!("RAM USAGE · {:.1}/{:.1}G", used_gib, r.total_gib)
                    } else {
                        let sum_mib: f64 = r
                            .top_procs
                            .iter()
                            .filter(|p| p.name.to_lowercase().contains(&q))
                            .map(|p| leading_number(&p.metric))
                            .sum();
                        if sum_mib >= 1024.0 {
                            format!("RAM USAGE · {:.2}G", sum_mib / 1024.0)
                        } else {
                            format!("RAM USAGE · {:.0}M", sum_mib)
                        }
                    };

                    let header_h = fs as f32 + 16.0;
                    let header: Element<'_, Message> = row![
                        text(header_title)
                            .size((fs.max(12)) as f32)
                            .bold()
                            .color(text_col)
                            .wrapping(iced::widget::text::Wrapping::None),
                        iced::widget::space::horizontal(),
                    ]
                    .align_y(Alignment::Center)
                    .width(Length::Fill)
                    .into();
                    col = col.push(slanted_row(
                        header,
                        y + header_h * 0.5,
                        total_h,
                        slant_h,
                        slant_right,
                        safe,
                        w_f,
                        header_h,
                    ));
                    y += header_h + gap;

                    let (search_el, new_y) = self.render_search_bar(
                        t,
                        settings,
                        alpha,
                        y,
                        total_h,
                        slant_h,
                        slant_right,
                        safe,
                        w_f,
                        fs,
                        tooltip_slope,
                        gap,
                    );
                    col = col.push(search_el);
                    y = new_y;

                    col = col.push(self.render_proc_list(
                        &r.top_procs,
                        Some(total),
                        false,
                        "(no RAM processes tracked)",
                        "(no match)",
                        t,
                        fs,
                        alpha,
                        y,
                        total_h,
                        vpad,
                        slant_h,
                        slant_right,
                        safe,
                        w_f,
                        tooltip_slope,
                    ));
                }
            }
        } else {
            let header_h = fs as f32 + 16.0;
            let header: Element<'_, Message> = row![
                text("LOADING METRICS...")
                    .size((fs.max(12)) as f32)
                    .color(muted)
                    .wrapping(iced::widget::text::Wrapping::None),
                iced::widget::space::horizontal(),
            ]
            .align_y(Alignment::Center)
            .width(Length::Fill)
            .into();
            col = col.push(slanted_row(
                header,
                y + header_h * 0.5,
                total_h,
                slant_h,
                slant_right,
                safe,
                w_f,
                header_h,
            ));
        }

        container(col)
            .padding(Padding {
                top: vpad,
                right: 0.0,
                bottom: vpad,
                left: 0.0,
            })
            .width(Length::Fixed(self.w as f32))
            .height(Length::Fixed(self.h as f32))
            .clip(true)
            .into()
    }
}

fn select_gpu_index(gpu_list: &[GpuInfo], selected_id: &str) -> usize {
    gpu_list
        .iter()
        .position(|g| g.card_id == selected_id)
        .unwrap_or(0)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::select_gpu_index;
    use crate::libraries::backend::system::GpuInfo;

    fn gpu(card_id: &str) -> GpuInfo {
        GpuInfo {
            card_id: card_id.into(),
            ..Default::default()
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn selects_configured_secondary_gpu() {
        let gpus = vec![gpu("card0"), gpu("card1"), gpu("nvidia0")];
        assert_eq!(select_gpu_index(&gpus, "card1"), 1);
        assert_eq!(select_gpu_index(&gpus, "nvidia0"), 2);
    }

    #[test]
    fn falls_back_to_zero_when_missing_or_empty() {
        let gpus = vec![gpu("card0"), gpu("card1")];
        assert_eq!(select_gpu_index(&gpus, "card99"), 0);
        assert_eq!(select_gpu_index(&[], "card1"), 0);
    }
}

//! Lockscreen-related update handlers, extracted from `app/update.rs`.
//!
//! Covers:
//!   - `Message::Lock(msg)` — LockMessage dispatch (KeyPress, PollIpc)
//!   - `start_lockscreen_service` — trigger the systemd-managed
//!     lockscreen coordinator (moonbeauty-lockscreen.service)
//!
//! Crash recovery for the coordinator is handled by systemd
//! (Restart=on-failure + RestartSec=500ms on the unit), not by a
//! bar-side watchdog. Auth success exits the coordinator with code 0,
//! which Restart=on-failure correctly does NOT restart.

#![allow(clippy::collapsible_match)]

use super::*;

use moonbeauty::overlays::lockscreen::LockMessage;

impl MoonBeautyShellApp {
    pub(crate) fn handle_lock(&mut self, msg: LockMessage) -> Command<Message> {
        match msg {
            LockMessage::KeyPress(key) => {
                self.lockscreen.forward_key(&key);
                Command::none()
            }
            LockMessage::PollIpc => {
                if let Some(effect) = self.lockscreen.drain_ipc() {
                    if let LockMessage::AuthSuccess = effect {
                        eprintln!("[lock] coordinator signaled success — exiting");
                        std::process::exit(0);
                    }
                }
                Command::none()
            }
            _ => Command::none(),
        }
    }

    /// Start the systemd-managed lockscreen coordinator. Idempotent:
    /// `systemctl --user start` is a no-op when already active. Never
    /// stop from here — unlocking requires password auth handled by
    /// the coordinator; the only exit path is the coordinator's own
    /// SIGTERM handler after successful auth (exit 0, which systemd's
    /// Restart=on-failure honors).
    ///
    /// Non-blocking: `.spawn()` forks systemctl without waiting for
    /// the unit to be up. The coordinator becomes visible within
    /// ~200-500ms; the UI does not stall in the meantime.
    pub(crate) fn start_lockscreen_service(&self) -> Command<Message> {
        eprintln!("[ipc] lockscreen: systemctl --user start moonbeauty-lockscreen.service");
        match std::process::Command::new("systemctl")
            .args(["--user", "start", "moonbeauty-lockscreen.service"])
            .spawn()
        {
            Ok(_) => {}
            Err(e) => eprintln!("[ipc] systemctl spawn failed: {e}"),
        }
        Command::none()
    }
}

//! Reminders-related update handlers, extracted from `app/update.rs`.
//!
//! Covers:
//!   - `Message::Reminders(msg)` — ReminderMessage dispatch
//!   - `Message::TickClock` reminder-alert block — background one-shot
//!     that fires when a reminder's `target_epoch` passes

#![allow(clippy::collapsible_match)]

use super::*;

use moonbeauty::overlays::reminders::{ReminderMessage, RemindersOverlay};

impl MoonBeautyShellApp {
    pub(crate) fn handle_reminders(&mut self, msg: ReminderMessage) -> Command<Message> {
        match msg {
            ReminderMessage::Dismiss => {
                if self.is_standalone {
                    std::process::exit(0);
                }
                self.active_overlay = None;
                Command::none()
            }
            ReminderMessage::InitialFocus => {
                iced::widget::operation::focus(moonbeauty::overlays::reminders::REMINDER_TASK_ID)
                    .map(Message::Reminders)
            }
            ReminderMessage::Refocus => {
                iced::widget::operation::focus(moonbeauty::overlays::reminders::REMINDER_WHEN_ID)
                    .map(Message::Reminders)
            }
            ReminderMessage::FocusNextField => {
                self.reminders.cycle_focus_forward();
                let target = if self.reminders.active_field == 0 {
                    moonbeauty::overlays::reminders::REMINDER_TASK_ID
                } else {
                    moonbeauty::overlays::reminders::REMINDER_WHEN_ID
                };
                iced::widget::operation::focus(target).map(Message::Reminders)
            }
            ReminderMessage::FocusPrevField => {
                self.reminders.cycle_focus_backward();
                let target = if self.reminders.active_field == 0 {
                    moonbeauty::overlays::reminders::REMINDER_TASK_ID
                } else {
                    moonbeauty::overlays::reminders::REMINDER_WHEN_ID
                };
                iced::widget::operation::focus(target).map(Message::Reminders)
            }
            ReminderMessage::ScrollUp
            | ReminderMessage::ScrollDown
            | ReminderMessage::SelectFirst
            | ReminderMessage::SelectLast
            | ReminderMessage::DeleteSelected => {
                self.reminders.update(msg);
                iced::widget::operation::scroll_to(
                    iced::widget::Id::new("reminders_list"),
                    iced::widget::operation::AbsoluteOffset {
                        x: 0.0,
                        y: self.reminders.scroll_y,
                    },
                )
            }
            _ => {
                self.reminders.update(msg);
                Command::none()
            }
        }
    }

    /// Fire notifications + alarm sounds for any reminders whose
    /// `target_epoch` has passed and which haven't fired yet.
    ///
    /// **Only the primary bar process fires reminders.**  The standalone
    /// reminders overlay and the notification surface also run TickClock
    /// every second; without the guard both see `alerted = false`
    /// simultaneously and each fires a notify-send + writes `alerted = true`,
    /// producing duplicate alerts.
    pub(crate) fn check_reminder_alerts(&mut self) -> Command<Message> {
        if self.is_standalone || self.is_notif_surface {
            return Command::none();
        }
        let now = chrono::Local::now().timestamp();
        let mut entries = RemindersOverlay::load();
        let mut changed = false;
        for e in entries.iter_mut() {
            if e.target_epoch <= now && !e.alerted {
                e.alerted = true;
                changed = true;
                let text = if e.text.is_empty() {
                    "Timer Finished!".into()
                } else {
                    e.text.clone()
                };
                let _ = moonbeauty::libraries::process::spawn_and_reap(
                    std::process::Command::new("notify-send").args([
                        "-a",
                        "Alarm",
                        "-u",
                        "critical",
                        "--",
                        "⏰ Timer Complete!",
                        &text,
                    ]),
                );
                if e.play_sound {
                    if let Some(sound) = &self.settings.alarm_sound {
                        moonbeauty::libraries::backend::play_alarm_sound(
                            sound,
                            self.settings.alarm_sound_volume,
                            self.settings.alarm_sound_duration_sec,
                        );
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if changed {
            moonbeauty::overlays::reminders::save_reminders(&entries);
        }
        Command::none()
    }
}

==> /home/moonburst/projects/moonbeauty/src/app/update/email_sync.rs <==
use super::*;

impl MoonBeautyShellApp {
    pub(crate) fn handle_tick_email_sync(&mut self) -> Command<Message> {
        // Only the primary bar and the standalone email overlay
        // sync IMAP. The notif-surface doesn't need email data and
        // duplicating the sync doubles IMAP traffic + log noise.
        if self.is_notif_surface {
            return Command::none();
        }
        if moonbeauty::libraries::backend::email::client::config_exists() {
            eprintln!("[sync] Boot/Timer triggered email sync");
            let folder = "INBOX".to_string();
            return Command::perform(
                async move {
                    let old_envs =
                        moonbeauty::libraries::backend::email::client::load_index(&folder);
                    if let Ok(new_envs) =
                        moonbeauty::libraries::backend::email::client::fetch_from_network(&folder)
                            .await
                    {
                        moonbeauty::libraries::backend::email::client::save_index(
                            &folder, &new_envs,
                        );
                        moonbeauty::libraries::backend::email::client::sync_bodies_background(
                            folder,
                        )
                        .await;
                        Ok::<_, String>((old_envs, new_envs))
                    } else {
                        Err("fetch failed".into())
                    }
                },
                |res| match res {
                    Ok((old, new)) => Message::EmailSyncedWithDiff(old, new),
                    Err(_) => Message::EmailSynced,
                },
            );
        }

        Command::none()
    }

    pub(crate) fn handle_email_synced_with_diff(
        &mut self,
        old: Vec<moonbeauty::libraries::backend::email::client::NativeEnvelope>,
        new: Vec<moonbeauty::libraries::backend::email::client::NativeEnvelope>,
    ) -> Command<Message> {
        eprintln!(
            "[sync] EmailSyncedWithDiff: old={} new={}",
            old.len(),
            new.len()
        );

        // Cross-process dedup file: prevent two processes from notifying the same email
        let dedup_path = dirs::runtime_dir()
            .unwrap_or_else(|| std::path::PathBuf::from("/tmp"))
            .join("mbs-email-notified.txt");
        let mut notified: std::collections::HashSet<String> = std::fs::read_to_string(&dedup_path)
            .ok()
            .map(|s| {
                s.lines()
                    .map(|l| l.trim().to_string())
                    .filter(|l| !l.is_empty())
                    .collect()
            })
            .unwrap_or_default();

        let old_ids: std::collections::HashSet<String> = old.iter().map(|e| e.id.clone()).collect();
        for env in new {
            if !old_ids.contains(&env.id) && !notified.contains(&env.id) {
                eprintln!("[sync] New email from {}: {}", env.sender, env.subject);

                // Visual notification
                let _ = moonbeauty::libraries::process::spawn_and_reap(
                    std::process::Command::new("notify-send").args([
                        "-a",
                        "Email",
                        "--",
                        &env.sender,
                        &env.subject,
                    ]),
                );

                // Spoken announcement
                moonbeauty::overlays::notifications::NotificationOverlay::speak_tts(
                    "Email",
                    &env.sender,
                    &env.subject,
                    Some("New email from {sender}: {body}"),
                    self.settings.tts_command.clone(),
                    self.settings.notif_volume,
                    self.settings.notif_tts_read_body,
                );

                notified.insert(env.id.clone());
            }
        }

        // Persist dedup list (cap at 200 most recent)
        let mut sorted: Vec<_> = notified.into_iter().collect();
        sorted.sort();
        sorted.truncate(200);
        let _ = moonbeauty::libraries::process::private_write_file(
            &dedup_path,
            sorted.join("\n").as_bytes(),
        );

        Command::none()
    }

    pub(crate) fn handle_email_synced(&mut self) -> Command<Message> {
        Command::none()
    }
}
