use super::*;
use moonbeauty::overlays::screenshot;
use moonbeauty::overlays::screenshot::annotator::AnnotatorMessage;
use moonbeauty::overlays::screenshot::annotator::Tool;
use moonbeauty::overlays::screenshot::save_annotated_image;

impl MoonBeautyShellApp {
    pub(crate) fn handle_annotator(&mut self, msg: AnnotatorMessage) -> Command<Message> {
        let is_text_press =
            matches!(msg, AnnotatorMessage::Pressed(_)) && self.annotator.tool == Tool::Text;
        match msg {
            AnnotatorMessage::ToggleReveal => {
                self.annotator.reveal_mode = !self.annotator.reveal_mode;
                if !self.annotator.reveal_mode {
                    self.annotator.status = "Draw · Enter saves & closes · ESC cancels".into();
                } else if self.annotator.reveal_bytes.is_some() {
                    self.annotator.status = "Reveal: watermark amplified".into();
                } else if let Some(source) = self.annotator.source_path.clone() {
                    match std::fs::read(&source)
                        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())
                        .and_then(|b| screenshot::watermark::reveal(&b))
                    {
                        Ok(bytes) => {
                            self.annotator.reveal_handle =
                                Some(iced::widget::image::Handle::from_bytes(bytes.clone()));
                            self.annotator.reveal_bytes = Some(bytes);
                            self.annotator.status = "Reveal: watermark amplified".into();
                        }
                        Err(e) => {
                            self.annotator.status = format!("Reveal failed: {e}");
                            self.annotator.reveal_mode = false;
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    self.annotator.status = "Reveal: no source image".into();
                    self.annotator.reveal_mode = false;
                }
            }
            AnnotatorMessage::Save => {
                if self.annotator.reveal_mode {
                    if let Some(bytes) = self.annotator.reveal_bytes.clone() {
                        let save_dir = dirs::picture_dir()
                            .or_else(|| dirs::home_dir().map(|h| h.join("Pictures")))
                            .unwrap_or_else(|| std::path::PathBuf::from("/tmp"))
                            .join("Screenshots");
                        let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&save_dir);
                        let time_str = chrono::Local::now().format("%Y-%m-%d %H-%M").to_string();
                        let out = save_dir.join(format!("Revealed {}.jxl", time_str));

                        // reveal() emits PNG bytes; encode to JXL for disk.
                        let tmp_reveal =
                            save_dir.join(format!(".mbs-reveal-{}.png", std::process::id()));
                        let write_ok = std::fs::write(&tmp_reveal, &bytes).is_ok();
                        let convert_ok = write_ok
                            && moonbeauty::overlays::screenshot::annotator::png_to_jxl(
                                &tmp_reveal,
                                &out,
                            )
                            .is_ok();
                        let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&tmp_reveal);
                        let jxl_bytes_opt = if convert_ok {
                            std::fs::read(&out).ok()
                        } else {
                            None
                        };

                        match jxl_bytes_opt {
                            Some(_jxl_bytes) => {
                                eprintln!("[annotator] saved revealed proof -> {:?}", out);

                                // Copy the revealed JXL bytes and map its name
                                // Same reasoning as save_annotated_image:
                                // pipe the reveal PNG (`bytes`), not the JXL.
                                // PNG is what client apps request on Ctrl+V.
                                if let Ok(mut child) = std::process::Command::new("wl-copy")
                                    .args(["-t", "image/png"])
                                    .stdin(std::process::Stdio::piped())
                                    .spawn()
                                {
                                    use std::io::Write;
                                    if let Some(mut stdin) = child.stdin.take() {
                                        let _ = stdin.write_all(&bytes);
                                    }
                                    let _ = child.wait();

                                    let cache_dir =
                                        dirs::cache_dir().unwrap_or_else(std::env::temp_dir);
                                    let map_path = cache_dir.join("mbs-clip-names.txt");
                                    let filename = out
                                        .file_name()
                                        .unwrap_or_default()
                                        .to_string_lossy()
                                        .to_string();

                                    let mut existing_clip_ids = std::collections::HashSet::new();
                                    if let Ok(list_out) = std::process::Command::new("cliphist")
                                        .args(["list"])
                                        .output()
                                    {
                                        for line in
                                            String::from_utf8_lossy(&list_out.stdout).lines()
                                        {
                                            if let Some((id_str, _)) = line.split_once('\t') {
                                                if let Ok(id) = id_str.parse::<u64>() {
                                                    existing_clip_ids.insert(id);
                                                }
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }

                                    for _ in 0..20 {
                                        std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(50));
                                        if let Ok(list_out) = std::process::Command::new("cliphist")
                                            .args(["list"])
                                            .output()
                                        {
                                            let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&list_out.stdout);
                                            for line in text.lines() {
                                                if let Some((id_str, _)) = line.split_once('\t') {
                                                    if let Ok(id) = id_str.trim().parse::<u64>() {
                                                        if !existing_clip_ids.contains(&id) {
                                                            let entry =
                                                                format!("{}\t{}\n", id, filename);
                                                            if let Ok(mut f) =
                                                                std::fs::OpenOptions::new()
                                                                    .create(true)
                                                                    .append(true)
                                                                    .open(&map_path)
                                                            {
                                                                let _ =
                                                                    f.write_all(entry.as_bytes());
                                                            }
                                                            break;
                                                        }
                                                    }
                                                }
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }

                                if self.is_standalone {
                                    std::process::exit(0);
                                }
                                self.active_overlay = None;
                            }
                            None => {
                                self.annotator.status = "Reveal save failed: JXL encode".to_string()
                            }
                        }
                    } else {
                        self.annotator.status = "Reveal not ready".into();
                    }
                } else {
                    let source = self.annotator.source_path.clone();
                    let annotations = self.annotator.annotations.clone();
                    let watermark = if self.annotator.watermark_input.is_empty() {
                        None
                    } else {
                        Some(self.annotator.watermark_input.clone())
                    };
                    match source {
                        Some(p) => match save_annotated_image(
                            p,
                            annotations,
                            watermark,
                            self.settings.screenshot_save_format,
                        ) {
                            Ok(paths) => {
                                eprintln!("[annotator] saved {} file(s)", paths.len());
                                if self.is_standalone {
                                    std::process::exit(0);
                                }
                                self.active_overlay = None;
                            }
                            Err(e) => self.annotator.status = format!("Save failed: {e}"),
                        },
                        None => self.annotator.status = "Save failed: no source image".into(),
                    }
                }
            }
            AnnotatorMessage::Cancel => {
                if self.is_standalone {
                    std::process::exit(0);
                }
                self.active_overlay = None;
            }
            AnnotatorMessage::Saved(_) | AnnotatorMessage::RevealLoaded(_) => {}
            other => self.annotator.update(other),
        }
        if is_text_press {
            return Command::none();
        }

        Command::none()
    }
}

//! Clipboard-related update handlers, extracted from `app/update.rs`.
//!
//! Covers `Message::Clipboard(msg)` — the entire clipboard overlay dispatch,
//! including image preview (JXL via `handle_for_path`), OCR, and reveal.

#![allow(clippy::collapsible_match)]

use crate::app::{Message, MoonBeautyShellApp};
use iced::Task as Command;
use moonbeauty::overlays::clipboard::{ClipboardMessage, ClipboardOverlay};

impl MoonBeautyShellApp {
    pub(crate) fn handle_clipboard(&mut self, msg: ClipboardMessage) -> Command<Message> {
        match msg {
            ClipboardMessage::Dismiss => {
                if self.is_standalone {
                    std::process::exit(0);
                }
                self.active_overlay = None;
            }
            ClipboardMessage::CopyEntry(id) => {
                if self.is_standalone {
                    crate::app::helpers::run_then_exit(async move {
                        ClipboardOverlay::copy(id).await;
                        tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(200)).await;
                    });
                }
                self.active_overlay = None;
                return Command::perform(
                    async move {
                        ClipboardOverlay::copy(id).await;
                    },
                    |_| Message::DismissActiveOverlay,
                );
            }
            ClipboardMessage::DeleteEntry(id) => {
                ClipboardOverlay::delete(id);
                if self.clipboard.selected_id == Some(id) {
                    if let Some((next_id, _)) = self.clipboard.delete_selected_in_memory() {
                        return Command::perform(
                            ClipboardOverlay::load_preview(next_id),
                            move |(text, image_data)| {
                                Message::Clipboard(ClipboardMessage::PreviewLoaded {
                                    id: next_id,
                                    text,
                                    image_data,
                                })
                            },
                        );
                    }
                } else {
                    self.clipboard.entries.retain(|e| e.id != id);
                }
                return Command::none();
            }
            ClipboardMessage::WipeAll => {
                self.clipboard.entries.clear();
                self.clipboard.selected_id = None;
                self.clipboard.preview_text.clear();
                self.clipboard.preview_image_data = None;
                return Command::perform(
                    async move {
                        ClipboardOverlay::wipe().await;
                    },
                    |_| Message::DismissActiveOverlay,
                );
            }
            ClipboardMessage::SetFilter(f) => {
                self.clipboard.filter = f;
                self.clipboard.selected_id = None;
                self.clipboard.preview_text.clear();
                self.clipboard.preview_image_data = None;
                return Command::none();
            }
            ClipboardMessage::SearchChanged(q) => {
                self.clipboard.search_query = q;
                let vis = self.clipboard.filtered_ids();
                if let Some(&first_id) = vis.first() {
                    if self.clipboard.selected_id.is_none_or(|id| !vis.contains(&id)) {
                        self.clipboard.selected_id = Some(first_id);
                        return Command::perform(
                            ClipboardOverlay::load_preview(first_id),
                            move |(text, image_data)| {
                                Message::Clipboard(ClipboardMessage::PreviewLoaded {
                                    id: first_id,
                                    text,
                                    image_data,
                                })
                            },
                        );
                    }
                } else {
                    self.clipboard.selected_id = None;
                    self.clipboard.preview_text.clear();
                    self.clipboard.preview_image_data = None;
                }
            }
            ClipboardMessage::Reloaded(entries) => {
                self.clipboard.entries = entries;
            }
            ClipboardMessage::SelectNext => {
                let ids = self.clipboard.filtered_ids();
                if ids.is_empty() {
                    return Command::none();
                }
                let next_idx = self
                    .clipboard
                    .selected_id
                    .and_then(|sel| ids.iter().position(|&id| id == sel))
                    .map(|p| (p + 1) % ids.len())
                    .unwrap_or(0);
                let next_id = ids[next_idx];
                eprintln!(
                    "[debug-nav] Down pressed. next_idx: {}, next_id: {}",
                    next_idx, next_id
                );
                self.clipboard.selected_id = Some(next_id);
                return Command::batch([
                    Command::perform(
                        ClipboardOverlay::load_preview(next_id),
                        move |(text, image_data)| {
                            Message::Clipboard(ClipboardMessage::PreviewLoaded {
                                id: next_id,
                                text,
                                image_data,
                            })
                        },
                    ),
                    iced::widget::operation::scroll_to(
                        iced::widget::Id::new("clip_list"),
                        iced::widget::scrollable::AbsoluteOffset {
                            x: 0.0,
                            y: (next_idx as f32 * 64.0 - 200.0).max(0.0),
                        },
                    ),
                ]);
            }
            ClipboardMessage::SelectPrev => {
                let ids = self.clipboard.filtered_ids();
                if ids.is_empty() {
                    return Command::none();
                }
                let prev_idx = self
                    .clipboard
                    .selected_id
                    .and_then(|sel| ids.iter().position(|&id| id == sel))
                    .map(|p| (p + ids.len() - 1) % ids.len())
                    .unwrap_or(0);
                let prev_id = ids[prev_idx];
                eprintln!(
                    "[debug-nav] Up pressed. prev_idx: {}, prev_id: {}",
                    prev_idx, prev_id
                );
                self.clipboard.selected_id = Some(prev_id);
                return Command::batch([
                    Command::perform(
                        ClipboardOverlay::load_preview(prev_id),
                        move |(text, image_data)| {
                            Message::Clipboard(ClipboardMessage::PreviewLoaded {
                                id: prev_id,
                                text,
                                image_data,
                            })
                        },
                    ),
                    iced::widget::operation::scroll_to(
                        iced::widget::Id::new("clip_list"),
                        iced::widget::scrollable::AbsoluteOffset {
                            x: 0.0,
                            y: (prev_idx as f32 * 64.0 - 200.0).max(0.0),
                        },
                    ),
                ]);
            }
            ClipboardMessage::DeleteSelected => {
                eprintln!(
                    "[clip] Delete key pressed. Selected ID: {:?}",
                    self.clipboard.selected_id
                );
                if let Some(id) = self.clipboard.selected_id {
                    ClipboardOverlay::delete(id);
                    if let Some((next_id, next_pos)) = self.clipboard.delete_selected_in_memory() {
                        return Command::batch([
                            Command::perform(
                                ClipboardOverlay::load_preview(next_id),
                                move |(text, image_data)| {
                                    Message::Clipboard(ClipboardMessage::PreviewLoaded {
                                        id: next_id,
                                        text,
                                        image_data,
                                    })
                                },
                            ),
                            iced::widget::operation::scroll_to(
                                iced::widget::Id::new("clip_list"),
                                iced::widget::scrollable::AbsoluteOffset {
                                    x: 0.0,
                                    y: (next_pos as f32 * 64.0 - 200.0).max(0.0),
                                },
                            ),
                        ]);
                    }
                }
                return Command::none();
            }
            ClipboardMessage::RevealImage(id) => {
                let dir = dirs::data_dir()
                    .unwrap_or_else(std::env::temp_dir)
                    .join("moonbeauty")
                    .join("clipboard");
                if let Some(path) = ClipboardOverlay::get_file_path(&dir, id) {
                    if let Ok(bytes) = std::fs::read(&path) {
                        if let Ok(revealed) =
                            moonbeauty::overlays::screenshot::watermark::reveal(&bytes)
                        {
                            let out_path = dir.join(format!("revealed_{}.jxl", id));
                            let tmp = dir.join(format!(".revealed-{}.tmp.png", id));
                            let ok = std::fs::write(&tmp, &revealed).is_ok()
                                && moonbeauty::overlays::screenshot::annotator::png_to_jxl(
                                    &tmp, &out_path,
                                )
                                .is_ok();
                            let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&tmp);
                            if ok {
                                let _ = std::process::Command::new("xdg-open")
                                    .arg(&out_path)
                                    .spawn();
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                return Command::none();
            }
            ClipboardMessage::RunOcr(id) => {
                eprintln!("[ocr] RunOcr triggered for id {}", id);
                let is_img = self
                    .clipboard
                    .entries
                    .iter()
                    .find(|e| e.id == id)
                    .map(|e| e.is_image)
                    .unwrap_or(false);
                eprintln!("[ocr] entry found, is_image={}", is_img);
                let tmp_path = moonbeauty::libraries::process::mbs_subdir("mbs-clip")
                    .join(format!("mbs-ocr-{}.png", id));

                // Do OCR synchronously — it's fast (~1s) and we're about to close anyway
                // Read directly from our own clipboard store instead of cliphist.
                let ocr_ready = if let Some(src) = ClipboardOverlay::resolve_path(id) {
                    let ext = src
                        .extension()
                        .and_then(|e| e.to_str())
                        .unwrap_or("")
                        .to_ascii_lowercase();
                    if ext == "jxl" {
                        std::process::Command::new("djxl")
                            .arg(&src)
                            .arg(&tmp_path)
                            .status()
                            .map(|s| s.success())
                            .unwrap_or(false)
                    } else {
                        std::fs::copy(&src, &tmp_path).is_ok()
                    }
                } else {
                    eprintln!("[ocr] could not resolve path for id={}", id);
                    false
                };
                if ocr_ready {
                    let tess_out = std::process::Command::new("tesseract")
                        .args([tmp_path.to_str().unwrap(), "stdout"])
                        .env_remove("LD_LIBRARY_PATH")
                        .output();

                    if let Ok(tess_out) = tess_out {
                        let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&tess_out.stdout).trim().to_string();
                        if !text.is_empty() {
                            eprintln!("[ocr] {} chars extracted", text.len());
                            if let Ok(mut child) = std::process::Command::new("wl-copy")
                                .stdin(std::process::Stdio::piped())
                                .spawn()
                            {
                                use std::io::Write;
                                if let Some(mut stdin) = child.stdin.take() {
                                    let _ = stdin.write_all(text.as_bytes());
                                }
                                let _ = child.wait();
                            }
                        } else {
                            eprintln!(
                                "[ocr] no text found — stderr: {}",
                                String::from_utf8_lossy(&tess_out.stderr)
                            );
                        }
                    }
                }
                let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&tmp_path);

                if self.is_standalone {
                    std::process::exit(0);
                }
                self.active_overlay = None;
                return Command::none();
            }
            ClipboardMessage::CopySelected => {
                // Delegate to ClipboardOverlay::copy — it knows about
                // JXL (.preview.png) and picks the right MIME. The
                // previous cliphist-based path silently no-op'd on
                // JXL entries and served the wrong MIME for other
                // images.
                if let Some(id) = self.clipboard.selected_id {
                    if self.is_standalone {
                        crate::app::helpers::run_then_exit(ClipboardOverlay::copy(id));
                    }
                    self.active_overlay = None;
                    return Command::perform(
                        async move {
                            ClipboardOverlay::copy(id).await;
                        },
                        |_| Message::DismissActiveOverlay,
                    );
                }
            }
            ClipboardMessage::SelectEntry(id) => {
                // Only reset the preview if we're actually switching to a different item.
                // This prevents the UI from flashing "Loading..." when clicking the same image.
                if self.clipboard.selected_id != Some(id) {
                    self.clipboard.preview_text = "Loading...".to_string();
                    self.clipboard.preview_image_data = None;
                }
                self.clipboard.selected_id = Some(id);
                return Command::perform(
                    ClipboardOverlay::load_preview(id),
                    move |(text, image_data)| {
                        Message::Clipboard(ClipboardMessage::PreviewLoaded {
                            id,
                            text,
                            image_data,
                        })
                    },
                );
            }
            ClipboardMessage::PreviewLoaded {
                id,
                text,
                image_data,
            } => {
                // Ignore stale async results from older clicks
                if Some(id) == self.clipboard.selected_id {
                    self.clipboard.preview_text = text;
                    self.clipboard.preview_image_data = image_data;
                }
            }
        }
        Command::none()
    }
}

//! Small overlay handlers, extracted from `app/update.rs`.
//!
//! These overlays are individually small (~10-40 lines each); grouping them
//! in one file keeps `app/update/` from becoming 10 nearly-empty files.
//! Larger overlays (music, notifications, reminders, email, lockscreen,
//! clipboard, settings) have their own files.

#![allow(clippy::collapsible_match)]

use super::*;

async fn copy_pass_key(key: String) {
    let clean = key.trim();
    if clean.is_empty() {
        return;
    }
    let _ = tokio::process::Command::new("pass")
        .args(["-c", clean])
        .status()
        .await;
    let _ = tokio::process::Command::new("notify-send")
        .args(["-a", "Password Store", "Credential Copied", clean])
        .spawn();
}

async fn execute_power_action(action: PowerAction) {
    use tokio::process::Command as TokioCommand;
    match action {
        PowerAction::Lock => {
            // Triggers session lockscreen
        }
        PowerAction::Sleep => {
            let _ = TokioCommand::new("systemctl").arg("suspend").status().await;
        }
        PowerAction::Reboot => {
            let _ = TokioCommand::new("systemctl").arg("reboot").status().await;
        }
        PowerAction::Shutdown => {
            let _ = TokioCommand::new("systemctl").arg("poweroff").status().await;
        }
        PowerAction::Logout => {
            if std::env::var("HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE").is_ok() {
                let _ = TokioCommand::new("hyprctl")
                    .args(["dispatch", "exit"])
                    .status()
                    .await;
            } else if std::env::var("SWAYSOCK").is_ok() {
                let _ = TokioCommand::new("swaymsg").arg("exit").status().await;
            } else {
                let _ = TokioCommand::new("loginctl")
                    .args(["terminate-session", "self"])
                    .status()
                    .await;
            }
        }
    }
}

impl MoonBeautyShellApp {
    pub(crate) fn handle_calc(&mut self, msg: CalcMessage) -> Command<Message> {
        match msg {
            CalcMessage::Dismiss => {
                if self.is_standalone {
                    std::process::exit(0);
                }
                self.active_overlay = None;
            }
            CalcMessage::Refocus => {
                return iced::widget::operation::focus(moonbeauty::overlays::calc::CALC_INPUT_ID)
                    .map(Message::Calc);
            }
            CalcMessage::CopyResult(val) => {
                if self.is_standalone {
                    // Run copy to completion, then exit. On runtime
                    // failure, log + exit anyway — copy is best-effort.
                    let v = val.clone();
                    crate::app::helpers::run_then_exit(async move {
                        CalculatorOverlay::copy_to_clipboard(&v).await;
                    });
                }
                self.active_overlay = None;
                return Command::perform(
                    async move {
                        CalculatorOverlay::copy_to_clipboard(&val).await;
                    },
                    |_| Message::DismissActiveOverlay,
                );
            }
            _ => self.calc.update(msg),
        }
        Command::none()
    }

                self.todo.update(msg);
                // Refocus the input so the user can type immediately

                    .map(Message::Todo);

    pub(crate) fn handle_dict(&mut self, msg: DictMessage) -> Command<Message> {
        match msg {
            DictMessage::Dismiss => {
                if self.is_standalone {
                    std::process::exit(0);
                }
                self.active_overlay = None;
            }
            DictMessage::Refocus => {
                return iced::widget::operation::focus(
                    moonbeauty::overlays::dictionary::DICT_SEARCH_ID,

                .map(Message::Dict);
            }
            DictMessage::SearchWord => {
                let w = self.dict.word_query.clone();

                if let Some(cached) = self.dict.cache.get(&w.to_lowercase()).cloned() {
                    self.dict.update(DictMessage::DefinitionsLoaded(w, cached));
                    return Command::none();

                return Command::perform(

                            .await;

                    async move {

                            .await;

use super::*;
use moonbeauty::overlays::launcher::LauncherMessage;

impl MoonBeautyShellApp {
    pub(crate) fn handle_launcher(&mut self, msg: LauncherMessage) -> Command<Message> {
        match msg {
            LauncherMessage::EnterPressed => {
                if self.launcher.search_query.trim().to_lowercase() == "music" {
                    if self.launcher.music_focus_idx == 0 {
                        return self.handle_launcher(LauncherMessage::MusicPlaySelected);
                    } else {
                        return self.handle_launcher(LauncherMessage::MusicTriggerAction);
                    }
                } else if let Some(selected) = self.launcher.filtered_apps.get(self.launcher.selected_index) {
                    return self.handle_launcher(LauncherMessage::ExecuteApp(selected.exec.clone()));
                }
                return Command::none();
            }
            LauncherMessage::Dismiss => {
                if self.is_standalone {
                    std::process::exit(0);
                }
                self.active_overlay = None;
            }
            LauncherMessage::ExecuteApp(cmd) => {
                // Math result — copy to clipboard and close
                if let Some(result) = cmd.strip_prefix("math:") {
                    let result = result.to_string();
                    eprintln!("[launcher] math result -> wl-copy: {}", result);
                    let _ = std::process::Command::new("notify-send")
                        .args(["-a", "Launcher", "Copied", &result])
                        .spawn();
                    if self.is_standalone {
                        let r = result.clone();
                        crate::app::helpers::run_then_exit(async move {
                            let _ = tokio::process::Command::new("wl-copy")
                                .arg(&r)
                                .status()
                                .await;
                        });
                    }
                    self.active_overlay = None;
                    return Command::perform(
                        async move {
                            let _ = tokio::process::Command::new("wl-copy")
                                .arg(&result)
                                .status()
                                .await;
                        },
                        |_| Message::DismissActiveOverlay,
                    );
                }

                if let Some(definition) = cmd.strip_prefix("dict:") {
                    // Ignore sentinel entries (pending/hint)
                    if definition == "__pending__" || definition == "__hint__" {
                        return Command::none();
                    }
                    let def = definition.to_string();
                    eprintln!(
                        "[launcher] dict copy: {}...",
                        def.chars().take(40).collect::<String>()
                    );
                    let _ = std::process::Command::new("notify-send")
                        .args(["-a", "Dictionary", "Copied", &def])
                        .spawn();
                    if self.is_standalone {
                        let d = def.clone();
                        crate::app::helpers::run_then_exit(async move {
                            let _ = tokio::process::Command::new("wl-copy")
                                .arg(&d)
                                .status()
                                .await;
                        });
                    }
                    let _ = std::process::Command::new("wl-copy").arg(&def).spawn();
                    self.active_overlay = None;
                    return Command::none();
                }

                if let Some(key) = cmd.strip_prefix("pass:") {
                    eprintln!("[launcher] pass copy: {}", key);
                    // Detached: `pass -c` may block on GPG pinentry, so we
                    // spawn it as its own process and exit immediately.
                    // The `sh -c '... "$1"' -- <key>` pattern prevents shell
                    // injection when the key has special chars.
                    let _ = std::process::Command::new("sh")
                        .arg("-c")
                        .arg(
                            r#"pass -c "$1" 2>&1 && notify-send -a 'Password Store' 'Copied' "$1""#,
                        )
                        .arg("--")
                        .arg(key)
                        .spawn();
                    if self.is_standalone {
                        std::process::exit(0);
                    }
                    self.active_overlay = None;
                    return Command::none();
                }

                if let Some(target_str) = cmd.strip_prefix("internal:") {
                    if let Some(target) = OverlayTarget::from_str(target_str) {
                        if self.is_standalone {
                            self.spawn_standalone(target);
                            std::process::exit(0);
                        } else {
                            self.active_overlay = Some(target);
                            return Command::none();
                        }
                    }
                }
                if self.is_standalone {
                    let c = cmd.clone();
                    crate::app::helpers::run_then_exit(async move {
                        AppLauncher::launch(&c).await;
                    });
                }
                self.active_overlay = None;
                return Command::perform(
                    async move {
                        AppLauncher::launch(&cmd).await;
                    },
                    |_| Message::DismissActiveOverlay,
                );
            }
            LauncherMessage::SelectNext
            | LauncherMessage::SelectPrev
            | LauncherMessage::SelectDown
            | LauncherMessage::SelectUp => {
                let cmd = self.launcher.update(msg);

                // If we are in music mode, the launcher update already returns a scroll task for "music_scroll"
                if self.launcher.search_query.trim().to_lowercase() == "music" {
                    return cmd.map(Message::Launcher);
                }

                let idx = self.launcher.selected_index;
                let math_count = self
                    .launcher
                    .filtered_apps
                    .iter()
                    .filter(|a| a.exec.starts_with("math:"))
                    .count();

                let y = if idx < math_count {
                    let row = idx / 3;
                    (row as f32) * (76.0 + 6.0)
                } else {
                    let math_rows = (math_count + 2) / 3;
                    let math_height = if math_rows > 0 {
                        (math_rows as f32) * 76.0 + ((math_rows - 1) as f32) * 6.0 + 10.0
                    } else {
                        0.0
                    };

                    let app_idx = idx - math_count;
                    let icon_size = self.settings.launcher_icon_size as f32;
                    let row_h = icon_size * 1.4 + 20.0;
                    math_height + (app_idx as f32) * (row_h + 12.0)
                };

                let scroll_y = (y - 150.0).max(0.0);

                eprintln!("[launcher-handler] scroll_to y={}", scroll_y);

                let scroll_cmd = iced::widget::operation::scroll_to(
                    iced::widget::Id::new("launcher_scroll"),
                    iced::widget::scrollable::AbsoluteOffset {
                        x: 0.0,
                        y: scroll_y,
                    },
                );

                return Command::batch([cmd.map(Message::Launcher), scroll_cmd]);
            }
            _ => return self.launcher.update(msg).map(Message::Launcher),
        }

        Command::none()
    }
}
