//! Email-related update handlers, extracted from `app/update.rs`.
//!
//! Covers `Message::Email(msg)` — the entire email overlay dispatch.

#![allow(clippy::collapsible_match)]

use crate::app::{Message, MoonBeautyShellApp};
use iced::Task as Command;
use moonbeauty::overlays::email::EmailMessage;

impl MoonBeautyShellApp {
    fn email_post_remove_commands(&mut self, next_id: Option<String>) -> Vec<Command<Message>> {
        let mut cmds = Vec::new();
        if let Some(id) = next_id {
            cmds.push(self.handle_email(EmailMessage::SelectMail(id)));
        }
        let vis_pos = self
            .email
            .visible_envelopes()
            .iter()
            .position(|(i, _)| *i == self.email.selected_index)
            .unwrap_or(0);
        let scroll_y = (vis_pos as f32 * 64.0 - 180.0).max(0.0);
        cmds.push(iced::widget::operation::scroll_to(
            iced::widget::Id::new("email_mail_list"),
            iced::widget::scrollable::AbsoluteOffset { x: 0.0, y: scroll_y },
        ));
        cmds
    }

    pub(crate) fn handle_email(&mut self, msg: EmailMessage) -> Command<Message> {
        match msg {
            EmailMessage::Dismiss => {
                if self.email.is_searching {
                    return self.handle_email(EmailMessage::CloseSearch);
                }
                if self.email.fullscreen_read {
                    self.email.fullscreen_read = false;
                    return Command::none();
                }
                if self.email.is_composing {
                    self.email.update(EmailMessage::CancelCompose);
                    if self.email.active_folder == "Drafts" {
                        if let Some(id) = self
                            .email
                            .envelopes
                            .get(self.email.selected_index)
                            .map(|m| m.id.clone())
                        {
                            return self.handle_email(EmailMessage::SelectMail(id));
                        }
                    }
                    return Command::none();
                } else {
                    if self.is_standalone {
                        std::process::exit(0);
                    }
                    self.active_overlay = None;
                }
            }
            EmailMessage::SelectFolder(f) => {
                println!("[email] SelectFolder: {:?}", f);
                self.email.update(EmailMessage::SelectFolder(f.clone()));
                self.email.envelopes.clear();
                self.email.selected_index = 0;
                self.email.active_mail_id = None;
                self.email.parsed_email = None;

                if f == "Drafts" {
                    self.email.is_loading = false;
                    let envs = moonbeauty::libraries::backend::email::client::load_drafts();
                    self.email.envelopes = envs.clone();
                    return Command::done(Message::Email(EmailMessage::EnvelopesLoaded(f, envs)));
                }

                self.email.is_loading = true;
                let f_fetch = f.clone();
                let f_resp = f;
                return Command::perform(
                    async move { moonbeauty::libraries::backend::email::client::fetch_envelopes(&f_fetch).await },
                    move |res| match res {
                        Ok(envs) => Message::Email(EmailMessage::EnvelopesLoaded(f_resp, envs)),
                        Err(e) => Message::Email(EmailMessage::Error(e)),
                    },
                );
            }
            EmailMessage::SelectMail(id) => {
                let folder = self.email.active_folder.clone();
                let source = moonbeauty::libraries::backend::email::local_sort::source_folder_for(&id, &folder).unwrap_or_else(|| folder.clone());
                self.email.update(EmailMessage::SelectMail(id.clone()));

                if self.email.active_mail_id.as_deref() == Some(&id) && self.email.parsed_email.is_some() {
                    return Command::none();
                }
                let id_resp = id.clone();
                return Command::perform(
                    async move { moonbeauty::libraries::backend::email::client::read_message(&id, &source).await },
                    move |body| Message::Email(EmailMessage::MessageLoadedFor(folder, id_resp, body)),
                );
            }
            EmailMessage::SelectFolderNext | EmailMessage::SelectFolderPrev => {
                if self.email.is_composing || self.email.is_logging_in || self.email.is_adding_folder {
                    return Command::none();
                }
                if self.email.folders.is_empty() {
                    return Command::none();
                }
                let next_idx = if matches!(msg, EmailMessage::SelectFolderNext) {
                    (self.email.active_folder_idx + 1) % self.email.folders.len()
                } else if self.email.active_folder_idx == 0 {
                    self.email.folders.len() - 1
                } else {
                    self.email.active_folder_idx - 1
                };
                let folder = self.email.folders[next_idx].clone();
                return self.handle_email(EmailMessage::SelectFolder(folder));
            }
            EmailMessage::OpenSearch => {
                if self.email.is_composing || self.email.is_logging_in || self.email.is_adding_folder {
                    return Command::none();
                }
                self.email.update(EmailMessage::OpenSearch);
                return iced::widget::operation::focus(moonbeauty::overlays::email::EMAIL_SEARCH_ID)
                    .map(Message::Email);
            }
            EmailMessage::SearchChanged(_) => {
                self.email.update(msg);
                let vis_indices: Vec<usize> = self
                    .email
                    .visible_envelopes()
                    .into_iter()
                    .map(|(i, _)| i)
                    .collect();
                let mut cmds = Vec::new();
                if let Some(&first_idx) = vis_indices.first() {
                    if !vis_indices.contains(&self.email.selected_index) {
                        self.email.selected_index = first_idx;
                        if let Some(id) = self.email.envelopes.get(first_idx).map(|m| m.id.clone()) {
                            cmds.push(self.handle_email(EmailMessage::SelectMail(id)));
                        }
                    }
                    let vis_pos = vis_indices
                        .iter()
                        .position(|&i| i == self.email.selected_index)
                        .unwrap_or(0);
                    let scroll_y = (vis_pos as f32 * 64.0 - 180.0).max(0.0);
                    cmds.push(iced::widget::operation::scroll_to(
                        iced::widget::Id::new("email_mail_list"),
                        iced::widget::scrollable::AbsoluteOffset { x: 0.0, y: scroll_y },
                    ));
                } else {
                    self.email.active_mail_id = None;
                    self.email.parsed_email = None;
                }
                return Command::batch(cmds);
            }
            EmailMessage::CloseSearch => {
                self.email.update(EmailMessage::CloseSearch);
                let mut cmds = Vec::new();
                if self.email.active_mail_id.is_none() {
                    if let Some(id) = self
                        .email
                        .envelopes
                        .get(self.email.selected_index)
                        .map(|m| m.id.clone())
                    {
                        cmds.push(self.handle_email(EmailMessage::SelectMail(id)));
                    }
                }
                let scroll_y = (self.email.selected_index as f32 * 64.0 - 180.0).max(0.0);
                cmds.push(iced::widget::operation::scroll_to(
                    iced::widget::Id::new("email_mail_list"),
                    iced::widget::scrollable::AbsoluteOffset { x: 0.0, y: scroll_y },
                ));
                return Command::batch(cmds);
            }
            EmailMessage::OpenLink(url) => {
                let lower = url.trim().to_ascii_lowercase();
                if lower.starts_with("https://") || lower.starts_with("http://") {
                    let _ = moonbeauty::libraries::process::spawn_and_reap(
                        std::process::Command::new("xdg-open").arg(url.trim()),
                    );
                }
                return Command::none();
            }
            EmailMessage::OpenInBrowser => {
                if let Some(id) = &self.email.active_mail_id {
                    let cache_file = dirs::data_dir()
                        .unwrap_or_else(|| std::path::PathBuf::from("/tmp"))
                        .join("moonbeauty/email_cache")
                        .join(&self.email.active_folder)
                        .join(format!("{}.eml", id));
                    if cache_file.exists() {
                        return Command::perform(
                            async move {
                                let _ = tokio::process::Command::new("xdg-open")
                                    .arg(cache_file)
                                    .spawn();
                            },
                            |_| Message::Noop,
                        );
                    }
                }
                return Command::none();
            }
            EmailMessage::SaveAttachment(name) => {
                if let Some(email) = &self.email.parsed_email {
                    if let Some((_, data)) = email.attachments.iter().find(|(n, _)| n == &name) {
                        // Sanitize: keep only the basename, strip leading dots.
                        let safe_name: String = std::path::Path::new(&name)
                            .file_name()
                            .and_then(|s| s.to_str())
                            .map(|s| s.trim_start_matches('.').to_string())
                            .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())
                            .unwrap_or_else(|| "attachment".to_string());
                        let data = data.clone();
                        let configured_dir =
                            self.settings.attachment_download_dir.trim().to_string();
                        return Command::perform(
                            async move {
                                tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || {
                                    let home = dirs::home_dir()
                                        .unwrap_or_else(|| std::path::PathBuf::from("/tmp"));
                                    let download_dir = if !configured_dir.is_empty() {
                                        std::path::PathBuf::from(configured_dir)
                                    } else {
                                        let fallback_dl = home.join("Downloads");
                                        match dirs::download_dir() {
                                            Some(d) => d,
                                            None if fallback_dl.exists() => fallback_dl,
                                            None => {
                                                let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&fallback_dl);
                                                fallback_dl
                                            }
                                        }
                                    };
                                    let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&download_dir);
                                    let out_path = moonbeauty::overlays::email::unique_download_path(
                                        &download_dir,
                                        &safe_name,
                                    );
                                    moonbeauty::dbg_log!("[attach] saving to {:?}", out_path);
                                    if moonbeauty::libraries::process::private_write_new(
                                        &out_path, &data,
                                    )
                                    .is_ok()
                                    {
                                        if moonbeauty::overlays::email::is_safe_to_auto_open(
                                            &out_path,
                                        ) {
                                            let _ = moonbeauty::libraries::process::spawn_and_reap(
                                                std::process::Command::new("notify-send").args([
                                                    "-a",
                                                    "Email",
                                                    "Attachment Saved",
                                                    &format!("Saved to {}", out_path.display()),
                                                ]),
                                            );
                                            let _ = moonbeauty::libraries::process::spawn_and_reap(
                                                std::process::Command::new("xdg-open")
                                                    .arg(&out_path),
                                            );
                                        } else {
                                            let _ = moonbeauty::libraries::process::spawn_and_reap(
                                                std::process::Command::new("notify-send").args([
                                                    "-a",
                                                    "Email",
                                                    "Attachment Saved",
                                                    &format!(
                                                        "Saved (not auto-opened for safety) → {}",
                                                        out_path.display()
                                                    ),
                                                ]),
                                            );
                                        }
                                    } else {
                                        let _ = moonbeauty::libraries::process::spawn_and_reap(
                                            std::process::Command::new("notify-send").args([
                                                "-a",
                                                "Email",
                                                "Save Failed",
                                                &format!(
                                                    "Could not write to {}",
                                                    out_path.display()
                                                ),
                                            ]),
                                        );
                                    }
                                })
                                .await
                                .ok();
                            },
                            |_| Message::Noop,
                        );
                    }
                }
                return Command::none();
            }
            EmailMessage::SelectMailNext | EmailMessage::SelectMailPrev => {
                if self.email.is_composing || self.email.is_logging_in || self.email.is_adding_folder {
                    return Command::none();
                }
                self.email.update(msg);
                let mut cmds = Vec::new();
                if let Some(id) = self
                    .email
                    .envelopes
                    .get(self.email.selected_index)
                    .map(|m| m.id.clone())
                {
                    cmds.push(self.handle_email(EmailMessage::SelectMail(id)));
                }
                let vis_pos = self
                    .email
                    .visible_envelopes()
                    .iter()
                    .position(|(i, _)| *i == self.email.selected_index)
                    .unwrap_or(0);
                let scroll_y = (vis_pos as f32 * 64.0 - 180.0).max(0.0);
                cmds.push(iced::widget::operation::scroll_to(
                    iced::widget::Id::new("email_mail_list"),
                    iced::widget::scrollable::AbsoluteOffset { x: 0.0, y: scroll_y },
                ));
                return Command::batch(cmds);
            }
            EmailMessage::OpenSelected => {
                if self.email.is_composing || self.email.is_logging_in || self.email.is_adding_folder {
                    return Command::none();
                }
                if !self
                    .email
                    .visible_envelopes()
                    .iter()
                    .any(|(i, _)| *i == self.email.selected_index)
                {
                    return Command::none();
                }
                if self.email.fullscreen_read {
                    return self.handle_email(EmailMessage::ReplySelected);
                }
                if let Some(mail) = self.email.envelopes.get(self.email.selected_index).cloned() {
                    if mail.id.starts_with("draft_") || self.email.active_folder == "Drafts" {
                        return self.handle_email(EmailMessage::EditDraft(mail.id));
                    }
                    let already_loaded = self.email.active_mail_id.as_deref() == Some(mail.id.as_str())
                        && self.email.parsed_email.is_some();
                    if already_loaded {
                        self.email.fullscreen_read = true;
                    } else {
                        return self.handle_email(EmailMessage::SelectMail(mail.id));
                    }
                }
            }
            EmailMessage::EditDraft(_) => {
                self.email.update(msg);
                let target_id = if self.email.compose_to.is_empty() {
                    moonbeauty::overlays::email::COMPOSE_TO_ID
                } else {
                    moonbeauty::overlays::email::COMPOSE_BODY_ID
                };
                return iced::widget::operation::focus(target_id).map(Message::Email);
            }
            EmailMessage::ReplySelected => {
                self.email.update(EmailMessage::ReplySelected);
                let target_id = if self.email.compose_to.is_empty() {
                    moonbeauty::overlays::email::COMPOSE_TO_ID
                } else {
                    moonbeauty::overlays::email::COMPOSE_BODY_ID
                };
                return iced::widget::operation::focus(target_id).map(Message::Email);
            }
            EmailMessage::SendMail => {
                let to = self.email.compose_to.clone();
                let sub = self.email.compose_subject.clone();
                let body = self.email.compose_body.text().to_string();

                let mut attachments = Vec::new();
                for path in &self.email.compose_attachments {
                    eprintln!("[attach] reading {:?}", path);
                    if let (Some(name), Ok(data)) = (path.file_name(), std::fs::read(path)) {
                        eprintln!(
                            "[attach] attached {} ({} bytes)",
                            name.to_string_lossy(),
                            data.len()
                        );
                        attachments.push((name.to_string_lossy().to_string(), data));
                    } else {
                        eprintln!("[attach] FAILED to read {:?}", path);
                    }
                }

                eprintln!(
                    "[send] sending to={:?} subject={:?} attachments={}",
                    to,
                    sub,
                    attachments.len()
                );
                self.email.update(EmailMessage::SendMail);
                return Command::perform(
                    async move {
                        moonbeauty::libraries::backend::email::client::send_message(
                            &to,
                            &sub,
                            &body,
                            attachments,
                        )
                        .await
                    },
                    |res| match res {
                        Ok(_) => Message::Email(EmailMessage::MessageLoaded(
                            moonbeauty::libraries::backend::email::client::ParsedEmail {
                                text: "✓ Message sent.".into(),
                                images: Vec::new(),
                                attachments: Vec::new(),
                                links: Vec::new(),
                            },
                        )),
                        Err(e) => Message::Email(EmailMessage::MessageLoaded(
                            moonbeauty::libraries::backend::email::client::ParsedEmail {
                                text: format!("✗ Send failed: {}", e),
                                images: Vec::new(),
                                attachments: Vec::new(),
                                links: Vec::new(),
                            },
                        )),
                    },
                );
            }
            EmailMessage::EnvelopesLoaded(folder, envs) => {
                println!("[email] EnvelopesLoaded for {:?} ({} emails)", folder, envs.len());
                if folder == "Drafts" {
                    if self.email.active_folder == "Drafts"
                        && self.email.active_mail_id.is_none()
                        && !self.email.is_composing
                        && !self.email.is_logging_in
                    {
                        if let Some(id) = self.email.envelopes.get(self.email.selected_index).map(|m| m.id.clone()) {
                            return self.handle_email(EmailMessage::SelectMail(id));
                        }
                    }
                    return Command::none(); // NEVER accept IMAP updates for Drafts
                }
                let mut cmds = Vec::new();
                if folder == self.email.active_folder {
                    self.email.update(EmailMessage::EnvelopesLoaded(folder.clone(), envs));
                    if self.email.active_mail_id.is_none()
                        && !self.email.is_composing
                        && !self.email.is_logging_in
                    {
                        if let Some(id) = self.email.envelopes.get(self.email.selected_index).map(|m| m.id.clone()) {
                            cmds.push(self.handle_email(EmailMessage::SelectMail(id)));
                        }
                    }
                }
                let folder_for_fetch = folder.clone();
                let folder_for_resp = folder;
                cmds.push(Command::perform(
                    async move {
                        moonbeauty::libraries::backend::email::client::fetch_from_network(
                            &folder_for_fetch,
                        )
                        .await
                    },
                    move |res| match res {
                        Ok(envs) => Message::Email(EmailMessage::NetworkEnvelopesLoaded(
                            folder_for_resp,
                            envs,
                        )),
                        Err(_) => Message::Email(EmailMessage::SyncDone),
                    },
                ));
                return Command::batch(cmds);
            }
            EmailMessage::NetworkEnvelopesLoaded(folder, envs) => {
                if folder == "Drafts" || folder != self.email.active_folder {
                    return Command::none();
                }
                self.email.update(EmailMessage::NetworkEnvelopesLoaded(folder, envs));
                if self.email.active_mail_id.is_none()
                    && !self.email.is_composing
                    && !self.email.is_logging_in
                {
                    if let Some(id) = self.email.envelopes.get(self.email.selected_index).map(|m| m.id.clone()) {
                        return self.handle_email(EmailMessage::SelectMail(id));
                    }
                }
            }
            EmailMessage::ToggleStar => {
                if !self
                    .email
                    .visible_envelopes()
                    .iter()
                    .any(|(i, _)| *i == self.email.selected_index)
                {
                    return Command::none();
                }
                if let Some(mail) = self.email.envelopes.get(self.email.selected_index) {
                    let id = mail.id.clone();
                    let folder = self.email.active_folder.clone();
                    let source = moonbeauty::libraries::backend::email::local_sort::source_folder_for(&id, &folder)
                        .unwrap_or_else(|| folder.clone());
                    let star = !mail.is_starred;
                    self.email.update(EmailMessage::ToggleStar);
                    return Command::perform(
                        async move {
                            moonbeauty::libraries::backend::email::client::toggle_star(
                                &id, &source, star,
                            )
                            .await
                        },
                        |res| match res {
                            Ok(_) => Message::Email(EmailMessage::SyncDone),
                            Err(e) => Message::Email(EmailMessage::Error(e)),
                        },
                    );
                }
            }
            EmailMessage::DeleteSelected => {
                if self.email.is_composing || self.email.is_logging_in || self.email.is_adding_folder {
                    return Command::none();
                }
                let vis_pos = self
                    .email
                    .visible_envelopes()
                    .iter()
                    .position(|(i, _)| *i == self.email.selected_index);
                if vis_pos.is_none() {
                    return Command::none();
                }
                if let Some(mail) = self.email.envelopes.get(self.email.selected_index) {
                    if mail.is_starred {
                        self.email.imap_error =
                            Some("Cannot delete a starred email. Unstar it first.".into());
                    } else {
                        let id = mail.id.clone();
                        let mail_clone = mail.clone();
                        let folder = self.email.active_folder.clone();
                        let source = moonbeauty::libraries::backend::email::local_sort::source_folder_for(&id, &folder)
                            .unwrap_or_else(|| folder.clone());

                        if folder == "Drafts" {
                            if let Err(e) = moonbeauty::libraries::backend::email::client::delete_draft(&id) {
                                self.email.imap_error = Some(e);
                                return Command::none();
                            }
                            self.email.envelopes = moonbeauty::libraries::backend::email::client::load_drafts();
                            self.email.parsed_cache.clear();
                            let next_id = self.email.select_after_removal(vis_pos);
                            let cmds = self.email_post_remove_commands(next_id);
                            return Command::batch(cmds);
                        }

                        self.email.envelopes.remove(self.email.selected_index);
                        let next_id = self.email.select_after_removal(vis_pos);
                        let mut cmds = self.email_post_remove_commands(next_id);

                        moonbeauty::libraries::backend::email::client::save_index(
                            &folder,
                            &self.email.envelopes,
                        );
                        if source != folder {
                            let mut src_envs =
                                moonbeauty::libraries::backend::email::client::load_index(&source);
                            src_envs.retain(|e| e.id != id);
                            moonbeauty::libraries::backend::email::client::save_index(
                                &source,
                                &src_envs,
                            );
                        }

                        let is_trash = folder == "Trash" || source == "Trash";

                        if !is_trash {
                            let mut trash_envs =
                                moonbeauty::libraries::backend::email::client::load_index("Trash");
                            trash_envs.insert(0, mail_clone);
                            moonbeauty::libraries::backend::email::client::save_index(
                                "Trash",
                                &trash_envs,
                            );
                        }

                        cmds.push(Command::perform(
                            async move {
                                if is_trash {
                                    moonbeauty::libraries::backend::email::client::delete_message(
                                        &id, &source,
                                    )
                                    .await
                                } else {
                                    moonbeauty::libraries::backend::email::client::move_to_trash(
                                        &id, &source,
                                    )
                                    .await
                                }
                            },
                            |res| match res {
                                Ok(_) => Message::Email(EmailMessage::SyncDone),
                                Err(e) => Message::Email(EmailMessage::Error(e)),
                            },
                        ));
                        return Command::batch(cmds);
                    }
                }
            }
            EmailMessage::CopyGmailFilter => {
                let folder = self.email.active_folder.clone();
                if let Some(filter_text) =
                    moonbeauty::libraries::backend::email::local_sort::gmail_filter_text_for(
                        &folder,
                    )
                {
                    return Command::perform(
                        async move {
                            if let Ok(mut child) = tokio::process::Command::new("wl-copy")
                                .stdin(std::process::Stdio::piped())
                                .spawn()
                            {
                                use tokio::io::AsyncWriteExt;
                                if let Some(mut stdin) = child.stdin.take() {
                                    let _ = stdin.write_all(filter_text.as_bytes()).await;
                                }
                                let _ = child.wait().await;
                            }
                            let _ = tokio::process::Command::new("notify-send")
                                .args([
                                    "-a",
                                    "Email",
                                    "Gmail Filter Copied",
                                    "Paste into Gmail Settings → Filters → Create new filter",
                                ])
                                .spawn();
                        },
                        |_| Message::Email(EmailMessage::SyncDone),
                    );
                } else {
                    let _ = std::process::Command::new("notify-send")
                        .args([
                            "-a",
                            "Email",
                            "No filter available",
                            "Select a locally-sorted folder (like Steam (local)) first",
                        ])
                        .spawn();
                }
            }
            EmailMessage::MarkSpam => {
                let vis_pos = self
                    .email
                    .visible_envelopes()
                    .iter()
                    .position(|(i, _)| *i == self.email.selected_index);
                if vis_pos.is_none() {
                    return Command::none();
                }
                if let Some(mail) = self.email.envelopes.get(self.email.selected_index) {
                    let id = mail.id.clone();
                    let folder = self.email.active_folder.clone();
                    let source = moonbeauty::libraries::backend::email::local_sort::source_folder_for(&id, &folder)
                        .unwrap_or_else(|| folder.clone());
                    self.email.envelopes.remove(self.email.selected_index);
                    let next_id = self.email.select_after_removal(vis_pos);
                    let mut cmds = self.email_post_remove_commands(next_id);
                    moonbeauty::libraries::backend::email::client::save_index(
                        &folder,
                        &self.email.envelopes,
                    );
                    if source != folder {
                        let mut src_envs =
                            moonbeauty::libraries::backend::email::client::load_index(&source);
                        src_envs.retain(|e| e.id != id);
                        moonbeauty::libraries::backend::email::client::save_index(
                            &source,
                            &src_envs,
                        );
                    }
                    cmds.push(Command::perform(
                        async move {
                            moonbeauty::libraries::backend::email::client::move_to_spam(
                                &id, &source,
                            )
                            .await
                        },
                        |res| match res {
                            Ok(_) => Message::Email(EmailMessage::SyncDone),
                            Err(e) => Message::Email(EmailMessage::Error(e)),
                        },
                    ));
                    return Command::batch(cmds);
                }
            }
            EmailMessage::MarkNotSpam => {
                let vis_pos = self
                    .email
                    .visible_envelopes()
                    .iter()
                    .position(|(i, _)| *i == self.email.selected_index);
                if vis_pos.is_none() {
                    return Command::none();
                }
                if let Some(mail) = self.email.envelopes.get(self.email.selected_index) {
                    let id = mail.id.clone();
                    self.email.envelopes.remove(self.email.selected_index);
                    let next_id = self.email.select_after_removal(vis_pos);
                    let mut cmds = self.email_post_remove_commands(next_id);
                    moonbeauty::libraries::backend::email::client::save_index(
                        "Spam",
                        &self.email.envelopes,
                    );
                    cmds.push(Command::perform(
                        async move {
                            moonbeauty::libraries::backend::email::client::mark_not_spam(&id).await
                        },
                        |res| match res {
                            Ok(_) => Message::Email(EmailMessage::SyncDone),
                            Err(e) => Message::Email(EmailMessage::Error(e)),
                        },
                    ));
                    return Command::batch(cmds);
                }
            }
            EmailMessage::SaveContact => {
                if let Some(mail) = self.email.envelopes.get(self.email.selected_index) {
                    let email = mail.sender_email.clone();
                    if !email.is_empty() {
                        if self
                            .email
                            .contacts
                            .iter()
                            .any(|c| c.eq_ignore_ascii_case(&email))
                        {
                            self.email.status_notice =
                                Some(format!("✓ Contact already saved: {}", email));
                            return Command::none();
                        }
                        let email_resp = email.clone();
                        return Command::perform(
                            async move {
                                moonbeauty::libraries::backend::email::client::save_contact(&email)
                                    .await
                            },
                            move |res| match res {
                                Ok(_) => Message::Email(EmailMessage::ContactSaved(email_resp)),
                                Err(e) => Message::Email(EmailMessage::Error(e)),
                            },
                        );
                    }
                }
            }
            EmailMessage::GetAppPassword
            | EmailMessage::SelectContact(_)
            | EmailMessage::SelectAutocompleteNext
            | EmailMessage::SelectAutocompletePrev
            | EmailMessage::ConfirmAutocomplete
            | EmailMessage::StartAddFolder
            | EmailMessage::AddFolderChanged(_)
            | EmailMessage::SubmitAddFolder
            | EmailMessage::RemoveFolder(_)
            | EmailMessage::AttachmentsPicked(_)
            | EmailMessage::RemoveAttachment(_)
            | EmailMessage::ManualAttachChanged(_)
            | EmailMessage::SubmitManualAttach => {
                self.email.update(msg);
            }
            EmailMessage::AddAttachment => {
                return Command::perform(
                    async {
                        let files = rfd::AsyncFileDialog::new()
                            .add_filter("All Files", &["*"])
                            .pick_files()
                            .await;
                        let paths = files
                            .map(|f| {
                                f.into_iter()
                                    .map(|file| file.path().to_path_buf())
                                    .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                            })
                            .unwrap_or_default();
                        eprintln!("[attach] rfd picked: {:?}", paths);
                        paths
                    },
                    |paths| Message::Email(EmailMessage::AttachmentsPicked(paths)),
                );
            }
            EmailMessage::OpenComposer => {
                self.email.fullscreen_read = false;
                self.email.reply_from_fullview = false;
                self.email.update(msg);
                return iced::widget::operation::focus(moonbeauty::overlays::email::COMPOSE_TO_ID)
                    .map(Message::Email);
            }
            EmailMessage::SaveLogin => {
                let cfg = moonbeauty::libraries::backend::email::client::EmailConfig {
                    email: self.email.login_email.clone(),
                    password: Some(self.email.login_password.clone()),
                    password_cmd: None,
                    imap_host: self.email.login_imap.clone(),
                    imap_port: 993,
                    smtp_host: self.email.login_smtp.clone(),
                    smtp_port: 465,
                    sops_key: if self.email.login_sops_key.trim().is_empty() {
                        None
                    } else {
                        Some(self.email.login_sops_key.clone())
                    },
                };
                let use_sops = self.email.use_sops;
                match moonbeauty::libraries::backend::email::client::save_config(&cfg, use_sops) {
                    Ok(_) => {
                        self.email.is_logging_in = false;
                        self.email.login_error = None;
                        return Command::batch(vec![
                            Command::perform(
                                async move {
                                    moonbeauty::libraries::backend::email::client::fetch_envelopes(
                                        "INBOX",
                                    )
                                    .await
                                },
                                |res| match res {
                                    Ok(envs) => Message::Email(EmailMessage::EnvelopesLoaded(
                                        "INBOX".to_string(),
                                        envs,
                                    )),
                                    Err(e) => Message::Email(EmailMessage::Error(e)),
                                },
                            ),
                        ]);
                    }
                    Err(e) => {
                        self.email.login_error = Some(e);
                    }
                }
            }
            _ => self.email.update(msg),
        }
        Command::none()
    }
}

use super::*;

impl MoonBeautyShellApp {
    pub(crate) fn handle_dismiss_active_overlay(&mut self) -> Command<Message> {
        if let Some(ref mut tip) = self.in_bar_tooltip {
            return match tip {
                InBarTooltip::Weather(app) => app
                    .update(moonbeauty::bar::weather::tooltip::Message::Dismiss)
                    .map(Message::InBarWeatherTip),
                InBarTooltip::System(app) => app
                    .update(moonbeauty::overlays::system_tooltip::Message::Dismiss)
                    .map(Message::InBarSysTip),
                InBarTooltip::Info(app) => app
                    .update(moonbeauty::overlays::info_tooltip::Message::Dismiss)
                    .map(Message::InBarInfoTip),
            };
        }
        // Todo edit mode: Escape cancels the edit rather than
        // closing the overlay.
        if matches!(self.active_overlay, Some(OverlayTarget::Todo))
            && self.todo.editing_task_id.is_some()
        {
            self.todo
                .update(moonbeauty::overlays::todo::TodoMessage::CancelEdit);
            return Command::none();
        }
        // Reminders: Escape clears the current input field, then the
        // list selection, then finally dismisses. Prevents a mistyped
        // reminder from wiping out the whole overlay on Esc.
        if matches!(self.active_overlay, Some(OverlayTarget::Reminders)) {
            if !self.reminders.task_text.is_empty() {
                self.reminders.task_text.clear();
                return Command::none();
            }
            if !self.reminders.when_text.is_empty() {
                self.reminders.when_text.clear();
                return Command::none();
            }
            if self.reminders.selected_idx.is_some() {
                self.reminders.selected_idx = None;
                return Command::none();
            }
        }
        // Persist if we're closing the Settings overlay via Esc.
        if matches!(self.active_overlay, Some(OverlayTarget::Settings)) {
            let _ = self.settings.save();
        }
        if self.is_standalone {
            std::thread::spawn(|| {
                std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(200));
                std::process::exit(0);
            });
            return Command::none();
        }
        self.active_overlay = None;

        Command::none()
    }
}

==> /home/moonburst/projects/moonbeauty/src/app/update/ipc.rs <==
use super::*;
use moonbeauty::libraries::ipc::IpcCommand;

impl MoonBeautyShellApp {
    pub(crate) fn handle_ipc(&mut self, cmd: IpcCommand) -> Command<Message> {
        let _ = match cmd {
            IpcCommand::Toggle(target) => {
                // Every overlay runs as a standalone child so it gets
                // keyboard=Exclusive from its layer surface. The bar's own
                // layer is KeyboardInteractivity::None, so in-bar overlays
                // cannot receive keystrokes.
                eprintln!("[ipc] toggle {:?} (standalone)", target);

                // SECURITY: the lockscreen must NEVER be unlockable via
                // IPC. Before this guard, two rapid Toggle(Lockscreen)
                // calls spawn-then-kill (200ms+ desktop-visible window),
                // and any local script could dismiss the lock by sending
                // two toggles. Lockscreen is now idempotent-spawn: IPC
                // can spawn it, but only password auth removes it.
                if matches!(target, OverlayTarget::Lockscreen) {
                    return self.start_lockscreen_service();
                } else {
                    self.toggle_standalone(target);
                }
            }
            IpcCommand::Open(target, arg) => {
                if matches!(
                    target,
                    OverlayTarget::Launcher
                        | OverlayTarget::Clipboard
                        | OverlayTarget::NotificationsHistory
                        | OverlayTarget::Settings
                        | OverlayTarget::Todo
                        | OverlayTarget::Notes
                        | OverlayTarget::Unicode
                ) {
                    self.spawn_standalone(target);
                } else if matches!(target, OverlayTarget::Lockscreen) {
                    return self.start_lockscreen_service();
                } else if matches!(target, OverlayTarget::Annotator) {
                    // Annotator needs fullscreen + exclusive keyboard, which only
                    // the standalone (--annotator-session) process gets via its
                    // LayerShellSettings. Spawn a child with the captured path.
                    let exe = resolve_exe();
                    let mut cmd = std::process::Command::new(exe);
                    cmd.arg("--annotator-session");
                    if let Some(ref p) = arg {
                        cmd.env("MBS_ANNOTATOR_PATH", p);
                    }
                    match cmd.spawn() {
                        Ok(child) => {
                            eprintln!("[annotator] spawned pid={}", child.id());
                            self.standalone_child = Some((OverlayTarget::Annotator, child));
                        }
                        Err(e) => eprintln!("[annotator] spawn failed: {e}"),
                    }
                } else {
                    self.active_overlay = Some(target);
                }
            }
            IpcCommand::Close(target) => {
                // SECURITY: the lockscreen cannot be closed via IPC.
                // Unlocking requires password auth handled by the
                // coordinator; the only exit path is the coordinator's
                // own SIGTERM handler after successful auth (exit 0,
                // which systemd's Restart=on-failure honors).
                if matches!(target, OverlayTarget::Lockscreen) {
                    eprintln!("[ipc] Close(Lockscreen) refused — requires auth via coordinator");
                } else if self.active_overlay == Some(target) {
                    self.active_overlay = None;
                }
            }
            IpcCommand::DismissLatestNotif => return self.dismiss_latest_notif(),
            IpcCommand::JumpToLatestNotif => return self.jump_to_latest_notif(),
            IpcCommand::ToggleHistory => return self.toggle_history(),
            IpcCommand::ReloadSettings => {
                let prev_screen = self.settings.notif_screen_name.clone();
                let prev_corner = self.settings.notif_corner.clone();
                self.settings = ShellSettings::load();
                self.theme = ShellTheme::from_settings(&self.settings);
                if self.settings.notif_screen_name != prev_screen
                    || self.settings.notif_corner != prev_corner
                {
                    self.notif_screen_at_startup = self.settings.notif_screen_name.clone();
                    self.restart_notif_surface();
                }
            }
            IpcCommand::TestNotification => return self.test_notification(),
            IpcCommand::MusicCycle => return self.music_cycle(),
            IpcCommand::MusicNext => return self.music_next_track_ipc(),
            IpcCommand::MusicPrevious => return self.music_previous_track_ipc(),
            IpcCommand::MusicPlayPause => return self.music_toggle_play_pause_ipc(),
        };
        Command::none()
    }
}

//! Music-related update handlers, extracted from `app/update.rs`.
//!
//! Two entry points:
//!   `music_*` — called from `Message::TopBar(Action(CapsuleAction::Music*))`
//!   `music_*_ipc` — called from `Message::IpcReceived(IpcCommand::Music*)`
//!
//! Both paths run identical async bodies; the only difference is the
//! completion Message (`TopBarMessage::Noop` vs `Message::TickHardware`).

#![allow(clippy::collapsible_match)]

use crate::app::{Message, MoonBeautyShellApp};

use iced::Task as Command;

use moonbeauty::bar::TopBarMessage;
use moonbeauty::libraries::backend::music::{
    poll_track, LocalMusicBackend, MprisBackend, MusicCycleState, TrackSource,
};

impl MoonBeautyShellApp {
    // ── Bar capsule paths ─────────────────────────────────────────────

    pub(crate) fn music_toggle_play_pause(&self) -> Command<Message> {
        Command::perform(toggle_play_pause_async(), |_| {
            Message::TopBar(TopBarMessage::Noop)
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn music_next_track(&self) -> Command<Message> {
        Command::perform(next_track_async(), |_| Message::TopBar(TopBarMessage::Noop))
    }

    pub(crate) fn music_previous_track(&self) -> Command<Message> {
        Command::perform(previous_track_async(), |_| {
            Message::TopBar(TopBarMessage::Noop)
        })
    }

    // ── IPC paths ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    pub(crate) fn music_cycle(&mut self) -> Command<Message> {
        if self.is_cycling {
            eprintln!("[music-cycle] ignored spam (already cycling)");
            return Command::none();
        }
        self.is_cycling = true;
        let mut state = self.music_cycle_state.clone();
        Command::perform(
            async move {
                moonbeauty::libraries::backend::music::press(&mut state).await;
                state
            },
            Message::MusicCycleDone,
        )
    }

    pub(crate) fn music_next_track_ipc(&self) -> Command<Message> {
        Command::perform(next_track_async(), |_| Message::TickHardware)
    }

    pub(crate) fn music_previous_track_ipc(&self) -> Command<Message> {
        Command::perform(previous_track_async(), |_| Message::TickHardware)
    }

    pub(crate) fn music_toggle_play_pause_ipc(&self) -> Command<Message> {
        Command::perform(toggle_play_pause_async(), |_| Message::TickHardware)
    }

    // ── Completion handler ────────────────────────────────────────────

    pub(crate) fn handle_music_cycle_done(
        &mut self,
        new_state: MusicCycleState,
    ) -> Command<Message> {
        self.is_cycling = false;
        self.music_cycle_state = new_state;
        Command::done(Message::TickHardware)
    }
}

// ── Shared async bodies ──────────────────────────────────────────────

async fn toggle_play_pause_async() {
    let (_, src) = poll_track().await;
    match src {
        TrackSource::Local => LocalMusicBackend::toggle_play_pause().await,
        TrackSource::Mpris => MprisBackend::toggle_play_pause().await,
        TrackSource::None => {}
    }
}

async fn next_track_async() {
    let (_, src) = poll_track().await;
    match src {
        TrackSource::Local => LocalMusicBackend::next().await,
        TrackSource::Mpris => MprisBackend::next().await,
        TrackSource::None => {}
    }
}

async fn previous_track_async() {
    let (_, src) = poll_track().await;
    match src {
        TrackSource::Local => LocalMusicBackend::previous().await,
        TrackSource::Mpris => MprisBackend::previous().await,
        TrackSource::None => {}
    }
}

//! Settings-related update handlers, extracted from `app/update.rs`.
//!
//! Covers `Message::Settings(msg)` — the entire settings overlay dispatch.
//! The dead `{ let s = format!("{:?}", msg); ... }` debug block at the top
//! of this handler is left verbatim; removing it is a separate cleanup.

#![allow(clippy::collapsible_match)]

use super::*;

impl MoonBeautyShellApp {
    pub(crate) fn handle_settings(&mut self, msg: SettingsMessage) -> Command<Message> {
        if let SettingsMessage::TestProfileSound(idx) = msg {
            if let Some(p) = self.settings.friend_profiles.get(idx) {
                if let Some(path) = &p.sound_path {
                    moonbeauty::overlays::notifications::NotificationOverlay::play_sound(
                        path.clone(),
                        self.settings.notif_volume,
                    );
                }
            }
            return Command::none();
        }

        if let SettingsMessage::TestProfileTts(idx) = msg {
            if let Some(p) = self.settings.friend_profiles.get(idx) {
                moonbeauty::overlays::notifications::NotificationOverlay::speak_tts(
                    "Diagnostics",
                    &p.summary,
                    "Sample message body",
                    p.default_readout.as_deref(),
                    self.settings.tts_command.clone(),
                    self.settings.notif_volume,
                    p.read_body,
                );
            }
            return Command::none();
        }

        // Copy command to clipboard. Handled here (not in
        // settings_ui.update) because it returns a Command;
        // settings_ui.update is sync.
        if let SettingsMessage::CopyIpc(cmd) = &msg {
            let cmd = cmd.clone();
            eprintln!("[settings] copied to clipboard: {}", cmd);
            return iced::clipboard::write(cmd);
        }

        match msg {
            SettingsMessage::AvatarFilePicked(idx, src_path) => {
                self.settings_ui
                    .update(SettingsMessage::BrowseCancel, &mut self.settings);
                if let Some(p) = self.settings.friend_profiles.get(idx) {
                    let name_clone = p.name.clone();
                    return Command::perform(
                        async move {
                            let _ = tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || {
                                let av_dir = dirs::data_dir()
                                    .unwrap_or_else(|| std::path::PathBuf::from("/tmp"))
                                    .join("moonbeauty")
                                    .join("avatars")
                                    .join(&name_clone);
                                let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&av_dir);
                                let dest_path = av_dir.join(format!("{}.png", name_clone));

                                let status = std::process::Command::new("magick")
                                    .arg(&src_path)
                                    .args([
                                        "-trim",
                                        "+repage",
                                        "-resize",
                                        "256x256>",
                                        "-background",
                                        "none",
                                        "-gravity",
                                        "center",
                                        "-extent",
                                        "256x256",
                                    ])
                                    .arg(&dest_path)
                                    .status();

                                if let Err(e) = status {
                                    eprintln!("[avatar-picker] magick failed: {e}");
                                }
                            })
                            .await;

                            let _ = std::process::Command::new("pkill")
                                .args(["-SIGUSR1", "-f", "(^|/)moonbeauty --notif-surface$"])
                                .status();
                        },
                        |_| Message::Settings(SettingsMessage::AvatarUpdated),
                    );
                }
                return Command::none();
            }
            SettingsMessage::AvatarUpdated => {
                return Command::none();
            }
            SettingsMessage::ImportAlarmSound => {
                return Command::perform(
                    async move {
                        let file = rfd::AsyncFileDialog::new()
                            .add_filter(
                                "Audio",
                                &["wav", "mp3", "ogg", "flac", "opus", "m4a", "aac"],
                            )
                            .add_filter("All Files", &["*"])
                            .pick_file()
                            .await;
                        let Some(f) = file else {
                            return None;
                        };
                        let src_path = f.path().to_path_buf();
                        tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || {
                            moonbeauty::overlays::settings::import_alarm_sound_file(&src_path).ok()
                        })
                        .await
                        .ok()
                        .flatten()
                    },
                    |name| Message::Settings(SettingsMessage::AlarmSoundImported(name)),
                );
            }
            /* PickMusicDir handled in settings_ui */
            SettingsMessage::RescanMusicLibrary => {
                return Command::perform(
                    async move {
                        moonbeauty::libraries::backend::music::LocalMusicBackend::rescan_library()
                            .await;
                    },
                    |_| Message::Noop,
                );
            }
            _ => {}
        }

        let is_test = matches!(msg, SettingsMessage::TestNotification);
        let rescan_music = matches!(
            msg,
            SettingsMessage::MusicDirPicked(Some(_))
                | SettingsMessage::RemoveMusicDir(_)
                | SettingsMessage::BrowseSelectCurrent
        );

        if is_test {
            return self.test_notification();
        } else if matches!(msg, SettingsMessage::Dismiss) {
            // Persist before closing / exiting the settings process.
            let _ = self.settings.save();
            if self.is_standalone {
                std::process::exit(0);
            }
            self.active_overlay = None;
        } else {
            self.settings_ui.update(msg, &mut self.settings);
            self.theme = ShellTheme::from_settings(&self.settings);

            if self.is_standalone {
                tokio::spawn(async {
                    let _ = send_client_command(IpcCommand::ReloadSettings).await;
                });
            }
            if rescan_music {
                return Command::perform(
                    async move {
                        moonbeauty::libraries::backend::music::LocalMusicBackend::rescan_library()
                            .await;
                    },
                    |_| Message::Noop,
                );
            }
        }

        Command::none()
    }
}

==> /home/moonburst/projects/moonbeauty/src/app/update/tray.rs <==
use super::*;

impl MoonBeautyShellApp {
    fn step_tray_anim(&mut self) -> (u64, f32) {
        let elapsed_ms = self.tray_anim_started_at.elapsed().as_millis() as u64;
        let dur = self.tray_anim_duration_ms.max(1);
        let t = (elapsed_ms as f32 / dur as f32).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
        let expanding = self.tray_target_width > self.tray_anim_start_width;
        let eased = if expanding {
            1.0 - (1.0 - t).powi(3)
        } else {
            t * t * t
        };
        let delta = self.tray_target_width - self.tray_anim_start_width;
        self.tray_anim_width = self.tray_anim_start_width + delta * eased;
        if elapsed_ms >= dur || t >= 1.0 {
            self.tray_anim_width = self.tray_target_width;
        }
        (elapsed_ms, t)
    }

    pub(crate) fn handle_tray_watchdog(&mut self) -> Command<Message> {
        // 1) Timeout check
        if self.tray_expanded
            && self.settings.tray_timeout_sec > 0
            && self.tray_opened_at.elapsed().as_secs() >= self.settings.tray_timeout_sec as u64
        {
            eprintln!(
                "[tray-watchdog] elapsed={}s >= timeout={}s, closing (settings.tray_width={})",
                self.tray_opened_at.elapsed().as_secs(),
                self.settings.tray_timeout_sec,
                self.settings.tray_width
            );
            self.close_tray();
        }

        // 2) Animation step. Note: the completion check is OUTSIDE
        //    the `elapsed < duration` guard so the snap-to-target
        //    ALWAYS runs on the first tick past duration. Previous
        //    version froze at width=89.7 because once elapsed
        //    reached 180ms, the guard `elapsed < duration` became
        //    false and the inner `if t >= 1.0 { snap }` never ran.
        if (self.tray_anim_width - self.tray_target_width).abs() > 0.01 {
            let (elapsed_ms, t) = self.step_tray_anim();
            moonbeauty::dbg_log!(
                "[tray-anim] elapsed={}ms t={:.2} width={:.1} target={:.1}",
                elapsed_ms,
                t,
                self.tray_anim_width,
                self.tray_target_width
            );
        }

        Command::none()
    }

    pub(crate) fn handle_fetch_tray_items(&mut self) -> Command<Message> {
        // Background refresh so tray_items is populated before
        // the user ever clicks the tray capsule. Eliminates the
        // 0-item → N-item re-animation on first open.
        return Command::perform(
            moonbeauty::bar::tray::watcher::fetch_tray_items(self.tray_items.clone()),
            Message::TrayItemsLoaded,
        );
    }

    pub(crate) fn handle_tray_items_loaded(
        &mut self,
        items: Vec<moonbeauty::bar::tray::TrayItem>,
    ) -> Command<Message> {
        // Merge the new list with the old list.
        // If D-Bus temporarily drops an app, we keep its old icon instead of losing it.
        let mut merged = items;
        for old_item in &self.tray_items {
            // Check if the old item is missing from the new list
            if !merged.iter().any(|new_item| new_item.id == old_item.id || new_item.bus == old_item.bus) {
                merged.push(old_item.clone());
            }
        }
        
        if !merged.is_empty() {
            self.tray_items = merged;
        }
        if self.tray_expanded {
            let new_target = moonbeauty::bar::capsules::compute_expanded_visible_width(
                &self.settings,
                self.tray_items.len(),
            );
            // Re-anchor if target changed mid-animation
            if (new_target - self.tray_target_width).abs() > 1.0 {
                self.tray_anim_start_width = self.tray_anim_width;
                self.tray_anim_started_at = std::time::Instant::now();
                self.tray_target_width = new_target;
            }
        }

        Command::none()
    }
}

use super::*;
use moonbeauty::libraries::backend::*;

impl MoonBeautyShellApp {
    pub(crate) fn handle_metrics_collected(
        &mut self,
        cpu: CpuMetrics,
        ram: RamMetrics,
        gpu: GpuMetrics,
        audio: AudioStatus,
        mic: AudioStatus,
        mpris: Option<MprisTrack>,
        net: NetMetrics,
    ) -> Command<Message> {
        self.telemetry.cpu = cpu;
        self.telemetry.ram = ram;
        self.telemetry.gpu = gpu;
        self.telemetry.audio = audio;
        self.telemetry.mic = mic;
        self.telemetry.mpris = mpris;
        self.telemetry.net = net;
        Command::none()
    }

    pub(crate) fn handle_tick_hardware(&mut self) -> Command<Message> {
        self.telemetry.gpu_selected_idx = self
            .detected_gpus
            .iter()
            .position(|g| g.card_id == self.settings.gpu_selected_id)
            .unwrap_or(0);
        let bat = SystemCollector::collect_battery();
        self.telemetry.battery = bat;

        let gpu_id = self.settings.gpu_selected_id.clone();
        // update_net() blocks on TcpStream::connect_timeout and an `ss` subprocess,
        // so run it inside the async task on a blocking thread instead of the UI thread.
        let net_collector = self.system_collector.clone();

        return Command::perform(
            async move {
                let (cpu, ram) = SystemCollector::collect_all().await;
                let gpu = SystemCollector::collect_gpu_by_card_id(&gpu_id).await;
                let audio = AudioBackend::get_sink().await;
                let mic = AudioBackend::get_source().await;
                // Prefer the dedicated music daemon over incidental browser media when both are playing.
                let (mpris, _source) = moonbeauty::libraries::backend::poll_track().await;
                // Blocking net poll on a dedicated thread, not the async executor or UI thread.
                let net =
                    tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || net_collector.lock().unwrap().update_net())
                        .await
                        .unwrap_or_default();
                (cpu, ram, gpu, audio, mic, mpris, net)
            },
            |(cpu, ram, gpu, audio, mic, mpris, net)| {
                Message::MetricsCollected(cpu, ram, gpu, audio, mic, mpris, net)
            },
        );
    }

    pub(crate) fn handle_weather_loaded(
        &mut self,
        w: Option<moonbeauty::bar::weather::WeatherData>,
    ) -> Command<Message> {
        self.telemetry.weather = w;
        Command::none()
    }

    pub(crate) fn handle_tick_weather(&mut self) -> Command<Message> {
        return Command::perform(
            async { moonbeauty::bar::weather::WeatherBackend::fetch().await.ok() },
            Message::WeatherLoaded,
        );
    }

    pub(crate) fn handle_tick_clock(&mut self) -> Command<Message> {
        self.telemetry.bar_time = ClockBackend::get_bar_time();
        return self.check_reminder_alerts();
    }

    pub(crate) fn handle_idle_tick(&mut self) -> Command<Message> {
        // Reap zombie standalone overlays so self-exiting children don't
        // stay defunct until the next spawn of the same target.
        if let Some((_, c)) = self.standalone_child.as_mut() {
            if matches!(c.try_wait(), Ok(Some(_))) {
                self.standalone_child = None;
            }
        }
        let dead = match self.notif_surface_child.as_mut() {
            Some(c) => matches!(c.try_wait(), Ok(Some(_))),
            None => true,
        };
        if dead {
            self.notif_surface_child = crate::app::helpers::spawn_notif_surface_child();
        }
        let mtime = std::fs::metadata(ShellSettings::config_path())
            .ok()
            .and_then(|m| m.modified().ok());
        if mtime != self.settings_json_mtime {
            self.settings_json_mtime = mtime;
            let prev_screen = self.settings.notif_screen_name.clone();
            let prev_corner = self.settings.notif_corner.clone();
            self.settings = ShellSettings::load();
            self.theme = ShellTheme::from_settings(&self.settings);
            if self.settings.notif_screen_name != prev_screen
                || self.settings.notif_corner != prev_corner
            {
                self.notif_screen_at_startup = self.settings.notif_screen_name.clone();
                self.restart_notif_surface();
            }
        }
        let c1 = self.update(Message::TickClock);
        let c2 = self.update(Message::TickHardware);
        return Command::batch(vec![c1, c2]);
    }
}
