//! Notification-related update handlers, extracted from `app/update.rs`.
//!
//! Covers:
//!   - `Message::Notif(msg)` — NotifMessage dispatch
//!   - `Message::PollNotifs` — background poll, CLI command, resize, DND
//!   - `Message::TickToasts` — toast animation tick
//!   - `IpcCommand::{DismissLatestNotif, JumpToLatestNotif, ToggleHistory, TestNotification}`
//!   - `CapsuleAction::ToggleNotificationDnd`


#![allow(clippy::collapsible_match)]

use super::*;
use crate::app::keys::focus_notification_app;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize)]
struct NotifActivateCmd {
    id: u32,
    token: Option<String>,
    action_key: Option<String>,
    is_resident: bool,
    #[serde(default)]
    close_notification: bool,
}

fn is_notif_surface_pid_alive(pid: u32) -> bool {
    if pid == 0 {
        return false;
    }
    let Ok(bytes) = std::fs::read(format!("/proc/{}/cmdline", pid)) else {
        return false;
    };
    bytes.split(|b| *b == 0).any(|arg| {
        arg == b"--notif-surface"
            || arg == b"moonbeauty"
            || arg.ends_with(b"/moonbeauty")
            || arg == b"moon-beauty-shell"
            || arg.ends_with(b"/moon-beauty-shell")
    })
}

impl MoonBeautyShellApp {
    fn trigger_toast_handshake(
        &mut self,
        t: moonbeauty::overlays::notifications::NotificationToast,
        action_key: Option<String>,
    ) -> Command<Message> {
        let nid = t.id;
        let is_resident = t.is_resident;
        let (tx, rx) = tokio::sync::oneshot::channel::<Option<String>>();
        let tx = std::sync::Arc::new(std::sync::Mutex::new(Some(tx)));
        let cb = iced_layershell::actions::ActivationCallback::new(move |token| {
            if let Ok(mut guard) = tx.lock() {
                if let Some(sender) = guard.take() {
                    let _ = sender.send(token);
                }
            }
        });

        let handshake_task = Command::perform(
            async move {
                // Step 1: Wait for the xdg_activation_v1 token minted from the click event.
                let token =
                    match tokio::time::timeout(std::time::Duration::from_millis(500), rx).await {
                        Ok(Ok(tok)) => tok,
                        _ => None,
                    };
                // Steps 2 -> 3 -> 4 (D-Bus):
                // ActivationToken -> ActionInvoked (if registered) -> NotificationClosed(2) (unless resident)
                moonbeauty::overlays::notifications::emit_click_handshake(
                    nid,
                    token,
                    action_key,
                    is_resident,
                )
                .await;
            },
            move |_| {
                Message::Notif(NotifMessage::FinishToastActivation {
                    id: nid,
                    dismiss: !is_resident,
                })
            },
        );

        Command::batch(vec![
            Command::done(Message::RequestXdgActivation(cb)),
            handshake_task,
        ])
    }

    pub(crate) fn handle_notif(&mut self, msg: NotifMessage) -> Command<Message> {
        match msg {
            NotifMessage::DismissDrawer => {
                if self.is_standalone {
                    std::process::exit(0);
                }
                self.active_overlay = None;
            }
            NotifMessage::HistoryScrollTo(y) => {
                return iced::widget::operation::scroll_to(
                    iced::widget::Id::new("history_list"),
                    iced::widget::operation::AbsoluteOffset { x: 0.0, y },
                );
            }
            NotifMessage::HistorySelectNext | NotifMessage::HistorySelectPrev => {
                self.notifs.update(msg);
                if let Some(y) = self
                    .notifs
                    .scroll_offset_for_selected(&self.theme, &self.settings)
                {
                    return iced::widget::operation::scroll_to(
                        iced::widget::Id::new("history_list"),
                        iced::widget::operation::AbsoluteOffset { x: 0.0, y },
                    );
                }
            }
            NotifMessage::HistoryDeleteSelected => {
                self.notifs.update(msg);
                if let Some(y) = self
                    .notifs
                    .scroll_offset_for_selected(&self.theme, &self.settings)
                {
                    return iced::widget::operation::scroll_to(
                        iced::widget::Id::new("history_list"),
                        iced::widget::operation::AbsoluteOffset { x: 0.0, y },
                    );
                }
            }
            NotifMessage::DismissToast(id) => {
                self.notifs.dismiss_toast_ui(id);
                if self.is_notif_surface {
                    self.notifs.mark_history_closed(id);
                    return Command::perform(
                        moonbeauty::overlays::notifications::emit_notification_closed(id, 2),
                        |_| Message::Noop,
                    );
                }
            }
            NotifMessage::ActivateToast(id) => {
                if let Some(t) = self
                    .notifs
                    .active_toasts
                    .iter()
                    .find(|t| t.id == id && t.exit_started_at.is_none())
                    .cloned()
                {
                    let action_key = t
                        .actions
                        .chunks_exact(2)
                        .find(|pair| pair[0] == "default")
                        .map(|_| "default".to_string());
                    return self.trigger_toast_handshake(t, action_key);
                }
            }
            NotifMessage::InvokeToastAction(id, key) => {
                if let Some(t) = self
                    .notifs
                    .active_toasts
                    .iter()
                    .find(|t| t.id == id && t.exit_started_at.is_none())
                    .cloned()
                {
                    let action_key = if t.actions.chunks_exact(2).any(|pair| pair[0] == key) {
                        Some(key)
                    } else {
                        None
                    };
                    return self.trigger_toast_handshake(t, action_key);
                }
            }
            NotifMessage::FinishToastActivation { id, dismiss } => {
                if dismiss {
                    self.notifs.dismiss_toast_ui(id);
                    if self.is_notif_surface {
                        self.notifs.mark_history_closed(id);
                    }
                }
            }
            NotifMessage::HistoryActivateSelected => {
                let Some(sel_id) = self.notifs.selected_history_id else {
                    return Command::none();
                };
                let Some(t) = self
                    .notifs
                    .history
                    .iter()
                    .find(|t| t.id == sel_id)
                    .cloned()
                else {
                    return Command::none();
                };

                let has_default = t.actions.chunks_exact(2).any(|pair| pair[0] == "default");
                let live_capable =
                    !t.closed && has_default && is_notif_surface_pid_alive(t.daemon_pid);

                let (tx, rx) = tokio::sync::oneshot::channel::<Option<String>>();
                let tx = std::sync::Arc::new(std::sync::Mutex::new(Some(tx)));
                let cb = iced_layershell::actions::ActivationCallback::new(move |token| {
                    if let Ok(mut guard) = tx.lock() {
                        if let Some(sender) = guard.take() {
                            let _ = sender.send(token);
                        }
                    }
                });

                let jump_task = Command::perform(
                    async move {
                        let token = match tokio::time::timeout(
                            std::time::Duration::from_millis(500),
                            rx,
                        )
                        .await
                        {
                            Ok(Ok(tok)) => tok,
                            _ => None,
                        };

                        if live_capable {
                            let cmd_path = moonbeauty::libraries::process::mbs_runtime_dir()
                                .join("moonbeauty-notif-cmd");
                            let tmp_path = cmd_path.with_extension("tmp");
                            let payload = NotifActivateCmd {
                                id: t.id,
                                token: token.clone(),
                                action_key: Some("default".to_string()),
                                is_resident: t.is_resident,
                                close_notification: false,
                            };
                            if let Ok(json) = serde_json::to_vec(&payload) {
                                if moonbeauty::libraries::process::private_write_file(
                                    &tmp_path, &json,
                                )
                                .is_ok()
                                    && std::fs::rename(&tmp_path, &cmd_path).is_ok()
                                {
                                    for _ in 0..20 {
                                        if !cmd_path.exists() {
                                            break;
                                        }
                                        tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(10))
                                            .await;
                                    }
                                    return;
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || {
                            focus_notification_app(
                                &t.app_name,
                                t.desktop_entry.as_deref(),
                                token.as_deref(),
                            );
                        })
                        .await
                        .ok();
                    },
                    |_| Message::Notif(NotifMessage::FinishHistoryActivation),
                );

                return Command::batch(vec![
                    Command::done(Message::RequestXdgActivation(cb)),
                    jump_task,
                ]);
            }
            NotifMessage::FinishHistoryActivation => {
                if self.is_standalone {
                    std::process::exit(0);
                }
                self.active_overlay = None;
            }
            _ => self.notifs.update(msg),
        }
        Command::none()
    }

    pub(crate) fn handle_poll_notifs(&mut self) -> Command<Message> {
        if !self.is_notif_surface {
            return Command::none();
        }
        let mtime = std::fs::metadata(ShellSettings::config_path())
            .ok()
            .and_then(|m| m.modified().ok());
        if mtime != self.settings_json_mtime {
            self.settings_json_mtime = mtime;
            self.settings = ShellSettings::load();
            self.theme = ShellTheme::from_settings(&self.settings);
        }
        if let Some(rx) = self.notif_rx.as_ref() {
            while let Ok(n) = rx.try_recv() {
                let is_test = n.app_name == "Diagnostics";
                self.notifs.push_notification(
                    n.id,
                    &n.app_name,
                    &n.summary,
                    &n.body,
                    n.is_urgent,
                    n.is_resident,
                    is_test,
                    n.desktop_entry.as_deref(),
                    n.actions.clone(),
                    &self.settings,
                );
            }
        }
        if self.is_notif_surface || !self.is_standalone {
            let runtime = std::env::var("XDG_RUNTIME_DIR")
                .unwrap_or_else(|_| format!("/tmp/user-{}", std::process::id()));
            let cmd_path = std::path::PathBuf::from(&runtime).join("moonbeauty-notif-cmd");
            if let Ok(cmd) = std::fs::read_to_string(&cmd_path) {
                let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&cmd_path);
                match cmd.trim() {
                    "dismiss" => {
                        // Dismiss the oldest active toast first so newer ones remain visible
                        if let Some(oldest) = self.notifs.oldest_active_toast() {
                            let oid = oldest.id;
                            self.notifs.dismiss_toast_ui(oid);
                            self.notifs.mark_history_closed(oid);
                            return Command::perform(
                                moonbeauty::overlays::notifications::emit_notification_closed(
                                    oid, 2,
                                ),
                                |_| Message::Noop,
                            );
                        }
                    }
                    "activate-latest" => {
                        if let Some(t) = self.notifs.oldest_active_toast() {
                            let action_key = t
                                .actions
                                .chunks_exact(2)
                                .find(|pair| pair[0] == "default")
                                .map(|_| "default".to_string());
                            return self.trigger_toast_handshake(t, action_key);
                        } else {
                            eprintln!("[activate-latest] no active toast");
                        }
                    }
                    other => {
                        if let Ok(req) = serde_json::from_str::<NotifActivateCmd>(other) {
                            self.notifs.dismiss_toast_ui(req.id);
                            if req.close_notification && !req.is_resident {
                                self.notifs.mark_history_closed(req.id);
                            }
                            let skip_dbus_close = !req.close_notification || req.is_resident;
                            return Command::perform(
                                moonbeauty::overlays::notifications::emit_click_handshake(
                                    req.id,
                                    req.token,
                                    req.action_key,
                                    skip_dbus_close,
                                ),
                                |_| Message::Noop,
                            );
                        }
                    }
                }
            }


            if !moonbeauty::overlays::notifications::dnd_active() {
                let held = moonbeauty::overlays::notifications::take_held_notifs();
                if !held.is_empty() {
                    eprintln!(
                        "[dnd] unpaused! releasing {} held toast(s) to screen",
                        held.len()
                    );
                    for mut item in held {
                        item.created_at = std::time::Instant::now();
                        item.hold_reset_at = Some(std::time::Instant::now());
                        item.exit_started_at = None;
                        item.slot_shift_start = None;
                        const MAX_PENDING_TOASTS: usize = 50;
                        if self.notifs.active_toasts.len() < 4 {
                            self.notifs.active_toasts.push(item);
                        } else {
                            if self.notifs.pending_toasts.len() >= MAX_PENDING_TOASTS {
                                self.notifs.pending_toasts.pop_front();
                            }
                            self.notifs.pending_toasts.push_back(item);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            let big_w =
                (self.settings.notif_card_width as i32 + 2 * self.settings.notif_margin_x + 100)
                    .max(200) as u32;
            let big_h = (3 * self.settings.notif_card_height as i32
                + 2 * self.settings.notif_margin_x
                + 100)
                .max(300) as u32;
            let want = if self.notifs.active_toasts.is_empty() {
                (1u32, 1u32)
            } else {
                (big_w, big_h)
            };
            let toast_count = self.notifs.active_toasts.len();
            let count_changed = toast_count != self.last_toast_count;

            let active_pending = self.notifs.active_toasts.len() + self.notifs.pending_toasts.len();
            let should_write = match self.last_active_pending_written {
                None => true,
                Some((prev, at)) => prev != active_pending || at.elapsed().as_secs() >= 3,
            };
            if should_write {
                moonbeauty::overlays::notifications::write_active_count(active_pending);
                self.last_active_pending_written =
                    Some((active_pending, std::time::Instant::now()));
            }

            if self.is_notif_surface {
                if want != self.notif_surface_size || count_changed {
                    self.notif_surface_size = want;
                    self.last_toast_count = toast_count;
                    let rects = self.compute_toast_rects();
                    return Command::batch(vec![
                        Command::done(Message::ResizeNotifSurface(None, want.0, want.1)),
                        Command::done(Message::SetToastInputRegion(None, rects)),
                    ]);
                }
            }
        }
        Command::none()
    }

    pub(crate) fn dismiss_latest_notif(&self) -> Command<Message> {
        let cmd_path =
            moonbeauty::libraries::process::mbs_runtime_dir().join("moonbeauty-notif-cmd");
        // private_write_file: O_EXCL + 0600 + refuses pre-placed
        // symlinks. std::fs::write followed symlinks and inherited umask.
        let tmp_path = cmd_path.with_extension("tmp");
        if moonbeauty::libraries::process::private_write_file(&tmp_path, b"dismiss").is_ok() {
            let _ = std::fs::rename(&tmp_path, &cmd_path);
            eprintln!("[ipc] DismissLatestNotif -> notif-surface");
        } else {
            eprintln!("[ipc] DismissLatestNotif write failed");
        }
        Command::none()
    }

use crate::app::Message;
use moonbeauty::overlays::email::EmailMessage;
use moonbeauty::overlays::lockscreen::LockMessage;
use moonbeauty::overlays::screenshot::annotator::AnnotatorMessage;

pub fn focused_app_id() -> Option<String> {
    let out = std::process::Command::new("swaymsg")
        .args(["-t", "get_tree", "-r"])
        .stderr(std::process::Stdio::null())
        .output()
        .ok()?;
    if !out.status.success() {
        return None;
    }
    let v: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_slice(&out.stdout).ok()?;
    fn walk(node: &serde_json::Value) -> Option<String> {
        if node.get("focused").and_then(|f| f.as_bool()) == Some(true) {
            if let Some(app_id) = node.get("app_id").and_then(|a| a.as_str()) {
                if !app_id.is_empty() {
                    return Some(app_id.to_string());
                }
            }
        }
        for key in ["nodes", "floating_nodes"] {
            if let Some(nodes) = node.get(key).and_then(|n| n.as_array()) {
                for child in nodes {
                    if let Some(r) = walk(child) {
                        return Some(r);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        None
    }
    walk(&v)
}

pub fn notification_candidates(app_name: &str, desktop_entry: Option<&str>) -> Vec<String> {
    use std::collections::HashSet;
    let lower = app_name.to_lowercase();
    let mut cand_set: HashSet<String> = HashSet::new();
    cand_set.insert(lower.clone());
    cand_set.insert(lower.replace(' ', "-"));
    cand_set.insert(lower.replace(' ', "_"));
    cand_set.insert(lower.replace(' ', ""));
    if let Some(de) = desktop_entry {
        let de_clean = de.trim_end_matches(".desktop").to_lowercase();
        cand_set.insert(de_clean);
    }
    cand_set
        .into_iter()
        .filter(|s| !s.is_empty() && moonbeauty::libraries::process::is_safe_app_id(s))
        .collect()
}

pub fn is_app_focused(candidates: &[String]) -> bool {
    let Some(focused) = focused_app_id() else {
        return false;
    };
    candidates.iter().any(|c| focused.eq_ignore_ascii_case(c))
}

pub fn focus_notification_app(
    app_name: &str,
    desktop_entry: Option<&str>,
    activation_token: Option<&str>,
) -> bool {
    let candidates = notification_candidates(app_name, desktop_entry);
    if is_app_focused(&candidates) {
        return true;
    }
    if std::env::var("SWAYSOCK").is_ok() {
        for cand in &candidates {
            let _ = std::process::Command::new("swaymsg")
                .args(["-t", "command", &format!("[app_id=\"{}\"] focus", cand)])
                .stdout(std::process::Stdio::null())
                .stderr(std::process::Stdio::null())
                .status();
        }
        if is_app_focused(&candidates) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    if let Some(de) = desktop_entry {
        let de_clean = de.trim_end_matches(".desktop");
        if moonbeauty::libraries::process::is_safe_app_id(de_clean) {
            let mut cmd = std::process::Command::new("gtk-launch");
            cmd.arg(de_clean);
            if let Some(tok) = activation_token.filter(|s| !s.is_empty()) {
                cmd.env("XDG_ACTIVATION_TOKEN", tok);
            }
            let ok = cmd.status().map(|s| s.success()).unwrap_or(false);
            if ok {
                return true;
            }
        }
    }
    if let Some(first) = candidates.first() {
        let mut cmd = std::process::Command::new("gtk-launch");
        cmd.arg(first);
        if let Some(tok) = activation_token.filter(|s| !s.is_empty()) {
            cmd.env("XDG_ACTIVATION_TOKEN", tok);
        }
        let _ = cmd.status();
    }
    false
}

pub fn handle_lock_keypress(
    event: iced::Event,
    status: iced::event::Status,
    _window: iced::window::Id,
) -> Option<Message> {
    if status == iced::event::Status::Captured {
        return None;
    }
    let debug = std::env::var_os("MBS_LOCK_DEBUG").is_some();
    moonbeauty::overlays::lockscreen::resolve_lock_key(event).map(|k| {
        if debug {
            eprintln!("[lock-key] resolved: {:?}", k);
        }
        Message::Lock(LockMessage::KeyPress(k))
    })
}

pub fn handle_email_keypress(
    event: iced::Event,
    status: iced::event::Status,
    _window: iced::window::Id,
) -> Option<Message> {
    let iced::Event::Keyboard(iced::keyboard::Event::KeyPressed { key, modifiers, .. }) = event
    else {
        return None;
    };
    use iced::keyboard::{key::Named, Key};

    if key == Key::Named(Named::Enter) && (modifiers.control() || modifiers.alt()) {
        return Some(Message::Email(EmailMessage::SendMail));
    }
    if let Key::Character(c) = &key {
        if modifiers.control() && c.to_lowercase() == "s" {
            return Some(Message::Email(EmailMessage::SendMail));
        }
        if modifiers.control() && c.to_lowercase() == "o" {
            return Some(Message::Email(EmailMessage::AddAttachment));
        }
        if modifiers.control() && c.to_lowercase() == "f" {
            return Some(Message::Email(EmailMessage::OpenSearch));
        }
    }
    if key == Key::Named(Named::Tab) {
        return Some(Message::ComposeTabPressed(modifiers.shift()));
    }
    if modifiers.alt() || modifiers.control() {
        match key {
            Key::Named(Named::ArrowUp) => return Some(Message::Email(EmailMessage::SelectFolderPrev)),
            Key::Named(Named::ArrowDown) => return Some(Message::Email(EmailMessage::SelectFolderNext)),
            _ => {}
        }
    }
    if modifiers.control() {
        if let Key::Character(c) = &key {
            match c.to_lowercase().as_str() {
                "n" | "j" => return Some(Message::Email(EmailMessage::SelectMailNext)),
                "p" | "k" => return Some(Message::Email(EmailMessage::SelectMailPrev)),
                _ => {}
            }
        }
    }
    if matches!(key, Key::Character(_)) && status == iced::event::Status::Captured && !modifiers.control() {
        return None;
    }
    match key {
        Key::Named(Named::ArrowUp) => Some(Message::Email(EmailMessage::SelectMailPrev)),
        Key::Named(Named::ArrowDown) => Some(Message::Email(EmailMessage::SelectMailNext)),
        Key::Named(Named::Enter) => Some(Message::Email(EmailMessage::OpenSelected)),
        Key::Named(Named::Delete) => Some(Message::Email(EmailMessage::DeleteSelected)),
        Key::Character(c) if c == "n" && !modifiers.control() => Some(Message::Email(EmailMessage::OpenComposer)),
        Key::Character(c) if c == "s" && !modifiers.control() => Some(Message::Email(EmailMessage::ToggleStar)),
        Key::Character(c) if c == "d" && !modifiers.control() => Some(Message::Email(EmailMessage::DeleteSelected)),
        Key::Character(c) if c == "c" && !modifiers.control() => Some(Message::Email(EmailMessage::SaveContact)),
        _ => None,
    }
}

pub fn handle_annotator_text_input(
    event: iced::Event,
    status: iced::event::Status,
    _window: iced::window::Id,
) -> Option<Message> {
    let iced::Event::Keyboard(iced::keyboard::Event::KeyPressed { modified_key, text, modifiers, .. }) = event
    else {
        return None;
    };
    use iced::keyboard::{key::Named, Key};

    if modifiers.control() || modifiers.alt() || modifiers.logo() {
        return None;
    }
    if status == iced::event::Status::Captured {
        return None;
    }
    if let Key::Named(named) = &modified_key {
        match named {
            Named::Enter => return Some(Message::Annotator(AnnotatorMessage::NewLinePressed)),
            Named::Backspace => return Some(Message::Annotator(AnnotatorMessage::BackspacePressed)),
            _ => {}
        }
    }
    if let Some(t) = text {
        if !t.is_empty() && !t.chars().any(|c| c.is_control()) {
            return Some(Message::Annotator(AnnotatorMessage::CharacterInput(t.to_string())));
        }
    }
    if let Key::Character(c) = modified_key {
        if !c.is_empty() {
            return Some(Message::Annotator(AnnotatorMessage::CharacterInput(c.to_string())));
        }
    }
    None
}

//! --restart-bar: restart the bar with orphan detection.
//!
//! Three-path restart logic:
//!   1. systemctl user unit active → kill ppid=1 orphans, then delegate
//!   2. no unit → pkill bar + watchers + notif-surface, then respawn
//!   3. exit immediately if --restart-bar absent

use moonbeauty::libraries::process::resolve_exe;

pub fn run(args: &[String]) {
    // Restart bar (used by Settings when changing monitor)
    if args.iter().any(|a| a == "--restart-bar") {
        // Under systemd with Restart=always, pkill+spawn races the
        // service auto-restart and produces two bars for ~1s. An orphaned
        // bar (re-parented to PID 1, no unit) is invisible to scope checks:
        //   1. Kill orphans first (ppid=1, not under any unit)
        //   2. Delegate to systemctl if a unit is active
        //   3. Fall through to pkill+spawn otherwise
        let user_active = std::process::Command::new("systemctl")
            .args(["--user", "is-active", "--quiet", "moonbeauty.service"])
            .status()
            .map(|s| s.success())
            .unwrap_or(false);
        if user_active {
            // Kill orphans reparented to PID 1 before delegating.
            if let Ok(out) = std::process::Command::new("pgrep")
                .args(["-f", "(^|/)(moonbeauty|moon-beauty-shell)$"])
                .output()
            {
                for line in String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout).lines() {
                    let pid = line.trim();
                    if pid.parse::<u32>().is_err() {
                        continue;
                    }
                    let ppid = std::process::Command::new("ps")
                        .args(["-o", "ppid=", "-p", pid])
                        .output()
                        .ok()
                        .and_then(|o| {
                            String::from_utf8_lossy(&o.stdout)
                                .trim()
                                .parse::<u32>()
                                .ok()
                        });
                    if ppid == Some(1) {
                        eprintln!(
                            "[restart-bar] killing orphan bar pid={} (ppid=1, no unit)",
                            pid
                        );
                        let _ = std::process::Command::new("kill")
                            .args(["-9", pid])
                            .status();
                    }
                }
            }
            eprintln!("[restart-bar] delegating to systemctl --user restart moonbeauty.service");
            let _ = std::process::Command::new("systemctl")
                .args(["--user", "restart", "moonbeauty.service"])
                .status();
            std::process::exit(0);
        }

        // Kill orphaned clipboard watchers first: their cmdline ends with
        // "--clipboard-ingest", so the anchored shell pkill below misses them
        // and restarts would create duplicate clipboard entries.
        let _ = std::process::Command::new("pkill")
            .args(["-f", "wl-paste --watch.*moonbeauty"])
            .status();
        // Anchored patterns require a path-prefix before the binary name
        // and end-of-argv after the flag so unrelated scripts aren't matched.
        let _ = std::process::Command::new("pkill")
            .args(["-f", "(^|/)(moonbeauty|moon-beauty-shell)$"])
            .status();
        let _ = std::process::Command::new("pkill")
            .args([
                "-f",
                "(^|/)(moonbeauty|moon-beauty-shell) --notif-surface$",
            ])
            .status();
        std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(400));
        let exe = resolve_exe();
        let mut cmd = std::process::Command::new(exe);
        let _ = moonbeauty::libraries::process::spawn_and_reap(&mut cmd);
        std::process::exit(0);
    }
}

impl TryInto<iced_layershell::actions::LayershellCustomActionWithId> for Message {
    type Error = Message;
    fn try_into(
        self,
    ) -> Result<iced_layershell::actions::LayershellCustomActionWithId, Self::Error> {
        match self {
            Message::ResizeNotifSurface(id, w, h) => {
                Ok(iced_layershell::actions::LayershellCustomActionWithId::new(
                    id,
                    iced_layershell::actions::LayershellCustomAction::SizeChange((w, h)),
                ))
            }
            Message::SetToastInputRegion(id, rects) => {
                Ok(iced_layershell::actions::LayershellCustomActionWithId::new(
                    id,
                    iced_layershell::actions::LayershellCustomAction::SetInputRegion(
                        iced_layershell::actions::ActionCallback::new(move |region| {
                            for (x, y, w, h) in &rects {
                                region.add(*x, *y, *w, *h);
                            }
                        }),
                    ),
                ))
            }
            Message::OpenNotifLayer(id, settings) => {
                Ok(iced_layershell::actions::LayershellCustomActionWithId::new(
                    None,
                    iced_layershell::actions::LayershellCustomAction::NewLayerShell {
                        settings,
                        id,
                    },
                ))
            }
            Message::CloseNotifLayer(id) => {
                Ok(iced_layershell::actions::LayershellCustomActionWithId::new(
                    Some(id),
                    iced_layershell::actions::LayershellCustomAction::RemoveWindow,
                ))
            }
            Message::RequestXdgActivation(cb) => {
                Ok(iced_layershell::actions::LayershellCustomActionWithId::new(
                    None,
                    iced_layershell::actions::LayershellCustomAction::RequestActivationToken(cb),
                ))
            }
            other => Err(other),
        }
    }
}

use super::*;

impl MoonBeautyShellApp {
    pub fn new_app() -> (Self, Command<Message>) {
        moonbeauty::libraries::process::tighten_existing_runtime_state();
        moonbeauty::libraries::process::prune_standalone_logs();
        let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().collect();
        let standalone_target = detect_standalone_overlay(&args);

        let is_notif_surface = detect_notif_surface(&args);
        let is_standalone = standalone_target.is_some();
        let settings = ShellSettings::load();
        let tray_width_px = settings.tray_width as f32;
        eprintln!(
            "[startup] tray_width={} tray_timeout={}s",
            settings.tray_width, settings.tray_timeout_sec
        );
        let theme = ShellTheme::from_settings(&settings);

        let (ipc_tx, ipc_rx) = tokio::sync::mpsc::unbounded_channel::<IpcCommand>();
        let _ = crate::app::subscription::IPC_RX
            .set(std::sync::Arc::new(tokio::sync::Mutex::new(ipc_rx)));
        if standalone_target.is_none() && !is_notif_surface {
            std::thread::spawn(move || {
                use std::io::Read;
                use std::os::unix::net::UnixListener;
                let path = moonbeauty::libraries::ipc::get_socket_path();
                let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&path);
                let listener = match UnixListener::bind(&path) {
                    Ok(l) => {
                        eprintln!("[ipc] listener bound (sync thread)");
                        l
                    }
                    Err(e) => {
                        eprintln!("[ipc] bind failed: {e}");
                        return;
                    }
                };
                loop {
                    match listener.accept() {
                        Ok((mut stream, _)) => {
                            // 1s timeout bounds per-connection accept-loop blocking.
                            let _ =
                                stream.set_read_timeout(Some(std::time::Duration::from_secs(1)));
                            // Cap IPC read at 4 MB.
                            let mut buf = Vec::new();
                            let mut limited = std::io::Read::take(&mut stream, 4 * 1024 * 1024);
                            if let Err(e) = limited.read_to_end(&mut buf) {
                                eprintln!("[ipc] read error: {e}");
                                continue;
                            }
                            match serde_json::from_slice::<IpcCommand>(&buf) {
                                Ok(cmd) => {
                                    eprintln!("[ipc] accepted: {:?}", cmd);
                                    if ipc_tx.send(cmd).is_err() {
                                        eprintln!("[ipc] channel closed");
                                        break;
                                    }
                                }
                                Err(e) => eprintln!("[ipc] deserialize error: {e}"),
                            }
                        }
                        Err(e) => eprintln!("[ipc] accept error: {e}"),
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        // ── TTY return watcher ──
        // Sway drops layer surfaces on TTY switch and does not recreate
        // them on return. The bar cannot recreate its own surface from
        // inside iced_layershell, so exit cleanly on return-to-desktop
        // and let systemd's Restart=always (or --restart-bar for
        // non-systemd launches) bring up a fresh bar with new surfaces.
        //
        // The lockscreen coordinator has its own TTY watcher and
        // respawns its children independently. When the bar exits and
        // systemd restarts it, the coordinator survives as an orphan
        // and keeps the lockscreen up.
        if !is_standalone && !is_notif_surface {
            std::thread::spawn(|| {
                let read_tty = || {
                    std::fs::read_to_string("/sys/class/tty/tty0/active")
                        .ok()
                        .map(|s| s.trim().to_string())
                };
                let desktop_tty = match read_tty() {
                    Some(v) => v,
                    None => {
                        eprintln!(
                            "[bar] TTY watcher disabled: \
                             /sys/class/tty/tty0/active unreadable"
                        );
                        return;
                    }
                };
                eprintln!("[bar] TTY watcher active (desktop_tty={:?})", desktop_tty);
                let mut last_tty = Some(desktop_tty.clone());
                loop {
                    std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(500));
                    let now_tty = read_tty();
                    if now_tty == last_tty {
                        continue;
                    }
                    if now_tty.as_deref() == Some(desktop_tty.as_str())
                        && last_tty.as_deref() != Some(desktop_tty.as_str())
                    {
                        let is_systemd = std::env::var_os("INVOCATION_ID").is_some();
                        eprintln!(
                            "[bar] TTY return to desktop (from {:?}), \
                             is_systemd={}",
                            last_tty, is_systemd
                        );
                        if is_systemd {
                            std::process::exit(0);
                        } else {
                            let _ = std::process::Command::new(resolve_exe())
                                .arg("--restart-bar")
                                .spawn();
                            std::process::exit(0);
                        }
                    }
                    last_tty = now_tty;
                }
            });
        }

        // Spawn exactly one wl-paste watcher. Kill any orphaned watcher
        // from previous runs first — the shell pkill pattern anchors on
        // "moonbeauty$", but the watcher cmdline ends with
        // "--clipboard-ingest" and so escapes it, causing duplicate
        // clipboard entries after bar restarts.
        if standalone_target.is_none() && !is_notif_surface {
            let _ = std::process::Command::new("pkill")
                .args(["-f", "wl-paste --watch.*(moonbeauty|moon-beauty-shell)"])
                .status();
            std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(50));
            let exe = resolve_exe();
            let exe_str = exe.to_string_lossy().to_string();
            let mut paste_cmd = std::process::Command::new("wl-paste");
            paste_cmd.args(["--watch", &exe_str, "--clipboard-ingest"]);
            let _ = moonbeauty::libraries::process::spawn_and_reap(&mut paste_cmd);
        }

        let is_bar = !is_standalone && !is_notif_surface;
        let notif_rx = if is_notif_surface {
            // Bounded channel (256) so notification floods cannot OOM the shell.
            let (tx, rx) = std::sync::mpsc::sync_channel(256);
            moonbeauty::overlays::notifications::spawn(tx);
            Some(rx)
        } else {
            None
        };
        if is_bar {
            moonbeauty::bar::tray::watcher::spawn();
        }
        let notif_surface_child = if is_bar {
            crate::app::helpers::spawn_notif_surface_child()
        } else {
            None
        };

        let notif_screen_at_startup = settings.notif_screen_name.clone();
        let app = Self {
            settings_ui: if matches!(standalone_target, Some(OverlayTarget::Settings)) {
                SettingsOverlay::new(&settings)
            } else {
                SettingsOverlay::empty()
            },
            settings,
            theme,
            telemetry: UnifiedTelemetry {
                cpu: Default::default(),
                gpu: Default::default(),
                gpu_selected_idx: 0,
                ram: Default::default(),
                net: Default::default(),
                battery: Default::default(),
                audio: Default::default(),
                mic: Default::default(),
                mpris: None,
                weather: None,
                podman: Default::default(),
                borg: Default::default(),
                bar_time: ClockBackend::get_bar_time(),
            },
            active_overlay: standalone_target.clone(),
            in_bar_tooltip: None,
            tooltip_window_id: None,
            closing_tooltip_id: None,
            notif_surface_child,
            is_standalone,
            system_collector: std::sync::Arc::new(std::sync::Mutex::new(SystemCollector::new())),
            standalone_child: None,
            is_notif_surface,
            notif_rx,
            settings_json_mtime: std::fs::metadata(ShellSettings::config_path())
                .ok()
                .and_then(|m| m.modified().ok()),
            notif_screen_at_startup,
            notif_surface_size: if is_notif_surface { (1, 1) } else { (0, 0) },
            tray_expanded: false,
            tray_items: Vec::new(),
            tray_anim_width: tray_width_px,
            tray_target_width: tray_width_px,
            tray_anim_start_width: tray_width_px,
            tray_anim_started_at: std::time::Instant::now(),
            tray_anim_duration_ms: 220,
            tray_timeout_gen: 0,
            tray_opened_at: std::time::Instant::now(),
            detected_gpus: if is_notif_surface || is_standalone {
                Vec::new()
            } else {
                SystemCollector::list_gpus_sync()
            },

            launcher: if matches!(standalone_target, Some(OverlayTarget::Launcher)) {
                AppLauncher::new()
            } else {
                AppLauncher::new_empty()
            },
            calc: {
                if let Ok(expr) = std::env::var("MBS_CALC_EXPR") {
                    CalculatorOverlay::new_with_input(&expr)
                } else {
                    CalculatorOverlay::new()
                }
            },
            clipboard: ClipboardOverlay::new(),
            notes: if matches!(standalone_target, Some(OverlayTarget::Notes)) {
                NotesOverlay::new()
            } else {
                NotesOverlay::empty()
            },
            pass: if matches!(standalone_target, Some(OverlayTarget::Pass)) {
                PassOverlay::new()
            } else {
                PassOverlay::empty()
            },
            power: PowerOverlay::new(),
            todo: if matches!(standalone_target, Some(OverlayTarget::Todo)) {
                TodoOverlay::new()
            } else {
                TodoOverlay::empty()
            },
            reminders: if matches!(standalone_target, Some(OverlayTarget::Reminders)) {
                RemindersOverlay::new()
            } else {
                RemindersOverlay::empty()
            },
            dict: if matches!(standalone_target, Some(OverlayTarget::Dictionary)) {
                DictionaryOverlay::new()
            } else {
                DictionaryOverlay::empty()
            },
            unicode: UnicodeOverlay::new(),
            web: WebSearchOverlay::new(),
            amogus: AmogusOverlay::new(),
            annotator: {
                let mut a = AnnotatorOverlay::new();
                if let Ok(p) = std::env::var("MBS_ANNOTATOR_PATH") {
                    // Reject non-absolute / traversal paths and confine to mbs-tmp
                    // before reading to close IPC path-injection.
                    let pb = std::path::PathBuf::from(&p);
                    let safe = pb.is_absolute() && !p.contains("..");
                    let in_tmp = moonbeauty::libraries::process::path_is_under_mbs_tmp(&pb);
                    if !safe {
                        eprintln!("[annotator] rejecting unsafe MBS_ANNOTATOR_PATH: {:?}", p);
                    } else if !in_tmp {
                        eprintln!(
                            "[annotator] rejecting MBS_ANNOTATOR_PATH outside mbs-tmp: {:?}",
                            p
                        );
                    } else {
                        match std::fs::read(&pb) {
                            Ok(bytes) => {
                                a.load_image(pb, bytes);
                                eprintln!("[annotator] loaded capture from {p}");
                            }
                            Err(e) => eprintln!("[annotator] failed to read {p}: {e}"),
                        }
                    }
                }
                a
            },
            rng: RngOverlay::new(),
            email: if matches!(standalone_target, Some(OverlayTarget::Email)) {
                EmailOverlay::new()
            } else {
                EmailOverlay::empty()
            },
            notifs: if is_notif_surface
                || matches!(standalone_target, Some(OverlayTarget::NotificationsHistory))
            {
                NotificationOverlay::new()
            } else {
                NotificationOverlay::empty()
            },
            lockscreen: if matches!(standalone_target, Some(OverlayTarget::Lockscreen)) {
                LockscreenOverlay::new()
            } else {
                LockscreenOverlay::empty()
            },

            music_cycle_state: Default::default(),
            is_cycling: false,

            last_cursor_x: 0.0,
            last_cursor_time: std::time::Instant::now() - std::time::Duration::from_secs(30),
            last_toast_count: 0,
            last_active_pending_written: None,
        };

        // Bar-only init tasks. Overlays and the notif-surface don't render
        // weather/tray/email — the bar's TopBar::view is the only consumer.
        let is_bar = !is_standalone && !is_notif_surface;
        let mut init_tasks: Vec<Command<Message>> = Vec::new();
        if is_bar {
            init_tasks.push(Command::done(Message::FetchTrayItems));
            init_tasks.push(Command::done(Message::TickHardware));
            init_tasks.push(Command::perform(
                async { moonbeauty::bar::weather::WeatherBackend::fetch().await.ok() },
                Message::WeatherLoaded,
            ));
        }

        if matches!(app.active_overlay, Some(OverlayTarget::Launcher)) {
            // Immediate focus attempt
            init_tasks
                .push(iced::widget::operation::focus("launcher_search").map(Message::Launcher));
            // Delayed re-focus — catches compositor focus arriving after map
            init_tasks.push(Command::perform(
                async {
                    tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(100)).await;
                },
                |_| Message::Launcher(LauncherMessage::Refocus),
            ));
        } else if matches!(app.active_overlay, Some(OverlayTarget::Calc)) {
            init_tasks.push(
                iced::widget::operation::focus(moonbeauty::overlays::calc::CALC_INPUT_ID)
                    .map(Message::Calc),
            );
            init_tasks.push(Command::perform(
                async {
                    tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(100)).await;
                },
                |_| Message::Calc(CalcMessage::Refocus),
            ));
        } else if matches!(app.active_overlay, Some(OverlayTarget::Pass)) {
            init_tasks.push(
                iced::widget::operation::focus(moonbeauty::overlays::pass::PASS_SEARCH_ID)
                    .map(Message::Pass),
            );
            init_tasks.push(Command::perform(
                async {
                    tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(100)).await;
                },
                |_| Message::Pass(PassMessage::Refocus),
            ));
        } else if matches!(app.active_overlay, Some(OverlayTarget::Dictionary)) {
            init_tasks.push(
                iced::widget::operation::focus(moonbeauty::overlays::dictionary::DICT_SEARCH_ID)
                    .map(Message::Dict),
            );
            init_tasks.push(Command::perform(
                async {
                    tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(100)).await;
                },
                |_| Message::Dict(DictMessage::Refocus),
            ));
        } else if matches!(app.active_overlay, Some(OverlayTarget::Lockscreen)) {
            // No widget to focus — keyboard capture is via subscription
        } else if matches!(app.active_overlay, Some(OverlayTarget::Clipboard)) {
            init_tasks.push(Command::perform(ClipboardOverlay::reload(), |entries| {
                Message::Clipboard(ClipboardMessage::Reloaded(entries))
            }));
        } else if matches!(app.active_overlay, Some(OverlayTarget::Notes)) {
            init_tasks.push(
                iced::widget::operation::focus(moonbeauty::overlays::notes::NOTES_INPUT_ID)
                    .map(Message::Notes),
            );
            init_tasks.push(Command::perform(
                async {
                    tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(100)).await;
                },
                |_| Message::Notes(NotesMessage::Refocus),
            ));
        }

        // Todo autofocus: schedule input focus, then retry after 100ms in case
        // the compositor delivers window focus late on standalone layer surfaces.
        if matches!(app.active_overlay, Some(OverlayTarget::Todo)) {
            init_tasks.push(
                iced::widget::operation::focus(moonbeauty::overlays::todo::TODO_INPUT_ID)
                    .map(Message::Todo),
            );
            init_tasks.push(Command::perform(
                async {
                    tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(100)).await;
                },
                |_| Message::Todo(TodoMessage::Refocus),
            ));
        }

        if matches!(app.active_overlay, Some(OverlayTarget::Unicode)) {
            init_tasks.push(
                iced::widget::operation::focus(moonbeauty::overlays::unicode::UNICODE_INPUT_ID)
                    .map(Message::Unicode),
            );
            init_tasks.push(Command::perform(
                async {
                    tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(100)).await;
                },
                |_| Message::Unicode(UnicodeMessage::Refocus),
            ));
        }

        if matches!(app.active_overlay, Some(OverlayTarget::Email)) {
            init_tasks.push(Command::done(Message::Email(EmailMessage::SetLoading)));
            init_tasks.push(Command::perform(
                async { moonbeauty::libraries::backend::email::client::fetch_folder_list().await },
                |res| match res {
                    Ok(folders) => Message::Email(EmailMessage::FoldersLoaded(folders)),
                    Err(_) => Message::Email(EmailMessage::SyncDone),
                },
            ));
            init_tasks.push(Command::perform(
                async {
                    moonbeauty::libraries::backend::email::client::fetch_envelopes("INBOX").await
                },
                |res| match res {
                    Ok(envs) => {
                        Message::Email(EmailMessage::EnvelopesLoaded("INBOX".to_string(), envs))
                    }
                    Err(e) => Message::Email(EmailMessage::Error(e)),
                },
            ));
        }

        if matches!(app.active_overlay, Some(OverlayTarget::Reminders)) {
            init_tasks.push(
                iced::widget::operation::focus(moonbeauty::overlays::reminders::REMINDER_TASK_ID)
                    .map(Message::Reminders),
            );
            init_tasks.push(Command::perform(
                async {
                    tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(100)).await;
                },
                |_| Message::Reminders(ReminderMessage::InitialFocus),
            ));
        }

        // History: on open, scroll to the auto-selected newest (bottom) row.
        // The delayed retry catches the case where the scrollable hasn't been laid out yet.
        if matches!(
            app.active_overlay,
            Some(OverlayTarget::NotificationsHistory)
        ) {
            // Force scroll to the absolute bottom on mount.
            init_tasks.push(iced::widget::operation::scroll_to(
                iced::widget::Id::new("history_list"),
                iced::widget::scrollable::AbsoluteOffset {
                    x: 0.0,
                    y: f32::MAX,
                },
            ));

            init_tasks.push(Command::perform(
                async move {
                    tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(100)).await;
                },
                |_| Message::Notif(NotifMessage::HistoryScrollTo(f32::MAX)),
            ));
        }

        (app, Command::batch(init_tasks))
    }
}

use super::*;

impl MoonBeautyShellApp {
    fn build_notifs_view(&self) -> Element<'_, Message> {
        let is_right_corner = self.settings.notif_corner.contains("right");
        let is_top_corner = self.settings.notif_corner.contains("top");
        let pad_top = if is_top_corner { self.settings.notif_baseline_y as f32 } else { 0.0 };
        let pad_bottom = if !is_top_corner { self.settings.notif_baseline_y as f32 } else { 0.0 };
        let pad_right = if is_right_corner { self.settings.notif_margin_x.max(16) as f32 } else { 0.0 };
        let pad_left = if !is_right_corner { self.settings.notif_margin_x.max(16) as f32 } else { 0.0 };
        container(self.notifs.view_toasts(&self.theme, &self.settings).map(Message::Notif))
            .width(Length::Fill)
            .height(Length::Fill)
            .align_x(if is_right_corner { iced::alignment::Horizontal::Right } else { iced::alignment::Horizontal::Left })
            .align_y(if is_top_corner { iced::alignment::Vertical::Top } else { iced::alignment::Vertical::Bottom })
            .padding(Padding { top: pad_top, right: pad_right, bottom: pad_bottom, left: pad_left })
            .style(|_t| iced::widget::container::Style { background: None, ..Default::default() })
            .into()
    }

    fn build_in_bar_tooltip_view(&self) -> Element<'_, Message> {
        match &self.in_bar_tooltip {
            Some(InBarTooltip::Weather(app)) => app.view().map(Message::InBarWeatherTip),
            Some(InBarTooltip::System(app)) => app.view().map(Message::InBarSysTip),
            Some(InBarTooltip::Info(app)) => app.view().map(Message::InBarInfoTip),
            None => container(iced::widget::Space::new())
                .width(Length::Fill)
                .height(Length::Fill)
                .into(),
        }
    }

    pub fn view_window(&self, id: iced::window::Id) -> Element<'_, Message> {
        if self.tooltip_window_id == Some(id) || self.closing_tooltip_id == Some(id) {
            return self.build_in_bar_tooltip_view();
        }
        self.view()
    }

    pub fn view(&self) -> Element<'_, Message> {
        if self.is_notif_surface {
            return self.build_notifs_view();
        }

        let overlay_element: Option<Element<'_, Message>> = match &self.active_overlay {
            Some(OverlayTarget::Launcher) => Some(
                self.launcher
                    .view(&self.theme, &self.settings)
                    .map(Message::Launcher),
            ),
            Some(OverlayTarget::Calc) => Some(
                self.calc
                    .view(&self.theme, &self.settings)
                    .map(Message::Calc),
            ),
            Some(OverlayTarget::Clipboard) => Some(
                self.clipboard
                    .view(&self.theme, &self.settings)
                    .map(Message::Clipboard),
            ),
            Some(OverlayTarget::Notes) => Some(
                self.notes
                    .view(&self.theme, &self.settings)
                    .map(Message::Notes),
            ),
            Some(OverlayTarget::Pass) => Some(
                self.pass
                    .view(&self.theme, &self.settings)
                    .map(Message::Pass),
            ),
            Some(OverlayTarget::Power) => Some(self.power.view(&self.theme).map(Message::Power)),
            Some(OverlayTarget::Todo) => Some(
                self.todo
                    .view(&self.theme, &self.settings)
                    .map(Message::Todo),
            ),
            Some(OverlayTarget::Reminders) => Some(
                self.reminders
                    .view(&self.theme, &self.settings)
                    .map(Message::Reminders),
            ),
            Some(OverlayTarget::Dictionary) => Some(
                self.dict
                    .view(&self.theme, &self.settings)
                    .map(Message::Dict),
            ),
            Some(OverlayTarget::Unicode) => Some(
                self.unicode
                    .view(&self.theme, &self.settings)
                    .map(Message::Unicode),
            ),
            Some(OverlayTarget::Web) => Some(self.web.view(&self.theme).map(Message::Web)),
            Some(OverlayTarget::Amogus) => Some(
                self.amogus
                    .view(&self.theme, &self.settings)
                    .map(Message::Amogus),
            ),
            Some(OverlayTarget::Rng) => {
                Some(self.rng.view(&self.theme, &self.settings).map(Message::Rng))
            }
            Some(OverlayTarget::Email) => Some(
                self.email
                    .view(&self.theme, &self.settings)
                    .map(Message::Email),
            ),
            Some(OverlayTarget::NotificationsHistory) => Some(
                self.notifs
                    .view_history(&self.theme, &self.settings)
                    .map(Message::Notif),
            ),
            Some(OverlayTarget::Settings) => Some(
                self.settings_ui
                    .view(&self.settings, &self.theme)
                    .map(Message::Settings),
            ),
            Some(OverlayTarget::Lockscreen) => {
                Some(self.lockscreen.view(&self.theme).map(Message::Lock))
            }
            Some(OverlayTarget::Annotator) => Some(self.annotator.view().map(Message::Annotator)),
            None => None,
        };

        if self.is_standalone {
            if let Some(overlay) = overlay_element {
                return Stack::new().push(overlay).push(self.build_notifs_view()).into();
            } else {
                eprintln!("[FATAL-EXIT] is_standalone=true but overlay_element=None");
                eprintln!("[FATAL-EXIT] active_overlay = {:?}", self.active_overlay);
                eprintln!("[FATAL-EXIT] is_notif_surface = {}", self.is_notif_surface);
                std::process::exit(0);
            }
        }

        let bar_view = TopBar::view(
            &self.settings,
            &self.theme,
            &self.telemetry,
            self.tray_expanded,
            &self.tray_items,
            self.tray_anim_width,
        )
        .map(Message::TopBar);

        let base_content: Element<'_, Message> = bar_view;

        if let Some(overlay) = overlay_element {
            Stack::new().push(base_content).push(overlay).into()
        } else {
            base_content
        }
    }
}

#![allow(clippy::collapsible_match)]
use super::*;

mod annotator;
mod clipboard;

mod email_sync;

impl MoonBeautyShellApp {
    pub fn update(&mut self, message: Message) -> Command<Message> {
        match message {
            Message::ResizeNotifSurface(id, w, h) => {
                // Intercepted by `try_into`; never reached. Arm kept only
                // to keep the match exhaustive.
                let _ = (id, w, h);
            }
            Message::IdleTick => return self.handle_idle_tick(),

            Message::PollNotifs => return self.handle_poll_notifs(),
            Message::TickClock => return self.handle_tick_clock(),

            Message::TickToasts => return self.handle_tick_toasts(),
            Message::ComposeTabPressed(shift) => {
                if self.email.is_composing {
                    if !self.email.get_autocomplete_matches().is_empty() {
                        self.email.update(EmailMessage::ConfirmAutocomplete);
                        return Command::none();
                    }
                    // Iced 0.14 only has focus_next, so Shift+Tab will just go forward.
                    let _ = shift;
                    return iced::widget::operation::focus_next();
                }
            }
            Message::TickEmailSync => return self.handle_tick_email_sync(),

            Message::EmailSyncedWithDiff(old, new) => {
                return self.handle_email_synced_with_diff(old, new)
            }

            Message::EmailSynced => return self.handle_email_synced(),

            Message::TickWeather => return self.handle_tick_weather(),

            Message::WeatherLoaded(w) => return self.handle_weather_loaded(w),

            Message::TickHardware => return self.handle_tick_hardware(),

            Message::MetricsCollected(cpu, ram, gpu, audio, mic, mpris, net) => {
                return self.handle_metrics_collected(cpu, ram, gpu, audio, mic, mpris, net)
            }

            Message::IpcReceived(cmd) => return self.handle_ipc(cmd),
            Message::TopBar(msg) => return self.handle_top_bar(msg),
            Message::Launcher(msg) => return self.handle_launcher(msg),
            Message::Calc(msg) => return self.handle_calc(msg),
            Message::Clipboard(msg) => return self.handle_clipboard(msg),
            Message::Notes(msg) => return self.handle_notes(msg),
            Message::Pass(msg) => return self.handle_pass(msg),
            Message::Power(msg) => return self.handle_power(msg),
            Message::Todo(msg) => return self.handle_todo(msg),
            Message::Reminders(msg) => return self.handle_reminders(msg),
            Message::Dict(msg) => return self.handle_dict(msg),
            Message::Unicode(msg) => return self.handle_unicode(msg),
            Message::Web(msg) => return self.handle_web(msg),
            Message::Annotator(msg) => return self.handle_annotator(msg),

            Message::Amogus(msg) => return self.handle_amogus(msg),
            Message::Rng(msg) => return self.handle_rng(msg),
            Message::Email(msg) => return self.handle_email(msg),
            Message::Notif(msg) => return self.handle_notif(msg),
            Message::Settings(msg) => return self.handle_settings(msg),
            Message::Lock(msg) => return self.handle_lock(msg),
            Message::TrayWatchdogTick => return self.handle_tray_watchdog(),
            Message::FetchTrayItems => return self.handle_fetch_tray_items(),
            Message::TrayItemsLoaded(items) => return self.handle_tray_items_loaded(items),
            Message::InBarWeatherTip(m) => {
                if let Some(InBarTooltip::Weather(ref mut app)) = self.in_bar_tooltip {
                    let cmd = app.update(m).map(Message::InBarWeatherTip);
                    if app.should_close {
                        self.in_bar_tooltip = None;
                        if let Some(wid) = self.tooltip_window_id.take() {
                            self.closing_tooltip_id = Some(wid);
                            return Command::batch([cmd, Command::done(Message::CloseNotifLayer(wid))]);
                        }
                    }
                    return cmd;
                }
            }
            Message::InBarSysTip(m) => {
                if let Some(InBarTooltip::System(ref mut app)) = self.in_bar_tooltip {
                    let cmd = app.update(m).map(Message::InBarSysTip);
                    if app.should_close {
                        self.in_bar_tooltip = None;
                        if let Some(wid) = self.tooltip_window_id.take() {
                            self.closing_tooltip_id = Some(wid);
                            return Command::batch([cmd, Command::done(Message::CloseNotifLayer(wid))]);
                        }
                    }
                    return cmd;
                }
            }
            Message::InBarInfoTip(m) => {
                if let Some(InBarTooltip::Info(ref mut app)) = self.in_bar_tooltip {
                    let cmd = app.update(m).map(Message::InBarInfoTip);
                    if app.should_close {
                        self.in_bar_tooltip = None;
                        if let Some(wid) = self.tooltip_window_id.take() {
                            self.closing_tooltip_id = Some(wid);
                            return Command::batch([cmd, Command::done(Message::CloseNotifLayer(wid))]);
                        }
                    }
                    return cmd;
                }
            }

            Message::DismissActiveOverlay => return self.handle_dismiss_active_overlay(),

            Message::MusicCycleDone(new_state) => return self.handle_music_cycle_done(new_state),
            Message::Noop => {}
            Message::SetToastInputRegion(_, _)
            | Message::RequestXdgActivation(_)
            | Message::OpenNotifLayer(_, _)
            | Message::CloseNotifLayer(_) => {
                // Intercepted by `try_into` — never reaches update.
            }
            Message::CloseShell => {
                std::process::exit(0);
            }
        }
        Command::none()
    }
}

use super::*;
use crate::app::keys::{handle_annotator_text_input, handle_email_keypress, handle_lock_keypress};

pub(crate) static IPC_RX: std::sync::OnceLock<
    std::sync::Arc<tokio::sync::Mutex<tokio::sync::mpsc::UnboundedReceiver<IpcCommand>>>,
> = std::sync::OnceLock::new();

fn ipc_stream() -> impl futures_util::Stream<Item = Message> {
    let rx = IPC_RX.get().expect("IPC_RX not initialized").clone();
    futures_util::stream::unfold(rx, |rx| async move {
        let mut guard = rx.lock().await;
        let cmd = guard.recv().await;
        drop(guard);
        cmd.map(|c| (Message::IpcReceived(c), rx))
    })
}

impl MoonBeautyShellApp {
    pub fn subscription(&self) -> iced::Subscription<Message> {
        let is_bar = !self.is_standalone && !self.is_notif_surface;
        let toast_sub = if self.is_notif_surface {
            let interval = if self.notifs.active_toasts.is_empty() {
                1000
            } else {
                16
            };
            iced::time::every(std::time::Duration::from_millis(interval))
                .map(|_| Message::TickToasts)
        } else {
            iced::Subscription::none()
        };

        let email_sync_sub = if is_bar
            && moonbeauty::libraries::backend::email::client::config_exists()
        {
            iced::time::every(std::time::Duration::from_secs(60)).map(|_| Message::TickEmailSync)
        } else {
            iced::Subscription::none()
        };

        let email_sub = if matches!(self.active_overlay, Some(OverlayTarget::Email)) {
            iced::event::listen_with(handle_email_keypress)
        } else {
            iced::Subscription::none()
        };

        let weather_sub = if is_bar {
            iced::time::every(std::time::Duration::from_secs(900)).map(|_| Message::TickWeather)
        } else {
            iced::Subscription::none()
        };

        let clip_sub = if matches!(self.active_overlay, Some(OverlayTarget::Clipboard)) {
            iced::event::listen_with(|event, _status, _window| {
                let iced::Event::Keyboard(iced::keyboard::Event::KeyPressed { key, .. }) = event
                else {
                    return None;
                };
                match key {
                    iced::keyboard::Key::Named(iced::keyboard::key::Named::ArrowUp) => {
                        Some(Message::Clipboard(ClipboardMessage::SelectPrev))
                    }
                    iced::keyboard::Key::Named(iced::keyboard::key::Named::ArrowDown) => {
                        Some(Message::Clipboard(ClipboardMessage::SelectNext))
                    }
                    iced::keyboard::Key::Named(iced::keyboard::key::Named::Enter) => {
                        Some(Message::Clipboard(ClipboardMessage::CopySelected))
                    }
                    iced::keyboard::Key::Named(iced::keyboard::key::Named::Delete) => {
                        Some(Message::Clipboard(ClipboardMessage::DeleteSelected))
                    }
                    iced::keyboard::Key::Named(iced::keyboard::key::Named::Backspace) => {
                        Some(Message::Clipboard(ClipboardMessage::DeleteSelected))
                    }
                    _ => None,
                }
            })
        } else {
            iced::Subscription::none()
        };

        let text_typing_sub = if self.annotator.text_editing.is_some() {
            iced::event::listen_with(handle_annotator_text_input)
        } else {
            iced::Subscription::none()
        };

        let todo_sub = if matches!(self.active_overlay, Some(OverlayTarget::Todo)) {
            iced::event::listen_with(|event, status, _window| {
                // No status gate: text_input returns Captured for Delete/arrows
                // even when empty. Handlers check new_task_text.is_empty() instead.
                if let iced::Event::Keyboard(iced::keyboard::Event::KeyPressed {
                    key: ref dbg_key,
                    ..
                }) = event
                {
                    moonbeauty::dbg_log!("[todo-sub] key={:?} status={:?}", dbg_key, status);
                }
                let iced::Event::Keyboard(iced::keyboard::Event::KeyPressed { key, .. }) = event
                else {
                    return None;
                };
                use iced::keyboard::{key::Named, Key};
                match key {
                    Key::Named(Named::ArrowLeft) => Some(Message::Todo(TodoMessage::CategoryPrev)),
                    Key::Named(Named::ArrowRight) => Some(Message::Todo(TodoMessage::CategoryNext)),
                    Key::Named(Named::ArrowUp) => Some(Message::Todo(TodoMessage::TaskSelectPrev)),
                    Key::Named(Named::ArrowDown) => {
                        Some(Message::Todo(TodoMessage::TaskSelectNext))
                    }
                    Key::Named(Named::Delete) => Some(Message::Todo(TodoMessage::DeleteSelected)),
                    // Enter is handled by text_input::on_submit -> AddTask.
                    _ => None,
                }
            })
        } else {
            iced::Subscription::none()
        };

        let reminders_tick_sub = if matches!(self.active_overlay, Some(OverlayTarget::Reminders)) {

                .map(|_| Message::Reminders(ReminderMessage::Tick))
        } else {

        let reminders_sub = if matches!(self.active_overlay, Some(OverlayTarget::Reminders)) {
            iced::event::listen_with(|event, _status, _window| {
                let iced::Event::Keyboard(iced::keyboard::Event::KeyPressed {
                    key, modifiers, ..
                }) = event
                else {

                use iced::keyboard::{key::Named, Key};
                match key {
                    // Tab / Shift+Tab cycle between the two input fields
                    Key::Named(Named::Tab) if modifiers.shift() => {
                        Some(Message::Reminders(ReminderMessage::FocusPrevField))
                    }
                    Key::Named(Named::Tab) => {
                        Some(Message::Reminders(ReminderMessage::FocusNextField))
                    }
                    // ArrowUp/Down scroll the list regardless of input focus
                    Key::Named(Named::ArrowUp) => {
                        Some(Message::Reminders(ReminderMessage::ScrollUp))
                    }
                    Key::Named(Named::ArrowDown) => {

                    }
                    Key::Named(Named::Delete) => {
                        Some(Message::Reminders(ReminderMessage::DeleteSelected))
                    }
                    Key::Named(Named::Home) => {
                        Some(Message::Reminders(ReminderMessage::SelectFirst))

                    Key::Character(c) if modifiers.control() && c.to_lowercase() == "s" => {

        // Pre-fetch tray items every 15s so the first open animates to the right width.

            iced::Subscription::none()
