use super::*;

impl MoonBeautyShellApp {
    pub fn close_tray(&mut self) {
        eprintln!(
            "[close-tray] invoked: expanded={} width={:.1} target_set={} (settings.tray_width)",
            self.tray_expanded, self.tray_anim_width, self.settings.tray_width
        );
        if self.tray_expanded {
            self.tray_expanded = false;
            self.tray_anim_start_width = self.tray_anim_width;
            self.tray_anim_started_at = std::time::Instant::now();
            self.tray_target_width = self.settings.tray_width as f32;
            self.tray_anim_duration_ms = 180;
        }
        // Invalidate any pending timeout timers
        self.tray_timeout_gen = self.tray_timeout_gen.wrapping_add(1);
    }

    pub fn standalone_running(&mut self) -> Option<OverlayTarget> {
        if let Some((t, child)) = self.standalone_child.as_mut() {
            if matches!(child.try_wait(), Ok(None)) {
                return Some(t.clone());
            }
        }
        if self.standalone_child.is_some() {
            if let Some((_, mut child)) = self.standalone_child.take() {
                let _ = child.wait();
            }
        }
        None
    }

    pub fn kill_standalone(&mut self) {
        if let Some((target, mut child)) = self.standalone_child.take() {
            // For lockscreen, SIGKILL bypasses the coordinator's clean exit,
            // leaving orphan --lockscreen-instance children holding dead sockets.
            if matches!(target, OverlayTarget::Lockscreen) {
                let _ = std::process::Command::new("pkill")
                    .args([
                        "-KILL",
                        "-f",
                        "--",
                        "(^|/)(moonbeauty|moon-beauty-shell) --lockscreen-instance( .*)?$",
                    ])
                    .status();
            }
            let _ = child.kill();
            let _ = child.wait();
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn dismiss_tooltip_child(&mut self) -> Command<Message> {
        self.in_bar_tooltip = None;
        if let Some(wid) = self.tooltip_window_id.take() {
            self.closing_tooltip_id = Some(wid);
            return Command::done(Message::CloseNotifLayer(wid));
        }
        Command::none()
    }

    /// Toggle the tooltip for `id` (bar capsule click handler):
    /// toggle-off if already open, compute placement and slant, and open
    /// the in-bar layer surface.
    pub fn toggle_tooltip(&mut self, id: &str) -> Command<Message> {
        let id = id.to_string();
        if let Some(ref mut tip) = self.in_bar_tooltip {
            eprintln!("[tooltip] Already open in-bar; toggling off (animate)");
            return match tip {
                InBarTooltip::Weather(app) => app
                    .update(moonbeauty::bar::weather::tooltip::Message::Dismiss)
                    .map(Message::InBarWeatherTip),
                InBarTooltip::System(app) => app
                    .update(moonbeauty::overlays::system_tooltip::Message::Dismiss)
                    .map(Message::InBarSysTip),
                InBarTooltip::Info(app) => app
                    .update(moonbeauty::overlays::info_tooltip::Message::Dismiss)
                    .map(Message::InBarInfoTip),
            };
        }
        // Recent click => use cursor position for dynamic placement.
        // Fallback to capsule_center_x if no click in last 5s (e.g. IPC trigger).
        let recent_click = self.last_cursor_time.elapsed() < std::time::Duration::from_secs(5);

        let target_output = if self.settings.notif_screen_name != "Auto"
            && self.settings.notif_screen_name != "Auto (Primary)"
            && !self.settings.notif_screen_name.is_empty()
        {
            Some(self.settings.notif_screen_name.as_str())
        } else {
            None
        };
        let sw = get_screen_width_for(target_output);
        let in_left = self.settings.bar_left.contains(&id);
        let in_center = self.settings.bar_center.contains(&id);
        let in_right = self.settings.bar_right.contains(&id);
        // Right-side capsules use capsule_center_x rather than last_cursor_x:
        // right-anchored margin math assumes cx is the capsule center, so a
        // click near the right edge would shift the tooltip off-screen.
        let cx = if id == "clock" {
            capsule_center_x(&self.settings, sw, &id)
        } else if recent_click && self.last_cursor_x > 0.0 && in_left {
            self.last_cursor_x as i32
        } else {
            capsule_center_x(&self.settings, sw, &id)
        };
        let (slant_l, slant_r): (&str, &str) = match self.settings.slant_mode.as_str() {
            "left" => ("L", "L"),
            "right" => ("R", "R"),
            _ => {
                if in_center {
                    let vis: Vec<&String> = self
                        .settings
                        .bar_center
                        .iter()
                        .filter(|x| {
                            self.settings
                                .visible_capsules
                                .get(*x)
                                .copied()
                                .unwrap_or(true)
                        })
                        .collect();
                    let k = vis.len() / 2;
                    match vis.iter().position(|x| **x == id) {
                        Some(i) if i == k => ("L", "R"),
                        Some(i) if i < k => ("L", "L"),
                        Some(_) => ("R", "R"),
                        None => ("L", "R"),
                    }
                } else if in_right {
                    ("R", "R")
                } else {
                    ("L", "L")
                }
            }
        };
        let cap_w = capsule_actual_width(&id);
        let grow_right = if in_left {
            true
        } else if in_right {
            false
        } else {
            cx < (sw as i32) / 2
        };
        let (tip_w, _tip_h) = self.settings.tooltip_size(&id);

        // Per-capsule tooltip bias.
        let (bias_l, bias_r) = moonbeauty::bar::capsules::tooltip_bias(&id, &self.theme);
        let tip_h = moonbeauty::bar::tooltip_spawn::compute_height(
            &id,
            &self.settings,
            &self.telemetry,
        );
        use moonbeauty::libraries::style::shape_box::SlantSide;
        let parse_slant = |s: &str| {
            if s == "R" {
                SlantSide::Right
            } else {
                SlantSide::Left
            }
        };
        let final_w = if id == "ram" {
            tip_w.max(cap_w as u32).max(540)
        } else {
            tip_w.max(cap_w as u32)
        };
        let final_h = if id == "ram" { tip_h.max(480) } else { tip_h };
        let cfg = moonbeauty::overlays::tooltip_common::InBarTooltipConfig {
            id: id.clone(),
            w: final_w,
            h: final_h,
            cx,
            sw,
            cap_w,
            grow_right,
            slant_l: parse_slant(slant_l),
            slant_r: parse_slant(slant_r),
            drop_ms: self.settings.tooltip_drop_ms as f32,
            expand_ms: self.settings.tooltip_expand_ms as f32,
        };
        let (anchor, margin) = moonbeauty::overlays::tooltip_common::layer_anchor_and_margin_for(
            &self.settings,
            final_w,
            id == "clock",
            cx,
            sw as i32,
            cap_w,
            bias_l,
            bias_r,
        );
        let (tip_state, init_cmd) = if id == "weather" {
            let (app, cmd) = moonbeauty::bar::weather::tooltip::App::new_in_bar(&cfg);
            (InBarTooltip::Weather(app), cmd.map(Message::InBarWeatherTip))
        } else if matches!(
            id.as_str(),
            "calendar" | "music" | "unified" | "net" | "custom" | "clock"
        ) {
            let (app, cmd) = moonbeauty::overlays::info_tooltip::App::new_in_bar(&cfg);
            (InBarTooltip::Info(app), cmd.map(Message::InBarInfoTip))
        } else {
            let (app, cmd) = moonbeauty::overlays::system_tooltip::App::new_in_bar(&cfg);
            (InBarTooltip::System(app), cmd.map(Message::InBarSysTip))
        };
        let win_id = iced::window::Id::unique();
        let ns = format!("mbs-inbar-tip-{}", id);
        let layer_settings = iced_layershell::reexport::NewLayerShellSettings {
            size: Some((final_w, final_h)),
            layer: iced_layershell::reexport::Layer::Overlay,
            anchor,
            exclusive_zone: Some(-1),
            margin: Some(margin),
            keyboard_interactivity:
                iced_layershell::reexport::KeyboardInteractivity::Exclusive,
            output_option: iced_layershell::reexport::OutputOption::None,
            events_transparent: false,
            namespace: Some(ns),
        };
        self.in_bar_tooltip = Some(tip_state);
        self.tooltip_window_id = Some(win_id);
        Command::batch([
            Command::done(Message::OpenNotifLayer(win_id, layer_settings)),
            init_cmd,
        ])
    }

    /// Handle a bar capsule action (bar-side click handler dispatch).
    pub fn handle_capsule_action(&mut self, act: CapsuleAction) -> Command<Message> {
        match act {
            CapsuleAction::OpenOverlay(id) => {
                eprintln!("[topbar-action] OpenOverlay: id = {:?}", id);

                // 1. ALARM — standalone reminders overlay.
                // Handled before the tooltip block so an open tooltip can't
                // hijack the click and "alarm" never falls into sys-tooltip.
                if id == "alarm" {
                    let cmd = self.dismiss_tooltip_child();
                    self.toggle_standalone(OverlayTarget::Reminders);
                    return cmd;
                }

                // 2. DROPDOWN TOOLTIPS
                if matches!(
                    id.as_str(),
                    "weather"
                        | "cpu"
                        | "gpu"
                        | "ram"
                        | "calendar"
                        | "music"
                        | "unified"
                        | "net"
                        | "custom"
                        | "clock"
                ) {
                    return self.toggle_tooltip(&id);
                }
                // 3. FULLSCREEN / STANDALONE OVERLAYS (Settings, History, Power)
                let mapped: Option<OverlayTarget> = match id.as_str() {
                    "notify" => Some(OverlayTarget::NotificationsHistory),
                    "battery" => Some(OverlayTarget::Power),
                    _ => OverlayTarget::from_str(&id),
                };
                if let Some(target) = mapped {
                    if matches!(
                        target,
                        OverlayTarget::Launcher
                            | OverlayTarget::Clipboard
                            | OverlayTarget::NotificationsHistory
                            | OverlayTarget::Settings
                    ) {
                        self.spawn_standalone(target);
                    } else {
                        self.active_overlay = Some(target);
                    }
                }
            }
            CapsuleAction::TogglePlayPause => return self.music_toggle_play_pause(),
            CapsuleAction::NextTrack => return self.music_next_track(),
            CapsuleAction::PreviousTrack => return self.music_previous_track(),
            CapsuleAction::CycleAudioSink => {
                return Command::perform(AudioBackend::cycle_sinks(), |_| {
                    Message::TopBar(TopBarMessage::Noop)
                });
            }
            CapsuleAction::ToggleSinkMute => {
                return Command::perform(AudioBackend::toggle_sink_mute(), |_| {
                    Message::TopBar(TopBarMessage::Noop)
                });
            }
            CapsuleAction::ToggleNotificationDnd => return self.toggle_notification_dnd(),
            CapsuleAction::CancelTooltip(id) => {
                eprintln!("[topbar] CancelTooltip: {}", id);
                let cmd = self.dismiss_tooltip_child();
                // Right-click on alarm capsule: wipe active timers
                if id == "alarm" {
                    moonbeauty::overlays::reminders::save_reminders(&[]);
                    eprintln!("[topbar] cleared active timers");
                }
                return cmd;
            }
            CapsuleAction::ToggleSourceMute => {
                return Command::perform(AudioBackend::toggle_source_mute(), |_| {
                    Message::TopBar(TopBarMessage::Noop)
                });
            }
            CapsuleAction::ToggleTrayExpanded => {
                if !self.tray_expanded {
                    // OPENING
                    self.tray_timeout_gen = self.tray_timeout_gen.wrapping_add(1);
                    let _my_gen = self.tray_timeout_gen;

                    self.tray_opened_at = std::time::Instant::now();
                    self.tray_expanded = true;
                    self.tray_anim_start_width = self.tray_anim_width;
                    self.tray_anim_started_at = std::time::Instant::now();
                    let expanded_w = moonbeauty::bar::capsules::compute_expanded_visible_width(
                        &self.settings,
                        self.tray_items.len(),
                    );
                    self.tray_target_width = expanded_w;
                    self.tray_anim_duration_ms = 220;

                    return Command::perform(
                        moonbeauty::bar::tray::watcher::fetch_tray_items(self.tray_items.clone()),
                        Message::TrayItemsLoaded,
                    );
                } else {
                    // CLOSING — bump gen to invalidate any pending timer
                    self.close_tray();
                }
            }
            CapsuleAction::TrayActivate(item) => {
                self.close_tray();
                return Command::perform(
                    async move {
                        let _ = moonbeauty::bar::tray::watcher::activate_tray_item(
                            &item.bus, &item.path,
                        )
                        .await;
                    },
                    |_| Message::TopBar(TopBarMessage::Noop),
                );
            }
            CapsuleAction::TrayContextMenu(item) => {
                let item_clone = item.clone();
                return Command::perform(
                    async move {
                        if let Some((menu_path, items)) =
                            moonbeauty::bar::tray::watcher::get_menu_tree(
                                &item_clone.bus,
                                &item_clone.path,
                            )
                            .await
                        {
                            let json = serde_json::to_string(&items).unwrap();
                            let tmp_path = moonbeauty::libraries::process::mbs_unique_tmp(
                                "mbs-tray-menu",
                                "json",
                            );
                            if let Err(e) = moonbeauty::libraries::process::private_write_new(
                                &tmp_path,
                                json.as_bytes(),
                            ) {
                                eprintln!("[tray-menu] write failed: {e}");
                                return;
                            }
                            let exe = resolve_exe();
                            let h = (items.len() as u32 * 36).clamp(100, 600) + 40;
                            let _ = std::process::Command::new(exe)
                                .args([
                                    "--tray-context-menu",
                                    tmp_path.to_str().unwrap_or(""),
                                    &item_clone.bus,
                                    &menu_path,
                                    "250",
                                    &h.to_string(),
                                ])
                                .spawn();
                        }
                    },
                    |_| Message::TopBar(TopBarMessage::Noop),
                );
            }
            CapsuleAction::CycleGpuTarget => {
                let gpus = &self.detected_gpus;
                if !gpus.is_empty() {
                    let current = &self.settings.gpu_selected_id;
                    let next_idx = gpus
                        .iter()
                        .position(|g| &g.card_id == current)
                        .map(|i| (i + 1) % gpus.len())
                        .unwrap_or(0);
                    self.settings.gpu_selected_id = gpus[next_idx].card_id.clone();
                    let _ = self.settings.save();
                    eprintln!(
                        "[bar] right-click GPU: switched to {}",
                        self.settings.gpu_selected_id
                    );
                    return Command::done(Message::TickHardware);
                }
            }
            _ => {}
        }
        Command::none()
    }

    pub fn spawn_standalone(&mut self, target: OverlayTarget) {
        self.kill_standalone();
        moonbeauty::libraries::process::prune_standalone_logs();
        let exe = resolve_exe();
        let tag = target.as_arg();
        let log_path = moonbeauty::libraries::process::mbs_unique_tmp("mbs-standalone", "log");
        let stderr_file = moonbeauty::libraries::process::private_create_new(&log_path).ok();
        let stdout_file = stderr_file.as_ref().and_then(|f| f.try_clone().ok());

        let mut cmd = std::process::Command::new(exe);
        if matches!(target, OverlayTarget::Lockscreen) {
            // Lockscreen requires the coordinator (--lockscreen), which
            // spawns per-output --lockscreen-instance children connected to
            // its socket. Using --overlay lockscreen would omit the coordinator.
            cmd.arg("--lockscreen");
        } else {
            cmd.arg("--overlay");
            cmd.arg(tag);
        }
        if let Some(sf) = stderr_file {
            cmd.stderr(sf);
        }
        if let Some(of) = stdout_file {
            cmd.stdout(of);
        }

        match cmd.spawn() {
            Ok(c) => {
                eprintln!(
                    "[ipc] spawned {:?} pid={} (log: {})",
                    target,
                    c.id(),
                    log_path.display()
                );
                self.standalone_child = Some((target, c));
            }
            Err(e) => eprintln!("[ipc] spawn {:?} failed: {e}", target),
        }
    }

    pub fn toggle_standalone(&mut self, target: OverlayTarget) {
        match self.standalone_running() {
            Some(ref t) if t == &target => self.kill_standalone(),
            _ => self.spawn_standalone(target),
        }
    }

    pub fn compute_toast_rects(&self) -> Vec<(i32, i32, i32, i32)> {
        let s = &self.settings;
        let is_right = s.notif_corner.contains("right");
        let is_top = s.notif_corner.contains("top");

        let card_w = s.notif_card_width as i32;
        let card_h = s.notif_card_height as i32;
        let margin_x = s.notif_margin_x.max(16);
        let baseline = s.notif_baseline_y;
        let surface_w = (s.notif_card_width as i32 + 2 * s.notif_margin_x + 100).max(200);

        let pad_top = if is_top { baseline } else { 0 };
        let pad_left = if is_right { 0 } else { margin_x };
        let pad_right = if is_right { margin_x } else { 0 };

        let peek = s.notif_stack_overlap.abs().max(4);
        let drop_dist = s.notif_drop_distance_px as i32;
        let fixed_base = drop_dist + 4 * peek;

        let x_surface = if is_right {
            surface_w - pad_right - card_w
        } else {
            pad_left
        };

        let n = self.notifs.active_toasts.len();
        let mut rects = Vec::with_capacity(n);
        for i in 0..n {
            let y_surface = pad_top + fixed_base - (i as i32) * peek;
            rects.push((x_surface, y_surface, card_w, card_h));
        }
        rects
    }
}

/// Run a standalone-overlay copy to completion, then exit the process.
/// On runtime creation failure, logs a diagnostic and exits anyway so
/// the overlay still closes.
pub(crate) fn run_then_exit<F>(future: F) -> !
where
    F: std::future::Future<Output = ()>,
{
    match tokio::runtime::Runtime::new() {
        Ok(rt) => rt.block_on(future),
        Err(e) => eprintln!(
            "[standalone-copy] failed to create tokio runtime: {e} \
             (copy skipped, exiting anyway)"
        ),
    }
    std::process::exit(0)
}

pub(crate) fn spawn_notif_surface_child() -> Option<std::process::Child> {
    let exe = resolve_exe();
    let mut cmd = std::process::Command::new(exe);
    cmd.arg("--notif-surface");
    #[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
    {
        use std::os::unix::process::CommandExt;
        #[allow(unsafe_code)]
        unsafe {
            cmd.pre_exec(|| {
                libc::prctl(libc::PR_SET_PDEATHSIG, libc::SIGKILL);
                Ok(())
            });
        }
    }
    match cmd.spawn() {
        Ok(c) => {
            eprintln!("[bar] spawned --notif-surface pid={}", c.id());
            Some(c)
        }
        Err(e) => {
            eprintln!("[bar] failed to spawn --notif-surface: {e}");
            None
        }
    }
}

impl MoonBeautyShellApp {
    pub(crate) fn restart_notif_surface(&mut self) {
        if let Some(mut c) = self.notif_surface_child.take() {
            let _ = c.kill();
            let _ = c.wait();
        }
        let _ = std::process::Command::new("pkill")
            .args([
                "-9",
                "-f",
                "--",
                "(^|/)(moonbeauty|moon-beauty-shell) --notif-surface$",
            ])
            .status();
        std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(50));
        self.notif_surface_child = spawn_notif_surface_child();
    }
}

//! Music backend: native local player, MPRIS D-Bus client, and the
//! player-cycling state machine that picks between them.

pub mod cycle;
pub mod local;
pub mod mpris;

pub use cycle::{press, MusicCycleState, MusicSources, PlayerKind, PressOutcome};
pub use local::LocalMusicBackend;
pub use mpris::{MprisBackend, MprisTrack};

/// Which backend is currently serving the music capsule's data.
/// Local player is preferred over MPRIS when both report Playing —
/// local playback is dedicated, MPRIS usually means a browser tab.
#[derive(Copy, Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum TrackSource {
    Local,
    Mpris,
    None,
}

/// Poll both the local player and MPRIS, pick a winner.
///
/// Priority:
///   1. Local playing         -> Local
///   2. MPRIS playing         -> Mpris
///   3. Local loaded          -> Local
///   4. MPRIS exists          -> Mpris
///   5. Local idle fallback   -> Local
///   6. Neither               -> None
pub async fn poll_track() -> (Option<MprisTrack>, TrackSource) {
    let local = LocalMusicBackend::poll().await;
    let mpris = MprisBackend::poll().await;
    match (local, mpris) {
        (Some(m), _) if m.is_playing => (Some(m), TrackSource::Local),
        (_, Some(m)) if m.is_playing => (Some(m), TrackSource::Mpris),
        (Some(m), _) if m.url.is_some() => (Some(m), TrackSource::Local),
        (_, Some(m)) => (Some(m), TrackSource::Mpris),
        (Some(m), _) => (Some(m), TrackSource::Local),
        (None, None) => (None, TrackSource::None),
    }
}

//! Music CLI flags: --music-cycle, --music-next, --music-previous,
//! --music-play-pause. All fire IpcCommand::Music* over the local socket.

use crate::libraries::ipc::IpcCommand;

use crate::libraries::ipc::send_ipc_sync;

pub fn run(args: &[String]) {
    if args.iter().any(|a| a == "--audio-daemon") {
        crate::libraries::backend::music::local::run_audio_daemon();
    }

    // Music CLI flags — fired from the tooltip's Cycle/Prev/Play/Next
    // buttons and bindable to sway keybinds.
    for (flag, cmd) in [
        ("--music-cycle", IpcCommand::MusicCycle),
        ("--music-next", IpcCommand::MusicNext),
        ("--music-previous", IpcCommand::MusicPrevious),
        ("--music-play-pause", IpcCommand::MusicPlayPause),
    ] {
        if args.iter().any(|a| a == flag) {
            match send_ipc_sync(&cmd) {
                Ok(_) => std::process::exit(0),
                Err(e) => {
                    eprintln!("[{flag}] IPC failed: {e}");
                    std::process::exit(1);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

//! Music cycle — press the tooltip's Cycle button (or `--music-cycle`)
//! to cycle through available players: play, pause, next, play, pause,
//! next, ... Only one plays at a time.
//!
//! Available = probe result. Only players with a loaded track count.
//! MPD with empty queue won't appear (nothing to play). Firefox with
//! no video loaded → no Metadata → no appearance. Users close a player
//! and the cycle redistributes automatically on the next press.
//!
//! State: `next_idx` (which to play next) + `last_playing` (which we
//! most recently started). Both updated atomically per press.

use super::local::LocalMusicBackend;
use super::mpris::MprisBackend;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct MusicSources {
    pub local: bool,
    pub spotify: bool,
    pub browser: bool,
}

impl Default for MusicSources {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            local: true,
            spotify: true,
            browser: true,
        }
    }
}

impl MusicSources {
    fn path() -> std::path::PathBuf {
        crate::libraries::process::mbs_runtime_dir().join("mbs-music-sources.json")
    }

    pub fn load() -> Self {
        crate::libraries::process::read_json_capped(&Self::path(), 1024).unwrap_or_default()
    }

    pub fn save(&self) {
        if let Ok(json) = serde_json::to_string(self) {
            let _ = crate::libraries::process::private_write_file(&Self::path(), json.as_bytes());
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum PlayerKind {
    Local,
    Mpris(String),
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum PressOutcome {
    Played,
    Paused,
}

#[derive(Debug, Default, Clone)]
pub struct MusicCycleState {
    pub(crate) next_idx: usize,
    pub(crate) last_playing: Option<PlayerKind>,
}

/// Pure state-machine step. Separated from the async `press` so
/// tests can exercise every branch without spawning D-Bus connections.
#[derive(Debug)]
pub enum Decision {
    Pause(PlayerKind, usize),
    Play(PlayerKind, usize),
    Nothing,
}

pub fn decide_step(
    available: &[PlayerKind],
    playing_set: &[PlayerKind],
    last_playing: Option<&PlayerKind>,
    next_idx: usize,
) -> Decision {
    if available.is_empty() {
        return Decision::Nothing;
    }
    let n = available.len();

    // Which to pause? Prefer last-playing (honor intent). Otherwise
    // the first in the playing set (probe order = MPD first, then
    // MPRIS registration order, which is also priority order).
    let to_pause = last_playing
        .filter(|p| playing_set.contains(p))
        .cloned()
        .or_else(|| playing_set.first().cloned());

    if let Some(p) = to_pause {
        let pause_idx = available.iter().position(|a| a == &p).unwrap_or(0);
        let new_next = (pause_idx + 1) % n;
        return Decision::Pause(p, new_next);
    }

    let target = &available[next_idx % n];
    Decision::Play(target.clone(), (next_idx + 1) % n)
}

pub async fn probe_all() -> Vec<(PlayerKind, bool)> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    let sources = MusicSources::load();

    if sources.local {
        if let Some(track) = LocalMusicBackend::poll().await {
            if track.url.is_some() || track.is_playing {
                out.push((PlayerKind::Local, track.is_playing));
            }
        }
    }

    for bus in MprisBackend::list_players().await {
        let b = bus.to_lowercase();
        let is_spotify = b.contains("spotify");
        let is_browser = b.contains("firefox")
            || b.contains("chrome")
            || b.contains("chromium")
            || b.contains("brave")
            || b.contains("vivaldi");

        if is_spotify && !sources.spotify {
            continue;
        }
        if is_browser && !sources.browser {
            continue;
        }

        if let Some(track) = MprisBackend::poll_for(&bus).await {
            out.push((PlayerKind::Mpris(bus), track.is_playing));
        }
    }

    out
}

async fn dispatch_play(kind: &PlayerKind, play: bool) {
    match kind {
        PlayerKind::Local => {
            if play {
                LocalMusicBackend::play().await
            } else {
                LocalMusicBackend::pause().await
            }
        }
        PlayerKind::Mpris(bus) => MprisBackend::set_playing_for(bus, play).await,
    }
}

/// Perform one cycle press. Updates `state` in place. Returns what
/// was acted on (for logging / UI feedback), or None if no players
/// are available.
pub async fn press(state: &mut MusicCycleState) -> Option<(PlayerKind, PressOutcome)> {
    LocalMusicBackend::clear_cache();
    let probed = probe_all().await;
    let available: Vec<PlayerKind> = probed.iter().map(|(k, _)| k.clone()).collect();
    let playing: Vec<PlayerKind> = probed
        .iter()
        .filter(|(_, p)| *p)
        .map(|(k, _)| k.clone())
        .collect();

    let decision = decide_step(
        &available,
        &playing,
        state.last_playing.as_ref(),
        state.next_idx,
    );

    match decision {
        Decision::Nothing => {
            crate::dbg_log!("[music-cycle] no players available");
            None
        }
        Decision::Pause(target, new_next) => {
            crate::dbg_log!("[music-cycle] pausing {:?}", target);
            dispatch_play(&target, false).await;
            LocalMusicBackend::clear_cache();
            state.last_playing = None;
            state.next_idx = new_next;
            Some((target, PressOutcome::Paused))
        }
        Decision::Play(target, new_next) => {
            crate::dbg_log!("[music-cycle] playing {:?}", target);
            dispatch_play(&target, true).await;
            LocalMusicBackend::clear_cache();
            state.last_playing = Some(target.clone());
            state.next_idx = new_next;
            Some((target, PressOutcome::Played))
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod decide_tests {
    use super::{decide_step, Decision, PlayerKind};

    fn browser() -> PlayerKind {
        PlayerKind::Mpris("org.mpris.MediaPlayer2.firefox.instance_1".into())
    }
    fn mpd() -> PlayerKind {
        PlayerKind::Local
    }

    #[test]
    fn empty_available_returns_nothing() {
        assert!(matches!(decide_step(&[], &[], None, 0), Decision::Nothing));
    }

    #[test]
    fn nothing_playing_plays_next() {
        let avail = vec![browser(), mpd()];
        match decide_step(&avail, &[], None, 0) {
            Decision::Play(t, next) => {
                assert_eq!(t, browser());
                assert_eq!(next, 1);
            }
            _ => panic!("expected Play browser"),
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn playing_pauses_last_targeted_first() {
        let avail = vec![browser(), mpd()];
        let playing = vec![browser(), mpd()]; // both playing (external)
        match decide_step(&avail, &playing, Some(&mpd()), 0) {
            Decision::Pause(t, next) => {
                // last = MPD wins over priority order
                assert_eq!(t, mpd());
                assert_eq!(next, 0); // MPD at idx 1, next = 0
            }
            _ => panic!("expected Pause mpd"),
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn playing_without_last_falls_to_priority() {
        let avail = vec![browser(), mpd()];
        let playing = vec![browser()];
        match decide_step(&avail, &playing, None, 0) {
            Decision::Pause(t, next) => {
                assert_eq!(t, browser());
                assert_eq!(next, 1);
            }
            _ => panic!("expected Pause browser"),
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn full_cycle_four_presses() {
        let avail = vec![browser(), mpd()];
        let mut next = 0;
        let mut last: Option<PlayerKind> = None;
        let mut playing: Vec<PlayerKind> = vec![];

        // Press 1: play browser
        match decide_step(&avail, &playing, last.as_ref(), next) {
            Decision::Play(t, n) => {
                assert_eq!(t, browser());
                playing.push(t.clone());
                last = Some(t);
                next = n;
            }
            _ => panic!("press 1 should play browser"),
        }
        // Press 2: pause browser
        match decide_step(&avail, &playing, last.as_ref(), next) {
            Decision::Pause(t, n) => {
                assert_eq!(t, browser());
                playing.clear();
                last = None;
                next = n;
            }
            _ => panic!("press 2 should pause browser"),
        }
        // Press 3: play mpd
        match decide_step(&avail, &playing, last.as_ref(), next) {
            Decision::Play(t, n) => {
                assert_eq!(t, mpd());
                playing.push(t.clone());
                last = Some(t);
                next = n;
            }
            _ => panic!("press 3 should play mpd"),
        }
        // Press 4: pause mpd
        match decide_step(&avail, &playing, last.as_ref(), next) {
            Decision::Pause(t, _) => {
                assert_eq!(t, mpd());
                playing.clear();
            }
            _ => panic!("press 4 should pause mpd"),
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn external_interrupt_respects_reality() {
        // We last played browser, but user externally started MPD.
        // Playing = [MPD], last = browser. Should pause MPD, not
        // continue the abandoned plan.
        let avail = vec![browser(), mpd()];
        let playing = vec![mpd()];
        let last = Some(browser());
        match decide_step(&avail, &playing, last.as_ref(), 1) {
            Decision::Pause(t, next) => {
                // last (browser) not in playing set → use playing[0]
                assert_eq!(t, mpd());
                assert_eq!(next, 0);
            }
            _ => panic!("external MPD should be paused"),
        }
    }
}

//! MPRIS media player client — pure zbus, no libdbus, no playerctl.
//!
//! Enumerates `org.mpris.MediaPlayer2.*` bus names, prefers whichever is
//! currently Playing, and reads/writes the standard Player interface.

#![allow(clippy::type_complexity)]
use std::collections::HashMap;
use tokio::process::Command;
use zbus::zvariant::OwnedValue;
use zbus::Connection;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]
pub struct MprisTrack {
    pub title: String,
    pub artist: String,
    pub album: String,
    pub is_playing: bool,
    pub position_sec: f64,
    pub length_sec: f64,
    pub volume_pct: u8,
    pub url: Option<String>,
}

pub struct MprisBackend;

use std::sync::{Mutex, OnceLock};
use std::time::Instant;
static CACHE: OnceLock<Mutex<Option<(Instant, Option<MprisTrack>)>>> = OnceLock::new();

const MPRIS_IFACE: &str = "org.mpris.MediaPlayer2.Player";
const MPRIS_PATH: &str = "/org/mpris/MediaPlayer2";

/// Cap MPRIS-provided strings before concatenation or display to bound
/// derived allocations.
fn truncate_chars(s: &str, max: usize) -> String {
    if s.chars().count() <= max {
        s.to_string()
    } else {
        s.chars().take(max).collect()
    }
}

/// Parse a `file://` MPRIS track URL into a safe absolute media path,
/// rejecting relative paths, traversal, and non-media extensions.
fn safe_mpris_file_path(url: &str) -> Option<std::path::PathBuf> {
    let clean = url.strip_prefix("file://")?;
    if !clean.starts_with('/') || clean.contains("..") {
        crate::dbg_log!("[mpris] rejected unsafe track url: {:?}", clean);
        return None;
    }
    let path = std::path::PathBuf::from(clean);
    const MEDIA_EXTS: &[&str] = &[
        "mp3", "flac", "ogg", "opus", "m4a", "wav", "aac", "m4v", "mkv", "webm", "mp4", "wma",
    ];
    let ext_ok = path
        .extension()
        .and_then(|s| s.to_str())
        .is_some_and(|ext| MEDIA_EXTS.iter().any(|m| ext.eq_ignore_ascii_case(m)));
    if !ext_ok {
        crate::dbg_log!("[mpris] rejected non-media track url: {:?}", clean);
        return None;
    }
    Some(path)
}

impl MprisBackend {
    async fn get_active_player() -> Option<(Connection, String)> {
        let conn = Connection::session().await.ok()?;

        let reply = conn
            .call_method(
                Some("org.freedesktop.DBus"),
                "/org/freedesktop/DBus",
                Some("org.freedesktop.DBus"),
                "ListNames",
                &(),
            )
            .await
            .ok()?;

        let names: Vec<String> = reply.body().deserialize().ok()?;
        // Cap enumeration at 20 to bound D-Bus probe calls.
        let mpris_names: Vec<String> = names
            .into_iter()
            .filter(|n| n.starts_with("org.mpris.MediaPlayer2."))
            .filter(|n| !n.ends_with(".playerctld"))
            .take(20)
            .collect();

        if mpris_names.is_empty() {
            return None;
        }

        // Prefer a player that's currently Playing, with a per-player timeout
        // so a hung proxy doesn't block enumeration.
        for name in &mpris_names {
            if let Ok(proxy) = zbus::Proxy::new(&conn, name.as_str(), MPRIS_PATH, MPRIS_IFACE).await
            {
                if let Ok(Ok(status)) = tokio::time::timeout(
                    std::time::Duration::from_secs(2),
                    proxy.get_property::<String>("PlaybackStatus"),
                )
                .await
                {
                    if status == "Playing" {
                        return Some((conn, name.clone()));
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        Some((conn, mpris_names[0].clone()))
    }

    pub fn clear_cache() {
        let c = CACHE.get_or_init(|| Mutex::new(None));
        let mut g = c.lock().unwrap();
        *g = None;
    }

    pub async fn poll() -> Option<MprisTrack> {
        let c = CACHE.get_or_init(|| Mutex::new(None));
        {
            let g = c.lock().unwrap();
            if let Some((t, tr)) = &*g {
                // Cache None results for 30s to avoid repeated 10s hangs
                // across hardware ticks when a player is unresponsive.
                let cache_ttl = if tr.is_some() { 5 } else { 30 };
                if t.elapsed().as_secs() < cache_ttl {
                    return tr.clone();
                }
            }
        }
        // Outer 10s timeout caps worst-case poll_uncached duration.
        let result =
            match tokio::time::timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(10), Self::poll_uncached())
                .await
            {
                Ok(r) => r,
                Err(_) => {
                    eprintln!("[mpris] poll timed out at 10s (finding 32)");
                    None
                }
            };
        {
            let mut g = c.lock().unwrap();
            *g = Some((Instant::now(), result.clone()));
        }
        result
    }

    async fn read_track_from_bus(conn: &Connection, bus: &str) -> Option<MprisTrack> {
        let proxy = zbus::Proxy::new(conn, bus, MPRIS_PATH, MPRIS_IFACE)
            .await
            .ok()?;
        let t = std::time::Duration::from_secs(2);
        let metadata: HashMap<String, OwnedValue> =
            tokio::time::timeout(t, proxy.get_property("Metadata"))
                .await
                .ok()?
                .ok()?;

        let get_str = |key: &str, max: usize| -> Option<String> {
            metadata.get(key).and_then(|v| match &**v {
                zbus::zvariant::Value::Str(s) => Some(truncate_chars(s.as_str(), max)),
                _ => None,
            })
        };

        let title = get_str("xesam:title", 512).unwrap_or_default();
        let album = get_str("xesam:album", 512).unwrap_or_default();
        let url = get_str("xesam:url", 4096);

        let artist = metadata
            .get("xesam:artist")
            .and_then(|v| match &**v {
                zbus::zvariant::Value::Str(s) => Some(truncate_chars(s.as_str(), 512)),
                zbus::zvariant::Value::Array(arr) => {
                    let parts: Vec<String> = arr
                        .iter()
                        .take(8)
                        .filter_map(|item| {
                            if let zbus::zvariant::Value::Str(s) = item {
                                Some(truncate_chars(s.as_str(), 256))
                            } else {
                                None
                            }
                        })
                        .collect();
                    if parts.is_empty() { None } else { Some(parts.join(", ")) }
                }
                _ => None,
            })
            .unwrap_or_default();

        if title.is_empty() && artist.is_empty() {
            return None;
        }

        let length_sec = metadata
            .get("mpris:length")
            .and_then(|v| match &**v {
                zbus::zvariant::Value::I64(n) => Some(*n as f64 / 1_000_000.0),
                zbus::zvariant::Value::U64(n) => Some(*n as f64 / 1_000_000.0),
                _ => None,
            })
            .unwrap_or(0.0);

        let is_playing = tokio::time::timeout(t, proxy.get_property::<String>("PlaybackStatus"))
            .await.ok().and_then(|r| r.ok()).map(|s| s == "Playing").unwrap_or(false);

        let position_sec = tokio::time::timeout(t, proxy.get_property::<i64>("Position"))
            .await.ok().and_then(|r| r.ok()).map(|p| p as f64 / 1_000_000.0).unwrap_or(0.0);

        let volume_pct = tokio::time::timeout(t, proxy.get_property::<f64>("Volume"))
            .await.ok().and_then(|r| r.ok()).map(|v| (v * 100.0).clamp(0.0, 100.0) as u8).unwrap_or(100);

        Some(MprisTrack {
            title, artist, album, is_playing, position_sec, length_sec, volume_pct, url,
        })
    }

    async fn poll_uncached() -> Option<MprisTrack> {
        let (conn, bus_name) = Self::get_active_player().await?;
        Self::read_track_from_bus(&conn, bus_name.as_str()).await
    }

    async fn call_method(method: &str) {
        let Some((conn, bus_name)) = Self::get_active_player().await else {
            return;
        };
        let Ok(proxy) = zbus::Proxy::new(&conn, bus_name.as_str(), MPRIS_PATH, MPRIS_IFACE).await
        else {
            return;
        };
        let _ = proxy.call_method(method, &()).await;
    }

    pub async fn toggle_play_pause() {
        Self::call_method("PlayPause").await;
    }

    pub async fn next() {
        Self::call_method("Next").await;
    }

    /// List all currently registered MPRIS bus names, capped at 20.
    /// Used by the music cycle to enumerate available players.
    pub async fn list_players() -> Vec<String> {
        let Ok(conn) = Connection::session().await else {
            return Vec::new();
        };
        let Ok(reply) = conn
            .call_method(
                Some("org.freedesktop.DBus"),
                "/org/freedesktop/DBus",
                Some("org.freedesktop.DBus"),
                "ListNames",
                &(),
            )
            .await
        else {
            return Vec::new();
        };
        let Ok(names) = reply.body().deserialize::<Vec<String>>() else {
            return Vec::new();
        };
        names
            .into_iter()
            .filter(|n| n.starts_with("org.mpris.MediaPlayer2."))
            .filter(|n| !n.ends_with(".playerctld"))
            .take(20)
            .collect()
    }

    /// Poll a specific player by bus name. Used by the music cycle;
    /// the normal `poll()` auto-selects.
    pub async fn poll_for(bus: &str) -> Option<MprisTrack> {
        let conn = Connection::session().await.ok()?;
        Self::read_track_from_bus(&conn, bus).await
    }

    /// Play or pause a specific player by bus name, falling back to PlayPause.
    pub async fn set_playing_for(bus: &str, play: bool) {
        let Ok(conn) = Connection::session().await else {
            crate::dbg_log!("[mpris] set_playing_for({}): no session conn", bus);
            return;
        };
        let Ok(proxy) = zbus::Proxy::new(&conn, bus, MPRIS_PATH, MPRIS_IFACE).await else {
            crate::dbg_log!("[mpris] set_playing_for({}): proxy failed", bus);
            return;
        };
        let method = if play { "Play" } else { "Pause" };
        match proxy.call_method(method, &()).await {
            Ok(_) => crate::dbg_log!("[mpris] set_playing_for({}): {} (idempotent)", bus, method),
            Err(_) => {
                let _ = proxy.call_method("PlayPause", &()).await;
                crate::dbg_log!("[mpris] set_playing_for({}): PlayPause fallback", bus);
            }
        }
    }

    pub async fn previous() {
        Self::call_method("Previous").await;
    }

    pub async fn set_position(sec: f64) {
        let Some((conn, bus_name)) = Self::get_active_player().await else {
            return;
        };
        let Ok(proxy) = zbus::Proxy::new(&conn, bus_name.as_str(), MPRIS_PATH, MPRIS_IFACE).await
        else {
            return;
        };
        // Most players ignore the TrackId argument for SetPosition and just
        // seek within the current track. NoTrack is the safe sentinel.
        let Ok(track_id) =
            zbus::zvariant::ObjectPath::try_from("/org/mpris/MediaPlayer2/TrackList/NoTrack")
        else {
            return;
        };
        let pos_us = (sec * 1_000_000.0) as i64;
        let _ = proxy.call_method("SetPosition", &(track_id, pos_us)).await;
    }

    pub async fn set_volume(vol_pct: u8) {
        let Some((conn, bus_name)) = Self::get_active_player().await else {
            return;
        };
        let Ok(proxy) = zbus::Proxy::new(&conn, bus_name.as_str(), MPRIS_PATH, MPRIS_IFACE).await
        else {
            return;
        };
        let _ = proxy.set_property("Volume", (vol_pct as f64) / 100.0).await;
    }

    pub async fn open_track_folder(url_opt: Option<&str>) {
        crate::dbg_log!("[open-folder] RECEIVED URL: {:?}", url_opt);
        
        if let Some(url) = url_opt {
            let mut clean_url = url;
            if clean_url.starts_with("file://") {
                clean_url = &clean_url[7..];
            }
            let decoded = clean_url.replace("%20", " ").replace("%5B", "[").replace("%5D", "]").replace("%28", "(").replace("%29", ")").replace("%26", "&");
            let mut path = std::path::PathBuf::from(decoded);
            
            if !path.is_absolute() {
                let base = crate::libraries::backend::music::local::get_music_dir();
                path = base.join(path);
            }
            
            crate::dbg_log!("[open-folder] CONSTRUCTED PATH: {:?}", path);
            
            // If the exact file exists, open its parent folder
            if path.exists() && path.is_file() {
                if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
                    crate::dbg_log!("[open-folder] SUCCESS (file exists), opening parent: {:?}", parent);
                    let _ = Command::new("xdg-open").arg(parent).spawn();
                    return;
                }
            }
            
            // If the file is missing, but the directory of the file exists, open that
            if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
                if parent.exists() && parent.is_dir() {
                    crate::dbg_log!("[open-folder] PARTIAL SUCCESS (parent dir exists), opening: {:?}", parent);
                    let _ = Command::new("xdg-open").arg(parent).spawn();
                    return;
                }
            }

            // If not found, just try opening the music root as a last resort
            let base = crate::libraries::backend::music::local::get_music_dir();
            crate::dbg_log!("[open-folder] FAILED to find exact path, falling back to root: {:?}", base);
            let _ = Command::new("xdg-open").arg(base).spawn();
            return;
        }
        
        let base = crate::libraries::backend::music::local::get_music_dir();
        crate::dbg_log!("[open-folder] NO URL PROVIDED, opening root: {:?}", base);
        let _ = Command::new("xdg-open").arg(base).spawn();
    }

    pub async fn trash_current_track(url_opt: Option<&str>) -> bool {
        // Only trash validated absolute media paths so untrusted xesam:url
        // values cannot destroy arbitrary user files.
        if let Some(path) = url_opt.and_then(safe_mpris_file_path) {
            let status = Command::new("gio")
                .args(["trash"])
                .arg(&path)
                .status()
                .await;
            if status.map(|s| s.success()).unwrap_or(false) {
                Self::next().await;
                return true;
            }
        }
        false
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod safe_mpris_tests {
    use super::{safe_mpris_file_path, truncate_chars};
    use std::path::PathBuf;

    #[test]
    fn truncate_short_unchanged() {
        assert_eq!(truncate_chars("", 10), "");
        assert_eq!(truncate_chars("abc", 10), "abc");
        assert_eq!(truncate_chars("abcdefghij", 10), "abcdefghij");
    }

    #[test]
    fn truncate_long_ascii() {
        assert_eq!(truncate_chars("abcdefghij", 5), "abcde");
        assert_eq!(truncate_chars("a".repeat(10000).as_str(), 100).len(), 100);
    }

    #[test]
    fn truncate_unicode_respects_char_boundary() {
        // 5 chars (each 3 bytes UTF-8), cap to 3 chars = 9 bytes
        assert_eq!(truncate_chars("日本語です", 3), "日本語");
        // Never splits a multi-byte char in half
        let out = truncate_chars("日本語です", 4);
        assert_eq!(out.chars().count(), 4);
        assert_eq!(out, "日本語で");
    }

    #[test]
    fn file_path_absolute_accepted() {
        let p = safe_mpris_file_path("file:///home/user/Music/track.mp3");
        assert_eq!(p, Some(PathBuf::from("/home/user/Music/track.mp3")));
    }

    #[test]
    fn file_path_relative_rejected() {
        assert!(safe_mpris_file_path("file://etc/passwd").is_none());
        assert!(safe_mpris_file_path("file://home/user/track.mp3").is_none());
    }

    #[test]
    fn file_path_traversal_rejected() {
        assert!(safe_mpris_file_path("file:///home/user/../../../etc/passwd").is_none());
        assert!(safe_mpris_file_path("file:///home/user/..").is_none());
    }

    #[test]
    fn file_path_non_file_scheme_rejected() {
        assert!(safe_mpris_file_path("http://example.com/track.mp3").is_none());
        assert!(safe_mpris_file_path("https://example.com/track.mp3").is_none());
        assert!(safe_mpris_file_path("spotify:track:abc123").is_none());
        assert!(safe_mpris_file_path("").is_none());
    }

    #[test]
    fn non_media_extension_rejected() {
        // Non-media extensions must be rejected so xesam:url cannot target sensitive files.
        assert!(safe_mpris_file_path("file:///home/u/.ssh/id_rsa").is_none());
        assert!(safe_mpris_file_path("file:///home/u/Documents/thesis.pdf").is_none());
        assert!(safe_mpris_file_path("file:///tmp/notes.txt").is_none());
        assert!(safe_mpris_file_path("file:///home/u/no_extension").is_none());
    }

    #[test]
    fn media_extensions_accepted() {
        for ext in &["mp3", "flac", "ogg", "opus", "m4a", "wav", "aac", "m4v", "mkv", "webm"] {
            let url = format!("file:///home/u/Music/track.{}", ext);
            assert!(safe_mpris_file_path(&url).is_some(), "{} rejected", ext);
        }
        assert!(safe_mpris_file_path("file:///home/u/Music/TRACK.MP3").is_some());
    }
}
